/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
Funkcje do operacji na flagach (globalnych i dla danej mapy)

IsFlag/IsMapFlag - sprawdza czy flaga istnieje
Flag/MapFlag - sprawdza czy flaga istnieje i zwraca jej wartoæ
NoFlag/NoMapFlag - sprawdza czy flaga nie istnieje
SetFlag/SetMapFlag - ustawia (w³¹cza, tworzy) flagê.. jeli podano drugi parametr to wartoæ flagi jest na niego ustawiana
ClearFlag/ClearMapFlag - czyci (wy³¹cza, kasuje) flagê
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

function IsFlag(flag)
	return gameStates.flags[flag]
end

function Flag(flag)
	return gameStates.flags[flag]
end

function NoFlag(flag)
	return not gameStates.flags[flag]
end

function SetFlag(flag, value)
	gameStates.flags[flag] = value or 1
end

function ClearFlag(flag)
	gameStates.flags[flag] = nil
end


function IsMapFlag(flag)
	if strbyte(flag) == 43 then -- jeli '+' na pocz¹tku stringa
		return levelFlags[flag]
	else
		return levelGameStates.flags[flag]
	end
end

function MapFlag(flag)
	if strbyte(flag) == 43 then -- jeli '+' na pocz¹tku stringa
		return levelFlags[flag]
	else

end

function NoMapFlag(flag)
	if strbyte(flag) == 43 then -- jeli '+' na pocz¹tku stringa
		return not levelFlags[flag]
	else
		return not levelGameStates.flags[flag]

end

function SetMapFlag(flag, value)

end

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

function CutsceneOn(zoomChange)
	while not guiDesktop.active do
		gui:StopProcess()
	end
	ResurrectAll()
    Cutscene(1)
	DesktopOff()
	WideScreenOn()
	AiOff()
	ActiveScreenOff()
    guiScroll.zoomChange = zoomChange
end

function CutsceneOff()
	guiDesktop:MouseReset()
	DesktopOn()
	WideScreenOff()
	AiOn()
	ActiveScreenOn()
	guiScroll.traceActor = nil
    Cutscene(nil)
end

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
Chat()

Startowanie rozmowy dla dowolnej iloci osób.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

function Chat(dialogName, ...)
	local dialogData = {}
	dialogData.dialog = dialogName

	local actors = getn(arg)
	if actors >= 2 then
		dialogData.actors = {}
		local a = 1
		while a <= actors - 1 do
			dialogData.actors[arg[a]] = Actor(arg[a+1])
			a = a + 2
		end
		if a <= actors and arg[a] == 1 then
			dialogData.noSetup = 1
		end
	end

	gui:StartProcess(guiChat, gui.topProcess, dialogData)
end

	if result then

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------

Uruchamianie sklepu
[player] to obiekt gracza
[dealer] to obiekt sprzedawcy
[mode] to tryb handlu, mo¿liwe wartoci: "buy" (kupowanie), "sell" (sprzedawanie)
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

function Shop(player, dealer, mode)
    while guiInventory.active do
    	gui:StopProcess()
    end
	local actor1 = Actor(player)
	local actor2 = Actor(dealer)
    local tradeMode
    if mode == "buy" then
    	tradeMode = 1
    else
    	tradeMode = 2
    end
	gui:StartKeyProcess(guiInventory, gui.topProcess, {owner = actor1, dealer = actor2, tradeType = tradeMode})
end

function FadeIn(czas)
	local frames = floor(czas*30)
    for i=frames,1,-1 do
        gui.fadeScreen = i/frames
        NextTask()
    end
	gui.fadeScreen = 0
end

		NextTask()
	end
	gui.fadeScreen = 1

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Aktor idzie w przypadkowy punkt
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function MoveActorToRandomPoint(actorName, ...)
	local actor = Actor(actorName)
	assert(actor, "MoveActorToRandomPoint: No defined actor.")
	local counter = 0
	for i,v in arg do
        if i ~= "n" then
            counter = counter + 1
        end
	end
	if counter > 0 then
		if State(actor) != "WALKING" then
			local rnd = 0
			if counter > 0 then
				rnd = random(counter * 30)			-- uwzglednia tez to, ze aktor stoi <counter..counter*30)
			end
			counter = 0
			for i, v in arg do
				if i ~= "n" then
					counter = counter + 1
					if rnd == counter then
						QGoToPoint(actor, v)
						break
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end


/*----------------------------------------------------------------------------- TODO !
 Aktor mowi przypadkowy dialog
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function ActorRandomText(actorName, dlg, chance)
	local actor = Actor(actorName)
	assert(actor, "ActorRandomText: no actor")
	if not Speaking(actor) then
		local rnd = random(3000)
		if chance and (chance < rnd) then
			return
		end
		if not guiChat.active then
			//local dialog = _dialogs[dlg]
			local dialog = FindDialog(dlg)
			assert(dialog, "ActorRandomText: Dialog not found")
			local counter = 0
			for i,v in dialog[1].random do
				if i ~= "n" then
					counter = counter + 1
				end
			end
			if counter > 0 then
				rnd = random(counter)
			end
			counter = 0
			for i, v in dialog[1].random do
				if i ~= "n" then
					counter = counter + 1
					if rnd == counter then
						Speak(actor, v.text, time and time or 1)
						break
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
LocationAvailable(name, !available)

 je¿eli podamy available funkcja ustawia lokacjê jako dostepn¹ lub niedostêpn¹ dla gracza
 je¿eli nie podamy available funkcja zwróci 1 gdy lokacj jest dostêpna dla gracza
 je¿eli nie podamy parametru name a podamy available f-cja zastosuje parametr available do wszystkich lokacji

 parametry:
 [name] - nazwa lokacji np. "hans_camp"
 [available] - parametr okrelaj¹cy dostêpboæ lokacji: 0 - niedostêpna, 1 - dostêpna
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function LocationAvailable(name, available)
	if name and type(name) == "string" then
		local location = LocationOnMap(name)
		if location then
			if available then
            	if available == 0 then
            		mapLocations[location].available = nil
            	elseif available == 1 then
            		mapLocations[location].available = 1
            	end

			elseif mapLocations[location].available then
				return 1
			end
		end
	elseif available then
		for i,v in mapLocations do
			if i ~= "n" and v.image then
            	if available == 0 then
            		v.available = nil
            	elseif available == 1 then
            		v.available = 1
            	end
			end
		end
	end
end

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
SomethingInInventory(actor, except)

 funkcja zwraca listê przedmiotów znajduj¹cych siê w plecaku aktora, je¿eli nic
 nie znajdzie zwróci nil

 parametry:
 [actor] - w³aciciel plecaka (nazwa, lub obiekt)
 [except] - przedmioty których nie uwzglêdniamy przy przeszukiwaniu
 		mo¿emy nie podawaæ tego parametru, podaæ jedn¹ nazwê lub tablicê nazw
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function SomethingInInventory(actor, except)
	actorThings = ActorThings(actor, 2)
	local exceptList = {}
	if type(except) == "string" then
		tinsert(exceptList, except)
	elseif type(except) == "table" then
		exceptList = except
	end
	local itemsList = {}
    for i, v in actorThings do
    	if i ~= "n" then
    		if not IsInTable(Name(v), exceptList) then
    			tinsert(itemsList, v)
			end
    	end
    end
    if getn(itemsList) > 0 then
    	return itemsList
    end
end

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
QChat()

Startowanie rozmowy dla dowolnej iloci osób (w kolejce aktora)
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

function QChat(dialogName, ...)
	local dialogData = {}
	dialogData.dialog = dialogName

	local actors = getn(arg)
	if actors >= 2 then
		dialogData.actors = {}
		for i = 1, (actors - 1), 2 do
			dialogData.actors[arg[i]] = Actor(arg[i+1])
		end
		if arg[actors] == 1 then
			dialogData.noSetup = 1
		end
		-- wrzucenie polecenia startuj¹cego chat w kolejkê pierwszej z postaci
		local fa = dialogData.actors[arg[1]]
		QLuaFunc(fa, "StartGuiChat", { topProcess = gui.topProcess, chatParams = dialogData})
		Queue(fa, "WFCHAT")
	end
end

function SetObservationPoints(actor, pointsTable)
	for i,v in pointsTable do
		if i != "n" then
			local x, y = ASGetPointer(v)
			if x and y then
				x, y = ConvertPointBackgroundToScreen(x, y)
				local dest = PickPos(x, y)
				AddAiObsPoint(actor, PosToVec(dest))
			end
		end
	end
end

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

		if i != "n" then

			if x and y then
				x, y = ConvertPointBackgroundToScreen(x, y)
				local dest = PickPos(x, y)
				AddAiPoint(actor, PosToVec(dest))
			end
		end
	end
end


function GoTo(actor, x, y, run) // x, y - wspó³rzêdne ekranowe
	local destination = PickPos(x, y, 2)
	actor = Actor(actor)
	if not destination then
		local actorPos = ActorPosToVec(actor)
		destination = GetNearestValidPos(Pick(x, y, actorPos.y), 100)
 	end
 	if not destination then
 		destination = GetNearestValidPos(Pick(x, y, minGroundLevel), 100)
 	end
	if destination then
		local vec = PosToVec(destination)
		QGoToPoint(actor, vec, run)
		return vec
	end
end

function ImpActor(actor, standardName, visName, findHidden)
	if actor == "kajetan" then
		local ident = GetIdent()
		if ident == "girl" then
			actor = "ania"
		else
			actor = "antek"
		end
	end
	local act = Actor(actor)
	if not act and findHidden then
		act = Hidden(actor)
		if act then
			Reveal(act)
		end
	end
	if not act then
		act = NewObject((standardName and standardName or actor)..".actor")
		if visName then
			go(act, "nameVis", visName)
		end
	end
	return act
end


function ImpObject(obj, standardName, visName, findHidden)
	local obj = Object(obj)
	if not obj and findHidden then
		obj = Hidden(obj)
		if obj then
			Reveal(obj)
		end
	end
	if not obj then
		obj = NewObject(standardName)
		if visName then
			go(obj, "nameVis", visName)
		end
	end
	return obj
end

function LastDigits(number, count)
	local numberStr = tostring(number)
    local n = strlen(numberStr)
    if n > count then
    	numberStr = strsub(numberStr, n - count + 1)
    end
    local add = ""
    add = strrep ("0", count - strlen(numberStr))
	return add..numberStr

function guiMenu:InputKeyUpdate(menu)
	local key = KbdGetStruck(0)
	self.lighting = guiMenu.lighting
	KbdReset()
	MouseReset()
	if key then
		if key == "esc" then
			guiMenu.lockInput = nil
			self.hint = Str("gme.hintStarDefineKey")
			return
		end
		specialKeys = {"ctrl", "lctrl", "rctrl", "alt", "lalt", "ralt", "shift", "lshift", "rshift", "tab", "up", "down", "left", "right", "eup", "edown", "eleft", "eright", "esc"}
		if IsInTable(key, specialKeys) then
			return
		end
		self.element.value = KeyName(key)
		guiMenu.lockInput = nil
		self.hint = Str("gme.hintStarDefineKey")
		//if IsNumber(key) then
			key = "_"..key
		//end
		local p = self.element.param
		for i, v in guiDesktop.shortcutKeys do
			if i ~= "n" and v.command == p.command and v.param == p.param then
				guiDesktop.shortcutKeys[i] = nil
            	break
			end
		end
		guiDesktop.shortcutKeys[key] = {command = p.command, param = p.param, param2 = p.param2}
		guiDesktop:UpdateShortcutKeys()
		guiMenu:SetStartValues(menu)
	end

function guiMenu:GetShortcutKey(el)

	for i, v in guiDesktop.shortcutKeys do
		if type(v) ~= "number" and v.command == p.command and v.param == p.param then
			p.code = i
			if strlen(i) > 0 and strsub(i, 1, 1) == "_" then
				return KeyName(gsub(i, "_", "", 1))
			else
            	return KeyName(i)
            end
		end
	end
    return Str("gme.keyUndefined")

function guiMenu:GoUp(param)
	if guiMenu.menu.oldMenu then
		if param == "savecfg" and type(SaveCfg) == "function" then
			SaveCfg()
		end
		if guiMenu.menu.elementsCreate then
			guiMenu.menu.elements = nil
		end
		local newMenu = guiMenu.menu.oldMenu
		guiMenu.menu.oldMenu = nil
		if guiMenu.menu.background ~= newMenu.background then
			guiMenu:ClearBackground()
			guiMenu:SetBackground(newMenu.background)
		end
		guiMenu:SetFade(newMenu.fade)
		guiMenu.menu = newMenu
		return 1
	end
end


function guiMenu:IsSave(fileName)
	local fileName2 = SavedGamesDir().."\\"..fileName

function guiMenu:NewSaveGame()
	for i=1, guiMenu.maxSaves do
		local fileName = "save"..i
		if not guiMenu:IsSave(fileName) then
			guiMenu:SaveGame(fileName)
			break
		end
	end
end


function guiMenu:DelSave(name)
	local fileName = SavedGamesDir().."\\"..name
	remove(fileName..".ssv")
	remove(fileName..".tga")
end

function guiMenu:SortSaves(list)
	local Compare = function(a1, a2)
		if (a1.time and a2.time) then
			if (a1.time > a2.time) then
				return 1
			end
		end
		return nil
	end

    sort(list, Compare)
end

function guiMenu:SetMusicVol(val, minVal, maxVal)
	if val > minVal then
		local musicVol = val / (maxVal - minVal) + minVal
		SetGlobalMusicVolume(2500 * musicVol - 2500)
	else
		SetGlobalMusicVolume(-10000)
	end
end


function guiMenu:GetMusicVol(minVal, maxVal)
	local musicVol = (max(-2500, SetGlobalMusicVolume()) + 2500) / 2500
	return musicVol * (maxVal - minVal) + minVal
end


function guiMenu:SetSoundVol(val, minVal, maxVal)
	if val > minVal then
		local soundVol = val / (maxVal - minVal) + minVal
		SetGlobalVolume(2500 * soundVol - 2500)
	else
		SetGlobalVolume(-10000)
	end
end


function guiMenu:GetSoundVol(minVal, maxVal)
	local soundVol = (max(-2500, SetGlobalVolume()) + 2500) / 2500
	return soundVol * (maxVal - minVal) + minVal
end

function guiMenu:PlayMiniGame(nr)
	local iName, iNr = GetIdent()
	if guiMenu.miniGameIdent and (not iName or iName ~= guiMenu.miniGameIdent) then
		SetIdent(guiMenu.miniGameIdent, 1)
	end

	EnableTasks(1)
    //gui:StopProcess()
    if nr == 3 then
    	local players = {}
    	for i = 1, 4 do
    		tinsert(players, 0)
    	end
    	local ok
    	for i, v in guiMenu.menu.elements do
    		if i ~= "n" then
    			for j = 1, 4 do
    				if v.tag == "PLAYER_"..j then
    					if v.element.index == 1 then
    						players[j] = 1
    						ok = 1
    					elseif v.element.index == 3 then
    						players[j] = 2
    						ok = 1
    					end
    					break
    				end
    			end
    		end
    	end
    	//ShowObjectData(players)
    	if ok then
			guiMenuInv:_PlayGame({nr = nr, players = players}, 1)
		end
    else
		guiMenuInv:_PlayGame(nr, 1)
	end
end

function guiMenu:GetHS3(fileName, twoNumbers, float)
//	local hs = GetHighScores(gc_savedGamesDir.."\\"..fileName)
	local hs
	if float then
		hs = GetHighScoresFloat(gc_savedGamesDir.."\\"..fileName)
	else
		hs = GetHighScores(gc_savedGamesDir.."\\"..fileName)
	end
/*
	local n = 3 - getn(hs)
	for i = 1, n do
		tinsert(hs, "***")
	end
*/
	local n = getn(hs)
	for i = 1, 3 do
        if i > n then
			tinsert(hs, "***")
		elseif float then
			hs[i] = format("%.1f", hs[i])
        elseif twoNumbers then
        	local a1, a2 = IntToShort(hs[i])
        	hs[i] = a1.." : "..a2
        end
	end
	tinsert(hs, 1, "#FFFFCCFF"..Str("gme.highScores").."#FFFF33FF")
	local text = MakeAdvancedBlockText(hs)
	return SetAdvancedBlockText(gui.fontBigFunny, 0, 0, 0.5, 0.5, -6, -7, text, nil, nil, "center")
end


function guiMenu:GetHS(fileName, twoNumbers, float, color)
//	local hs = GetHighScores(gc_savedGamesDir.."\\"..fileName)
	local hs
	if float then
		hs = GetHighScoresFloat(gc_savedGamesDir.."\\"..fileName)
	else
		hs = GetHighScores(gc_savedGamesDir.."\\"..fileName)
	end
/*
	local n = 3 - getn(hs)
	for i = 1, n do
		tinsert(hs, "***")
	end
*/
	local n = getn(hs)
	for i = 1, 3 do
        if i > n then
			tinsert(hs, "***")
		elseif float then
			hs[i] = format("%.1f", hs[i])
        elseif twoNumbers then
        	local a1, a2 = IntToShort(hs[i])
        	hs[i] = a1.." : "..a2
        end
	end
	if color then
		hs[1] = color..hs[1]
	end

	local text = MakeAdvancedBlockText(hs)
	return SetAdvancedBlockText(gui.fontBigFunny, 0, 0, 0.55, 0.55, -6, -10, text, nil, nil, "left")
end

function guiMenu:MiniGameOnUpdate(el, choosed)

		guiMenu.personSelected = el.person
	end
	if el._mouseInside then
		gui:MouseText(el.name)
	end

function guiMenu:IdentOnRender(el, choosed)
	if not el.person or guiMenu.personSelected == el.person then
		SprSetCurrentFrame(el.img, 0)
		DrawRectangle(Vector(el.rect.x0 - 1, ScreenHeight() - el.rect.y1 - 2	, 0), SprWidth(el.img), SprHeight(el.img), RGBA(1, 1, 1, el.activeIdent and 1 or 0.6))
		if choosed then
    		SetBlending("sa 1")
			DrawRectangle(Vector(el.rect.x0 - 1, ScreenHeight() - el.rect.y1 - 2, 0), SprWidth(el.img), SprHeight(el.img), RGBA(el.lighting * 0.6, el.lighting * 0.6, el.lighting * 0.6))
			SetBlending("sa 1-sa")
		end
	end
	if choosed then
		DrawRect2({x0 = el.rect.x0 + 6, y0 = el.rect.y0 + 5, x1 = el.rect.x1 - 7, y1 = el.rect.y1 - 7}, RGBA(1, 0, 0, 0.7))
	end
end

function guiMenu:FindLastSave()
	local list = {}
	for i=0, guiMenu.maxSaves do
		local _fileName
		if i == 0 then
			_fileName = "autosave"
		else
			_fileName = "chapter"..i
		end
		local fileName = nil
		fileName = guiMenu:IsSave(_fileName)
		if fileName then
			local time, year, month, day, hour, min, sec = FDateTime(fileName..".ssv")
			tinsert(list, {
				time = time,
				fileName = fileName,
			})
		end
	end
	if getn(list) > 0 then
		guiMenu:SortSaves(list)
		return list[1].fileName
	end
end

function guiMenu:SetElements(menu, parent)
	if not menu.align then
		if parent and parent.align then
			menu.align = parent.align
		else
			menu.align = self.align
		end
	end

	if not menu.marginTop then
		if parent and parent.marginTop then
			menu.marginTop = parent.marginTop
		else
			menu.marginTop = self.marginTop
		end
	end
	if not menu.marginDwn then
		if parent and parent.marginDwn then
			menu.marginDwn = parent.marginDwn
		else
			menu.marginDwn = self.marginDwn
		end
	end
	if not menu.marginLeft then
		if parent and parent.marginLeft then
			menu.marginLeft = parent.marginLeft
		else
			menu.marginLeft = self.marginLeft
		end
	end
	if not menu.marginRight then
		if parent and parent.marginRight then
			menu.marginRight = parent.marginRight
		else
			menu.marginRight = self.marginRight
		end
	end

	if not menu.fontMenu then
		if parent and parent.fontMenu then
			menu.fontMenu = parent.fontMenu
		else
			menu.fontMenu = self.fontMenu
		end
	end
	if not menu.fontSize then
		if parent and parent.fontSize then
			menu.fontSize = parent.fontSize
		else
			menu.fontSize = self.fontSize
		end
	end
	if not menu.fontSpace then
		if parent and parent.fontSpace then
			menu.fontSpace = parent.fontSpace
		else
			menu.fontSpace = self.fontSpace
		end
	end
	if not menu.space then
		if parent and parent.space then
			menu.space = parent.space
		else
			menu.space = self.space
		end
	end
	if not menu.spaceTitle then
		if parent and parent.spaceTitle then
			menu.spaceTitle = parent.spaceTitle
		else
			menu.spaceTitle = self.spaceTitle
		end
	end
	if not menu.spaceElement then
		if parent and parent.spaceElement then
			menu.spaceElement = parent.spaceElement
		else
			menu.spaceElement = self.spaceElement
		end
	end
	if not menu.background then
		if parent and parent.background then
			menu.background = parent.background
		end
	end
	if not menu.fade then
		if parent and parent.fade then
			menu.fade = parent.fade
		end
	end
	if not menu.identVisible then
		if parent and parent.identVisible then
			menu.identVisible = parent.identVisible
		else
			menu.identVisible = self.identVisible
		end
	end


	menu.index = 1

	local top = 0

	if not menu.title and menu.name then
		menu.title = CharUpper(menu.name)
	end

	if menu.title then
		local titleWidth = GetTextWidth(menu.fontMenu, menu.fontSpace, menu.title) * menu.fontSize * self.titleFactor
		local titleHeight = GetFontHeight(menu.fontMenu) * menu.fontSize * self.titleFactor
        if menu.align == "left" then
        	menu.titleX = menu.marginLeft
        elseif menu.align == "right" then
        	menu.titleX = ScreenWidth() - menu.marginRight - titleWidth
        else
        	menu.titleX = menu.marginLeft + (ScreenWidth() - menu.marginRight - menu.marginLeft - titleWidth) / 2
        end
        menu.titleY = ScreenHeight() - (menu.marginTop + top + titleHeight)
        menu.titleWidth = titleWidth
//        top = top + titleHeight + menu.space * self.titleFactor
		top = top + titleHeight + menu.spaceTitle
	end

	local spaceElement = menu.spaceElement * menu.fontSize

	local height = GetFontHeight(menu.fontMenu) * menu.fontSize
	for i=1, getn(menu.elements) do
		local v = menu.elements[i]

		if v.type == "TEXT" then

			local width = GetTextWidth(menu.fontMenu, menu.fontSpace, v.name) * menu.fontSize
        	v.rect = {}

   			v.rect.y0 = menu.marginTop + top
			v.rect.y1 = v.rect.y0 + height - 1
			v.y = ScreenHeight() - v.rect.y0 - height
       		v.height = height

        	if v.element then
	        	local elementWidth = 0

        		if v.element.type == "CHOICE" then
	        		for j = 1, getn(v.element.list) do
        				local w = v.element.list[j]
        				local elW = GetTextWidth(menu.fontMenu, menu.fontSpace, w) * menu.fontSize
        				if elW > elementWidth then
	        				elementWidth = elW
        				end
        			end

        		elseif v.element.type == "CHOICE_IMG" then
      				elementWidth = v.element.imgW

        		elseif v.element.type == "SLIDE" then
	   				elementWidth = v.element.width
        			v.element.widthFactor = elementWidth / SprWidth(self.scale, 0)
        			v.element.width2 = SprWidth(self.slide, 0) * v.element.widthFactor
					v.element.maxWidth = v.element.width - v.element.width2
					v.element.widthInterval = v.element.width / ((v.element.max - v.element.min) / v.element.interval)

        		elseif v.element.type == "INPUT" then
	   				elementWidth = (v.element.width or 50)

	   			end

       			if menu.align == "left" then
	        		v.rect.x0 = menu.marginLeft
        			v.element.x = menu.marginLeft + width + spaceElement
       			elseif menu.align == "right" then
	        		v.element.x = ScreenWidth() - menu.marginRight - elementWidth
        			v.rect.x0 = v.element.x - spaceElement - width
       			else
					local center = menu.marginLeft + (ScreenWidth() - menu.marginRight - menu.marginLeft) / 2
        			v.rect.x0 = center - width
        			v.element.x = center + spaceElement
       			end

				if v.element.type == "SLIDE" then
					v.element.x1 = v.element.x + v.element.width2 * 0.5
				end

            	v.element.y = v.y
      			v.width = width + spaceElement + elementWidth

	        else
        		if menu.align == "left" then
		        	v.rect.x0 = menu.marginLeft
        		elseif menu.align == "right" then
		        	v.rect.x0 = ScreenWidth() - menu.marginRight - width
        		else
		        	v.rect.x0 = menu.marginLeft + (ScreenWidth() - menu.marginRight - menu.marginLeft - width) / 2
        		end
        		v.width = width
        	end

			v.rect.x1 = v.rect.x0 + v.width
			v.x = v.rect.x0

        	v.lighting = 0
        	top = top + height + menu.space
        	if v.elements then self:SetElements(v, menu) end

		elseif v.type == "AREA" then
        	v.lighting = 0
        	if v.elements then self:SetElements(v, menu) end

		elseif v.type == "LIST" then

			if not v.height then
				v.height = ScreenHeight() - menu.marginTop - top - menu.marginDwn
			end

       		if menu.align == "left" then
	        	v.x = menu.marginLeft
       		elseif menu.align == "right" then
	        	v.x = ScreenWidth() - menu.marginRight - v.width
       		else
	        	v.x = menu.marginLeft + (ScreenWidth() - menu.marginRight - menu.marginLeft - v.width) / 2
       		end

			self:SetList(v, menu, top)

			v.rect = {x0 = v.x, x1 = v.x + v.width - 1, y0 = menu.marginTop + top, y1 = menu.marginTop + top + v.height - 1}

			top = top + v.height

        end
	end
end


function guiMenu:SetStartValues(menu)
	for i=1, getn(menu.elements) do
		local v = menu.elements[i]
		if v.element then
			if v.element.type == "CHOICE_IMG" then
				guiMenu:UpdateChoiceImg(v.element)
			end

			if v.element.startFunc then
       			if v.element.type == "CHOICE" or v.element.type == "CHOICE_IMG"  then
	   				v.element.index = v.element:startFunc(getn(v.element.list))

       			elseif v.element.type == "SLIDE" then
	       			local val = v.element:startFunc(v.element.min, v.element.max)
            		local num = RoundTo(val, v.element.interval)
   	        		val = max(v.element.min, val)
           			val = min(v.element.max, val)
					v.element.value = val

       			elseif v.element.type == "INPUT" then
	       			v.element.value = v.element:startFunc(v)

       			end
			end
		end
	end
	guiMenu:ClearBackground()
	self:SetBackground(menu.background)
	self:SetFade(menu.fade)
end


function guiMenu:SetList(list, menu, top)
	if not list.align then
		if menu.align then
			list.align = menu.align
		else
			list.align = self.align
		end
	end

	if not list.fontMenu then
		if menu.fontMenu then
			list.fontMenu = menu.fontMenu
		else
			list.fontMenu = self.fontMenu
		end
	end
	if not list.fontSize then
		if menu.fontSize then
			list.fontSize = menu.fontSize
		else
			list.fontSize = self.fontSize
		end
	end
	if not list.fontSpace then
		if menu.fontSpace then
			list.fontSpace = menu.fontSpace
		else
			list.fontSpace = self.fontSpace
		end
	end
	if not list.space then
		if menu.space then
			list.space = menu.space
		else
			list.space = self.space
		end
	end

	if not list.spaceElement then
		if menu.spaceElement then
			list.spaceElement = menu.spaceElement
		else
			list.spaceElement = self.spaceElement
		end
	end

	list.first = 1
	list.index = 1

	local spaceElement = list.spaceElement * list.fontSize

	local height = GetFontHeight(list.fontMenu) * list.fontSize

	top = top + menu.marginTop

	local maxCount
/*
	local maxCount = floor(list.height / (height + list.space))
	if (height + list.space) * maxCount + height <= list.height then
		maxCount = maxCount + 1
	end

	if maxCount >= getn(list.list) then
		list.rectArrowUp = nil
		list.rectArrowDown = nil

		list.height = maxCount * height + (maxCount - 1) * list.space
		list.realHeight = list.height

	else*/
		list.realHeight = list.height - self.listArrowsHeight * 2

		maxCount = floor(list.realHeight / (height + list.space))
		if (height + list.space) * maxCount + height <= list.realHeight then
			maxCount = maxCount + 1
		end

		list.height = maxCount * height + (maxCount - 1) * list.space + 2 * self.listArrowsHeight
		list.realHeight = list.height - self.listArrowsHeight * 2

		list.rectArrowUp = {x0 = list.x, x1 = list.x + list.width - 1, y0 = top, y1 = top + self.listArrowsHeight - 1}
		list.rectArrowDown = {x0 = list.x, x1 = list.x + list.width - 1, y0 = top + self.listArrowsHeight + list.realHeight, y1 = top + self.listArrowsHeight + list.realHeight + self.listArrowsHeight - 1}

		top = top + self.listArrowsHeight
	//end

	list.maxCount = maxCount

	list.rects = {}
	for i=0, maxCount - 1 do
		tinsert(list.rects, {x0 = list.x, x1 = list.x + list.width - 1, y0 = top, y1 = top + height - 1})
		list.rects[i+1].y = ScreenHeight() - list.rects[i+1].y1
		top = top + height + list.space
	end


	for i=1, getn(list.list) do
		local v = list.list[i]
		local width = GetTextWidth(list.fontMenu, list.fontSpace, v.name) * list.fontSize
        v.rect = {}

       	if list.align == "left" then
        	v.x = list.x
       	elseif list.align == "right" then
        	v.x = list.x + list.width - width
       	else
        	v.x = list.x + (list.width - width) / 2
       	end
       	v.width = width

        v.lighting = 0
	end
end


function guiMenu:CanScrollUp(list)
	if list.maxCount + list.first - 1 < getn(list.list) then
		return 1
	end
end


function guiMenu:CanScrollDown(list)
	if list.first > 1 then
		return 1
	end
end


function guiMenu:ScrollUp(list)
	if guiMenu:CanScrollUp(list) then
		list.first = list.first + 1
		if list.index < list.first or list.index > list.first + list.maxCount - 1 then
			list.index = list.first
		end
	end
end


function guiMenu:ScrollDown(list)
	if guiMenu:CanScrollDown(list) then
		list.first = list.first - 1
		if list.index < list.first or list.index > list.first + list.maxCount - 1 then
			list.index = list.first + list.maxCount - 1
		end
	end
end


function guiMenu:MoveUp(list)
	if list.index > 1 then
		if list.index <= list.first then
			guiMenu:ScrollDown(list)
		end
		list.index = list.index - 1
		return 1
	end
end


function guiMenu:MoveDown(list)
	if list.index < getn(list.list) then
		if list.index >= list.first + list.maxCount - 1 then
			guiMenu:ScrollUp(list)
		end
		list.index = list.index + 1
		return 1
	end
end


function guiMenu:ScrollList(list, index)
	local n = getn(list.list)
	if n == 0 then
		return
	end

	if index < 0 then
		index = 1
	elseif index > n then
		index = n
	end

	if list.first > 1 and list.maxCount > n - list.first + 1 then
		list.first = max(n - list.maxCount + 1, 1)
	end

	list.index = index
	if list.index < list.first then
		list.first = list.index
	elseif list.index > list.first + list.maxCount - 1 then
		list.first = max(list.index - list.maxCount + 1, 1)
	end
end


function guiMenu:DelFromList(list, index)
    tremove(list.list, index)
	self.indexOld = nil
	//guiMenu:ScrollList(list, index)
	local n = getn(list.list)
	if n < list.first + list.maxCount - 1 then
		if list.first > 1 then
			list.first = list.first - 1
			list.index = list.index - 1
		elseif list.index > n then
			list.index = n
		end
	end
	if list.index > n then
		list.index = n
	end
end


function guiMenu:GoodIndex(list)
	if list.index > 0 and list.index <= getn(list.list) then
		return 1
	end
end


function guiMenu:Choose(element, shift)
	local n = getn(element.list)
	if n > 0 then
		local index = element.index + shift
		if index > n then
			index = 1
		elseif index < 1 then
			index = n
		end
		element.index = index
		if element.type == "CHOICE_IMG" then
			guiMenu:UpdateChoiceImg(element)
		end
	end

	if (element.changeFunc) then
		element:changeFunc(element.index, n)
	end
end


function guiMenu:UpdateChoiceImg(element)
	element.img = CreateSprite(element.list[element.index])
	ReloadAllTextures()
end


function guiMenu:Val(element, shift)
	shift = shift * element.interval
	if element.value + shift >= element.min and element.value + shift <= element.max then
		element.value = element.value + shift
	end

	if (element.changeFunc) then
		element:changeFunc(element.value, element.min, element.max)
	end
end

function guiMenu:GoToTag(tabTags)
	local m = getn(tabTags)
	for j = 1, m do
		local tag = tabTags[j]
		local n = getn(guiMenu.menu.elements)
		local tagFound = nil
		for i = 1, n do
			v = guiMenu.menu.elements[i]
			if v.tag == tag then
				if guiMenu:TryGoIn(v) then
					tagFound = 1
					break
				end
			end
		end
		if not tagFound then
			return
		end
	end
end

function guiMenu:ShowHint(hint)
	if hint then
		self.hint = hint
		self.hintTime = 1
	end
end


function guiMenu:IndexUp()
	local n = getn(self.menu.elements)
	if n < 1 then
		return
	end
	if not self.menu.index then
		self.menu.index = n
	end
	local index = self.menu.index
	local newIndex
	while not newIndex do
		index = index - 1
		if index < 1 then
			index = n
		end
		if index == self.menu.index then
			return
		elseif not self.menu.elements[index].off then
			newIndex = index
		end
	end
	self.menu.index = newIndex
end


function guiMenu:IndexDown()
	local n = getn(self.menu.elements)
	if n < 1 then
		return
	end
	if not self.menu.index then
		self.menu.index = 1
	end
	local index = self.menu.index
	local newIndex
	while not newIndex do
		index = index + 1
		if index > n then
			index = 1
		end
		if index == self.menu.index then
			return
		elseif not self.menu.elements[index].off then
			newIndex = index
		end
	end
	self.menu.index = newIndex
end


function guiMenu:TryGoIn(el)
	if el.elementsCreate then -- funkcja tworz¹ca elementy
		el:elementsCreate(el)
	end
	if el.elements then -- wejcie w g³¹b
		el.oldMenu = self.menu
		self.menu = el
		self.menu.index = 1
		self.menu.indexOld = nil
		self:SetStartValues(self.menu)
		return 1
	end
end


/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
guiMenu:Update()
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

function guiMenu:Update()
//	print(musicVol)

	if self.hintTime and self.hintTime > 0 then
		self.hintTime = self.hintTime - 0.2
	else
		self.hintTime = nil
	end

	if self.setBackground then
		SetBkgBitmap(self.background)
		self.setBackground = nil
	end
	local mx, my = MouseGetXY()

	local mouseChange
	if self.mx ~= mx or self.my ~= my then
		mouseChange = 1
	end
	self.mx, self.my = mx, my

	if self.cloth then
		local click = 0
		if MouseIs("lbutton") then
			click = 1
		end
		if MouseIs("rbutton") then
			click = 2
		end

		for i=0, self.clothIterations do
			ClothUpdate(mx, my, click, self.MAIN_GRAVITY_Y, self.VELOCITY_DAMPING, self.FORCE_SCALER, self.WIND_FORCE_LEFT_BUTTON)
		end
		ClothCalcNormals()
	end

	if self.lockInput and self.lockInput.inputUpdate then
		self.lockInput:inputUpdate(self.menu)
	end

	if KbdStruck("esc") then
		if not guiMenu:GoUp() then
			guiMenu:BackToGame()
		end
	end

	local playClick = nil
	local playChange = nil

	self.mouseOverKey = nil
	self.mouseOverListKey = nil
	self.mouseOverArrowUp = nil
	self.mouseOverArrowDown = nil

	for i=1, getn(self.menu.elements) do
		v = self.menu.elements[i]
		v._mouseInside = IsInsideRect(mx, my, v.rect)
		if not v.off and (not self.lockInput or not self.lockInput.inputUpdate) and (not self.keyOn or self.keyOn == i) and v._mouseInside then
			gui:MouseCursor("select")
			self.mouseOverKey = i
			if v.type == "TEXT" then
				if v.lighting < self.lighting then
					v.lighting = self.lighting
				end
				if self.mouseOverKeyOld ~= i then
					playChange = 1
				end
			elseif v.type == "AREA" then
				if v.lighting < self.lighting then
					v.lighting = self.lighting
				end
				if self.mouseOverKeyOld ~= i then
					playChange = 1
				end
			elseif v.type == "LIST" then
				if v.rectArrowUp and IsInsideRect(mx, my, v.rectArrowUp) then
                    self.mouseOverArrowUp = 1
				elseif v.rectArrowDown and IsInsideRect(mx, my, v.rectArrowDown) then
                    self.mouseOverArrowDown = 1
				end
				local add = v.first - 1
				local n = min(v.maxCount, getn(v.list) - add)
				for j=1, n do
					local w = v.list[j + add]
					local rect = v.rects[j]
					if IsInsideRect(mx, my, rect) then
						self.mouseOverListKey = j + add
						if mouseChange then
							v.index = self.mouseOverListKey
						end
						if w.lighting < self.lighting then
							w.lighting = self.lighting
						end
						if self.mouseOverListKeyOld ~= self.mouseOverListKey then
							playChange = 1
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
		if v.funcOnUpdate then
			v:funcOnUpdate(v, i == self.menu.index)
		end
		if v.lighting and v.lighting > 0 then
			v.lighting = v.lighting - self.subLighting
		else
			v.lighting = 0
		end
		if v.type == "LIST" then
			for j, w in v.list do
				if j ~= "n" then
					if w.lighting and w.lighting > 0 then
						w.lighting = w.lighting - self.subLighting
					else
						w.lighting = 0
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	//print(self.mouseOverArrowUp)

	self.mouseOverKeyOld = self.mouseOverKey
	self.mouseOverListKeyOld = self.mouseOverListKey

	if self.mouseOverKey and mouseChange then
		self.menu.index = self.mouseOverKey
	end

	local el, elOld
	el = self.menu.elements[self.menu.index]
	if self.menu.index ~= self.menu.indexOld or el.index ~= el.indexOld then
		if self.menu.indexOld then
			elOld = self.menu.elements[self.menu.indexOld]
		end

		if elOld and elOld.type == "LIST" and self:GoodIndex(elOld) and elOld.list[elOld.indexOld].image then
			elOld.list[elOld.indexOld].image = nil
	 		//print("NIL   ",elOld.list[elOld.indexOld].imageName)
		end

		if el and el.type == "LIST" and self:GoodIndex(el) and el.list[el.index].imageName then
			//print("ImageName:  ",el.list[el.index].imageName)
	 		//print("CREATE   ",el.list[el.index].imageName)
	 		el.list[el.index].image = CreateSprite(el.list[el.index].imageName)
			ReloadAllTextures()
		end

		if elOld and elOld.image then
			elOld.image = nil
	 		//print("NIL   ",elOld.imageName)
		end
	 	if el.imageName then
	 		//print("CREATE   ",el.imageName)
			el.image = CreateSprite(el.imageName)
			ReloadAllTextures()
		end

	end

/*
	if self.menu.index ~= self.menu.indexOld then
		if self.menu.indexOld and self.menu.elements[self.menu.indexOld].image then
			self.menu.elements[self.menu.indexOld].image = nil
	 		//print("NIL   ",self.menu.elements[self.menu.indexOld].imageName)
		end
	 	if self.menu.elements[self.menu.index].imageName then
	 		//print("CREATE   ",self.menu.elements[self.menu.index].imageName)
			self.menu.elements[self.menu.index].image = CreateSprite(self.menu.elements[self.menu.index].imageName)
			ReloadAllTextures()
		end
	end
*/

	//print(self.menu.index, self.menu.indexOld)
	self.menu.indexOld = self.menu.index
	local el = self.menu.elements[self.menu.index]
	self:ShowHint(el.hint)

	if el.type == "LIST" then
		el.indexOld = el.index
		if self:GoodIndex(el) then
			self:ShowHint(el.list[el.index].hint)
		end
	end

	if MouseStruck("lbutton") or MouseDblClk("lbutton") then
		self.keyOn = self.mouseOverKey
		if self.keyOn and self.menu.elements[self.keyOn].element and self.menu.elements[self.keyOn].element.x <= mx then
			self.elementOn = self.keyOn
		end
		if self.mouseOverKey then
			self.menu.index = self.mouseOverKey
		end
		if self.mouseOverKey and not self.elementOn then
			playClick = 1
		end
	end

	if MouseStruck("rbutton") or MouseDblClk("rbutton") then
		self.keyOnR = self.mouseOverKey
		if self.mouseOverKey then
			self.menu.index = self.mouseOverKey
		end
		if self.mouseOverKey then
			playClick = 1
		end
	end

	local index = self.menu.index

	local command = nil
	if ((not MouseIs("lbutton") and self.keyOn and self.keyOn == self.mouseOverKey) or KbdStruck("enter")) and index then
		command = self.menu.elements[index].command
	elseif not MouseIs("rbutton") and self.keyOnR and self.keyOnR == self.mouseOverKey and index then
		command = self.menu.elements[index].commandR
	elseif KbdStruck("left") then
		command = self.menu.elements[index].commandKL
		--playClick = 1
	elseif KbdStruck("right") then
		command = self.menu.elements[index].commandKR
		--playClick = 1
	end

	if command then -- wywo³anie komendy podpiêtej pod klawisz
		if command == "CHOOSE_NEXT" then
           	self:Choose(self.menu.elements[index].element, 1)
		elseif command == "CHOOSE_PREV" then
           	self:Choose(self.menu.elements[index].element, -1)
		elseif command == "VAL_NEXT" then
           	self:Val(self.menu.elements[index].element, 1)
		elseif command == "VAL_PREV" then
           	self:Val(self.menu.elements[index].element, -1)
		end
		//self.menu.elements[index].lighting = self.lighting
	end

	if MouseIs("lbutton") and self.elementOn then -- przeci¹ganie lewym
		local v = self.menu.elements[self.elementOn]
		if v.element and v.element.type == "SLIDE" then
			local el = v.element
			local oldVal = el.value
            //local num = RoundTo((mx - el.x) / el.widthInterval, el.interval)
            local num = RoundTo(el.min + (el.max - el.min) * (mx - el.x1) / el.maxWidth, el.interval)
            num = max(el.min, num)
            num = min(el.max, num)
            el.value = num
            local interval = el.value - oldVal
            if interval < 0 then
            	interval = -interval
            end
            if interval > el.interval * 0.5 then
				//playClick = 1

				if (el.changeFunc) then
					el:changeFunc(el.value, el.min, el.max)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if not MouseIs("lbutton") and self.keyOn then -- klikniêcie lewym
		local v = self.menu.elements[self.keyOn]
		if self.keyOn == self.mouseOverKey then -- klikniêcie na zwyk³ej pozycji menu
			if v.func then -- wywo³anie funkcji podpiêtej pod klawisz
				v:func(v.param, v)
			end
			guiMenu:TryGoIn(v) -- próba wejcia w g³¹b
		end
		if self.mouseOverListKey then  -- klikniêcie na elemencie listy
			w = v.list[self.mouseOverListKey]
			if w.func then -- wywo³anie funkcji podpiêtej pod klawisz
				w:func(w.param, w)
			end
		end
		if self.mouseOverArrowUp then -- klikniêcie na strza³ce do góry na licie
			self:ScrollDown(v)
		elseif self.mouseOverArrowDown then -- klikniêcie na strza³ce w dó³
			self:ScrollUp(v)
		end
/*		if self.mouseOverArrowUp then  -- klikniêcie na strza³ce do góry na licie
			if v.maxCount + v.first - 1 < getn(v.list) then
				v.first = v.first + 1
			end
		end*/
		self.keyOn = nil
		self.elementOn = nil
	end

	if not MouseIs("rbutton") and self.keyOnR then -- klikniêcie prawym
		if self.keyOnR == self.mouseOverKey then
			if self.menu.elements[self.keyOnR].funcR then -- wywo³anie funkcji podpiêtej pod klawisz
				self.menu.elements[self.keyOnR]:funcR(self.menu.elements[self.keyOnR].paramR)
			end
		end
		self.keyOnR = nil
	end

	if KbdStruck("enter") and index then
		if self.menu.elements[index].func then -- wywo³anie funkcji podpiêtej pod klawisz
			self.menu.elements[index]:func(self.menu.elements[index].param, self.menu.elements[index])
		end
		guiMenu:TryGoIn(self.menu.elements[index]) -- próba wejcia w g³¹b
		playClick = 1
	end


	local n = getn(self.menu.elements)
	local el = self.menu.elements[self.menu.index]

	if el.type == "LIST" and self:GoodIndex(el) then
		if KbdStruck("enter") then
			if el.list[el.index].func then -- wywo³anie funkcji podpiêtej pod klawisz
				el.list[el.index]:func(el.list[el.index].param, el.list[el.index])
			end
		elseif KbdStruck("del") and not el.readOnly then
			guiMenu:DelItemFromListQ(el)
/*
			if el.list[el.index].funcDel then
				el.list[el.index]:funcDel(el.list[el.index].paramDel)
			end
			//self:DelSave(el.list[el.index].param)
			self:DelFromList(el, el.index)
			self.menu.indexOld = nil
*/
		end
	end

	if KbdStruck("up") then
		if el.type ~= "LIST" or not self:MoveUp(el) then
			self:IndexUp()
/*
			if not index or index <= 1 then
				self.menu.index	= n
			else
				self.menu.index = self.menu.index - 1

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
ConvertPointBackgroundToScreen(ptx, pty)

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

function ConvertPointBackgroundToScreen(ptx, pty)
    local view = {}
    BkgGetViewport(view)
	local nptx, npty
    nptx = (ptx - view.x0) * guiScroll.zoom
    npty = (pty - view.y0) * guiScroll.zoom
    return nptx, npty
end

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
ConvertRectBackgroundToScreen(bkgRect)

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

function ConvertRectBackgroundToScreen(bkgRect)
    local scrRect = {}
    local view = {}
    BkgGetViewport(view)
    scrRect.x0 = (bkgRect.x0 - view.x0) * guiScroll.zoom
    scrRect.y0 = (bkgRect.y0 - view.y0) * guiScroll.zoom
    scrRect.x1 = scrRect.x0 - 1 + (bkgRect.x1 - bkgRect.x0) * guiScroll.zoom
    scrRect.y1 = scrRect.y0 - 1 + (bkgRect.y1 - bkgRect.y0) * guiScroll.zoom
    return scrRect
end

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
IsInsideRect(px, py, rect)

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

function IsInsideRect(px, py, rect)
    if px >= rect.x0 and px <= rect.x1 and py >= rect.y0 and py <= rect.y1 then return 1
    else return nil end
end

function InsideRect(px, py, rect)
    if px >= rect.left and px <= rect.right and py >= rect.top and py <= rect.bottom then return 1
    else return nil end
end

	if d1 < d2 then
		if a2 >= a1 then m = d1

	end

/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
CutString(strIn, cutChar)

 funkcja "tnie" ³añcuch tekstu na fragmenty i zwraca tablicê z pociêtymi fragmentami ³añcucha

 strIn - ³añcuch
 cutChar - znak lub ci¹g znaków który jest znacznikiem miejsca przeciêcia ³añcucha (domylnie jest to |)
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

function CutString(strIn, cutChar)
	local tabOut = {}
	local pos, newPos
	if strIn and strlen(strIn) > 0 then
		if not cutChar then cutChar = "|" end
		newPos = 1 - strlen(cutChar)
		repeat
			pos = newPos + strlen(cutChar)
			newPos = strfind(strIn, cutChar, pos)
			if newPos then
	            tinsert(tabOut, strsub(strIn, pos, newPos - 1))
			else
	            tinsert(tabOut, strsub(strIn, pos))
			end
		until not newPos
	end
	return tabOut
end


/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
DecodeColor(colorStr)

 funkcja zamienia przekazany ³añcuch (colorStr) 6, 8 znaków - okrelaj¹cy kolor w formacie szestnastkowym
 na zmienn¹ RGBA
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

function DecodeColor(colorStr)
	local colorType = type(colorStr)
	if strfind(colorType, "us", 1) then
		return colorStr
	end
	if not colorStr or colorType ~= "string" or (strlen(colorStr) ~= 6 and strlen(colorStr) ~= 8) then
		colorStr = "FFFFFF"
	end
	local cTab = {}
	cTab.r = tonumber(strsub(colorStr,1,2),16) / 255
	cTab.g = tonumber(strsub(colorStr,3,4),16) / 255
	cTab.b = tonumber(strsub(colorStr,5,6),16) / 255
	if strlen(colorStr) == 6 then
		cTab.a = 1
	else
		cTab.a = tonumber(strsub(colorStr,7,8),16) / 255
	end
	return RGBA(cTab.r, cTab.g, cTab.b, cTab.a), cTab
end


/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
WrapWords(font, fontWidth, pressFont, text, maxLength)

 funkcja "zawija" linijki tekstu do zadanej d³ugoci maksymalnej

 font - czcionka
 fontWidth - szerokoæ czcionki
 pressFont - iloæ pikseli pomiêdzy znakami
 text - ³añcuch tekstu, lub tablica ³añcuchów
 maxLenght - maksymalna d³ugoæ linii w pikselach
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

function WrapWords(font, fontWidth, pressFont, text, maxLength)
	local lines = text
	if type(lines) == "string" then
		local lines2 = {}
		tinsert(lines2, lines)
		lines = lines2
	end
	local tabOut = {}
	local lineLenght, line, lineSpace, lineChar, pos, posSpace, lineNum
	for i, v in lines do
		if i ~= "n" then
			lineLenght = strlen(v)
			line = ""
			pos = 1
			lineNum = 1
			while pos <= lineLenght do
				lineSpace = ""
                while pos <= lineLenght and strsub(v, pos, pos) == " " do
    	            lineSpace = lineSpace.." "
    	            pos = pos + 1
                end
				lineChar = ""
                while pos <= lineLenght and strsub(v, pos, pos) ~= " " do
    	            lineChar = lineChar..strsub(v, pos, pos)
    	            pos = pos + 1
                end
				line2 = line
				if strlen(line) > 0 or lineNum == 1 then line2 = line2..lineSpace end
				if strlen(lineChar) > 0 then
					line2 = line2..lineChar
                	if GetTextWidth(font, pressFont, line2) * fontWidth > maxLength then
	                	if strlen(line) > 0 then
							tinsert(tabOut, line)
							lineNum = lineNum + 1
							pos = pos + strlen(line) - strlen(line2)
						else
							tinsert(tabOut, line2)
							lineNum = lineNum + 1
						end
						line = ""
    	           	else
	               		line = line2
                	end
               	end
			end
			tinsert(tabOut, line)
		end
	end
	return tabOut
end


/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
DrawBlockText(font, x, y, wFont, hFont, pressFont, hSpace, text, fontColor, backgroundColor, colorChar, mustShowOnScreen, align)

 funkcja wypisuje listê stringów umieszczonych w prosok¹cie o lewym górnym naro¿niku x,y

 font - czcionka
 x, y - wsp. lewego górnego naro¿nika kwadratu
 wFont - wzglêdna szerokoæ czcionki (1 = 100% szerokoci)
 hFont - wzglêdna wysokoæ czcionki (1 = 100% wysokoci)
 text - tablica stringów
 fontColor - kolor czcionki (RGBA) w kodzie szesnastkowym (np. "FFFFFFFF" bia³a czcinka nieprzeroczysta)
 backgroundColor - kolor t³a (RGBA) w kodzie szesnastkowym
 colorChar - znak który bêdzie rozpoznawany jako znak po którym wystêpuje definicja koloru (domylnie jest to "#")
 mustShowOnScreen - wymusza rysowanie tekstu na ekranie
 align - wyrównanie tekstu (w obrêbie jego kwadratu) - mo¿liwe wartoci: "left", "center", "right" (domylnie jest "left")
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

function DrawBlockText(font, x, y, wFont, hFont, pressFont, hSpace, text, fontColor, backgroundColor, colorChar, mustShowOnScreen, align)
	y = y + GetFontHeight(font) * hFont + 2
	local color, newTab, longestLine, addx, addy = DecodeColor(fontColor), {}, 0, 0, 0
	if not colorChar then colorChar = "#" end
	for i = 1, getn(text) do

		local shiftText, shiftPos, add, colStr, pos, newPos, line = 0, 0, ""
		if strlen(text[i]) > 0 then
			newPos = 1 - strlen(colorChar) - shiftPos
			repeat
				pos = newPos + strlen(colorChar) + shiftPos
				newPos = strfind(text[i], colorChar, pos)
				if newPos then
					line = add..strsub(text[i], pos, newPos -1)
				else
					line = add..strsub(text[i], pos)
				end
				if strlen(line) > 0 then
					tinsert(newTab, {line = line, color = color, x = x + shiftText, y = ScreenHeight() - (y + (GetFontHeight(font) * hFont + hSpace) * (i - 1))})
					shiftText = shiftText + GetTextWidth(font, pressFont, line) * wFont
				end
				if newPos then
                    if strsub(text[i], newPos + 1, newPos + strlen(colorChar)) ~= colorChar then
                    	shiftPos = 8
                    	color = DecodeColor(strsub(text[i], newPos + strlen(colorChar), newPos + strlen(colorChar) + 7))
						add = ""
                    else
           				shiftPos = strlen(colorChar)
           				add = colorChar
                    end
                end
			until not newPos
			newTab[getn(newTab)].width = shiftText
			if longestLine < shiftText + 4 then longestLine = shiftText + 4 end
		end

	end

	ret = {x, y, 0, 0}
	if getn(text) >0 then
		if mustShowOnScreen then
			if x + longestLine > ScreenWidth() then addx = x + longestLine - ScreenWidth() end
			if y + (GetFontHeight(font) * hFont + hSpace) * (getn(text) - 1) + 2 > ScreenHeight() then addy = y + (GetFontHeight(font) * hFont + hSpace) * (getn(text) - 1) + 2 - ScreenHeight() end
		end

        ret[1] = x - 2 - addx
        ret[2] = y - addy + (GetFontHeight(font) * hFont + hSpace) * (getn(text) - 1) + 2
        ret[3] = longestLine + 2
        ret[4] = (GetFontHeight(font) * hFont + hSpace) * (getn(text) - 1) + GetFontHeight(font) * hFont + 4
        if type(backgroundColor) ~= "number" then
			if not backgroundColor then
				backgroundColor = RGBA(0.2,0.2,0.2,0.45)
			else
				backgroundColor = DecodeColor(backgroundColor)
			end
	    	SprSetCurrentFrame()
	    	DrawRectangle(Vector(ret[1], ScreenHeight() - ret[2], 0), ret[3], ret[4], backgroundColor)
	    end
	    ret[2] = ret[2] - ret[4]

		for i, v in newTab do
			if i ~= "n" then
				if align == "right" then
					DrawText(font, Vector(v.x - addx + (longestLine - 4 - v.width), v.y + addy, 0), wFont, hFont, pressFont, v.color, v.line)
				elseif align == "center" then
					DrawText(font, Vector(v.x - addx + (longestLine - 4 - v.width) / 2, v.y + addy, 0), wFont, hFont, pressFont, v.color, v.line)
				else
					DrawText(font, Vector(v.x - addx, v.y + addy, 0), wFont, hFont, pressFont, v.color, v.line)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return ret[1], ret[2], ret[3], ret[4]
end


/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

 funkcja wyliczaj¹ca odleg³oæ w przestrzni 2D pomiêdzy punktami (x0, y0) i (x1, y1)
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

function Distance2D(x0, y0, x1, y1)
	if type(x0) == "table" and type(y0) == "table" then
		local _x0 = x0.x

		x0 = _x0

	end

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
RoundTo(numIn, roundTo)

 funkcja s³u¿¹ca do zaokr¹glania liczby do zadanej dok³adoci

 numIn - zaokr¹glana liczba
 roundTo - dok³adnoæ
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

function RoundTo(numIn, roundTo)
 	local count = floor(abs(numIn / roundTo))
	if (abs(numIn) - roundTo * count) / roundTo >= 0.5 then count = count + 1 end
	return roundTo * count * numIn / abs(numIn)
end

				if type(fields) ~= "table" or getn(fields) == 0 then

			end
		end
	end

function RotatePoint2D(x, y, angle, x0, y0)
	if x0 then
	    x = x - x0
	end
	if y0 then
   		y = y - y0
	end

	x = x * cos(angle) - y * sin(angle)
    y = y * sin(angle) + y * cos(angle)

	if x0 then
	    x = x + x0
	end
	if y0 then
   		y = y + y0
	end

	return x, y
end


function RotatePoint(point, angle, point0)
	if point0 then
    	point.x = point.x - point0.x
    	point.y = point.y - point0.y
    end

	local newPoint = {}
	newPoint.x = point.x * cos(angle) - point.y * sin(angle)
    newPoint.y = point.x * sin(angle) + point.y * cos(angle)

	if point0 then
	    newPoint.x = newPoint.x + point0.x
    	newPoint.y = newPoint.y + point0.y
    end

	return newPoint
end


function RotatePoint3D(point, angle, point0)
	local newPoint = RotatePoint({x = point.x, y = point.z}, angle, {x = point0.x, y = point0.z})
	newPoint.z = newPoint.y
	newPoint.y = point.y
	return newPoint
end

	local vadd = {}
	vadd.y = 0
	vadd.z = sin(angle) * dist
	vadd.x = cos(angle) * dist
	return VectorAdd(point, vadd)
end

							iHeight = tonumber(strsub(imageName, h1, h2))
						end
						imageName = strsub(imageName, 1, w1 - 2)
					end
					local image = CreateSprite(imageName)
					ReloadAllTextures()
					if not iWidth then
						iWidth = SprWidth(image, 0)
					end
					if not iHeight then
						iHeight = SprHeight(image, 0)
					end
					tinsert(newTab[last], {type = "image", image = image, color = color, colorTab = colorTab, width = iWidth, height = iHeight})
				end
				if funcName then
					local w1, w2, h1, h2
					local fWidth, fHeight, param = 0, 0, ""
					local paramPos = strfind(funcName, "/")
					if paramPos then
						w1 = strfind(funcName, "/", paramPos + 1)
						local paramPos2
						if w1 then
							paramPos2 = w1 - 1
						else
							paramPos2 = strlen(funcName)
						end
						param = strsub(funcName, paramPos + 1, paramPos2)
					end
					if w1 and w1 < strlen(funcName) then
						w1 = w1 + 1
						w2 = strfind(funcName, ",", w1 + 1)
						if not w2 then
							w2 = strlen(funcName)
						else
							h1 = w2 + 1
							w2 = w2 - 1
							if h1 < strlen(funcName) then
								h2 = strlen(funcName)
							else
								 h1 = nil
							end
						end
					else
						w1 = nil
					end
					if w1 then
						fWidth = tonumber(strsub(funcName, w1, w2))
						if h1 then
							fHeight = tonumber(strsub(funcName, h1, h2))
						end
					end
					if paramPos then
						funcName = strsub(funcName, 1, paramPos - 1)
					end
					tinsert(newTab[last], {type = "func", func = funcName, param = param, width = fWidth, height = fHeight})
				end
				if strlen(line) > 0 then
					tinsert(newTab[last], {type = "text", line = line, color = color, colorTab = colorTab})
				end
				imageName = nil
				funcName = nil
				if img then
                   	shiftPos = newPosImage2 - newPosImage
                   	imageName = strsub(text[i], newPosImage + strlen(imageChar), newPosImage2 - 1)
					add = ""
				elseif func then
                   	shiftPos = newPosFunc2 - newPosFunc
                   	funcName = strsub(text[i], newPosFunc + strlen(funcChar), newPosFunc2 - 1)
					add = ""
				elseif newPos then
                    if strsub(text[i], newPos + strlen(colorChar) + 1, newPos + 2 * strlen(colorChar)) ~= colorChar then
                    	shiftPos = 8
                    	color, colorTab = DecodeColor(strsub(text[i], newPos + strlen(colorChar), newPos + strlen(colorChar) + 7))
						add = ""
                	else
           				shiftPos = strlen(colorChar)
        	   			add = colorChar
    	            end
				end
			until not newPos and not img and not func
		end
	end
	return newTab
end


function WrapString(font, wFont, fontSpace, line, maxLenght, partWord)
	local s1, s2, pos, newPos = line, "", 1, nil
	if maxLenght then
		if GetTextWidth(font, fontSpace, line) * wFont <= maxLenght then
			return line, ""
		end
		s1 = ""
		repeat
			newPos = strfind(line, " ", pos)
			if newPos and GetTextWidth(font, fontSpace, strsub(line, 1, newPos - 1)) * wFont <= maxLenght then
				s1 = strsub(line, 1, newPos - 1)
				if newPos < strlen(line) then
					s2 = strsub(line, newPos + 1)
					pos = newPos + 1
				else
					s2 = ""
					newPos = nil
				end
			else
				newPos = nil
			end
		until not newPos
		if strlen(s1) == 0 and partWord then
			pos = 0
        	repeat
        		pos = pos + 1
				s1 = strsub(line, 1, pos)
        	until GetTextWidth(font, fontSpace, s1) * wFont > maxLenght
        	if strlen(s1) > 1 then
				s1 = strsub(line, 1, pos - 1)
				s2 = strsub(line, pos)
			else
				s2 = strsub(line, pos + 1)
        	end
		end
	end
	return s1, s2
end


function AddLineInfo(newTab, last, lineWidth, lineHeight)
	if last > 0 then
		newTab[last].lineWidth = lineWidth
		newTab[last].lineHeight = lineHeight
	end
end


function NewGroup(newTab, last, lineWidth, lineHeight)
	AddLineInfo(newTab, last, lineWidth, lineHeight)
	tinsert(newTab, {})
	last = getn(newTab)
	lineWidth = 0
	lineHeight = 0
	return last, lineWidth, lineHeight
end


function AddToGroup(element, newTab, last, lineWidth, lineHeight, font, wFont, hFont, fontSpace)
	if element.type == "image" or element.type == "func" then
		tinsert(newTab[last], CloneLuaObject(element))
		lineWidth = lineWidth + element.width
		if lineHeight < element.height then
			lineHeight = element.height
		end

	elseif element.type == "text" then
		element.width = GetTextWidth(font, fontSpace, element.line) * wFont
		tinsert(newTab[last], CloneLuaObject(element))
		lineWidth = lineWidth + element.width
		local eH = GetFontHeight(font) * hFont
		if lineHeight < eH then
			lineHeight = eH
		end
	end
	return lineWidth, lineHeight
end


function AddPageInfo(pageTab, lastPage, pageHeight)
	if lastPage > 0 then
		pageTab[lastPage].pageHeight = pageHeight
	end
end


function NewPage(pageTab, lastPage, pageHeight)
	AddPageInfo(pageTab, lastPage, pageHeight)
	tinsert(pageTab, {})
	lastPage = getn(pageTab)
	pageHeight = 0
	pageTab[lastPage].pageWidth = 0
	return lastPage, pageHeight
end


function AddToPage(element, pageTab, lastPage, pageHeight, lineSpace)
	tinsert(pageTab[lastPage], CloneLuaObject(element))
	if getn(pageTab[lastPage]) > 1 then
		pageHeight = pageHeight + element.lineHeight + lineSpace
	else
		pageHeight = pageHeight + element.lineHeight
	end
	pageTab[lastPage].pageWidth = max(pageTab[lastPage].pageWidth, element.lineWidth)
	return pageHeight
end


function SetAdvancedBlockText(font, x, y, wFont, hFont, fontSpace, lineSpace, advencedText, wBlock, hBlock, align)
	local newTab = {}
	local last, s1, s2, lineWidth, lineHeight = 0

	for i = 1, getn(advencedText) do //ustalanie d³ugoci i wysokoci linii oraz zawaijanie
		local v = advencedText[i]
		last, lineWidth, lineHeight = NewGroup(newTab, last, lineWidth, lineHeight)
		for j = 1, getn(v) do
			local w = v[j]
            if w.type == "image" or w.type == "func" then
				if wBlock and lineWidth + w.width > wBlock and lineWidth > 0 then
					last, lineWidth, lineHeight = NewGroup(newTab, last, lineWidth, lineHeight)
				end
				lineWidth, lineHeight = AddToGroup(w, newTab, last, lineWidth, lineHeight, font, wFont, hFont, fontSpace)

            elseif w.type == "text" then
               	local object1 = CloneLuaObject(w)
               	local object2 = nil
               	repeat
              		s1, s2 = WrapString(font, wFont, fontSpace, object1.line, wBlock and wBlock - lineWidth or nil, lineWidth == 0 and 1 or nil)
               		if strlen(s2) > 0 then
	   					object2 = CloneLuaObject(object1)
    					if strlen(s1) > 0 then
	   						object2.line = s1
							lineWidth, lineHeight = AddToGroup(object2, newTab, last, lineWidth, lineHeight, font, wFont, hFont, fontSpace)
						end
						object2 = nil
						last, lineWidth, lineHeight = NewGroup(newTab, last, lineWidth, lineHeight)
    					object1.line = s2
               		elseif s1 == object1.line then
						lineWidth, lineHeight = AddToGroup(object1, newTab, last, lineWidth, lineHeight, font, wFont, hFont, fontSpace)
					else
						last, lineWidth, lineHeight = NewGroup(newTab, last, lineWidth, lineHeight)
               		end
               	until strlen(s2) == 0 and s1 == object1.line
           		object1 = nil
            end
		end
		AddLineInfo(newTab, last, lineWidth, lineHeight)
	end

	local lastPage, pageHeight = 0
	tabOut = {}
	lastPage, pageHeight = NewPage(tabOut, lastPage, pageHeight)
	for i = 1, getn(newTab) do
		local v = newTab[i]
   		if not hBlock or pageHeight + v.lineHeight < hBlock or getn(tabOut[lastPage]) == 0 then
			pageHeight = AddToPage(v, tabOut, lastPage, pageHeight, lineSpace)
   		else
			lastPage, pageHeight = NewPage(tabOut, lastPage, pageHeight)
			pageHeight = AddToPage(v, tabOut, lastPage, pageHeight, lineSpace)
   		end
	end
	AddPageInfo(tabOut, lastPage, pageHeight)

	// ustalenie wartoci x, y na ekranie oraz szerokoci stron
	local hShift, wShift
	for i = 1, getn(tabOut) do //storny
		v = tabOut[i]
		if type(v) == "table" then
			//print("storna")
			hShift = 0
			for j = 1, getn(v) do //linie
				w = v[j]
				if type(w) == "table" then
					//print("linia")
					if align == "right" then
						wShift = v.pageWidth - w.lineWidth
					elseif align == "center" then
						wShift = (v.pageWidth - w.lineWidth) * 0.5
					else
						wShift = 0
					end
					for k = 1, getn(w) do //elemety
						u = w[k]
						if type(u) == "table" then
							//print("element")
							u.x = x + wShift
				            if u.type == "text" then
	                           	u.y = ScreenHeight() - (y + hShift + GetFontHeight(font) * hFont)
            				elseif u.type == "image" then
	                           	u.y = ScreenHeight() - (y + hShift + SprHeight(u.image, 0))
            				elseif u.type == "func" then
	                           	u.y = ScreenHeight() - (y + hShift + u.height)
            				end
							wShift = wShift + u.width
						end
					end
					hShift = hShift + w.lineHeight + lineSpace
				end
			end
		end
	end
	//ShowObjectData(tabOut)
	return tabOut
end


function CountPagesAdvancedText(advencedText)
	local pages = 0
	for i, v in advencedText do //storny
		if type(v) == "table" then
			pages = pages + 1
		end
	end
	return pages
end


function DrawAdvancedBlockText(font, addx, addy, wFont, hFont, fontSpace, advencedText, page, alpha)
	local pages = CountPagesAdvancedText(advencedText)
	if pages < 1 then
		return
	end
	if not page or page > pages then
		page = 1
	end
	local v = advencedText[page]
	if alpha then
		alpha = min(alpha, 1)
	end
	for j, w in v do //linie
		if j ~= "n" and type(w) == "table" then
			for k, u in w do //elementy linii
				if k ~= "n" and type(u) == "table" then
		            if u.type == "text" then
						DrawText(font, Vector(u.x + addx, u.y - addy, 0), wFont, hFont, fontSpace, alpha and RGBA(u.colorTab.r, u.colorTab.g, u.colorTab.b, u.colorTab.a * alpha) or u.color, u.line)
        			elseif u.type == "image" then
						SprSetCurrentFrame(u.image, 0)
						DrawRectangle(Vector(u.x + addx, u.y - addy, 0), SprWidth(u.image, 0), SprHeight(u.image, 0), /*u.color*/ alpha and RGBA(1, 1, 1, u.colorTab.a * alpha) or RGBA(1,1,1,1))
        			elseif u.type == "func" then
                        dostring(format("%s(%d,%d,%d,%d,%s)", u.func, u.x + addx, u.y - addy, u.width, u.height, u.param))
                        //print(format("%s(%d,%d,%d,%d,%s)", u.func, u.x + addx, u.y - addy, u.width, u.height, u.param))
       				end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end


function CountLettersAdvancedText(advencedText, page)
	local len = 0
	local pages = CountPagesAdvancedText(advencedText)
	if pages < 1 then
		return
	end
	if not page or page > pages then
		page = 1
	end
	local v = advencedText[page]
	for j, w in v do //linie
		if j ~= "n" and type(w) == "table" then
			for k, u in w do //elementy linii
				if k ~= "n" and type(u) == "table" then
		            if u.type == "text" then
                        len = len + SLen(u.line)
       				end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return len
end

function Rect(left, top, right, bottom)
	return {left = left, top = top, right = right, bottom = bottom}
end

function RectOK(rect)
	if type(rect) ~= "table" then
		return
	end
	if rect.left and rect.top and rect.right and rect.bottom then
		return 1
	end
end

function DrawBar(rect, color)
    DrawRectangle(Vector(rect.left, ScreenHeight() - rect.bottom - 1, 0), rect.right - rect.left + 1, rect.bottom - rect.top + 1, color)
end


function DrawRect(rect, color)
    local v1 = Vector(rect.left, ScreenHeight() - rect.top, 0)
    local v2 = Vector(rect.right, ScreenHeight() - rect.top, 0)
    local v3 = Vector(rect.right, ScreenHeight() - rect.bottom, 0)
    local v4 = Vector(rect.left, ScreenHeight() - rect.bottom, 0)
    DrawLine(v1, v2, color)
    DrawLine(v2, v3, color)
    DrawLine(v3, v4, color)
    DrawLine(v4, v1, color)
end


function VecToStr(vec)
	return "Vector("..vec.x..", "..vec.y..", "..vec.z..")"
end


function VecMod(vec, x, y, z)
	local v = CloneLuaObject(vec)
	if x then
		v.x = v.x + x
	end
	if x then
		v.y = v.y + y
	end
	if x then
		v.z = v.z + z
	end
	return v
end

/*#############################################################################

guiMsgBox (proces GUI)

#############################################################################*/

guiMsgBox = {
    font = nil,
    item = nil,
	head_icon = nil,
	line_icon = nil,
	end_icon = nil,

	box_left = nil,
	box_top = nil,

	key1x = nil,

	box_h_l = 25, -- wysokoæ jednej linii opisu

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
guiMsgBox:Init()
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

function guiMsgBox:Init()
    //self.font = gui.fontSmall
    self.font = gui.fontBigFunny
    self.fontSize = 0.4
    self.fontDist = -7
/*
	self.head_icon = CreateSprite("data\\bitmap\\GuiMsgBox\\headline")
	self.line_icon = CreateSprite("data\\bitmap\\GuiMsgBox\\line")
	self.end_icon = CreateSprite("data\\bitmap\\GuiMsgBox\\endline")

*/

function guiMsgBox:CanStart(param)
	return not FindTask("Task_TheEnd")
end


/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
guiMsgBox:Start(param)
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

function guiMsgBox:Start(param)
	self.head_icon = CreateSprite("data\\bitmap\\GuiMsgBox\\headline")
	self.line_icon = CreateSprite("data\\bitmap\\GuiMsgBox\\line")
	self.end_icon = CreateSprite("data\\bitmap\\GuiMsgBox\\endline")
	self.keyOn_icon = CreateSprite("data\\bitmap\\GuiMsgBox\\keyon")
	self.keyOff_icon = CreateSprite("data\\bitmap\\GuiMsgBox\\keyoff")
	self.keyOff2_icon = CreateSprite("data\\bitmap\\GuiMsgBox\\keyoff2")
	ReloadAllTextures()

	message, self.soundId = hudMessage:FindSound(param.message, 1)
	self.message = WrapWords(self.font, self.fontSize, self.fontDist, CutString(message), self.box_w_noShadow - 2 * self.leftMargin)
	self.title = param.title

	local keys = param.keys

	self.box_h = self.box_h_hl + self.box_h_el
    for i, v in self.message do
        if i ~= "n" then
			self.box_h = self.box_h + self.box_h_l
        end
    end

	self.box_left = (ScreenWidth() - self.box_w_noShadow) * 0.5
	self.box_top = ScreenHeight() * 0.5 + self.box_h * 0.5

    local n = getn(keys)
    local keysw = self.keyWidth * n
    local dist = max(self.box_w_noShadow - keysw, 0)
    local dist1 = dist / (n + 1)
    local left = self.box_left + min((self.box_w_noShadow - keysw) * 0.5, 0)
   	local y = ScreenHeight() - (self.box_top - (self.box_h - self.box_h_el + self.box_h_add) - (self.box_h_el - self.box_h_add - self.keyHeight) * 0.5)
    for i = 1, n do
    	local v = keys[i]
    	v.id = i
    	local x = left + dist1 + (dist1 + self.keyWidth) * (i - 1)
    	v.rect = {left = x, right = x + self.keyWidth - 1, top = y, bottom = y + self.keyHeight - 1}
    end

	self.keys = keys

	self.keyOn = nil
	self.mouseOverKey = nil

	self.asUpdate = gui.asUpdateKeep
	gui.asUpdateKeep = nil

	self.stopGame = param.stopGame
	if self.stopGame then
	    self.stopFrameMode = StopFrameMode()
    	StopFrameMode(1)
    	self.tasksEnabled = TasksEnabled()
    	EnableTasks(0)
	end
	self.hudRender = hudMessage.render
	hudMessage.render = nil
	self.hudUpdate = hudMessage.update
	hudMessage.update = nil
end


/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
guiMsgBox:Stop()
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function guiMsgBox:Stop()
	self.head_icon = nil
	self.line_icon = nil
	self.end_icon = nil
	self.keyOn_icon = nil
	self.keyOff_icon = nil
	self.keyOff2_icon = nil
	gui.asUpdateKeep = self.asUpdate
	if self.stopGame then
	    StopFrameMode(self.stopFrameMode and self.stopFrameMode or 0)
    	EnableTasks(self.tasksEnabled and self.tasksEnabled or 0)
	end
	hudMessage.render = self.hudRender
	hudMessage.update = self.hudUpdate
	if self.soundId and IsPlaying(self.soundId) then
		StopSound(self.soundId)
	end
	self.soundId = nil
end


/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
guiMsgBox:Update()
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function guiMsgBox:Update()
	local mx, my = MouseGetXY()
	gui:MouseCursor("normal")

	for i, v in self.keys do
		if i ~= "n" then
			if v.key and KbdStruck(v.key) then
				gui:StopProcess()
				if self.keys[v.id].func then
					if self.keys[v.id].global then
						local func = self.keys[v.id].func
						func(self.keys[v.id].funcParam)
					else
						self.keys[v.id]:func(self.keys[v.id].funcParam)
					end
				end
				self.keys = nil
				return
			end
		end
	end

	self.mouseOverKey = nil
	for i, v in self.keys do
		if i ~= "n" then
			if InsideRect(mx, my, v.rect) then
				self.mouseOverKey = v.id
				gui:MouseCursor("select")
				break
			end
		end
	end

	if MouseStruck("lbutton") then
		self.keyOn = self.mouseOverKey
	end

	if not MouseIs("lbutton") and self.keyOn then
		if self.mouseOverKey == self.keyOn then
			gui:StopProcess()
			if self.keys[self.keyOn].func then
				if self.keys[self.keyOn].global then
					local func = self.keys[self.keyOn].func
					func(self.keys[self.keyOn].funcParam)
				else
					self.keys[self.keyOn]:func(self.keys[self.keyOn].funcParam)
				end
			end
			self.keys = nil
		end
		self.keyOn = nil
	end
end


/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
guiMsgBox:Render()
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function guiMsgBox:Render()

    SprSetCurrentFrame(self.head_icon, 0)
	DrawRectangle(Vector(self.box_left, self.box_top - SprHeight(self.head_icon, 0), 0), SprWidth(self.head_icon, 0), SprHeight(self.head_icon, 0), RGBA(1,1,1,1))

    if self.fontSize ~= 1 then SetRenderState("tf1") end
	DrawText(self.font, Vector(self.box_left + (self.box_w_noShadow - GetTextWidth(self.font, self.fontDist,self.title) * self.fontSize) / 2, self.box_top - GetFontHeight(self.font) * self.fontSize * 0.5 - self.box_m_hl, 0), self.fontSize, self.fontSize, self.fontDist, RGBA(0.9, 0.9, 0.8), self.title)
    if self.fontSize ~= 1 then SetRenderState("tf0") end

	local numLine = 0
    for i, v in self.message do
        if i ~= "n" then
			numLine = numLine + 1
		    SprSetCurrentFrame(self.line_icon, 0)
			DrawRectangle(Vector(self.box_left, self.box_top - self.box_h_hl - self.box_h_l * (numLine - 1) - SprHeight(self.line_icon, 0), 0), SprWidth(self.line_icon, 0), SprHeight(self.line_icon, 0), RGBA(1,1,1,1))
		    if self.fontSize ~= 1 then SetRenderState("tf1") end
			DrawText(self.font, Vector(self.box_left + self.leftMargin, self.box_top - self.box_h_hl - self.box_h_l * numLine + (self.box_h_l - GetFontHeight(self.font) * self.fontSize) / 2, 0), self.fontSize, self.fontSize, self.fontDist, RGBA(0.8, 0.8, 0.7), v)
		    if self.fontSize ~= 1 then SetRenderState("tf0") end
        end
    end

	SprSetCurrentFrame(self.end_icon, 0)
	DrawRectangle(Vector(self.box_left, self.box_top - self.box_h_hl - self.box_h_l * numLine - SprHeight(self.end_icon, 0), 0), SprWidth(self.end_icon, 0), SprHeight(self.end_icon, 0), RGBA(1,1,1,1))

	for i, v in self.keys do
		if i ~= "n" then
			if self.mouseOverKey == v.id and self.keyOn == v.id then
				SprSetCurrentFrame(self.keyOn_icon, 0)
				DrawRectangle(Vector(v.rect.left, ScreenHeight() - v.rect.bottom, 0), SprWidth(self.keyOn_icon, 0), SprHeight(self.keyOn_icon, 0), RGBA(1,1,1,1))
			    if self.fontSize ~= 1 then SetRenderState("tf1") end
	    		DrawText(self.font, Vector(v.rect.left + (self.keyWidth - GetTextWidth(self.font, self.fontDist, v.caption) * self.fontSize) * 0.5 + 2, ScreenHeight() - v.rect.bottom + (self.keyHeight - GetFontHeight(self.font) * self.fontSize) * 0.5 - 2, 0), self.fontSize, self.fontSize, self.fontDist, RGBA(0.7, 0.7, 0.6), v.caption)
			    if self.fontSize ~= 1 then SetRenderState("tf0") end

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------

Zarzadzanie procesami

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- gui:StartProcess(proc, callProc, parameter)
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function gui:StartProcess(proc, callProc, parameter)
	local canStart = 1
	for i=1, getn(self.procStack) - 1 do
		if self.procStack[i] == callProc or self.procStack[i] == proc then
			canStart = nil
			break
		end
	end
	if canStart and ((getn(self.procStack) > 0 and self.procStack[getn(self.procStack)] == proc) or (proc.CanStart and not proc:CanStart(parameter))) then
		canStart = nil
	end
	if canStart then
		if getn(self.procStack) > 0 then  self.procStack[getn(self.procStack)].onTop = nil  end  -- kasowanie flagi active staremu procesowi
		proc.onTop = 1 -- ustawianie flagi onTop nowemu procesowi
		proc.active = 1 -- ustawianie flagi active nowemu procesowi
		self.topProcess = proc
		proc.__previousFirstRenderedProcess__ = self.firstRenderedProcess
		tinsert(self.procStack, proc)
    	if proc.Start then proc:Start(parameter) end  -- jesli istnieje funkcja startujaca proces, to jest uruchamiana
    	return 1
    end
end

function StartGui(proc, callProc, parameter)
	gui:StartProcess(proc, callProc, parameter)
end


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- gui:StartKeyProcess(proc, callProc, parameter)
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function gui:StartKeyProcess(proc, callProc, parameter)
	if self:StartProcess(proc, callProc, parameter) then
		self.firstRenderedProcess = proc
		return 1
	end
end


function gui:SetKeyLastProcess()
	self.firstRenderedProcess = self.procStack[getn(self.procStack)]
end


function gui:ClearKeyLastProcess()
	self.firstRenderedProcess = self.procStack[getn(self.procStack)].__previousFirstRenderedProcess__
end


function StartKeyGui(proc, callProc, parameter)
	gui:StartKeyProcess(proc, callProc, parameter)
end


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- gui:StopProcess(parameter)
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function gui:StopProcess(parameter)
	if getn(self.procStack) > 0 then
		local proc = self.procStack[getn(self.procStack)]
		if proc.Stop then  -- jesli istnieje funkcja zatrzymujaca proces, to jest uruchamiana
			proc:Stop(parameter)
		end
		self.firstRenderedProcess = proc.__previousFirstRenderedProcess__
		proc.active = nil  -- kasowanie flagi active staremu procesowi
		proc.onTop = nil  -- kasowanie flagi onTop staremu procesowi
		tremove(self.procStack)
		if getn(self.procStack) > 0 then
			self.procStack[getn(self.procStack)].onTop = 1
			self.topProcess = self.procStack[getn(self.procStack)]
		end  -- ustawianie flagi active nowemu procesowi
	end
end

function StopGui(parameter)
	gui:StopProcess(parameter)
end

function gui:ProcessIsRendering(proc)
	if proc.__previousFirstRenderedProcess__ == self.firstRenderedProcess then
		return 1
	end
end

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
