Podobnie jak Add, ale komunikat jest tylko do testów, nie bêdzie siê pojawia³
w ostatecznej wersji gry.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

function hudMessage:AddDev(message)
	--dprint("hudmsg: added")
	tinsert(self.console.data, message)
	while getn(self.console.data) > self.console.cntMax do
		tremove(self.console.data, 1)
		--dprint("hudmsg: removed")
	end
	self.console.timer = self.console.textDelay * 30
end

function hudMessage:FindSound(msg, play)
	local str = nil
	local k = nil
	local i = nil
	i = strfind(msg, "<", 1, 1)
	if i then
		k = strfind(msg, ">", i+1, 1)
		if k then
			str = strsub (msg, i , k)
			msg = gsub (msg, str, "")
			str = gsub (str, "<", "")
			str = gsub (str, ">", "")
		end
	end
	if play then
		return msg, str and PlaySound(str, 10) or nil
	else
		return msg, str
	end
	//return msg, play and PlaySound(str) or str
end

function hudMessage:AddText(_text, time)
	local soundId
	_text, soundId = self:FindSound(_text, 1)
	//print("Add text:  ", _text)
/*
	local textId = self:IsText()
	if textId then
		self:Delete(textId)

	hudMessage:DeleteTexts()

	local d = {}
	d.soundId = soundId

		time = 1
	else
		text = MakeAdvancedBlockText(CutString(_text))
		text = SetAdvancedBlockText(self.textFont, 0, 0, self.textFontSize, self.textFontSize, self.textFontSpace, self.textLineSpace, text, ScreenWidth() - self.textWindowMargin * 2 - self.textMargin * 2, nil, "center")
		local h = max(text[1].pageHeight + self.textMargin * 2, 80)
		local w = max(text[1].pageWidth + self.textMargin * 2, 300)

		d.text = text
		d.rect = Rect((ScreenWidth() - w) * 0.5, ScreenHeight() - self.textWindowMarginDown - h + 1, (ScreenWidth() - w) * 0.5 + w, ScreenHeight() - self.textWindowMarginDown)
		d.x = d.rect.left + (w - text[1].pageWidth) * 0.5
		d.y = d.rect.top + (h - text[1].pageHeight) * 0.5
	end

	d.timer = 0
	d.alphaMax = maxAlpha or 1
	if not time then
		local len = CountLettersAdvancedText(text)
		//print(len)
		d.visibleTime = 30 + (len * 0.1 * 30)
		//d.visibleTime = 3 * 30
	else
		d.visibleTime = time * 30
	end
	d.id = self.nextId
	self.nextId = self.nextId + 1
	tinsert(self.big, d)
	return d.id
end

	d.alphaMax = maxAlpha or 1
	if noBump then
		d.bumpy = nil
	else
		d.bumpy = 1
	end
	d.id = self.nextId
	self.nextId = self.nextId + 1
	tinsert(self.big, d)

function hudMessage:Delete(id)

			if v.soundId and IsPlaying(v.soundId) then
                StopSound(v.soundId)
            end
			v.visibleTime = v.timer + 14
		end
	end
end


function hudMessage:DeleteAll()
	for i, v in self.big do
		if i ~= "n" and v.visibleTime - v.timer > 14 then

                StopSound(v.soundId)

	end

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

function hudMessage:Update(onlyConsole)
	if not hudMessage.update then
		return
	end
	-- console
	if self.console.timer > 0 then
		self.console.timer = self.console.timer - 1
	else
		if getn(self.console.data) > 0 then
			--dprint("hudmsg: cleared")
			self.console.data = {}
		end
	end

	-- regular
	if not onlyConsole and getn(self.big) > 0 then
		local delete = 1

		local toRemove = {}
		for i, v in self.big do
			if i ~= "n" then
               	if v.soundId then
               		if IsPlaying(v.soundId) then
               			if v.timer > v.visibleTime - 16 then
               				v.timer = v.visibleTime - 16
               			end
               		else
               			if v.timer < v.visibleTime - 15 then
               				v.timer = v.visibleTime - 14
               			end
               		end
               	end
				if v.timer < v.visibleTime then
					delete = nil
					v.timer = v.timer + 1

					if v.bumpy then
						if v.timer == 15 then
							--v.y = v.y + v.vel
							v.vel = 3
							--PlaySound("ui\\hudmsg.wav")
						elseif v.timer < 22 or v.timer > v.visibleTime - 15 then
							v.y = v.y + v.vel
							v.vel = v.vel + v.acc
						elseif v.timer == 22 then
							v.vel = 0
							v.acc = -0.5
							--PlaySound("ui\\hudmsg.wav")
						end
					end
				else
					tinsert(toRemove, v)
				end
			end
		end
		RemoveTabFromTab(toRemove, self.big)

		if delete then
			self.big = {}
		end
	end
end


/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
hudMessage:Render()

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

function hudMessage:Render(onlyConsole)
	if not hudMessage.render then
		return
	end
	if self.console.timer > 0 or getn(self.big) > 0 then
		HUDBegin()
		SetBlending("sa 1-sa")
		SetRenderState("tf0")

		if self.console.timer > 0 then
			local lineHeight = GetFontHeight(gui.fontSmall) * 1.0
			local x = 0
			local y = 10
			local alpha = 1.0
			if self.console.timer < self.console.fadeTime then
				alpha = alpha * self.console.timer / self.console.fadeTime
			end

			for i = 1, getn(self.console.data) do
				x = (ScreenWidth() - GetTextWidth(gui.fontSmall, -2, self.console.data[i])) / 2
				DrawText(gui.fontSmall, Vector(x, y, 0), 1, 1, -2, RGBA(1, 1, 1, alpha), self.console.data[i])
				y = y + lineHeight
			end
		end

		SetRenderState("tf1")

		if not onlyConsole and getn(self.big) > 0 then
			HUDBegin()
			SetBlending("sa 1-sa")

			local alpha

			for i, v in self.big do
				if i ~= "n" then
					alpha = v.alphaMax
					if v.timer < 15 then
						alpha = alpha * v.timer / 15
					end

					if v.timer > v.visibleTime - 15 then
						alpha = alpha * (v.visibleTime - v.timer) / 15
					end
					alpha = min(alpha, 1)
					if v.message then
						//DrawText(gui.fontBig, Vector(v.x, v.y, 0), v.scale, v.scale, -10, RGBA(1,1,1, alpha), v.message)
						//DrawBlockText(gui.fontBigFunny, v.x, ScreenHeight() - v.y, v.scale, v.scale, -7, -5, v.message, RGBA(1,1,1, alpha), 0, nil, 1, "left")
						SetRenderState("tf1")
						DrawAdvancedBlockText(gui.fontBigFunny, v.x, ScreenHeight() - v.y, v.scale, v.scale, self.textFontSpace, v.message, 1, alpha)
						SetRenderState("tf0")
					elseif v.text then
						if v.text ~= 1 then
							SprSetCurrentFrame()
							DrawBar(v.rect, RGBA(0,0,0,0.5 * alpha))
							SetRenderState("tf1")
							DrawAdvancedBlockText(self.textFont, v.x, v.y, self.textFontSize, self.textFontSize, self.textFontSpace, v.text, 1, alpha)
							SetRenderState("tf0")
						end
					elseif v.image then
						SprSetCurrentFrame(v.image, 0)
						DrawRectangle(Vector(v.x, v.y, 0), v.scale*v.w, v.scale*v.h, RGBA(1,1,1, alpha))
						--print(alpha, " ", v.x, " ",  v.y, " ",  v.w, " ",  v.h)
					end
				end
			end
		end

		SetBlending("1 0")
		HUDEnd()
	end
end

-- CloneLuaObject
---------------------------------------------------------------------
function CloneLuaObject(template)
    local newObject = {}                    -- creates a new object
    local i, v = next(template, nil)        -- gets first index of "template" and its value
    while i do
        if type(v) == "table" then          -- store them in new table
            newObject[i] = CloneLuaObject(v)
        else
            newObject[i] = v
        end
        i, v = next(template, i)            -- get next index and its value
    end
    return newObject
end

function ShowObjectData(template, indent)
    local i, v = next(template, nil)        -- gets first index of "template" and its value

	local ind = indent or ""
    while i do
        vtype = type(v)
        if vtype == "nil" then
            print(ind..i.." : NIL")
        elseif vtype == "number" then
            print(ind..i.." : "..v.." : NUMBER")
        elseif vtype == "string" then
            print(ind..i.." : '"..v.."' : STRING")
        elseif vtype == "table" then

        elseif vtype == "function" then

        elseif vtype == "userdata" then
            print(ind..i.." : USERDATA")
        end
        i, v = next(template, i)            -- get next index and its value
    end
end

-- SaveVariable
---------------------------------------------------------------------
function SaveVariable(n,v)
    if v == nil then return end
    if type(v)=="userdata" or type(v)=="function" then return end
    -- if type(v)=="userdata" or type(v)=="function" then write("\t-- ") end
    write(n,"=")
    if type(v) == "string" then
        write(format("%q",v))
    elseif type(v) == "table" then
        if v.__visited__ ~= nil then
           write(v.__visited__)
        else
            write("{}\n")
            v.__visited__ = n
            for r,f in v do
                if r ~= "__visited__" then
                    if type(r) == 'string' then
                        SaveVariable(n.."."..r,f)
                    else
                        SaveVariable(n.."["..r.."]",f)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    else
        write(tostring(v))
    end
    write("\n")
end

    foreach(globals(), SaveVariable)

/*#############################################################################

hudMessage

Modu³ wywietlaj¹cy komunikaty na ekranie, z prostym kolejkowaniem.

#############################################################################*/

hudMessage = {
	console = {
		cntMax = 6,  -- ile maksymalnie mo¿e byæ komunikatów na ekranie
		textDelay = 6, -- czas (w sekundach) przez jaki komunikat jest widoczny na ekranie
		fadeTime = 15, -- jak szybki bêdzie efekt wygasania tekstu (im mniejsza wartoæ tym szybciej)
		timer = 0,
		data = { }
	},
	big = {	},
	nextId = 1,
	update = 1,
	render = 1,
	textFont = _fonts.bigFunny,
	textFontSize = 0.55,
	textFontSpace = -6,
	textLineSpace = -4,
	textWindowMargin = 80,
	textWindowMarginDown = 140,
	textMargin = 30,
}


/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
hudMessage:AddDev(message)

Podobnie jak Add, ale komunikat jest tylko do testów, nie bêdzie siê pojawia³
w ostatecznej wersji gry.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

function hudMessage:AddDev(message)
	--dprint("hudmsg: added")
	tinsert(self.console.data, message)
	while getn(self.console.data) > self.console.cntMax do
		tremove(self.console.data, 1)
		--dprint("hudmsg: removed")
	end
	self.console.timer = self.console.textDelay * 30
end

function hudMessage:FindSound(msg, play)
	local str = nil
	local k = nil
	local i = nil
	i = strfind(msg, "<", 1, 1)
	if i then
		k = strfind(msg, ">", i+1, 1)
		if k then
			str = strsub (msg, i , k)
			msg = gsub (msg, str, "")
			str = gsub (str, "<", "")
			str = gsub (str, ">", "")
		end
	end
	if play then
		return msg, str and PlaySound(str, 10) or nil
	else
		return msg, str
	end
	//return msg, play and PlaySound(str) or str
end



/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
hudMessage:Add(message, position)

Dodaje nowy komunikat do kolejki
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

function hudMessage:Add(message, px, py, time, scale, noBump, maxAlpha, maxWidth, align, alignRectW)
	local d = {}
	message, d.soundId = self:FindSound(message, 1)
	d.timer = 0
	d.scale = scale or 1
	//d.x = px or ((ScreenWidth() - GetTextWidth(gui.fontBigFunny, -4, message) * d.scale) / 2)
	//d.y = ScreenHeight() - (py or 450) - GetFontHeight(gui.fontBig) * d.scale
	d.y = ScreenHeight() - (py or 450)
	d.vel = 14
	d.acc = -2
	//d.message = message
	local text = MakeAdvancedBlockText(CutString(message))
	d.message = SetAdvancedBlockText(gui.fontBigFunny, 0, 0, d.scale, d.scale, self.textFontSpace, self.textLineSpace, text, maxWidth and maxWidth or ScreenWidth(), nil, align and align or "left")
/*
	if maxWidth then
        d.message = WrapWords(gui.fontBigFunny, d.scale, -4, CutString(message), maxWidth)
	else
		d.message = CutString(message)
	end
*/
	if alignRectW == "left" then
		d.x = px and px or 0
	elseif alignRectW == "right" then
		d.x = px and (ScreenWidth() - d.message[1].pageWidth - px) or (ScreenWidth() - d.message[1].pageWidth)
	elseif px then
		d.x = px
	else
		d.x = (ScreenWidth() - d.message[1].pageWidth) * 0.5
	end

	//d.maxWidth = maxWidth
	d.maxWidth = d.message[1].pageWidth
	if not time then
		d.visibleTime = 3 * 30
	elseif time == 0 then
		d.visibleTime = 24 * 60 * 60 * 30
	else
		d.visibleTime = time * 30
	end
	d.alphaMax = maxAlpha or 1
	if noBump then
		d.bumpy = nil
	else
		d.bumpy = 1
	end
	d.id = self.nextId
	self.nextId = self.nextId + 1
	tinsert(self.big, d)
	return d.id
end

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
hudMessage:AddText(text, time)
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

function hudMessage:AddText(_text, time)
	local soundId
	_text, soundId = self:FindSound(_text, 1)
	//print("Add text:  ", _text)
/*
	local textId = self:IsText()
	if textId then
		self:Delete(textId)
	end
*/
	hudMessage:DeleteTexts()

	local text = MakeAdvancedBlockText(CutString(_text))
	text = SetAdvancedBlockText(self.textFont, 0, 0, self.textFontSize, self.textFontSize, self.textFontSpace, self.textLineSpace, text, ScreenWidth() - self.textWindowMargin * 2 - self.textMargin * 2, nil, "center")

	local h = max(text[1].pageHeight + self.textMargin * 2, 80)
	local w = max(text[1].pageWidth + self.textMargin * 2, 300)

	local d = {}
	d.soundId = soundId
	d.text = text
	d.rect = Rect((ScreenWidth() - w) * 0.5, ScreenHeight() - self.textWindowMarginDown - h + 1, (ScreenWidth() - w) * 0.5 + w, ScreenHeight() - self.textWindowMarginDown)
	d.x = d.rect.left + (w - text[1].pageWidth) * 0.5
	d.y = d.rect.top + (h - text[1].pageHeight) * 0.5
	d.timer = 0
	d.alphaMax = maxAlpha or 1
	if not time then
		local len = CountLettersAdvancedText(text)
		//print(len)
		d.visibleTime = 30 + (len * 0.1 * 30)
		//d.visibleTime = 3 * 30
	else
		d.visibleTime = time * 30
	end
	d.id = self.nextId
	self.nextId = self.nextId + 1
	tinsert(self.big, d)
	return d.id
end

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
hudMessage:IsText()
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function hudMessage:IsText()
	for i, v in self.big do
		if i ~= "n" and v.text then
			return v.id
		end
	end
end

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
hudMessage:DeleteTexts()
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function hudMessage:DeleteTexts()
	for i, v in self.big do
		if i ~= "n" and v.text then
			hudMessage:Delete(v.id)
		end
	end
end

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
hudMessage:IsId()
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function hudMessage:IsId(id)
	for i, v in self.big do
		if i ~= "n" and v.id == id then
			return id
		end
	end
end

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
hudMessage:AddImage(image, px, py, time)

Dodaje nowy komunikat do kolejki
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

function hudMessage:AddImage(image, px, py, time, scale, noBump, maxAlpha)
	local d = {}
	d.image = CreateSprite(image)
	ReloadAllTextures()
	d.w = SprWidth(d.image, 0)
	d.h = SprHeight(d.image, 0)
	d.timer = 0
	d.x = px or ((ScreenWidth() - d.w) / 2)
	d.y = ScreenHeight() - (py or ((ScreenHeight() - d.h)/2)) - d.h
	d.vel = 14
	d.acc = -2
	if not time then
		d.visibleTime = 3 * 30
	elseif time == 0 then
		d.visibleTime = 24 * 60 * 60 * 30
	else
		d.visibleTime = time * 30
	end
	d.scale = scale or 1
	d.alphaMax = maxAlpha or 1
	if noBump then
		d.bumpy = nil
	else
		d.bumpy = 1
	end
	d.id = self.nextId
	self.nextId = self.nextId + 1
	tinsert(self.big, d)
	return d.id
end

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
hudMessage:Delete(id)

Usuwa komunikat
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

function hudMessage:Delete(id)
	for i, v in self.big do
		if i ~= "n" and v.id == id and v.visibleTime - v.timer > 14 then
			if v.soundId and IsPlaying(v.soundId) then
                StopSound(v.soundId)
            end
			v.visibleTime = v.timer + 14
		end
	end
end


function hudMessage:DeleteAll()
	for i, v in self.big do
		if i ~= "n" and v.visibleTime - v.timer > 14 then
			if v.soundId and IsPlaying(v.soundId) then
                StopSound(v.soundId)
            end
			v.visibleTime = v.timer + 14
		end
	end
end


/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
hudMessage:Clear()
Usuwa wszystkie komunikaty
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

function hudMessage:Clear()
	self.big = {}
end



/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
hudMessage:Update()

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

function hudMessage:Update(onlyConsole)
	if not hudMessage.update then
		return
	end
	-- console
	if self.console.timer > 0 then
		self.console.timer = self.console.timer - 1
	else
		if getn(self.console.data) > 0 then
			--dprint("hudmsg: cleared")
			self.console.data = {}
		end
	end

	-- regular
	if not onlyConsole and getn(self.big) > 0 then
		local delete = 1

		local toRemove = {}
		for i, v in self.big do
			if i ~= "n" then
               	if v.soundId then
               		if IsPlaying(v.soundId) then
               			if v.timer > v.visibleTime - 16 then
               				v.timer = v.visibleTime - 16
               			end
               		else
               			if v.timer < v.visibleTime - 15 then
               				v.timer = v.visibleTime - 14
               			end
               		end
               	end
				if v.timer < v.visibleTime then
					delete = nil
					v.timer = v.timer + 1

					if v.bumpy then
						if v.timer == 15 then
							--v.y = v.y + v.vel
							v.vel = 3
							--PlaySound("ui\\hudmsg.wav")
						elseif v.timer < 22 or v.timer > v.visibleTime - 15 then
							v.y = v.y + v.vel
							v.vel = v.vel + v.acc
						elseif v.timer == 22 then
							v.vel = 0
							v.acc = -0.5
							--PlaySound("ui\\hudmsg.wav")
						end
					end
				else
					tinsert(toRemove, v)
				end
			end
		end
		RemoveTabFromTab(toRemove, self.big)

		if delete then
			self.big = {}
		end
	end
end


/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
hudMessage:Render()

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

function hudMessage:Render(onlyConsole)
	if not hudMessage.render then
		return
	end
	if self.console.timer > 0 or getn(self.big) > 0 then
		HUDBegin()
		SetBlending("sa 1-sa")
		SetRenderState("tf0")

		if self.console.timer > 0 then
			local lineHeight = GetFontHeight(gui.fontSmall) * 1.0
			local x = 0
			local y = 10
			local alpha = 1.0
			if self.console.timer < self.console.fadeTime then
				alpha = alpha * self.console.timer / self.console.fadeTime
			end

			for i = 1, getn(self.console.data) do
				x = (ScreenWidth() - GetTextWidth(gui.fontSmall, -2, self.console.data[i])) / 2
				DrawText(gui.fontSmall, Vector(x, y, 0), 1, 1, -2, RGBA(1, 1, 1, alpha), self.console.data[i])
				y = y + lineHeight
			end
		end

		SetRenderState("tf1")

		if not onlyConsole and getn(self.big) > 0 then
			HUDBegin()
			SetBlending("sa 1-sa")

			local alpha

			for i, v in self.big do
				if i ~= "n" then
					alpha = v.alphaMax
					if v.timer < 15 then
						alpha = alpha * v.timer / 15
					end

					if v.timer > v.visibleTime - 15 then
						alpha = alpha * (v.visibleTime - v.timer) / 15
					end
					alpha = min(alpha, 1)
					if v.message then
						//DrawText(gui.fontBig, Vector(v.x, v.y, 0), v.scale, v.scale, -10, RGBA(1,1,1, alpha), v.message)
						//DrawBlockText(gui.fontBigFunny, v.x, ScreenHeight() - v.y, v.scale, v.scale, -7, -5, v.message, RGBA(1,1,1, alpha), 0, nil, 1, "left")
						SetRenderState("tf1")
						DrawAdvancedBlockText(gui.fontBigFunny, v.x, ScreenHeight() - v.y, v.scale, v.scale, self.textFontSpace, v.message, 1, alpha)
						SetRenderState("tf0")
					elseif v.text then
						SprSetCurrentFrame()
						DrawBar(v.rect, RGBA(0,0,0,0.5 * alpha))
						SetRenderState("tf1")
						DrawAdvancedBlockText(self.textFont, v.x, v.y, self.textFontSize, self.textFontSize, self.textFontSpace, v.text, 1, alpha)
						SetRenderState("tf0")
					elseif v.image then
						SprSetCurrentFrame(v.image, 0)
						DrawRectangle(Vector(v.x, v.y, 0), v.scale*v.w, v.scale*v.h, RGBA(1,1,1, alpha))
						--print(alpha, " ", v.x, " ",  v.y, " ",  v.w, " ",  v.h)
					end
				end
			end
		end

		SetBlending("1 0")
		HUDEnd()
	end
end

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
guiSlideShow:Start()
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function guiSlideShow:Start(param)
	//bitmaps, showTime, startFadeTime, func, funcParam, texts
	if not param then
		self.bitmaps = nil
		self.music = nil
		self.stopGame = nil
		self.endFuncGlobal = nil
		self.noStopMusic = nil
	else
		self.bitmaps = param.bitmaps
		self.showTime = param.showTime and param.showTime or self._showTime
		self.startFadeTime = param.startFadeTime and max(param.startFadeTime, 0) or 0
		self.endFunc = param.func
		self.endFuncParam = param.funcParam
		self.endFuncGlobal = param.global
		self.music = param.music
		self.stopGame = param.stopGame
		self.noStopMusic = param.noStopMusic
		self.fadeMusic = param.fadeMusic
	end
	if self.bitmaps then
		if not self.startFadeTime or self.startFadeTime <= 0 then
			gui.fadeScreen = 1
		else
			gui.fadeScreen = 0
		end
		self.stage = 0
		self.stageTime = 0
		self.bitmap = nil
		self.bitmapsCount = getn(self.bitmaps)

       	self.texts = {}
		if param.texts then
			local n = getn(param.texts)
			for i = 1, n do
				local v = param.texts[i]
				if RectOK(v.rect) and v.text then
					local font = v.font and v.font or _fonts.bigFunny
					local fontSize = v.fontSize and v.fontSize or 0.6
					local fontSpace = v.fontSpace and v.fontSpace or -6
					local lineSpace = v.lineSpace and v.lineSpace or -4

					local text, soundName = hudMessage:FindSound(v.text)
					text = MakeAdvancedBlockText(CutString(text))
					text = SetAdvancedBlockText(font, 0, 0, fontSize, fontSize, fontSpace, lineSpace, text, v.rect.right - v.rect.left, v.rect.bottom - v.rect.top, v.align)
					local pageCount = CountPagesAdvancedText(text)
					local textCoords = {}
					for j = 1, pageCount do
						local x = v.rect.left
						if v.rectAlignW == "center" then
							x = v.rect.left + ((v.rect.right - v.rect.left) - text[j].pageWidth) * 0.5
						elseif v.rectAlignW == "right" then
							x = v.rect.right - text[j].pageWidth
						end
						local y = v.rect.top
						if v.rectAlignH == "center" then
							y = v.rect.top + ((v.rect.bottom - v.rect.top) - text[j].pageHeight) * 0.5
						elseif v.rectAlignH == "bottom" then
							y = v.rect.bottom - text[j].pageHeight
						end
						tinsert(textCoords, {x = x, y = y})
					end
					self.texts[i] = {coords = textCoords, font = font, fontSize = fontSize, fontSpace = fontSpace, lineSpace = lineSpace, text = text, rect = v.rect, soundName = soundName}
        		end
        	end
        end
	end
	self.soundId = nil

function guiSlideShow:Stop()

	self.bitmaps = nil
	self.texts = nil

	if self.music and not self.noStopMusic then
		StopMusic()
	end
	self.music = nil

	RenderObjects(self.oldRendre)
	RenderObjectsHUD(self.oldRendreHUD)
	UpdateObjects(self.oldUpdate)

	gui.asUpdateKeep = self.asUpdate
	gui.levelRender = self.levelRender
	hudMessage.render = self.hudRender
	hudMessage.update = self.hudUpdate
	if self.stopGame then

    if self.oldTasksEnabled then

*/
end


/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
guiSlideShow:Update()
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function guiSlideShow:Update()

	if not self.bitmaps then
		gui:StopProcess()
		return
	end

	gui:MouseCursor("no")
	//gui.stopFrameModeDisabledInFrame = 1
	self.stageTime = self.stageTime + frameTime

 	if self.stage == 0 then
 		if self.startFadeTime > self.stageTime then
 			gui.fadeScreen = self.stageTime / self.startFadeTime
 		else
			gui.fadeScreen = 1
			self.stage = 1
			self.bitmapNr = 1
			self.text = nil
			SetBkgBitmap(nil)
			self.bitmap = nil
			self.stageTime = 0

			self.oldRendre = RenderObjects()
			self.oldRendreHUD = RenderObjectsHUD()
			self.oldUpdate = UpdateObjects()
			RenderObjects(0)
			RenderObjectsHUD(0)
			UpdateObjects(0)

			if self.fadeMusic then
				gui.fadeMusicInTime = nil
				gui.fadeMusicOutTime = nil
				OutFadeMusic(0)
				StopMusic()
			end

			if self.music then
				PlayMusic(self.music)
			end
		end

	elseif self.stage == 1 then
		if self.bitmapNr <= self.bitmapsCount then
			if self.stageTime < self.fadeTime then
				if not self.bitmap then
					self.bitmap = LoadBitmap(self.bitmaps[self.bitmapNr])
					SetBkgBitmap(self.bitmap)
					if not self.text then
						self.text = self.texts[self.bitmapNr]
						if self.text then
							self.page = 1
							self.pageCount = CountPagesAdvancedText(self.text.text)
							if self.text.soundName then
								self.soundId = PlaySound(self.text.soundName, 10)
							end
						end
					end
				end
				gui.fadeScreen = 1 - self.stageTime / self.fadeTime
			elseif self.stageTime < self.fadeTime + self.showTime then
				gui.fadeScreen = 0
            	if MouseStruck("anybutton") or KbdStruck("space") or KbdStruck("enter") or KbdStruck("esc") then
	            	self.stageTime = self.fadeTime + self.showTime
            	end
			elseif self.stageTime < 2 * self.fadeTime + self.showTime then
				gui.fadeScreen = self.stageTime - (self.fadeTime + self.showTime) / self.fadeTime
			else
				gui.fadeScreen = 1
				SetBkgBitmap(nil)
				self.bitmap = nil
				if self.text and self.page < self.pageCount then
					self.page = self.page + 1
				else
					self.bitmapNr = self.bitmapNr + 1
					self.text = nil
					if self.soundId and IsPlaying(self.soundId) then
	                	StopSound(self.soundId)
            		end
            		self.soundId = nil
				end
				self.stageTime = 0
			end
		else
			self.stage = 2
			self.stageTime = 0
		end

	elseif self.stage == 2 then
		self.stage = 3
		self.stageTime = 0

	else
		gui.fadeScreen = 0
		gui:StopProcess()
		local endFuncParam = self.endFuncParam
		self.endFuncParam = nil
		if self.endFunc then
			if self.endFuncGlobal then
				local func = self.endFunc
				func(endFuncParam)
			else
				self:endFunc(endFuncParam)
			end
		end
	end
end


/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
guiSlideShow:Render()
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function guiSlideShow:Render()
	//print("text = ", self.text, "  page = ", self.page)
	if self.text and self.page then
		if self.text.fontSize ~= 1 then
		    SetRenderState("tf1")
		end
		DrawAdvancedBlockText(self.text.font, self.text.coords[self.page].x, self.text.coords[self.page].y, self.text.fontSize, self.text.fontSize, self.text.fontSpace, self.text.text, self.page)
		if self.text.fontSize ~= 1 then
		    SetRenderState("tf0")
		end
	end
end

	gui:StartKeyProcess(guiSlideShow, gui.topProcess, {bitmaps = bitmaps, func = func, global = global, funcParam = funcParam, showTime = showTime, startFadeTime = startFadeTime, texts = texts, music = music, stopGame = stopGame, noStopMusic = noStopMusic, fadeMusic = fadeMusic})

function Tutorial(tutorial, endFucntion)

function tutorialMngr:Start(tutorial, endFunction)
	self.tutorial = tutorial
	self.tutorialEndFunction = endFunction
	self.tutPos = nil
	if type(self.tutorial) == "table" and getn(self.tutorial) > 0 then
		self.tutMax = getn(self.tutorial)
		self:NextMessage()
	end
end


function tutorialMngr:Stop(noEndFunction)
	//print(self.tutorialEndFunction)
	if self.tutorialEndFunction and not noEndFunction then
		self:tutorialEndFunction()
	end

	self.tutPos = nil
	self.tutRectStop = nil
	self.tutRectSkip = nil

	self.tutCloseIcon = nil
	self.tutSkipIcon = nil
	self.tutSkipStr = nil
	self.tutCloseStr = nil
	self.tutorial = nil
	self.tutorialEndFunction = nil
end


function tutorialMngr:NextMessage()
	if self.tutPos then
		if self.actTut and self.actTut.funcStop then
            self.actTut:funcStop()
		end
		self.tutPos = self.tutPos + 1
		if self.msgId and IsHud(self.msgId) then
			hudMessage:Delete(self.msgId)
		end
		if self.tutPos > self.tutMax then
			self.tutPos = nil
		end

	else
		self.tutPos = 1
	end
	if self.tutPos then
		self.actTut = self.tutorial[self.tutPos]
		if self.actTut.funcBeforeStart then
			self.actTut:funcBeforeStart()
		end
		if self.actTut.func and self.actTut:func() then
			self.actTut = nil
			self:NextMessage()
			return
		end
		if self.actTut.funcStart then
            self.actTut:funcStart()
		end
		if self.actTut.str then
			self.msgId = HudText(Str(self.actTut.str), self.actTut.strTime)
			self.lastMsgTime = currentTime
		else
			self.msgId = nil
			self.lastMsgTime = nil
		end
		self.actTutTime = currentTime
	else
		self.actTut = nil
	end
end


function tutorialMngr:Update()
	if self.tutPos and self.actTut then
		if self.actTut.funcUpdate then
			self.actTut:funcUpdate()
		end
		if self.lastMsgTime then
			if self.actTut.repeatTime and currentTime - self.lastMsgTime > self.actTut.repeatTime and not IsHud(self.msgId) then
				self.msgId = HudText(Str(self.actTut.str), self.actTut.strTime)
				self.lastMsgTime = 0
			end
		end
		if self.actTut.func and self.actTut:func() then
			self:NextMessage()
		elseif self.actTut.time and currentTime - self.actTutTime > self.actTut.time then
			self:NextMessage()
		elseif self.actTut.nextAfterStr and self.msgId and not IsHud(self.msgId) then
			self:NextMessage()
		end
		if not self.tutPos then
			self:Stop()
		end
	end
end

function SaveDataToFile(file, template, name)
    local i, v = next(template, nil)        -- gets first index of "template" and its value
    local vtype
   	write (file, name.." = {}\n")
    while i do
        itype = type(i)
        vtype = type(v)
        local _name
	    if itype == "number" and i ~= "n" then
    		_name = name.."["..i.."]"
		else
    		_name = name.."['"..i.."']"
       	end
       	if vtype == "number" and i ~= "n" then
        	write(file, _name.." = "..v.."\n")
       	elseif vtype == "string" then
        	write(file, _name.." = \""..v.."\"\n")
       	elseif vtype == "table" then
			SaveDataToFile(file, v, _name)
       	end
        i, v = next(template, i)            -- get next index and its value
    end
end


//-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// SAVE
//-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function SafeSave(fileName)
	if type(_safeSaveData) == "table" then
		local file = openfile(fileName, "w+")
		if file then
			SaveDataToFile(file, _safeSaveData, "_safeSaveData")
			closefile(file)
			return 1
		end
	end
end


//-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// LOAD
//-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function SafeLoad(fileName)
	if IsFile(fileName) then
		RemoveAllTasks()
		GoListRemoveAll()
		hudMessage:Clear()
		guiMenuInv:ClearItems()
		gui:MouseText()
		gui:MouseCursor("no")
		dofile(fileName)
		ClearScene()

	    // Objekty
	    for i, v in _safeSaveData.objects do
    		if i ~= "n" then
                obj = NewObject(v.file)
	    		if v._type == "OBJECT3D" then
                    go(obj, "scale", v.scale)
                    if v.posMenu then
                        guiMenuInv:PutItem(obj, v.posMenu)
                        go(obj, "setRender", 0)
                    else
	                    go(obj, "place", v.pos)
                    end

	    		elseif v._type == "OBJECT2D" then
                    if v.posMenu then
                        guiMenuInv:PutItem(obj, v.posMenu)
                        go(obj, "setRender", 0)
                    end

	    		end
	    		go(obj, "capacity", v.capacity)
				go(obj, "persistent", v.persistent)
				if v.isMoving then
					guiMenuInv:GetItem(obj)
				end
	    	end
	    end

		// Mini gry
		for i = 1, 5 do
			guiMenuInv:GameAvailable(i, _safeSaveData.games[i])
		end

	    // GameStates
    	gameStates = CloneLuaObject(_safeSaveData.gameStates)

	    // Podpowiedzi
		_ascreenHelp = _safeSaveData._ascreenHelp
		guiMenuInv.helpCount = _safeSaveData.helpCount

		if guiMenuInv.addHelpCount and guiMenuInv.addHelpCount > 0 then
			if not guiMenuInv.helpCount then
				guiMenuInv.helpCount = guiMenuInv.addHelpCount
			else
				guiMenuInv.helpCount = guiMenuInv.helpCount + guiMenuInv.addHelpCount
			end
		end
		guiMenuInv.addHelpCount = nil

    	// Identyfikacja gracza
    	if _safeSaveData._ident.type and _safeSaveData._ident.nr then
    		SetIdent(_safeSaveData._ident.type, _safeSaveData._ident.nr)
    	end

	    // Aktualna lokacja
    	ChangeMap(_safeSaveData.actLevelName, nil, _safeSaveData.lastLevelName)

    	return 1
	end
end


//-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// CREATE DATA
//-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function CreateSafeSaveData()
	_safeSaveData = {}

    // Objekty
	local objects = ObjectList("OBJECT3D")
	_safeSaveData.objects = {}
    for i, v in objects do
    	if i ~= "n" then
    		local obj = {}
    		obj._type = "OBJECT3D"
    		obj.id = v
    		obj.type = go(v, "type")
			obj.file = go(v, "file")
			obj.pos = go(v, "pos")
			obj.scale = go(v, "scale")
			obj.capacity = go(v, "capacity")
			obj.persistent = go(v, "persistent")
			for i = 1, 5 do
				if guiMenuInv.items[i] == v then
					obj.posMenu = i
				end
			end
			if guiMenuInv.movingItem == v then
				obj.isMoving = 1
			end
			tinsert(_safeSaveData.objects, obj)
    	end
    end

	local objects = ObjectList("OBJECT2D")
    for i, v in objects do
    	if i ~= "n" then
    		local obj = {}
    		obj._type = "OBJECT2D"
    		obj.id = v
    		obj.type = go(v, "type")
			obj.file = go(v, "file")
			obj.capacity = go(v, "capacity")
			obj.persistent = go(v, "persistent")
			for i = 1, 5 do
				if guiMenuInv.items[i] == v then
					obj.posMenu = i
				end
			end
			if guiMenuInv.movingItem == v then
				obj.isMoving = 1
			end
			tinsert(_safeSaveData.objects, obj)
    	end
    end

	// Mini gry
	_safeSaveData.games = {}
	for i = 1, 5 do
		if guiMenuInv:IsGameAvailable(i) then
			_safeSaveData.games[i] = 1
		end
	end

    // GameStates
    _safeSaveData.gameStates = CloneLuaObject(gameStates)

    // Podpowiedzi
	_safeSaveData._ascreenHelp = _ascreenHelp
	_safeSaveData.helpCount = guiMenuInv.helpCount

    // Aktualna lokacja
    _safeSaveData.actLevelName = CurrentMap()

    // Ostatnia lokacja
    _safeSaveData.lastLevelName = LastMap()

    // Identyfikacja gracza
    local iType, iNr = GetIdent()
    _safeSaveData._ident = {type = iType, nr = iNr}

end

// SAVE CHAPTER
//-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function SaveChapter(nr)
	if not nr or nr < 0.9 or nr > 5.1 then
		return
	end

	local flagName = "__CHAPTER"..nr.."_SAVED"
	if not gameStates.flags[flagName] then
		_saveChapter = {nr = nr, flagName = flagName}
	end
end

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
guiMenuInv:Update()
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function guiMenuInv:Update(mx, my)
	if not guiMenuInv.playerControl then
		return
	end

    local mx, my = MouseGetXY()

	self.overMenu = nil

	if self.movingItem then
		guiScroll.stopTrace = 1
	end

	if ASIIsInside(self.asi, "aMain", mx, my) then
//		if getn(ascreenFocus) > 0 then
			ASAllAreasFocusLost()
//		end
		if self.shineParticle and ParticleIsEnabled(self.shineParticle) then
			StopParticle(self.shineParticle)
		end


		gui.asUpdate = nil
		self.overMenu = 1
		local inside
		local insideNr
		for i = 1, 4 do
			if ASIIsInside(self.asi, "aItem"..i, mx, my) then
				inside = "i"
				insideNr = i
				break
			end
		end
		if not inside then
			for i = 1, 5 do
				if ASIIsInside(self.asi, "aGame"..i, mx, my) then
					inside = "g"
					insideNr = i
					break
				end
			end
		end
		if not inside then
			if ASIIsInside(self.asi, "aMenu", mx, my) then
				inside = "m"
			elseif ASIIsInside(self.asi, "aHelp", mx, my) then
				inside = "h"
			end
		end

		if inside then
			if inside == "i" then
				local item = self.items[insideNr]
				if item then
					//gui:MouseText(go(item, "nameVis"))
					local text = go(item, "nameVis")
					local capacity = go(item, "capacity")
					if capacity > 0 then
						text = text.." #E8E7A9FF("..capacity..")"
					end
					gui:MouseText(text)
					if not self.movingItem then
        				gui:MouseCursor("select")
        			end
        		end
				if MouseStruck("lbutton") then
					self:PutItem(self.movingItem, insideNr)
					self.movingItem = item
					self.movingHelp = nil
					if item then
						PlaySound(self.takeSound)
						self.movingItemName = go(item, "name")
					else
						self.movingItemName = nil
					end
					//if item then
						//go(item, "setPos2D", mx, my, "CENTER")
					//end
				end

			elseif inside == "g" then
				if self:IsGameAvailable(insideNr) then
					gui:MouseText("#FFFF99FF"..self.games[insideNr].name)
       				gui:MouseCursor("select")
					if MouseStruck("lbutton") then
						guiMenuInv.movingHelp = nil
						self:PlayGame(insideNr)
					end
				else
					gui:MouseText("#CCCCCCCC"..self.games[insideNr].name)
				end

			elseif inside == "m" then
				gui:MouseText(self.exitTxt)
        		gui:MouseCursor("select")
				if MouseStruck("lbutton") and not FindTask("Task_TheEnd") then
					guiMenuInv.movingHelp = nil
					QuitActGame()
					//Msg(Str("gme.quitActGame"), Str("gme.attention"), {{caption = Str("keyCaption.yes"), key = "enter", func = QuitGame, global = 1}, {caption = Str("keyCaption.no"), key = "esc"}}, 1)
					//Menu("menuInGame")
				end

			elseif inside == "h" then
				gui:MouseText(self.hintsStr.." #E8E7A9FF("..self.helpCount..")")
				if self.helpCount > 0.1 then
        			gui:MouseCursor("select")
					if not self.movingItem and MouseStruck("lbutton") then
						self.movingHelp = not self.movingHelp
						if self.movingHelp then
							PlaySound(self.takeSound)
						else
							PlaySound(self.dropSound)
						end

						//Menu("menuInGame")
						//Exit()
					end
				else
					if not self.movingItem and MouseStruck("lbutton") then
						HudText(Str("hint.noHints"))
						PlaySound("\\ui\\wrong2.wav")
					end
        		end

			end

        else
			if MouseStruck("lbutton") and not self.noDetectMouseClick then
				if self:PutItem(self.movingItem) then
					self.movingItem = nil
					self.movingItemName = nil
				end
			end

		end
		guiScroll:Update()

		return 1

	else
	   	if guiDesktop.mouseOverObject then
			go(guiDesktop.mouseOverObject, "onMouseOver")
   			if MouseStruck("lbutton") and not self.noDetectMouseClick then
   				if go(guiDesktop.mouseOverObject, "onMouseClick") then
   					//
				end
   			end
		end

		if self.movingItem then
/*
			if MouseStruck("lbutton") and not self.noDetectMouseClick then
				if self:PutItem(self.movingItem) then
					self.movingItem = nil
					self.movingItemName = nil
				end
			end
*/
			if self.movingItem then
				local dx, dy = go(self.movingItem, "cursorDelta")
				if dx and dy then
					gui.cursorPoint = {x = mx + dx, y = my + dy}
				end
			end

			/// lupa fx
			if self.movingItemName == "lupa" then
				if self.shineParticle and ParticleIsEnabled(self.shineParticle) then
					if self.shineParticle then
						local v2 = GetShinePos(self.shineSize)
						SetPartPos(self.shineParticle, v2)
					end
				end
			else
				if self.shineParticle and ParticleIsEnabled(self.shineParticle) then
					StopParticle(self.shineParticle)
				end
			end
			///

			guiScroll:Update()
			return 1
		end

	end

	self.noDetectMouseClick = nil
end

function guiMenuInv:ShineOn(size)
	if not size then
		size = 0
	end
	local v2 = GetShinePos(size)
	self.shineSize = size
	if not self.shineParticle then
		self.shineParticle = CreatePartEffect("data\\fx\\gwiazdki1.apd", v2, -1, "data\\bitmap\\shine", 0)
		ParOverCursor(self.shineParticle)
	else
		SetPartPos(self.shineParticle, v2)
	end
	StartParticle(self.shineParticle)
end

function guiMenuInv:ShineOff()
	if self.shineParticle then
		StopParticle(self.shineParticle)
	end
end



function guiMenuInv:ShineRelease()
	if self.shineParticle then
		RemovePartEffect(self.shineParticle);
		self.shineParticle = nil
	end
end

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
guiMenuInv:Render()
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function guiMenuInv:Render()
	if not guiMenuInv.playerControl then
		return
	end

   	SprSetCurrentFrame(self.icon, 0)
	local x = 0
	for i = 1, 2 do
		if (i > 1) then
			x = self.iconMenuParams[i - 1].width
		end
   		DrawRectangle(Vector(x, 0, 0), self.iconMenuParams[i].width, self.iconMenuParams[i].height, RGBA(1,1,1), self.iconMenuParams[i].coords)
   	end

   	local sH = ScreenHeight()
   	for i = 1, 5 do
   		if not self:IsGameAvailable(i) then
   			local p = self["pGame"..i]
   			local w = self["wIconGame"..i]
   			local h = self["hIconGame"..i]
   			SprSetCurrentFrame(self["iconGame"..i], 0)
   			DrawRectangle(Vector(p.x - w * 0.5, sH - p.y - h * 0.5, 0), w, h, RGBA(1,1,1))
   		end
   	end
/*
 	local p = self["pMenu"]
   	local w = self["wIconMenu"]
   	local h = self["hIconMenu"]
   	SprSetCurrentFrame(self["iconMenu"], 0)
  	DrawRectangle(Vector(p.x - w * 0.5, sH - p.y - h * 0.5, 0), w, h, RGBA(1,1,1))
*/
   	for i = 1, 5 do
   		//go(self.obj1, "setPos2D", 145, 527)
   		if self.items[i] then
   			go(self.items[i], "renderHUD")
   		end
   	end


	SprSetCurrentFrame(self.helpIcon, 0)
   	DrawBillboard(Vector(self.pHelp.x, ScreenHeight() - self.pHelp.y, 0), 64, 64, 0, RGBA(1, 1, 1, self.helpCount > 0.9 and 1 or 0.5))

   	if self.movingItem then
    	local mx, my = MouseGetXY()
    	local type = go(self.movingItem, "type")
    	if type == "Object2D" then
			go(self.movingItem, "setPos2D", mx, my, "POINT")
			if not go(self.movingItem, "animating") then
	   	 		go(self.movingItem, "setIcon", self.overMenu and "icon" or "icon2")
   	 		end
   	 	elseif type == "Object3D" then
			go(self.movingItem, "setPosHUDIcon", mx, my)
   	 		go(self.movingItem, "setHUDIcon", self.overMenu and "icon" or "icon2")
   	 	end
   	 	go(self.movingItem, "renderHUD")
   	end

end


/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
guiMenuInv:FreePlace()
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function guiMenuInv:FreePlace()
	for i = 1, 5 do
		if not self.items[i] then
			return i
		end
	end
end


/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
guiMenuInv:FreePlaces()
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function guiMenuInv:FreePlaces()
	local count
	for i = 1, 5 do
		if not self.items[i] then
			if not count then
				count = 1
			else
				count = count + 1
			end
		end
	end
	return count
end



/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
guiMenuInv:PutItem(item, nr)
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function guiMenuInv:PutItem(item, nr)
	item = Object(item)
	if nr then
		if nr < 1 or nr > 5 then
			return
		end

   		self.items[nr] = item
   		if item then
		   	if item == self.movingItem then
   				self.movingItem = nil
   				self.movingItemName = nil
   			end
	   		local p = self["pItem"..nr]
    		local type = go(item, "type")
    		if type == "Object2D" then
	   			go(item, "setPos2D", p.x, p.y, "POINT")
				go(item, "stopAnim")
   	 			go(item, "setIcon", "icon")
   	 		elseif type == "Object3D" then
	   			go(item, "setPosHUDIcon", p.x, p.y)
				//go(item, "stopAnim")
   	 			go(item, "setHUDIcon", "icon")
   	 		end
 			go(item, "persistent", 1)
   			PlaySound(self.dropSound)
   	 		return nr
   		end

   	elseif item then
		for i = 1, 4 do
			if not self.items[i] then
				return self:PutItem(item, i)
			end
		end

   	end
end


/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
guiMenuInv:GetItem(item)
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function guiMenuInv:GetItem(item)
	if not self:CanGetItem() then
		return
	end

	if self.movingItem then
		if not self:PutItem(self.movingItem) then
			return
		end
	end

	self.movingItem = item
	if item then
		self.movingItemName = go(item, "name")
 		go(item, "persistent", 1)
 		go(item, "setRender", 0)
		PlaySound(self.takeSound)
	else
		self.movingItemName = nil
	end
	return 1
end


function guiMenuInv:CanGetItem()
	local free = self:FreePlaces()
	if free then
		if not self.movingItem or free > 1 then
			return 1
		end
	end
end


function guiMenuInv:IsItem(item, checkMoving)
	local itemType = type(item)
	if itemType == "number" then
		for i = 1, 5 do
			if self.items[i] == item then
				return i, self.items[i]
			end
		end
		if checkMoving and self.movingItem == item then
			return 0, self.movingItem
		end

	elseif itemType == "string" then
		for i = 1, 5 do
			if self.items[i] and go(self.items[i], "name") == item then
				return i, self.items[i]
			end
		end
		if checkMoving and self.movingItem and go(self.movingItem, "name") == item then
			return 0, self.movingItem
		end

	end
end


function guiMenuInv:RemoveItem(item)
	local pos, item = self:IsItem(item, 1)
	if pos then
        if pos > 0 then
        	self.items[pos] = nil
        else
        	self.movingItem = nil
        	self.movingItemName = nil
        end
       	go(item, "remove")
	end
end

function RemoveFromInv(item)
	guiMenuInv:RemoveItem(item)
end

function guiMenuInv:GameAvailable(nr, av)
	if nr then
		if nr < 1 or nr > 5 then
			return
		end
		self.games[nr].av = av
		if av then
			SetMiniGameAvailable(nr, 1)
		end
	else
		for i = 1, 5 do
			self.games[i].av = av
			if av then
				SetMiniGameAvailable(i, 1)
			end
		end
	end
end

function guiMenuInv:IsGameAvailable(nr)
	if nr and nr > 0 and nr < 6 then
		return self.games[nr].av
	end
end

function NoBreakingTask(taskName)
	if not lgs._noBreakingTasks then
		lgs._noBreakingTasks = {}
	end
	tinsert(lgs._noBreakingTasks, taskName)
end

function guiMenuInv:PlayGame(nr)
	if not nr or nr < 1 or nr > 5 then
		return
	end
/*
	if IsHudText() then
		return
	end
*/
	if lgs and lgs._noBreakingTasks then
		for i, v in lgs._noBreakingTasks do
			if i ~= "n" then
				if FindTask(v) then
					return
				end
			end
		end
	end

	Msg(Str("gmi.hintInGame"..nr).."| |"..Str("gmi.playGame"), self.games[nr].name, {{caption = Str("keyCaption.yes"), key = "enter", func = guiMenuInv._PlayGame, funcParam = self.games[nr].playParam}, {caption = Str("keyCaption.no"), key = "esc"}}, 1)
end



function guiMenuInv:_PlayGame(nr, out)
	local players
	if type(nr) == "table" then
		players = nr.players
		nr = nr.nr
	end
	if not nr or nr < 1 or nr > 5 then
		return
	end

	SetFlag("_MINI_GAME", out and "_OUT" or 1)
	if players then
		SetFlag("_PLAYERS", players)
	else
		ClearFlag("_PLAYERS")
	end
	ChangeMap(guiMenuInv.games[nr].location)
end

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
Area()
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function Area(msg, name, funcName, param)
	//print(name, " -> ", msg, " ", funcName)

    if msg == "FSET" and not ascreenFocus[name] then
		if funcName then
        	ascreenFocus[name] = {func = getglobal(funcName)}
    		local area = ascreenFocus[name]
    		if area and area.func then
				area.func(name, "in", param)
			end
		end
    end

    if (msg == "FLST" or msg == "OFF") and ascreenFocus[name] then
    	local area = ascreenFocus[name]
    	if area and area.func then
			area.func(name, "out", param)
		end
        ascreenFocus[name] = nil
    end

    if msg == "UPDT" then
    	local area = ascreenFocus[name]
    	if area and area.func then
			area.func(name, "over", param)
		end
    end

   	if msg == "MLBD" or msg == "MLBS" then
    	local area = ascreenFocus[name]
    	if area and area.func then
    		local help = 0
   			local _name = CurrentMap().."__"..name
    		if guiMenuInv.movingHelp and gui.mouseCursor.img then
    			if _ascreenHelp[_name] then
    				if _ascreenHelp[_name] < 1.9 then
    					_ascreenHelp[_name] = _ascreenHelp[_name] + 1
                		guiMenuInv.helpCount = guiMenuInv.helpCount - 1
                		guiMenuInv.movingHelp = nil
					end
                else
                	_ascreenHelp[_name] = 1
                	guiMenuInv.helpCount = guiMenuInv.helpCount - 1
                	guiMenuInv.movingHelp = nil
    			end
    			help = _ascreenHelp[_name]

			elseif area.func(name, "click", param) then

				MouseReset()
				help = nil

			elseif gui.mouseCursor.img and _ascreenHelp[_name] then
    			help = _ascreenHelp[_name]

			end

			if gui.mouseCursor.img and help then
				if help > 0 then
					area.func(name, "help", help)
					PlaySound("\\ui\\good2.wav")
				else
                	HudText(Str("hint.doSome"))
                	PlaySound("\\ui\\good2.wav")
				end
			end
		end
   	end
end


/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
AddTwinAnimBkg(fileName)
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function AddTwinAnimBkg(fileName, twinAnims)
	if not lgs._twinBkgAnims then
		lgs._twinBkgAnims = {}
	end
	lgs._twinBkgAnims[AddAnimBkg(fileName)] = {twinAnims = twinAnims}
end


/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
TwinAnimBkg(name, animName)
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function TwinAnimBkg(name, animName, fromAct, force)
	local anim = lgs._twinBkgAnims[name]
	if anim then
		//print("TwinAnimBkg  ", name, "  ", animName, "  ", fromAct, "  ", force)
		if force then
			anim.forceAnim = nil
		elseif anim.forceAnim then
			return
		end
		if anim and anim.twinAnims then
			for i, v in anim.twinAnims do
				if i ~= "n" then
					local twinAnim = lgs._twinBkgAnims[v]
					if twinAnim then
						twinAnim.forceAnim = 1
						AnimBkg(v, "default")
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	AnimBkg(name, animName, fromAct)
	//print("AnimBkg  ", name, "  ", animName)
end


function RotateShine(x, y, speed)
	if not angleSh then
		angleSh = 0
	end
	local x1,y1
	x1 = x * sin(angleSh) + y * cos(angleSh)
	y1 = x * cos(angleSh) - y * sin(angleSh)

	angleSh = angleSh + speed
	if angleSh > 360 then
		angleSh = angleSh - 360
	end
	return x1,y1
end


function GetShinePos(dist)
	if not dist then
		dist = 0
	end
	local v = {}
	v.x, v.y = MouseGetXY()
	v.x = v.x - 50
	v.y = v.y - 30
	v.z = dist
	local x1,y1
	x1,y1 = RotateShine(40, 0, 10)
	v.x = v.x + x1
	v.y = v.y + y1
	return(MapScreenToWorld(v))
	//return v
end

	guiMenuInv.playerControl = nil
end

function ShowMenu()

end

		end

	else
		return HudMsg(Str("msg.nextHint"), nil, nil, ScreenHeight() * 0.5 - 140, 0.75, nil, nil, nil, "center")
	end
end

/*#############################################################################

guiDesktop (proces GUI)

Obsluguje glowna czesc interfejsu, czyli desktop. Miedzy innymi:
- wybieranie aktywnych postaci
- poruszanie po lokacji
- zmiana broni
- walka

#############################################################################*/

guiDesktop = {
    mouseLPressed = nil,
    mouseLNoNextReleaseCheck = nil,
    lastLRelease = 0,
    lastLPress = 0,
    mouseRPressed = nil,
	lastRPressX = nil,
	lastRPressY = nil,
    lastRPress = 0,

    playerControl = nil,

    actor = nil,

   	jumpDist = 30,
	jumpDelta = 10,

	canJump = 1,
}


/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
guiDesktop:Init()
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function guiDesktop:Init()
	self.icon1 = CreateSprite("data\\bitmap\\walkMarkers")
	guiMenuInv:Init()
	self.markerSize = 136
	self.markersCoord = {
		jump1 = UVCoords2(29, 365, self.markerSize, self.markerSize, 512, 512),
		jump2 = UVCoords2(197, 365, self.markerSize, self.markerSize, 512, 512),
		walk = UVCoords2(363, 365, self.markerSize, self.markerSize, 512, 512),
	}
	self.markerType = "walk"
end


/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
guiDesktop:Start()
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function guiDesktop:Start()
	self:MouseReset()
	self.selBoxActive = nil
	guiScroll:Start()
	self.choiceWeapons = nil
    self.startChat = nil
    self.noDetectMouseClick = nil
    self.noDetectMouseOver = nil
	self.choiceAi = nil
    self.playerControl = 1
	self.hideIcons = nil
	self.wheelMenuDisabled = nil
	self.update = 1
	self.mouseDetectClick = 1
	self.mouseEnabled = 1
	guiMenuInv.playerControl = 1
end


function guiDesktop:MouseReset()
	MouseReset()
    self.mouseLPressed = nil
    self.mouseLNoNextReleaseCheck = nil
    self.lastLRelease = 0
    self.lastLPress = 0
    self.lastRRelease = 0
	self.lastRPress = 0
end


/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
guiDesktop:Stop()
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function guiDesktop:Stop()
	self.playerControl = nil
end



/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
guiDesktop:Update()
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function guiDesktop:Update(updateParam)
	//print(1)
	if KbdStruck("esc") and not FindTask("Task_TheEnd") then
		QuitActGame()
		//Msg(Str("gme.quitActGame"), Str("gme.attention"), {{caption = Str("keyCaption.yes"), key = "enter", func = QuitGame, global = 1}, {caption = Str("keyCaption.no"), key = "esc"}}, 1)
		//Menu("menuInGame")
		return
	end

	local hideWalkMarker = self.hideWalkMarker
	self.hideWalkMarker = nil

	if not LevelLoaded() or not self.playerControl then
		return
	end

	if self.actor then
		self.actor = Actor(self.actor)
		guiScroll.traceObject = self.actor
	end
	//guiScroll.traceObject = nil

    if not self.noDetectMouseOver then
		self.mouseOverObject = MouseOverObject(self.actor)
	else
		self.mouseOverObject = nil
	end

	self.markerPos = nil

	if self.mouseEnabled and self.mouseDetect and self.mouseDetectClick then

		if guiMenuInv:Update() then
	        return
		end

		if not self.update then
			self.update	= 1
			return
		end

    	local mx, my = MouseGetXY()

    	local dontUseItem = self.noDetectMouseClick or self.noDetectMouseOver
    	local dontRPress = self.noDetectMouseClick

 		if self.actor and go(self.actor, "canBreak") and not guiMenuInv.movingHelp then
			local destination = PickPos(mx, my, 2, 1)
			local dest = destination and PosToVec(destination) or nil
			if dest then
				local area, moving = PosArea(destination)
				if not guiDesktop.canJump then
					moving = 1
				end
				//print(moving, "
				//print("area = ", area)
				local pos = go(self.actor, "pos")
				dist = Distance(dest, pos)
				local actorArea = go(self.actor, "area")
				if not moving or actorArea == area then
					if not moving and actorArea ~= area then
				    	if (dist < self.jumpDist + self.jumpDelta) then
							self.markerPos = dest
							self.markerAngle = DirToAngle(pos, dest)
							self.markerType = "jump"..(sin(gui.time * 500) > 0 and 1 or 2)
			    		end
					elseif dist > 3 then
						self.markerPos = dest
						self.markerAngle = DirToAngle(pos, dest)
						if not moving and dist > self.jumpDist and dist < self.jumpDist + self.jumpDelta then
		                    self.markerType = "jump"..(sin(gui.time * 500) > 0 and 1 or 2)
                		else
		                    self.markerType = "walk"
			 			end
					elseif not moving then
		                self.markerType = "jump"..(sin(gui.time * 500) > 0 and 1 or 2)
						self.markerPos = pos
						self.markerAngle = go(self.actor, "angle")
						//self.markerPos = nil
					end
				end
				if not hideWalkMarker and self.markerPos and MouseStruck("lbutton") then
					if self.markerType == "walk" then
						go(self.actor, "walk", dest)
					else
						if self.markerPos == pos then
							go(self.actor, "jumpUp", 7)
						else
							go(self.actor, "jump", dest)
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end

	end

	if self.markerPos then
		if hideWalkMarker then
	 		go(gui.walkMarker, "set")
	 	else
	 		go(gui.walkMarker, "set", 1, self.markerPos, self.markerAngle, self.markerType)
	 	end
	end

	self.mouseDetect = 1
   	if self.mouseOverObject then
   		local canGet
   		if guiMenuInv.playerControl and guiMenuInv:CanGetItem() then
   			canGet = 1
   		end
   		local toTake = go(self.mouseOverObject, "toTake")
   		if toTake then
   			gui:MouseText(go(self.mouseOverObject, "nameVis"))
   			if canGet then
   				gui:MouseCursor("select")
   			end
   			self.mouseDetect = nil
   			//mouseDetectClick
   		end
   		go(self.mouseOverObject, "onMouseOver")
   		if MouseStruck("lbutton") then
   			go(self.mouseOverObject, "onMouseClick")
   		end
   		if toTake and canGet and MouseStruck("lbutton") then
            guiMenuInv:GetItem(self.mouseOverObject)
            go(self.mouseOverObject, "onTake")
   		end
	end

	guiScroll:Update()
end


function guiDesktop:SetCanJump(canJump)
	if canJump == 0 then
		canJump = nil
	end
	self.canJump = canJump
	if not canJump and self.actor and Actor(self.actor) and go(self.actor, "movingMode") == "jump" and go(self.actor, "movingStage") ~= "on" then
		go(self.actor, "stop", 0, 1, 1)
	end
end


function guiDesktop:DrawIdent()
	if self.ident then
		SetRenderState("tf1")
		SprSetCurrentFrame(self.ident.icon, 0)
		DrawRectangle(Vector(self.ident.x, self.ident.y, 0), 40, 40, RGBA(1, 1, 1, 0.65), self.ident.coords)
		SetRenderState("tf0")
	end
end


function guiDesktop:SetIdent(pos)
	if pos ~= 1 and pos ~= 2 and pos ~= 3 and pos ~= 4 then
		self.ident = nil
	else
		local iName, iNum = GetIdent()
		if iName then
			local identName = iName.."_"..iNum
			local x, y
			if pos == 1 then
				x = 10
				y = ScreenHeight() - 50
			elseif pos == 2 then
				x = ScreenWidth() - 50
				y = ScreenHeight() - 50
			elseif pos == 3 then
				x = ScreenWidth() - 50
				y = 10
			elseif pos == 4 then
				x = 10
				y = 10
			end
			self.ident = {
				icon = CreateSprite("data\\bitmap\\ident_icons\\"..identName),
				x = x,
				y = y,
				coords = UVCoords(1, 42, 90, 126, 128, 128),
			}
			ReloadAllTextures()
		else
			self.ident = nil
		end

	end
end

guiDesktop:Render()
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

function guiDesktop:Render()
	guiDesktop:DrawIdent()

	if not self.playerControl then

	end


	guiMenuInv:Render()

/*#############################################################################

guiScroll

Obsluguje przewijanie ekranu w grze.

Byc moze w przyszlosci zostanie calkowicie wlaczony do guiDesktop.

#############################################################################*/

guiScroll = {
    screenx = 0,
    screeny = 0,
    step = 16,
    mouseMargin = 30,
    zoom = 1.0,
    zoomStep = 0.05,
    zoomMax = 2.0,
    zoomMin = 0.5,
    traceObject = nil,
    updateViewport = 1,
	shake = nil,
	shakeAmplitude = 16,
}

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
guiScroll:Init()
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

function guiScroll:Init()
end

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
guiScroll:Start()
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

function guiScroll:Start()
    self.screenx = ScreenWidth() / 2
    self.screeny = ScreenHeight() / 2
    self.zoom = 1.0
    self.zoomMin = min(1.0, max(0.5, max(ScreenWidth()/BkgBitmapWidth(), ScreenHeight()/BkgBitmapHeight())  ) )
    self.traceObject = nil
    self.updateViewport = 1
end

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
guiScroll:SetMiddleAtPoint3D()
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

function guiScroll:SetMiddleAtPoint3D(midPoint)
    local v = MapWorldToScreen(midPoint)
    v.x = v.x - ScreenWidth() / 2
    v.y = v.y - ScreenHeight() / 2
    self:SetMiddleAtPoint2D(self.screenx + v.x, self.screeny + v.y)
end

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
guiScroll:SetMiddleAtPoint2D()
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

function guiScroll:SetMiddleAtPoint2D(px, py)
    self.screenx = px
    self.screeny = py
    self.scrollToX = px
    self.scrollToY = py
	self:UpdateViewport()
end


/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
guiScroll:ScrollTo(var1, var2)
mo¿na podaæ wektor w przstrzeni 3D planszy, lub 2 wsp. ekranowe
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

function guiScroll:ScrollTo(var1, var2)
	local sh = ScreenHeight() - _bkgDwnMargin
	if type(var1) == "table" then
	    local v = MapWorldToScreen(var1)
	    v.x = v.x - ScreenWidth() * 0.5
	    v.y = v.y - sh * 0.5
	    var1 = self.screenx + v.x
	    var2 = self.screeny + v.y
	end
    self.scrollToX = var1
    self.scrollToY = var2
	self:UpdateViewport()
end


function guiScroll:ScrollNow(var1, var2)
	local sh = ScreenHeight() - _bkgDwnMargin
	if type(var1) == "table" then
	    local v = MapWorldToScreen(var1)
	    v.x = v.x - ScreenWidth() * 0.5
	    v.y = v.y - sh * 0.5
	    var1 = self.screenx + v.x
	    var2 = self.screeny + v.y
	end
    self.scrollToX = var1
    self.scrollToY = var2
    self.screenx = var1
    self.screeny = var2
	self:UpdateViewport()
end


/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
guiScroll:ZoomTo(zoom, time)
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

function guiScroll:ZoomTo(zoom, time)
	if not time or time < 0 then time = 0 end
    self.zoomTo = zoom
    self.zoomEnd = time
end


/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
guiScroll:UpdateViewport()

Pokazuje na ekranie aktualne ustawienia scrolla i zooma.
Jesli potrzeba, dokonuje korekty ustawien, tak by widok nie wychodzil
poza granice tla.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

function guiScroll:UpdateViewport()
//	print(self.zoom, "  ", self.zoomTo)
	if self.zoomChange or (not gui.wideScreen and (self.zoom > 1.01 or self.zoom < 0.99)) then
		if not gc_autoZoomOff then
			if self.zoomChange == 1 then
				self.zoomChange = 2
			else
				self.zoomTo = 1
				local zoomSpeed = 1
				if self.zoom > 1 then
					zoomSpeed = self.zoom - 1
				else
					zoomSpeed = (self.zoom - 0.5) * 2
				end
				self.zoomEnd = 0.3 * zoomSpeed
				self.zoomChange	= nil
			end
		else
			self.zoomChange	= nil
		end
	end

	if self.zoomTo and self.zoomEnd then
        if self.zoomEnd > 0.05 then
        	self.zoom = self.zoom + (self.zoomTo - self.zoom) / self.zoomEnd / 30
			self.zoomEnd = self.zoomEnd	- frameTime
        else
        	self.zoom = self.zoomTo
        	self.zoomTo = nil
        end
	end

    if self.zoom < self.zoomMin then
    	self.zoom = self.zoomMin
    elseif self.zoom > self.zoomMax then
    	self.zoom = self.zoomMax
    end

    local zoomTemp = self.zoom
    --if abs(zoomTemp - 1.0) < 0.1 then zoomTemp = 1.0 end

    local actWidth = floor(ScreenWidth() / zoomTemp)
    local actHeight = floor((ScreenHeight() - _bkgDwnMargin/*200*/) / zoomTemp)
    local actWidthHalf0 = floor(actWidth * 0.5)
    local actWidthHalf1 = actWidth - actWidthHalf0
    local actHeightHalf0 = floor(actHeight * 0.5)
    local actHeightHalf1 = actHeight - actHeightHalf0

	if self.scrollToX then
		if abs(self.scrollToX - self.screenx) > 1 then
			self.screenx = self.screenx + (self.scrollToX - self.screenx) * 0.1
		end
	end
	if self.scrollToY then
		if abs(self.scrollToY - self.screeny) > 1  then
			self.screeny = self.screeny + (self.scrollToY - self.screeny) * 0.1
		end
	end

    -- ograniczenia przewijania (w obrebie planszy)
    if self.screenx < actWidthHalf0 then
        self.screenx = actWidthHalf0
    end
    if self.screeny < actHeightHalf0 - _bkgDwnMargin then
        self.screeny = actHeightHalf0 - _bkgDwnMargin
    end
    local maxx = BkgBitmapWidth() - actWidthHalf1
    if self.screenx > maxx then
        self.screenx = maxx
    end
    local maxy = BkgBitmapHeight() - actHeightHalf1 - _bkgDwnMargin
    if self.screeny > maxy then
        self.screeny = maxy
    end

    -- pokazanie obszaru
	if self.shake then
		local screenx = self.screenx + random(1, self.shakeAmplitude)
		local screeny = self.screeny + random(1, self.shakeAmplitude) + _bkgDwnMargin
		BkgSetViewport(screenx - actWidthHalf0, screeny - actHeightHalf0, screenx + actWidthHalf1, screeny + actHeightHalf1)
	else
		BkgSetViewport(self.screenx - actWidthHalf0, self.screeny - actHeightHalf0 + _bkgDwnMargin, self.screenx + actWidthHalf1, self.screeny + actHeightHalf1 + _bkgDwnMargin)
	end

	self.update = nil
end

lgs.kajetan = ImpActor("kajetan")

guiScroll.traceObject = lgs.kajetan

PlaySoundLooped("\\waves1.wav",-1  )
PlaySoundLooped("\\waves1.wav",-1  )
PlaySoundLooped("\\upal.wav",-1  )
EnableWater("data\\maps\\preparation_port\\water\\woda_%d.jpg",RGBA(1,1,1,0.4), 12, 0.009, 0.003, 100, 20)


lgs.znak1 = NewObject("znak.object3d")
go(lgs.znak1,"place","znak1")
go(lgs.znak1,"anim","znak2",1,-1)
go(lgs.znak1,"rotateToPoint","znak1_look")
go(lgs.znak1, "evOnMouseOver", "OnZnakOver")
function OnZnakOver(obj)
	if obj == lgs.znak1 then
		gui:MouseText("#B46FF3FF"..Str("znak.africa_well_1")  )
	end
   	gui:MouseCursor("select")
end
AddTwinAnimBkg("data\\maps\\africa_coast\\anim\\kotwica.anim")
AddTwinAnimBkg("data\\maps\\africa_coast\\anim\\palma1.anim",{"palma3"})
AddTwinAnimBkg("data\\maps\\africa_coast\\anim\\palma2.anim")
AddTwinAnimBkg("data\\maps\\africa_coast\\anim\\palma3.anim",{"palma1"})
AddTwinAnimBkg("data\\maps\\africa_coast\\anim\\rozgwiazdy.anim")




if LastMap() == "africa_cross" then
	go(lgs.kajetan,"place","kajetan_start_2")
else

	go(lgs.kajetan,"place","kajetan_start")
end
go(lgs.kajetan,"rotateToPoint","help_start",1 )

 -- SetFlag("beczka_napelniona")

if Flag("beczka_napelniona") then
	ASObjectOff("trap")
	ASObjectOn("trap2")
else

	ASObjectOff("trap2")
end

//=======================================================================
// Animacje z lup¹
//=======================================================================

function Area_anims(name, event, param)

	if guiMenuInv.movingItemName ~= "lupa" then
		if event == "over" then
			lgs:ObjectName(param)
		end
		return 1
	end

	if event == "over" then
		lgs:ObjectName(param)

	elseif event == "in" then

           guiMenuInv:ShineOn(0.3)

  	elseif event == "out" then
	    guiMenuInv:ShineOff()

	elseif event == "click" then
		TwinAnimBkg(name, "standard", 1, 1)

		if name == "rozgwiazdy" and not MapFlag("+help")  then
            if not FindTask("Task_Help") then
            	SetMapFlag("+help")
	   			CreateTask("Task_Help")
	   			return 1
	   		end
	   	end
	end
end

function lgs:ObjectName(object)

	if object == "palma" then
		gui:MouseText(Str("africa_cross.palm"))
	elseif object == "kotwica" then
		gui:MouseText(Str("freq.kotwica"))
	elseif object == "rozgwiazdy" then
		gui:MouseText(Str("africa_coast.rozgwiazdy"))
    end
end

function OnLevelUpdate()
	if not lgs.counter or lgs.counter <= 0 then
		PlaySound(random(1,2) == 1 and "\\creak_1.wav" or "\\creak_2.wav", -1,"statek_sound")
		lgs.counter = 30*random(10,15)
	else
		lgs.counter = lgs.counter - 1
	end
end
////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
//=======================================================================
// Podpowiedzi
//=======================================================================
///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////


if not MapFlag("+help_zabrany") and not MapFlag("+help") then
	lgs.help= NewObject("zarowka.object3d")
	go(lgs.help, "place", "help_start")
	go(lgs.help, "evOnEndThrow", "HelpWyladowal")
	go(lgs.help, "evOnUpdateThrow", "HelpLeci")
	go(lgs.help, "scale",0)
	go(lgs.help, "evOnMouseOver", "OnHelpOver")
	lgs.helpshine  = CreatePartEffect("data\\fx\\gwiazdki1.apd", "",-1, "data\\bitmap\\shine", 15)
	StopParticle(lgs.helpshine)
	lgs.helpefekt = CreatePartEffect("data\\fx\\piana3.apd", "",-1, "data\\bitmap\\shine_3_blueb", 0)
	StopParticle(lgs.helpefekt)
elseif not MapFlag("+help_zabrany") and MapFlag("+help") then
	lgs.help= NewObject("zarowka.object3d")
	go(lgs.help, "scale", 1)
	go(lgs.help, "place", "help_stop")
	go(lgs.help, "evOnMouseClick", "OnHelpTake")
	go(lgs.help, "evOnMouseOver", "OnHelpOver")
end


function HelpLeci(item)
	StartParticle(lgs.helpshine)
    go(item, "rotate", 30 )
    go(item,"angUp",random(30 ))
	SetPartPos(lgs.helpshine, go(item,"pos"))
end

function HelpWyladowal(item)
	go(item,"angUp",0)
	StopParticle(lgs.helpshine)
	CreateTask("Task_HelpEfekt")
	go(lgs.help, "evOnMouseClick", "OnHelpTake")
end

function OnHelpTake()
	RemoveTask("Task_HelpEfekt")
	if lgs.helpefekt then
		StopParticle(lgs.helpefekt)
	end
	if not MapFlag("+help_zabrany") then
	    AddHelp()
	    SetMapFlag("+help_zabrany")
    end
    go(lgs.help,"remove")
end

function OnHelpOver(obj)
	gui:MouseText(go(obj,"nameVis"))
   	gui:MouseCursor("select")
   	guiDesktop.mouseDetect = nil
end

function Task_HelpEfekt( )
	BeginTask()
 	lgs.promien = 10
	lgs.kat = 0
	lgs.partlicznik = 0
	local a =   go(lgs.help,"pos" )
	a.y = a.y+1
	local v = {}
	v.x = a.x
	v.y = a.y
	v.z = a.z
    StartParticle(lgs.helpefekt)
    CreatePartEffect("data\\fx\\energy1.apd", go(lgs.help,"pos"), 2 , "data\\bitmap\\fx\\shine_twirl_purple", 2)
	repeat
		if lgs.promien >2 then
	    	lgs.promien = lgs.promien -1
	    end
        lgs.partlicznik = lgs.partlicznik+1
		v.x = a.x + sin(lgs.kat) * lgs.promien
		v.z = a.z + cos(lgs.kat) * lgs.promien
		lgs.kat = lgs.kat + 20
		Wait(0.01)
		if random(1,2) >1.5 then
			v.y = 5
		else
			v.y = 1
		end
		SetPartPos(lgs.helpefekt,v)
	until lgs.partlicznik >60
	StopParticle(lgs.helpefekt)
    lgs.partlicznik = 0

    RemoveTask()

end


function Task_Help()
	BeginTask()
	Wait(0.2)
	go(lgs.help, "scale",1)
	go(lgs.help, "throwAngle", "help_stop", 70  , 5)

	RemoveTask()
end
function OnLevelRelease()
	Area_anims = nil
	RemoveTask("Task_HelpEfekt")
    Task_HelpEfekt = nil
    RemoveTask("Task_Help")
    Task_Help = nil
    HelpLeci = nil
    HelpWyladowal = nil
    OnHelpTake = nil
    OnHelpOver = nil
	guiMenuInv:ShineRelease()
end

function OnLevelEntered()
	if not MapFlag("+afryka")then
		HudMsg(Str("rozdz.2") , 5, 200, 100, 2)
		SetMapFlag("+afryka")
        --PlaySound("\\afryka_bebny.wav")
        PlayMusic("data\\music\\afryka.ogg")
	end
end

function FireRing_extendet( )
 	BeginTask()
 	local efekt = CreatePartEffect("data\\fx\\gwiazdki1b.apd", "", -1, "data\\bitmap\\shine_3_blueb", 1 )
 	local promien = 10
	local kat = 0
	local a =   GroundPoint("beczka")
	local v = {}
	local licznik = 60
	v.x = a.x
	v.y = a.y
	v.z = a.z
    StartParticle(efekt)
	repeat
        SetPartPos(efekt,v)
        licznik = licznik -1
		promien =  promien
		v.x = a.x + sin( kat) *  promien
		v.z = a.z + cos( kat) *  promien
		kat =  kat + 40
		Wait(0.001)
		SetPartPos(efekt,v)
		v.y = v.y + 0.3

	until  licznik <=0
		StopParticle(efekt)

	RemoveTask()
end
function OnLevelEntered()
	CreateTask("Task_Rozmowa")
end

function OnLevelUpdate()
	if not lgs.counter or lgs.counter <= 0 then
		PlaySound(random(1,2) == 1 and "\\creak_1.wav" or "\\creak_2.wav", -1)
		lgs.counter = 30*random(10,15)
	else
		lgs.counter = lgs.counter - 1
	end
end //koniec OnLevelUpdate

function OnLevelRelease()
	RemoveTask("Task_Rozmowa")
	Task_Rozmowa = nil
	Area_beczka = nil
	OnBeczkaTake = nil
	RemoveTask("FireRing_extendet")
	FireRing_extendet = nil
end

	go(lgs.kajetan,"place","well_point")

end

	if Distance(lgs.kajetanPos ,GroundPoint(name.."_point") ) <100 then
		ASObjectOn(name.."_area")
	else
		ASObjectOff(name.."_area")
	end
end


//=======================================================================
// Obs³uga mlotka
//=======================================================================


if not Flag("mlotek_zabrany") and not Flag("mlotek") then
	lgs.mlotek = NewObject("mlotek.object3d")
	EnableTriangle("mlotek_start",1)
	go(lgs.mlotek, "place", "mlotek_start")
	EnableTriangle("mlotek_start",0)
	go(lgs.mlotek, "toTake", 1)
	go(lgs.mlotek, "evOnEndThrow", "MlotekWyladowal")
	go(lgs.mlotek, "evOnUpdateThrow", "MlotekLeci")
	go(lgs.mlotek, "scale",0)

	lgs.shineParticle = CreatePartEffect("data\\fx\\gwiazdki1.apd", "",-1, "data\\bitmap\\fx\\shine_blue", 1)
	lgs.efekt = CreatePartEffect("data\\fx\\moj2_fullcolor.apd", "", -1, "data\\bitmap\\shine", 1 )
elseif not Flag("mlotek_zabrany")and Flag("mlotek") then
	lgs.mlotek = NewObject("mlotek.object3d")
	go(lgs.mlotek, "toTake", 1)
	go(lgs.mlotek, "place", "mlotek")
	go(lgs.mlotek, "scale",1)
	go(lgs.mlotek, "evOnTake", "OnMlotekTake")
end

function Task_Mlotek()
	BeginTask()
	go(lgs.mlotek , "throwAngle", "mlotek", 60 , 5)
	SetFlag("mlotek")
	RemoveTask()
end

function MlotekLeci(item)
	StartParticle(lgs.shineParticle)
	lgs.mloteklicznik = lgs.mloteklicznik +0.02
	go(item, "scale",lgs.mloteklicznik)
    go(item, "rotate", 20)
	SetPartPos(lgs.shineParticle,  go(item,"pos"))
end

function MlotekWyladowal(item)
	 lgs.mloteklicznik = 0
 	 StopParticle(lgs.shineParticle)
 	 CreateTask("FireRing_extendet")
 	 go(lgs.mlotek, "evOnTake", "OnMlotekTake")
end

function OnMlotekTake()
    SetFlag("mlotek_zabrany")
	RemoveTask("FireRing_extendet")
	if lgs.efekt then
		StopParticle(lgs.efekt)
	end
end
//=======================================================================
// Animacje z lup¹
//=======================================================================

function Area_anims(name, event, param)
	if guiMenuInv.movingItemName ~= "lupa" then
		if event == "over" then
			lgs:ObjectName(param)
		end
		return 1
	end

	if event == "over" then
		lgs:ObjectName(param)
	elseif event == "in" then

           guiMenuInv:ShineOn(0.3)
	elseif event == "out" then
	    guiMenuInv:ShineOff()

	elseif event == "click" then
		TwinAnimBkg(name, "standard", 1, 1)
		if not Flag("mlotek") and name == "palma1" then
			CreateTask("Task_Mlotek")
			return 1
  		end

		if name == "palma5" and not MapFlag("+help")  then
            if not FindTask("Task_Help") then
            	SetMapFlag("+help")
	   			CreateTask("Task_Help")
	   			return 1
	   		end
	   	end
	end
end

function lgs:ObjectName(object)
	if object == "palma" then
		gui:MouseText(Str("africa_cross.palm"))
	end
end


//=======================================================================
// Obs³uga jaskini

	if event == "over" then
		gui:MouseText(Str("africa_cross.cave"))
	end
end



//=======================================================================

//=======================================================================

if not Flag("mostek_postawiony") then

	function Area_szczelina(name, event,param)
		if event == "over"  then
	        guiDesktop.update = nil
			gui:MouseImg("doSome")
			gui:MouseText (Str("africa_cross.szczelina"))
		elseif event == "click" then
			if guiMenuInv.movingItemName == "mostek" then
			  	RemoveFromInv("mostek")

				SetFlag("mostek_postawiony")
				EnableTriangle("szczelina_1",1)
				EnableTriangle("szczelina_2",1)
			return 1
			end

			if param == 1 then
				HudText(Str("hint.druga_szczelina_1"))
			elseif param == 2 then
				HudText(Str("hint.druga_szczelina_2"))
			end
		end

	EnableTriangle("szczelina_2",0)

	EnableTriangle("szczelina_1",1)
	EnableTriangle("szczelina_2",1)
	TwinAnimBkg("mostek", "set", 0, 0)

//=======================================================================

	if event == "over" then
		if not Flag("droga_otwarta") then
			gui:MouseImg("doSome")
		 	gui:MouseText (Str("africa_cross.rock"))
		end
	elseif event == "help" then
