		elseif param == 2 then
			HudText(Str("hint.skala_2"))
		end
	end
end

function Area_skok(name,event)
	if event == "over" then
		if not Flag("droga_otwarta")  then
		 	if not lgs.coll and (guiDesktop.markerType == "jump1" or guiDesktop.markerType == "jump2") then
			    lgs.coll = 1
			    TwinAnimBkg("kamien", "shake", 0, 0)
			end
		end
	else
		if  lgs.coll == 1 then
			lgs.coll = nil
		end
	end
end

function Level_OnActorStopJumping(actor, mode)
	if mode == "JUMP" and Distance(lgs.kajetanPos ,GroundPoint("skala_point") ) <50  and not Flag("droga_otwarta")then

	   if lgs.licznik < 2 then
			lgs.licznik = lgs.licznik +1
			Wait(0.2)
			TwinAnimBkg("kamien", "hit", 1, 1)
		else

			TwinAnimBkg("kamien", "hit2", 1, 1)
			CreateTask("Task_Przejscie")

			for i = 1,2 do
				EnableTriangle("przejscie_"..i ,1)
			end
			SetFlag("droga_otwarta")
			ASObjectOff("szczelina1_area")
		end
	end

	go(lgs.kajetan, "evOnStopJump", "Level_OnActorStopJumping")

	end

	end
	ASObjectOff("szczelina1_area")
    TwinAnimBkg("kamien", "lie", 1, 1)
end

function FireRing_extendet( )
 	BeginTask()
 	local promien = 10
	local kat = 0
	local a =   GroundPoint("mlotek")
	local v = {}
	v.x = a.x
	v.y = a.y +10
	v.z = a.z
    StartParticle(lgs.efekt)
	repeat
		promien =  promien - 0.1
		v.x = a.x + sin( kat) *  promien
		v.z = a.z + cos( kat) *  promien
		kat =  kat + 20
		Wait(0.01)
		SetPartPos(lgs.efekt,v)
		v.y = v.y +0.02
	until  promien <0
		StopParticle(lgs.efekt)

	RemoveTask()
end

function Task_Przejscie()
	BeginTask()
	Wait(0.4)
	local efekt3  = CreatePartEffect("data\\fx\\gwiazdki1b.apd", "przejscie_2", -1, "data\\bitmap\\fx\\ufoblysk3", 1 )
	StopParticle(efekt3)
 	local promien = 25
	local kat = 0
	local a =  GroundPoint("przejscie_2")
	local v = {}
	v.x = a.x
	v.y = a.y
	v.z = a.z
    StartParticle(efekt3)
	repeat
 		promien = promien - 0.2
		v.x = a.x + sin(kat) * promien
		v.z = a.z + cos(kat) * promien
		kat = kat + 30
		Wait(0.01)
		SetPartPos(efekt3,v)
        v.y = v.y+0.5
	until promien <0
	StopParticle(efekt3)
	RemoveTask()
end

function HelpLeci(item)
	StartParticle(lgs.helpshine)
    go(item, "rotate", 30 )
    go(item,"angUp",random(30 ))
	SetPartPos(lgs.helpshine, go(item,"pos"))
end

function HelpWyladowal(item)
 	go(item,"angUp",0)
	 StopParticle(lgs.helpshine)

	 CreateTask("Task_HelpEfekt")
end

function OnHelpTake()
	RemoveTask("Task_HelpEfekt")
	if lgs.helpefekt then
		StopParticle(lgs.helpefekt)
	end
	if not MapFlag("+help_zabrany") then
	    AddHelp()
	    SetMapFlag("+help_zabrany")
    end
    go(lgs.help,"remove")
end

function OnHelpOver(obj)
	gui:MouseText(go(obj,"nameVis"))
   	gui:MouseCursor("select")
   	guiDesktop.mouseDetect = nil
end

function Task_HelpEfekt( )
	BeginTask()
 	lgs.promien = 10
	lgs.kat = 0
	lgs.partlicznik = 0
	local a =   go(lgs.help,"pos" )
	a.y = a.y+1
	local v = {}
	v.x = a.x
	v.y = a.y
	v.z = a.z
    StartParticle(lgs.helpefekt)
    CreatePartEffect("data\\fx\\energy1.apd", go(lgs.help,"pos"), 2 , "data\\bitmap\\fx\\shine_twirl_purple", 2)
	repeat
		if lgs.promien >2 then
	    	lgs.promien = lgs.promien -1
	    end
        lgs.partlicznik = lgs.partlicznik+1
		v.x = a.x + sin(lgs.kat) * lgs.promien
		v.z = a.z + cos(lgs.kat) * lgs.promien
		lgs.kat = lgs.kat + 20
		Wait(0.01)
		if random(1,2) >1.5 then
			v.y = 5
		else
			v.y = 1
		end
		SetPartPos(lgs.helpefekt,v)
	until lgs.partlicznik >60
	StopParticle(lgs.helpefekt)
    lgs.partlicznik = 0
    go(lgs.help, "evOnMouseClick", "OnHelpTake")
    RemoveTask()

end

	go(lgs.help, "scale",1)
	go(lgs.help, "throwAngle", "help_stop", 70  , 5)

	RemoveTask()

		gui:MouseText(Str("freq.schody"))

function Area_anims(name, event, param)
	if guiMenuInv.movingItemName ~= "lupa" then
		if event == "over" then
			lgs:ObjectName(param)
		end
		return
	end

	if event == "over" then
		lgs:ObjectName(param)
	elseif event == "in" then

		guiMenuInv:ShineOn(0.8)
	elseif event == "out" then

		guiMenuInv:ShineOff()
	elseif event == "click" then
		TwinAnimBkg(name, "standard", 1, 1)
		return 1
	end
end

function OnLevelUpdate()
	if lgs.game then
		ClearMapFlag("szaman_dance")
		if lgs.gamePause then
			return
		end
		gui:MouseCursor("no")
		lgs:KbdGameUpdate()
		if lgs.celowanie then
			lgs:ComputeAttackPoint2D()
		end
		if lgs.celowanie and not lgs.multiPlayer then
			if abs(currentTime - lgs.lastChangeOwnDir) > (lgs.obrona and 0.7 or 0.5) then
				if lgs.obrona then
					if lgs.enemyDir == lgs.ownDir then
						if lgs.enemyDir > 0.1 then
							lgs:SetEnemyDir(-1)
						else
							lgs:SetEnemyDir(1)
						end
					end
				else
					lgs:SetEnemyDir(lgs.ownDir)
				end
			else
				lgs:SetEnemyDir()
			end
		end

	else

		lgs.aktorPos = go(lgs.aktor,"pos")
		lgs.szamanPos = go(lgs.szaman,"pos")

		if Distance2D(lgs.szamanPos.x,lgs.szamanPos.z, lgs.aktorPos.x, lgs.aktorPos.z) <= 70 then
			if not MapFlag("rozmowa") then
				SetMapFlag("rozmowa")

					CreateTask("Task_SzamanRozmowa")
				end
			else

			end
		else
	        if MapFlag("rozmowa") then
		   	ClearMapFlag("rozmowa")
			else

			end
			if  not FindTask("Task_SzamanDance") and  not FindTask("Task_SzamanRozmowa") and not FindTask("Task_OtwieranieStudni")  then
				CreateTask("Task_SzamanDance")

				if not MapFlag("szaman_dance")and not lgs.game then
				 		go(lgs.szaman,"anim","dance", 1,-1)
				 		SetMapFlag("szaman_dance")
				 	end
				end
 			end
 	end
end

function lgs:ComputeAttackPoint2D()
	if lgs.attackPoint then
		lgs.attackPoint2D = MapWorldToScreen(lgs.attackPoint)
	else
		lgs.attackPoint2D = nil
	end
end

function lgs:SetAttack(dir)
	if lgs.attackDir == dir then
		return
	end
	lgs.attackDir = dir
    lgs.pAttack = VectorMid(lgs.pSLewy, lgs.pSPrawy, 0.5 + 0.35 * lgs.attackDir)
    local d = Distance(lgs.pPilka, lgs.pAttack)
    local p = VectorMid(lgs.pPilka, lgs.pAttack, 52 / d)
    SetRectPos(lgs.strzAttack, p, 1)
    SetRectAngle(lgs.strzAttack, DirToAngle(lgs.pPilka, lgs.pAttack))

	local pDef = lgs.pPilka
	if dir < -0.1 then
		pDef = lgs.pSLewyLook
	elseif dir > 0.1 then
		pDef = lgs.pSPrawyLook
	end
    d = Distance(lgs.pBramkarz, pDef)
    lgs.attackPoint = VectorMid(lgs.pBramkarz, pDef, 28 / d)
    //d = Distance(lgs.pStrzelec, pDef)
    //lgs.attackPoint = VectorMid(lgs.pStrzelec, pDef, 30 / d)
    lgs:ComputeAttackPoint2D()
end


function lgs:SetDef(dir)
	if lgs.defDir == dir then
		return
	end
	lgs.defDir = dir

	local pDef = lgs.pPilka
	if dir < -0.1 then
		pDef = lgs.pSLewyLook
	elseif dir > 0.1 then
		pDef = lgs.pSPrawyLook
	end
    local d = Distance(lgs.pBramkarz, pDef)
    local p = VectorMid(lgs.pBramkarz, pDef, 15 / d)
    SetRectPos(lgs.strzDef, p, 1)
    SetRectAngle(lgs.strzDef, DirToAngle(lgs.pBramkarz, pDef))
end


function lgs:SetOwnDir(dir)
	if dir then
		lgs.ownDir = dir
	elseif lgs.forceChangeOwnDir or (abs(currentTime - lgs.lastChangeOwnDir) > 0.3 and random(0, 6) < 1) then
		if lgs.obrona then
			if lgs.ownDir == lgs.enemyDir then
				return
			else
				lgs.ownDir = random(-1, 1)
			end
		else
			if lgs.ownDir ~= lgs.enemyDir then
				return
			else
				lgs.ownDir = random(-1, 1)
			end
		end
	else
		return
	end
	lgs.forceChangeOwnDir = nil

	if lgs.obrona then
		lgs:SetDef(lgs.ownDir)
		//lgs.forceChangeEnemyDir = random(1, 100) < 30 and 1 or nil
	else
		lgs:SetAttack(lgs.ownDir)
		lgs.forceChangeEnemyDir = 1
	end

	lgs.lastChangeOwnDir = currentTime
end


function lgs:SetEnemyDir(dir)
	if dir then
		lgs.enemyDir = dir
	elseif lgs.forceChangeEnemyDir or (abs(currentTime - lgs.lastChangeEnemyDir) > 0.3 and random(0, 6) < 1) then
		if lgs.obrona then
			if lgs.enemyDir ~= lgs.ownDir then
				return
			else
				lgs.enemyDir = random(-1, 1)
			end
		else
			if lgs.enemyDir == lgs.ownDir then
				return
			else
				lgs.enemyDir = random(-1, 1)
			end
		end
	else
		return
	end
	lgs.forceChangeEnemyDir = nil

	if lgs.obrona then
		lgs:SetAttack(lgs.enemyDir)
	else
		lgs:SetDef(lgs.enemyDir)
	end

	lgs.lastChangeEnemyDir = currentTime
	lgs.forceChangeOwnDir = 1
end


function lgs:KbdGameUpdate()

	if FindTask("Task_strzal") then
		if lgs.celowanie then

			if KbdStruck("left") then
				lgs:SetOwnDir(-1)
			elseif KbdStruck("down") or KbdStruck("up") then
				lgs:SetOwnDir(0)
			elseif KbdStruck("right") then
				lgs:SetOwnDir(1)
			end

			if lgs.multiPlayer then
				if KbdStruck("q") then
					lgs:SetEnemyDir(-1)
				elseif KbdStruck("w") then
					lgs:SetEnemyDir(0)
				elseif KbdStruck("e") then
					lgs:SetEnemyDir(1)
				end
			end

/*
			if KbdStruck("left") then
				if lgs.cel > -0.5 then
					lgs.cel	= lgs.cel - 1
					lgs:CountCel()
				end
			elseif KbdStruck("right") then
				if lgs.cel < 0.5 then
					lgs.cel	= lgs.cel + 1
					lgs:CountCel()
				end
			end
*/
		end
	else
		if KbdStruck("space") then
    		CreateTask("Task_strzal")
		end
	end
end

	go(lgs.strzelec, "walk", VectorMid(lgs.pStrzelec, lgs.pPilka, 0.9), 1)
   	go(lgs.strzelec, "anim", "football_run", 0.2, -1)
   	WFWalkTo(lgs.strzelec)
   	go(lgs.strzelec, "anim", "wykop")
   	Wait(0.5)

   	lgs.celowanie = nil

    local p = VectorMid(lgs.pPilka, lgs.pAttack, 2)
   	go(lgs.pilka, "throwAngle", p, 3, 1.7)
   	PlaySound("models\\kop.wav")

	//go(lgs.bramkarz, "jump", pRzut, 1)
	if lgs.defDir > 0.9 then
		go(lgs.bramkarz, "qAnim", "rzut_lewo", 0.1, 1, 1, 0)
		go(lgs.bramkarz, "qDelay", 0.5)
		go(lgs.bramkarz, "qAnim", "po_rzucie_lewo", 0.1, -1)
	elseif lgs.defDir < -0.9 then
		go(lgs.bramkarz, "qAnim", "rzut_prawo", 0.1, 1, 1, 0)
		go(lgs.bramkarz, "qDelay", 0.5)
		go(lgs.bramkarz, "qAnim", "po_rzucie_prawo", 0.1, -1)
	else
		if lgs.attackDir == lgs.defDir then
			go(lgs.bramkarz, "qAnim", "rzut_przod", 0.1, 1, 1, 0)
			go(lgs.bramkarz, "qDelay", 0.5)
			go(lgs.bramkarz, "qAnim", "po_rzucie_przod", 0.1, -1)
		else
			go(lgs.bramkarz, "anim", "idle")
		end
	end
	Wait(0.15)
	local pRzut = VectorMid(lgs.pSLewyLook, lgs.pSPrawyLook, 0.5 + 0.28 * lgs.defDir)
	go(lgs.bramkarz, "throwAngle", pRzut, 3, 1)

	lgs.count = lgs.count + 1

   	SetRectColor(lgs.strzAttack, lgs.obrona and RGBA(1, 0, 0, 0.4) or RGBA(0, 0, 1, 0.4))
   	SetRectColor(lgs.strzDef, lgs.obrona and RGBA(0, 0, 1, 0.4) or RGBA(1, 0, 0, 0.4))

	Wait(0.25)

	local stop
	if lgs.attackDir == lgs.defDir then
		stop = 1
	//elseif not lgs.obrona and lgs.attackDir == 0 and random(1, 100) < 78 then
		//stop = 1
	end
	if lgs.defDir ~= 0 or stop then
   		PlaySound("models\\obrona.wav")
   	end

	if stop then
		go(lgs.pilka, "stop")
	   	go(lgs.strzelec, "anim", "missed", 0.2, -1)
	else
		if lgs.obrona then
			lgs.enemyPoints = lgs.enemyPoints + 1
		else
			lgs.ownPoints = lgs.ownPoints + 1
		end
	   	go(lgs.strzelec, "anim", "gol", 0.2, -1)
	end

	Wait(0.15)

	if stop then
		local pPilka
		if lgs.defDir > 0.9 then
			pPilka = go(lgs.bramkarz, "bonePos", "r_l_4")
		elseif lgs.defDir < -0.9 then
			pPilka = go(lgs.bramkarz, "bonePos", "r_p_4")
		else
			pPilka = VectorMid(go(lgs.bramkarz, "bonePos", "r_p_4"), go(lgs.bramkarz, "bonePos", "r_l_4"))
			pPilka.y = pPilka.y - 4
		end
		go(lgs.pilka, "place", pPilka)
	end

	Wait(1.5)

   	RemoveRect(lgs.strzAttack)
   	lgs.strzCel = nil

   	RemoveRect(lgs.strzDef)
   	lgs.strzDef = nil

	lgs.gamePause = 1
	if lgs.count + 0.1 > lgs.countMax then
		lgs:Stop(0)
	else
		SlideShow({}, nil, 0.5, lgs.NaMiejsca)
		Wait(0.55)
	end
	RemoveTask()
end


function lgs:StartGame(obrona)
    go(lgs.szaman, "hideAttachedModel", "laska")
	go(lgs.aktor, "stop")
	SetMapFlag("+po_grze")
	if lgs.game then
		return
	end
	lgs.game = 1

	lgs.count = 0

	DesktopOff()

	if type(obrona) == "table" then
		obrona = obrona.obrona
	end
	lgs.obrona = obrona

	Reveal(lgs.slupekLewy)
	go(lgs.slupekLewy, "place", lgs.pSLewy)
	//go(lgs.slupekLewy, "anim", "standing_happy", 0, -1)
	go(lgs.slupekLewy, "rotateToPoint", lgs.pSLewyLook, 1)

	Reveal(lgs.slupekPrawy)
	go(lgs.slupekPrawy, "place", lgs.pSPrawy)
	go(lgs.slupekPrawy, "anim", "idle", 0, -1,1.1)
	go(lgs.slupekPrawy, "rotateToPoint", lgs.pSPrawyLook, 1)

	Reveal(lgs.pilka)

	//RemoveTask("Task_SzamanDance")
    go(lgs.szaman,"stop" )

	lgs:NaMiejsca()
end


function lgs:StopGame(nextHalf)
	ClearMapFlag("info")

	if not lgs.game then
		return
	end
	lgs.game = nil
    go(lgs.szaman, "revealAttachedModel", "laska")
	if not MapFlag("_MINI_GAME") then
		DesktopOn()
	end

	go(lgs.pilka, "hide")
	go(lgs.slupekLewy, "hide")
	go(lgs.slupekPrawy, "hide")

	go(lgs.szaman, "anim", "dance", 0.2, -1)
	go(lgs.aktor, "anim", "idle", 0.2, -1)

	guiScroll.traceObject = lgs.aktor

	if nextHalf then
		lgs:NextHalf(nextHalf)
	end
end


function lgs:StopOut()
	//lgs.noFadeIn = 1
	local from = MapFlag("_MINI_GAME")
	if from and from ~= "_OUT" then
		local fileName = guiMenu:IsSave("autosave")
		if not fileName or not SafeLoad(fileName..".ssv") then
			__ResetGame()
			Menu("menuMain", 1, {"minigames"})
		end
	else
		__ResetGame()
		Menu("menuMain", 1, {"minigames"})
	end
end


function Task_Wynik()
	BeginTask()
	local from = MapFlag("_MINI_GAME")
	if from and from ~= "_OUT" and lgs.ownPoints >= lgs.enemyPoints then
		local hud = AddHelp(1)
		WFHud(hud)
	end
	Msg(lgs.msgText, Str("msg.endGame"), {{caption = Str("keyCaption.yes"), key = "enter", func = lgs._Start, funcParam = {count = lgs.countMax, multiPlayer = lgs.multiPlayer, startFadeTime = -1}}, {caption = Str("keyCaption.no"), key = "esc", func = lgs.StopOut}})
	lgs.msgText = nil
	RemoveTask()
end


function lgs:NextHalf(startFadeTime)
	if lgs.game then
		return
	end
	if lgs.half > 1.1 then
		//koniec gry
		if MapFlag("_MINI_GAME") then

			if lgs.multiPlayer then
				local scoreTxt
				if lgs.ownPoints > lgs.enemyPoints then
                	scoreTxt = format(Str("africa_well.miniGameWin1"), lgs.ownPoints, lgs.enemyPoints)
                elseif lgs.ownPoints < lgs.enemyPoints then
					scoreTxt = format(Str("africa_well.miniGameWin2"), lgs.enemyPoints, lgs.ownPoints)
                else
                	scoreTxt = format(Str("africa_well.miniGameTie"), lgs.enemyPoints, lgs.ownPoints)
                end

				Msg(scoreTxt.."| |"..Str("msg.playOnceMorePlayers"), Str("msg.endGame"), {{caption = Str("keyCaption.yes"), key = "enter", func = lgs._Start, funcParam = {count = lgs.countMax, multiPlayer = lgs.multiPlayer, startFadeTime = -1}}, {caption = Str("keyCaption.no"), key = "esc", func = lgs.StopOut}})

			else
				miejsce = AddHighScore2(gc_savedGamesDir.."\\game4.hs", lgs.ownPoints, lgs.enemyPoints)
				local score
				if miejsce then
					score = format(Str("msg.scoreOK"), miejsce)
				else
					score = Str("msg.scoreSmall")
				end
				local scoreTxt
				if lgs.ownPoints > lgs.enemyPoints then
                	scoreTxt = format(Str("africa_well.miniGameYouWin"), lgs.ownPoints, lgs.enemyPoints)
                elseif lgs.ownPoints < lgs.enemyPoints then
					scoreTxt = format(Str("africa_well.miniGameYouLoose"), lgs.enemyPoints, lgs.ownPoints)
                else
                	scoreTxt = format(Str("africa_well.miniGameTie"), lgs.enemyPoints, lgs.ownPoints)
                end

				lgs.msgText = scoreTxt.."|"..score.."| |"..Str("msg.playOnceMore")
				CreateTask("Task_Wynik")
			end


			//Msg(Str("msg.playOnceMore"), Str("msg.endGame"), {{caption = Str("keyCaption.yes"), key = "enter", func = lgs._Start, funcParam = {count = lgs.countMax, multiPlayer = lgs.multiPlayer, startFadeTime = -1}}, {caption = Str("keyCaption.no"), key = "esc", func = lgs.StopOut}})
			//lgs:StopOut()

		else
			local ok
			local y = ScreenHeight() * 0.5 - 50
			if lgs.ownPoints > lgs.enemyPoints then
				if lgs.multiPlayer then
					//HudMsg("Wygra³ gracz 1 - ("..lgs.ownPoints..":"..lgs.enemyPoints..")", nil, nil, y)
					HudMsg(format(Str("africa_well.miniGameWin1"), lgs.ownPoints, lgs.enemyPoints), nil, nil, y)
				else
					HudMsg(format(Str("africa_well.miniGameYouWin"), lgs.ownPoints, lgs.enemyPoints), nil, nil, y)
					//HudMsg("Wygra³e - ("..lgs.ownPoints..":"..lgs.enemyPoints..")", nil, nil, y)
					ok = 1
				end
			elseif lgs.ownPoints < lgs.enemyPoints then
				if lgs.multiPlayer then
					HudMsg(format(Str("africa_well.miniGameWin2"), lgs.enemyPoints, lgs.ownPoints), nil, nil, y)
					//HudMsg("Wygra³ gracz 2 - ("..lgs.enemyPoints..":"..lgs.ownPoints..")", nil, nil, y)

				else
					//Msg(format(Str("africa_well.miniGameYouLoose"), lgs.enemyPoints, lgs.ownPoints).."|"..Str("msg.tryAgain"), Str("msg.youLoose"), {{caption = Str("keyCaption.ok"), key = "enter", func = lgs._Start, funcParam = {count = lgs.countMax, multiPlayer = lgs.multiPlayer}}})
					local func, param
					if not MapFlag("+szaman_podszedl") then
						func = CreateTask
						param = "Task_SzamanRozmowa"
					end
					Msg(format(Str("africa_well.miniGameYouLoose"), lgs.enemyPoints, lgs.ownPoints).."| |"..Str("msg.playOnceMore"), Str("msg.youLoose"), {{caption = Str("keyCaption.yes"), key = "enter", func = lgs._Start, funcParam = {count = lgs.countMax, multiPlayer = lgs.multiPlayer}}, {caption = Str("keyCaption.no"), key = "esc", func = func, global = 1, funcParam = param}}, 1)
				end
			else
				HudMsg(format(Str("africa_well.miniGameTie"), lgs.enemyPoints, lgs.ownPoints), nil, nil, y)
				//HudMsg("Remis!", nil, nil, y)
            	ok = 1
			end
			if ok and not MapFlag("+szaman_podszedl") then
        	   	CreateTask("Task_SzamanRozmowa")

        	end
       	end

	else
		lgs.half = lgs.half + 1
		lgs.obrona = not lgs.obrona
		local text
		if lgs.multiPlayer then
			text = Str("info2b_start")
		else
			if lgs.obrona then
				text = Str("info2_start")
			else
				text = Str("info2a_start")
			end
		end
		SlideShow({"data\\bitmap\\info2.tga"}, 3600, startFadeTime, lgs.StartGame, nil, {obrona = lgs.obrona}, {{rect = Rect(190, 163, 636, 489), text = text, fontSize=0.45, fontSpace=-7, lineSpace=-4}})
		//SlideShow({"data\\bitmap\\info1.tga"}, 180, 0.7, lgs._Start, nil, {count = count, multiPlayer = multiPlayer}, {{rect = Rect(190, 163, 636, 489), text = Str("info1_start"),fontSize=0.45,fontSpace=-7,lineSpace=-4 }})
	end
end


function lgs:Stop(nextHalf)
	SlideShow({}, 3600, 0.8, lgs.StopGame, nil, nextHalf)
end


function lgs:Start(count, multiPlayer, startFadeTime)
PlayMusic("data\\music\\smieci.ogg")
	lgs.ownPoints = 0
	lgs.enemyPoints = 0
	lgs.multiPlayer = multiPlayer

	lgs.countMax = count
	lgs.half = 0
	lgs.obrona = nil
	lgs:NextHalf(startFadeTime and startFadeTime or 0.8)
	//lgs.player1Txt = lgs.multiPlayer and format(Str("msg.playerNo"), 1)..":  " or Str("msg.player")..":  "
	//lgs.player2Txt = lgs.multiPlayer and format(Str("msg.playerNo"), 2)..":  " or Str("msg.opponent")..":  "
	lgs.player1Txt = Str("msg.player1")..":  "
	lgs.player2Txt = Str("msg.player2")..":  "
end


function lgs:_Start(params)
	if params then
		lgs:Start(params.count, params.multiPlayer, params.startFadeTime)
	else
		lgs:Start()
	end
end

//=======================================================================
// Obs³uga desek
//=======================================================================
if not Flag("mostek_zabrany") then
	function Area_deski(name, event,param)
		if event == "over"  then
	        guiDesktop.update = nil
			gui:MouseImg("doSome")
			gui:MouseText(Str("freq.deski"))
			if guiMenuInv:CanGetItem() then
				gui:MouseCursor("select")
			end
		elseif event == "click" then
			if guiMenuInv.movingItemName == "mlotek" then
				if not Flag("mostek_zabrany") then

					CreateTask("Task_mostek")
				end

				return 1
			end
		elseif event == "help" then

			if param == 1 then
				HudText(Str("hint.deski_1"))
			elseif param == 2 then
				HudText(Str("hint.deski_2"))
			end

	    end
	end
else
	ASObjectOff("deski_area")
	TwinAnimBkg("deski", "taken", 0, 0)
end

function Task_mostek()
	BeginTask()
	guiDesktop.mouseEnabled = nil
	RemoveFromInv("mlotek")
	go(lgs.kajetan,"walk","kajetan_deski")
	WFWalkTo(lgs.kajetan)
	go(lgs.kajetan,"rotateToPoint","kajetan_look")
	WFRotate(lgs.kajetan)
	go(lgs.kajetan,"anim","catch",0,1)
	PlaySound("\\przybijanie.wav",1)
	Wait(0.8)
	go(lgs.kajetan,"anim","catch",0,1)
	PlaySound("\\przybijanie.wav",1)
	Wait(0.8)

	TwinAnimBkg("deski", "taken", 0, 0)
	if not guiMenuInv:IsItem("mostek",1) then
    	guiMenuInv:GetItem(NewObject("mostek.object2d"))
    end
    ASObjectOff("deski_area")

	SetFlag("mostek_zabrany")
    guiDesktop.mouseEnabled = 1
	RemoveTask()
end
//=======================================================================
// Animacje z lup¹
//=======================================================================
function Area_anims(name, event, param)
	if guiMenuInv.movingItemName ~= "lupa" then
		if event == "over" then
			lgs:ObjectName(param)
		end
		return
	end

	if event == "over" then
		lgs:ObjectName(param)

	elseif event == "in" then

		guiMenuInv:ShineOn(0.8)

	elseif event == "out" then

		guiMenuInv:ShineOff()

	elseif event == "click" then
		TwinAnimBkg(name, "standard", 1, 1)
        if name == "palma4" and not MapFlag("+help")  then
            if not FindTask("Task_Help") then
            	SetMapFlag("+help")
	   			CreateTask("Task_Help")

	   		end
	   	end
		return 1
	end
end

function lgs:ObjectName(object)
	if object == "palma" then
		gui:MouseText(Str("africa_cross.palm"))
	end
end

function Task_Jaszczurka_szpieg()
	BeginTask()
	if Distance(go(lgs.jaszczurka,"pos") ,go(lgs.kajetan,"pos" )) >20   then
	 	go(lgs.jaszczurka,"rotateToPoint",go(lgs.kajetan,"pos"))
	 	WFRotate(lgs.jaszczurka)
		go(lgs.jaszczurka,"walk",go(lgs.kajetan,"pos"))
	end
	RemoveTask()
end

function Level_OnKajetanWalking(object,mode)
	if mode =="WALK"  then
	    if not FindTask("Task_Jaszczurka_szpieg")  then
			CreateTask("Task_Jaszczurka_szpieg")
		end
	end
end

function Level_OnKajetanStopWalking(object,mode)
	if Distance(go(lgs.jaszczurka,"pos") ,go(lgs.kajetan,"pos" )) <20 then
	   RemoveTask("Task_Jaszczurka_szpieg")
	end
    local tabAnims = {"idle","idle2","catch_eat","catch_eat2" }
    go(lgs.jaszczurka,"stop")
    go(lgs.jaszczurka, "anim",tabAnims[random(1,4)],1)

	go(lgs.help, "evOnUpdateThrow", "HelpLeci")
	go(lgs.help, "scale",0)


	go(lgs.help, "evOnMouseOver", "OnHelpOver")
	lgs.helpshine  = CreatePartEffect("data\\fx\\gwiazdki1.apd", "",-1, "data\\bitmap\\shine", 15)
	StopParticle(lgs.helpshine)
	lgs.helpefekt = CreatePartEffect("data\\fx\\piana3.apd", "",-1, "data\\bitmap\\shine_3_blueb", 0)
	StopParticle(lgs.helpefekt)
elseif not MapFlag("+help_zabrany") and MapFlag("+help") then
	lgs.help= NewObject("zarowka.object3d")
	go(lgs.help, "scale", 1)
	go(lgs.help, "place", "help_stop")
	go(lgs.help, "evOnMouseClick", "OnHelpTake")

end


function HelpLeci(item)
	StartParticle(lgs.helpshine)
    go(item, "rotate", 30 )
    go(item,"angUp",random(30 ))
	SetPartPos(lgs.helpshine, go(item,"pos"))
end

function HelpWyladowal(item)
 	go(item,"angUp",0)
 	go(lgs.help, "evOnMouseClick", "OnHelpTake")
	StopParticle(lgs.helpshine)
	CreateTask("Task_HelpEfekt")
end

function OnHelpTake()
	RemoveTask("Task_HelpEfekt")
	if lgs.helpefekt then
		StopParticle(lgs.helpefekt)
	end
	if not MapFlag("+help_zabrany") then
	    AddHelp()
	    SetMapFlag("+help_zabrany")
    end
    go(lgs.help,"remove")
end

function OnHelpOver(obj)
	gui:MouseText(go(obj,"nameVis"))
   	gui:MouseCursor("select")
   	guiDesktop.mouseDetect = nil
end

function Task_HelpEfekt( )
	BeginTask()
 	lgs.promien = 10
	lgs.kat = 0
	lgs.licznik = 0
	local a =   go(lgs.help,"pos" )
	a.y = a.y+1
	local v = {}
	v.x = a.x
	v.y = a.y
	v.z = a.z
    StartParticle(lgs.helpefekt)
    CreatePartEffect("data\\fx\\energy1.apd", go(lgs.help,"pos"), 2 , "data\\bitmap\\fx\\shine_twirl_purple", 2)
	repeat
		if lgs.promien >2 then
	    	lgs.promien = lgs.promien -1
	    end
        lgs.licznik = lgs.licznik+1
		v.x = a.x + sin(lgs.kat) * lgs.promien
		v.z = a.z + cos(lgs.kat) * lgs.promien
		lgs.kat = lgs.kat + 20
		Wait(0.01)
		if random(1,2) >1.5 then
			v.y = 5
		else
			v.y = 1
		end
		SetPartPos(lgs.helpefekt,v)
	until lgs.licznik >60
	StopParticle(lgs.helpefekt)

    RemoveTask()

end


function Task_Help()
	BeginTask()
	go(lgs.help, "scale",1)
	go(lgs.help, "throwAngle", "help_stop", 70  , 5)

	RemoveTask()
end

function OnLevelRelease()
	Area_deski = nil
	Area_anims = nil
	guiMenuInv:ShineRelease()
	RemoveTask("Task_jaszczurka_szpieg")
	RemoveTask("Task_mostek")
	Task_mostek = nil
	Task_Jaszczurka_szpieg = nil
	Level_OnKajetanWalking = nil
	Level_OnKajetanStopWalking = nil
	RemoveTask("Task_HelpEfekt")
    Task_HelpEfekt = nil
    RemoveTask("Task_Help")
    Task_Help = nil
    HelpLeci = nil
    HelpWyladowal = nil
    OnHelpTake = nil
    OnHelpOver = nil
end

MarkArea(0)
guiScroll.traceHeight = 1


/*#############################################################################

FUNKCJE i Taski

#############################################################################*/

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Funkcja do tworzenia obiektow
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function lgs:TworzObiekty(nazwa, rodzaj, miejsce, tablica, ilosc, wysokosc, xstep, ystep, alfa, tabAngle)
	for i = 1 , ilosc do
		local obj = NewObject(rodzaj)
		local pos = GroundPoint(miejsce.."_"..i)
		go(obj, "place",pos)
		go(obj, "setPosY", wysokosc)
		local ang
		if tabAngle then
			ang = tabAngle[i]
		end
		go(obj, "rotate", ang and ang or random(1, 360))
		if alfa  then
 			go(obj,"setAlpha",alfa)
 		end
		tinsert(tablica, {coll = nil, id = obj, name = nazwa.."_"..i, pos =  pos,xstep = xstep, ystep = ystep})
	end
end


function lgs:ASKolizja(tablica)
	if lgs.lastCollisionTime and currentTime - lgs.lastCollisionTime < 0.6 then
		return
	end

	for i = 1, getn(tablica) do
		local name = "area_"..tablica[i].name
		//print(name)

		if ASIsInside(name, lgs.samolotPos2D.x, lgs.samolotPos2D.y) then
			if not tablica[i].coll then
				lgs.lastCollisionTime = currentTime
			    go(lgs.samolot, "anim", "hit", 0 , 1)
			    PlaySound("\\models\\car_hit_1.wav")
				tablica[i].coll = 1
				//lgs:Punkty()
				--DrawRectangle(Vector(0, ScreenHeight() - 110 , 0),128, 128, RGBA(1,1,1,1))
				//go(lgs.samolot, "brakingTo", 1)
				go(lgs.samolot,"rotate",180)
				go(lgs.samolot, "goForward")
				break
			end

		else
			tablica[i].coll = nil
		end
	end

end


function ACS_OnEndThrow(obj)
	go(obj, "anim", "zlozona", 0, -1)
	go(obj, "hide")
end


function Task_Bravo()
	BeginTask()
	local hud = HudMsg(Str("antarctica_chase_sea.bravo"), nil, nil, ScreenHeight() * 0.5, nil, nil, nil, nil, "center")
	Wait(0.1)
	go(lgs.samolot, "anim", "akr1", 0.2, -1, 0.8)
	WFHud(hud)
	ChangeMap("antarctica_sea_final_scene")
	RemoveTask()
end

function ACS_OnUpdateThrow(obj)
	local pos = VectorMid(go(obj, "bonePos", "skeleton7_1"), go(obj, "bonePos", "skeleton7_2"))
	local dist = Distance(lgs.smieciarzPos, pos)
	//print(dist)
	if dist < 20 then
		RemoveTask("Task_SiatkaRozlozona")
		go(obj, "hide")
		StopGui()
		lgs:SmieciarzStop()
		go(lgs.smieciarz, "revealAttachedModel", "siatka")
		go(lgs.samolot, "speed", 0)
		go(lgs.samolot, "off")
		guiScroll.traceObject = lgs.samolot
		CreateTask("Task_Bravo")
	end
end


function Task_SiatkaRozlozona()
	BeginTask()
	Wait(0.05)
	go(lgs.siatka, "shadow", 1)
	Wait(1)
	local siatka = Object3D(lgs.siatka)
	if siatka then
		go(siatka, "anim", "rozlozona", 0.2, -1)
	end
	RemoveTask()
end


function lgs:CheckSmieciarzPos()
	if lgs.smieciarzPos2D then
		local x = lgs.smieciarzPos2D.x - guiScroll.screenx + ScreenWidth() / 2
		local y = lgs.smieciarzPos2D.y - guiScroll.screeny + ScreenHeight() / 2
		local _x
		local _y
		if x < -50 then
			_x = -1
		elseif x > ScreenWidth() + 50 then
			_x = 1
		end
		if y < -50 then
			_y = -1
		elseif y > ScreenHeight() + 50 then
			_y = 1
		end
		if _x or _y then
			_x = _x or 0
			_y = _y or 0
			if _x < 0 and _y < 0 then
				lgs.arrow = {x = 50, y = 50, ang = 45}
			elseif _x == 0 and _y < 0 then
				lgs.arrow = {x = ScreenWidth() * 0.5, y = 50, ang = 0}
			elseif _x > 0 and _y < 0 then
				lgs.arrow = {x = ScreenWidth() - 50, y = 50, ang = -45}
			elseif _x > 0 and _y == 0 then
				lgs.arrow = {x = ScreenWidth() - 50, y = ScreenHeight() * 0.5, ang = -90}
			elseif _x > 0 and _y > 0 then
				lgs.arrow = {x = ScreenWidth() - 50, y = ScreenHeight() - 50, ang = -135}
			elseif _x == 0 and _y > 0 then
				lgs.arrow = {x = ScreenWidth() * 0.5, y = ScreenHeight() - 50, ang = -180}
			elseif _x < 0 and _y > 0 then
				lgs.arrow = {x = 50, y = ScreenHeight() - 50, ang = -225}
			elseif _x < 0 and _y == 0 then
				lgs.arrow = {x = 50, y = ScreenHeight() * 0.5, ang = 90}
			end
			lgs.arrow.ang = lgs.arrow.ang * PI / 180
			lgs.arrow.y = ScreenHeight() - lgs.arrow.y
		else
			lgs.arrow = nil
		end
	end
end

function lgs:NextPath()
	if not lgs.actPathName then
		return
	end
	local tab = lgs.pathCross[lgs.actPathName]
	if type(tab) == "table" and getn(tab) > 0 then
		lgs.actPathName = tab[random(1, getn(tab))]
	    lgs.actPath = ASGetPathIn3D(lgs.actPathName)
	end
    lgs.actPathPoint = 1
end


function lgs:GoPath(pathName)

			lgs:ObjectName(param)
		end
		return 1
	end

	if event == "over" then

	elseif event == "in" then

	elseif event == "click" then
		TwinAnimBkg(name, "standard", 1, 1)

	end

					end
				end


			end
			local d = 0
			if v.levelDest  then
            	if v.accelerate then
            		v.speed = v.speed + v.accelerate
            	end
				local newLevel
 				if v.levelDest < v.level then
					if v.level - v.speed < v.levelDest then
 						newLevel = v.levelDest
 						v.levelDest = nil
					else
						newLevel = v.level - v.speed
					end
 				else
					if v.level + v.speed > v.levelDest then
 						newLevel = v.levelDest
 						v.levelDest = nil
					else
						newLevel = v.level + v.speed
					end
 				end
 				d = d + newLevel - v.level
				v.level = newLevel

				if not lgs.endGame and v.level < -25 then
					lgs.endGame = 1
					guiDesktop:SetCanJump(0)
					CreateTask("Task_Loose")

				end
				if d ~= 0 then
					MoveArea(v.area, Vector(0, d, 0))
				end
			end
		end

	end

  end

					       else
								v.counter = v.counter - 1

						   end
			       	   end
		       	 elseif v.kierunek ==4 then


		           if Distance( go(v.kra,"pos"),GroundPoint("p3d")) >1 then
		       	    MoveArea(v.area, VectorScale(VectorSub(GroundPoint("p3d"),go(v.kra,"pos")),1/30))
		       	   else
		       	   	if v.counter <= 0 then
							v.counter = 30*3
							v.kierunek = 5

				       else
							v.counter = v.counter - 1

					   end
		       	   end
		      	elseif v.kierunek ==5 then


		           if Distance( go(v.kra,"pos"),GroundPoint("p3")) >1 then
		       	    MoveArea(v.area, VectorScale(VectorSub(GroundPoint("p3"),go(v.kra,"pos")),1/30))
		       	   else
		       	   	if v.counter <= 0 then
							v.counter = 30*3
							v.kierunek = 0

				       else
							v.counter = v.counter - 1

					   end
		       	   end
		       end
		       local d = 0
				if v.levelDest  then
	            	if v.accelerate then
	            		v.speed = v.speed + v.accelerate
	            	end
					local newLevel
	 				if v.levelDest < v.level then
						if v.level - v.speed < v.levelDest then
	 						newLevel = v.levelDest
	 						v.levelDest = nil
						else
							newLevel = v.level - v.speed
						end
	 				else
						if v.level + v.speed > v.levelDest then
	 						newLevel = v.levelDest
	 						v.levelDest = nil
						else
							newLevel = v.level + v.speed
						end
	 				end
	 				d = d + newLevel - v.level
					v.level = newLevel

					if not lgs.endGame and v.level < -25 then
						lgs.endGame = 1
						CreateTask("Task_Loose")

					end
					if d ~= 0 then
						MoveArea(v.area, Vector(0, d, 0))
					end
				end
                if v.counter ==90 then
                	 RotateArea(v.area,PosToVec(v.pos), -4)
                end

			end

	    end
end


function OnActorStartJump(actor)
	if lgs:ActorArea(actor,lgs.movingFloe1) then
		_MoveArea(lgs:ActorArea(actor,lgs.movingFloe1), 0)

	 	for i, v in lgs.movingFloe1 do
	       if i ~="n" then
	       	 v.counter = 90
	       end
		end
	end
	if lgs:ActorArea(actor,lgs.movingFloe2) then
		_MoveArea(lgs:ActorArea(actor,lgs.movingFloe2), 0)
		for i, v in lgs.movingFloe2 do
			if i ~="n" then
				v.counter = 90
			end
		end
	end
	if lgs:ActorArea(actor,lgs.movingFloe3) then
		_MoveArea(lgs:ActorArea(actor,lgs.movingFloe3), 0)
		for i, v in lgs.movingFloe1 do
			if i ~="n" then
				v.counter = 90
			end
		end
	end
    lgs.activeArea = nil
end

function OnActorStopJump(actor)
    CreatePartEffect("data\\fx\\piana4.apd", go(lgs.aktor,"pos"), 0.5 , "data\\bitmap\\fx\\pianka", 0.08)
    PlaySound("\\models\\stepr_snow1.wav")
	if lgs:ActorArea(actor,lgs.movingFloe1) then
        local area = lgs:ActorArea(actor,lgs.movingFloe1)
        PlaySound("\\models\\step_water3.wav")
		if area.levelDest then
			_MoveArea(lgs:ActorArea(actor,lgs.movingFloe1) , -30, 1, 1)
		else
			lgs.activeArea = {
					time = area.time,
					area = area
				}
		end
    end

	if lgs:ActorArea(actor,lgs.movingFloe2) then
        local area = lgs:ActorArea(actor,lgs.movingFloe2)
        PlaySound("\\models\\step_water3.wav")
		if area.levelDest then
			_MoveArea(lgs:ActorArea(actor,lgs.movingFloe2) , -30, 1, 1)
		else
			lgs.activeArea = {
					time = area.time,
					area = area
				}
		end
    end

    if lgs:ActorArea(actor,lgs.movingFloe3) then
        local area = lgs:ActorArea(actor,lgs.movingFloe3)
        PlaySound("\\models\\step_water3.wav")
		if area.levelDest then
			_MoveArea(lgs:ActorArea(actor,lgs.movingFloe3) , -30, 1, 1)
		else
			lgs.activeArea = {
					time = area.time,
					area = area
				}
		end
    end

end

function _MoveArea(area, level ,speed, accelerate)
	area.levelDest = level
	area.speed = speed and abs(speed) or 0.3
	area.accelerate = accelerate
end

function lgs:Repeat()

	Msg(Str("msg.tryAgain"), Str("msg.youLoose"), {{caption = Str("keyCaption.ok"), key = "enter", func = nil}})
	lgs:NewGame()
end

function lgs:NewGame()
    guiDesktop:SetCanJump(1)
    lgs.endGame = nil
	lgs.aktor = ImpActor("kajetan")
	guiDesktop.actor = lgs.aktor
	guiScroll.traceObject = lgs.aktor
	if LastMap() == "antarctica_ship_view" then
		go(lgs.aktor,"place","exit1_point")
	    go(lgs.aktor,"rotateToPoint","p1",1)
	else
		go(lgs.aktor,"place","exit2_point")
	    go(lgs.aktor,"rotateToPoint","start_k2",1)
	end
	go(lgs.aktor, "evOnStartJump", "OnActorStartJump")
	go(lgs.aktor, "evOnStopJump", "OnActorStopJump")
end
function Task_Loose()
	BeginTask()
	PlaySound("\\_hit.wav")
	guiDesktop:SetCanJump(0)
	lgs.endGame = 1
	lgs.activeArea = nil
	go(lgs.aktor, "evOnStartJump")
	go(lgs.aktor, "evOnStopJump")
    for i = 1, 1 do
		_MoveArea(lgs.movingFloe1[i],0,100 )
	end
	for i = 1, 1 do
		_MoveArea(lgs.movingFloe2[i],0,100 )
	end
	for i = 1, 1 do
		_MoveArea(lgs.movingFloe3[i],0,100 )
	end

	local hud = HudText(Str("easter_island_sea_from_upper.2"))
	WFHud(hud)
	SlideShow({}, nil, 1, lgs.Repeat)
	RemoveTask()
end

function lgs:OpenExit(name)
	if Distance(go(lgs.aktor,"pos") ,GroundPoint(name.."_point") ) <50 then
		ASObjectOn(name.."_area")
	else
		ASObjectOff(name.."_area")
	end
end

function Area_anims(name, event, param)

	if guiMenuInv.movingItemName ~= "lupa" then
		if event == "over" then
			lgs:ObjectName(param)
		end
		return 1
	end

	if event == "over" then
		lgs:ObjectName(param)

	elseif event == "in" then

           guiMenuInv:ShineOn(0.3)

  	elseif event == "out" then
	    guiMenuInv:ShineOff()

	elseif event == "click" then
		TwinAnimBkg(name, "standard", 1, 1)
		if name == "kwiat4" and not MapFlag("+help")  then
            if not FindTask("Task_Help") then
            	SetMapFlag("+help")
	   			CreateTask("Task_Help")
	   			return 1
	   		end
	   	end
	end
end

function lgs:ObjectName(object)


    if object == "kwiat" then
		 gui:MouseText(Str("ice_f_boat.kwiat"))
	elseif object == "kamien" then
		 gui:MouseText(Str("antarctica_ship.kamien"))
	elseif object == "snieg" then
		 gui:MouseText(Str("ice_f_boat.drzewo"))
    end
end

function OnLevelUpdate()
	if not lgs.endGame then
		if lgs.activeArea then
			lgs.activeArea.time = lgs.activeArea.time - frameTime
			if lgs.activeArea.time < 0 then
				_MoveArea(lgs.activeArea.area, -30, 0.01 , 0.01  )
				lgs.activeArea = nil
			end
		end

  	 	lgs:UpdateMovingFloe1()
  		lgs:UpdateMovingFloe2()
  	 	lgs:UpdateMovingFloe3()
	end

	lgs:OpenExit("exit2")

	lgs:OpenExit("exit1")

	for i, v in lgs.movingFloe2 do
       if i ~="n" then
			if v.counter >40 and v.counter <90 then
				SetAreaMoving(v.area,0)
				else
					SetAreaMoving(v.area,1)
			end

		end
	end
	for i, v in lgs.movingFloe3 do
	       if i ~="n" then
				if v.counter >40 and v.counter <90 then
					SetAreaMoving(v.area,0)
					else
						SetAreaMoving(v.area,1)
				end
			end
	end


end

    end
    go(lgs.help,"remove")
end

   	gui:MouseCursor("select")
end

function Task_HelpEfekt( )
	BeginTask()
 	lgs.promien = 10
	lgs.kat = 0
	lgs.licznik = 0
	local a =   go(lgs.help,"pos" )
	a.y = a.y+1
	local v = {}
	v.x = a.x
	v.y = a.y
	v.z = a.z
    StartParticle(lgs.helpefekt)
    CreatePartEffect("data\\fx\\energy1.apd", go(lgs.help,"pos"), 2 , "data\\bitmap\\fx\\shine_twirl_purple", 2)
	repeat
		if lgs.promien >2 then
	    	lgs.promien = lgs.promien -1
	    end
        lgs.licznik = lgs.licznik+1
		v.x = a.x + sin(lgs.kat) * lgs.promien
		v.z = a.z + cos(lgs.kat) * lgs.promien
		lgs.kat = lgs.kat + 20
		Wait(0.01)
		if random(1,2) >1.5 then
			v.y = 5
		else
			v.y = 1
		end
		SetPartPos(lgs.helpefekt,v)
	until lgs.licznik >60
	StopParticle(lgs.helpefekt)
	RemoveTask()

end


function Task_Help()
	BeginTask()
	go(lgs.help, "scale",1)
	go(lgs.help, "throwAngle", "help_stop", 70  , 5)

	RemoveTask()
end

function lgs:ObjectName(object)
	if object == "krysztal" then
		gui:MouseText(Str("antarctica_igloo.krysztal"))

	elseif object == "komin" then
		gui:MouseText(Str("freq.komin"))

	end
end


function Anim_KominBum()
	AnimBkg("komin", "bum")
	BkgAnimEvOnEndLoop("komin", "Anim_KominLoop", 1)
end

function Anim_KominLoop()
	AnimBkg("komin", "loop")
end


function Area_anims(name, event, param)
	if guiMenuInv.movingItemName ~= "lupa" then
		if event == "over" then
			lgs:ObjectName(param)
		end
        return 1
	end

	if event == "over" then
		lgs:ObjectName(param)
	elseif event == "in" then
		guiMenuInv:ShineOn(0)
	elseif event == "out" then
		guiMenuInv:ShineOff()
	elseif event == "click" then
		if name == "komin" then
			BkgAnimEvOnEndLoop("komin", "Anim_KominBum", 1)
		else
			TwinAnimBkg(name, "standard", 1, 1)
			if name == "krysztal1" and not MapFlag("+help")  then
        		if not FindTask("Task_Help") then
            		SetMapFlag("+help")
	   				CreateTask("Task_Help")
	   				return 1
	   			end
			end
		end

	end
end

function HelpLeci(item)
	StartParticle(lgs.helpshine)
    go(item, "rotate", 30 )
    go(item,"angUp",random(40,60)  )
	SetPartPos(lgs.helpshine, go(item,"pos"))
end

function HelpWyladowal(item)
	go(lgs.help, "evOnMouseClick", "OnHelpTake")
	go(item,"angUp",0)
	StopParticle(lgs.helpshine)
	CreateTask("Task_HelpEfekt")
end

function OnHelpTake()
	RemoveTask("Task_HelpEfekt")
	if lgs.helpefekt then
		StopParticle(lgs.helpefekt)
	end
	if not MapFlag("+help_zabrany") then
	    AddHelp()
	    SetMapFlag("+help_zabrany")
    end
    go(lgs.help,"remove")
end

function OnHelpOver(obj)
	gui:MouseText(go(obj,"nameVis"))
   	gui:MouseCursor("select")
end

function Task_HelpEfekt( )
	BeginTask()
 	lgs.promien = 10
	lgs.kat = 0
	lgs.partlicznik = 0
	local a =   go(lgs.help,"pos" )
	a.y = a.y+1
	local v = {}
	v.x = a.x
	v.y = a.y
	v.z = a.z
    StartParticle(lgs.helpefekt)
    CreatePartEffect("data\\fx\\energy1.apd", go(lgs.help,"pos"), 2 , "data\\bitmap\\fx\\shine_twirl_purple", 2)
	repeat
		if lgs.promien >2 then
	    	lgs.promien = lgs.promien -1
	    end
        lgs.partlicznik = lgs.partlicznik+1
		v.x = a.x + sin(lgs.kat) * lgs.promien
		v.z = a.z + cos(lgs.kat) * lgs.promien
		lgs.kat = lgs.kat + 20
		Wait(0.01)
		if random(1,2) >1.5 then
			v.y = 5
		else
			v.y = 1
		end
		SetPartPos(lgs.helpefekt,v)
	until lgs.partlicznik >60
	StopParticle(lgs.helpefekt)
    lgs.partlicznik = 0
    RemoveTask()

end


function Task_Help()
	BeginTask()

	go(lgs.help, "scale",2)
	go(lgs.help, "throwAngle", "help_stop", 70  , 5)

	RemoveTask()
end

function lgs:Przeszkoda()
	lgs.przeszkoda = lgs.desc[random(1, getn(lgs.desc))]
	local v = lgs.przeszkoda
	lgs.x = lgs.nextPrzeszkodaX
	lgs.nextPrzeszkodaX = random(500, 650)
	lgs.bojaPrzesunieta = nil
	go(v.obj, "scale", v.scale)
	go(v.obj, "setPosY", v.posY)
	go(v.obj, "rotate", v.angle and v.angle or random(0, 360))
	if v.vUp then
		go(v.obj, "angUp", random(-v.vUp, v.vUp))
	end
end

function lgs:Start()
	lgs:Przeszkoda()
	lgs.x = lgs.maxX
	lgs.bojaX = lgs.maxX
	lgs.przeszkoda.pos = VectorAdd(lgs.p0, VectorScale(lgs.dir, lgs.x))
	go(lgs.przeszkoda.obj, "place", lgs.przeszkoda.pos)
end

lgs:Start()

local p0 = VectorAdd(lgs.p1, VectorScale(lgs.dir, 10))
local p1 = VectorAdd(p0, VectorScale(lgs.dir, 20))

local p2 = RotatePoint3D(p1, -90, p0)
lgs.piana1 = CreatePartEffect("data\\fx\\piana5.apd", p2, -1, "data\\bitmap\\fx\\pianka", -1, Vector(-lgs.dir.x, 0.1, -lgs.dir.z), 0)
SetPartInitSpeedScale(lgs.piana1, 0.2)

local p2 = RotatePoint3D(p1, 90, p0)
lgs.piana2 = CreatePartEffect("data\\fx\\piana5.apd", p2, -1, "data\\bitmap\\fx\\pianka", -1, Vector(-lgs.dir.x, 0.1, -lgs.dir.z), 0)
SetPartInitSpeedScale(lgs.piana2, 0.2)
//WaterToZBuffer(0)

function lgs:PrzesunPrzeszkody(x)
	lgs.distToStart = lgs.distToStart - x
	local dir = VectorScale(lgs.dir, x)
	local sw = ScreenWidth()
	local v = lgs.przeszkoda

	lgs.x = lgs.x + x
	if lgs.dist < 0.97 and lgs.x < -sw - 300 then
		lgs:Przeszkoda()
	elseif lgs.x < v.xSize and lgs.x > -sw - v.xSize then
		v.pos = VectorAdd(lgs.p0, VectorScale(lgs.dir, lgs.x))
		go(v.obj, "place", v.pos)
		if Distance2D(v.pos, lgs.p1) < v.xCollision then
			if v.pos.y + v.yCollision > lgs.posY then
				if not FindTask("Task_hit") then
					CreateTask("Task_hit")
				end
			end
		end
	end

	lgs.bojaX = lgs.bojaX + x
	local bojaPos = VectorAdd(lgs.p3, VectorScale(lgs.dir, lgs.bojaX))
	bojaPos = VectorAdd(bojaPos, VectorScale(lgs.dir, x * 15))
	if lgs.bojaHide then
		lgs.bojaHide = nil
		Reveal(lgs.boja)
	end
	go(lgs.boja, "place", bojaPos)
	if lgs.dist < 0.97 and not lgs.bojaPrzesunieta and lgs.x < -sw then
		lgs.bojaPrzesunieta = 1
		lgs.bojaX = lgs.nextPrzeszkodaX + 300
	end
end


function OnLevelUpdate()
	if lgs.speed then
		gui:MouseCursor("no")
		if lgs.speed < lgs.maxSpeed + lgs.accelerate then
			lgs.speed = lgs.speed + lgs.accelerate
		else
			lgs.speed = lgs.maxSpeed
		end
		if NoMapFlag("koniec_gry") then
			lgs:PrzesunPrzeszkody(-lgs.speed)
		end
		SetWaterFollow(lgs.speed * lgs.dir.x, lgs.speed * lgs.dir.z)
		local s = max(0.2, lgs.speed * 0.1)
		SetPartInitSpeedScale(lgs.piana1, s)
		SetPartInitSpeedScale(lgs.piana2, s)
	else
		SetWaterFollow(0, 0)
		SetPartInitSpeedScale(lgs.piana1, 0.2)
		SetPartInitSpeedScale(lgs.piana2, 0.2)
	end

	local pos = go(lgs.samolot, "pos")
	if NoMapFlag("hit") and KbdStruck("space") and not MapFlag("koniec_gry") and not FindTask("Task_zmiana") then
		local d = lgs.p1.y - pos.y
		if abs(d) < 1 then
			go(lgs.samolot, "throwUp", min(150, 220 + d), nil, d)
			--HudText(Str("antek_okrzyki."..random(1,5)))
			StopParticle(lgs.piana1)
			StopParticle(lgs.piana2)
		end
	end
	lgs.posY = pos.y

	if NoMapFlag("hit") and not FindTask("Task_zmiana") then
		lgs.maxSpeed = lgs.maxSpeed - 0.002
	end
	if lgs.maxSpeed < 0 then
		lgs.maxSpeed = 0
	end
	lgs.dist = lgs.distToStart / lgs.maxDist
	SetClockAngle(1 - lgs.dist)
	if lgs.dist > 1 and not FindTask("Task_koniec") and not FindTask("Task_zmiana") then
		CreateTask("Task_Hamowanie")
		CreateTask("Task_zmiana")
	end
end


function Task_Hamowanie()
	BeginTask()
	while lgs.maxSpeed > 4.5 do
		lgs.maxSpeed = lgs.maxSpeed - 0.05
		NextTask()
	end
	RemoveTask()
end


function Task_zmiana()
StopMusic("data\\music\\wysypywacz.OGG",-1,80)
	local hud = HudText(Str("antarctica_landing.1"))
	WFHud(hud)
	hud = HudText(Str("antarctica_landing.2"))
	WFHud(hud)
	ChangeMap("antarctica_coast")
	RemoveTask()
end

	Msg(Str("msg.tryAgain"), Str("msg.youLoose"), {{caption = Str("keyCaption.ok"), key = "enter", func = lgs.zmiana2}}, 1)
end


function Task_hit()
	BeginTask()
	SetMapFlag("hit")
	lgs.licznik = 0
	lgs.licznik2 =0
	lgs.speed = nil
	go(lgs.samolot, "stop")
	go(lgs.samolot, "anim", "hit")

	StopSound(lgs.enginesound)
	WFAnim(lgs.samolot)
	go(lgs.samolot, "anim", "fly", 0, -1)
	lgs:Repeat()
	RemoveTask()

function EIE_OnUpdateThrow(obj)
	go(obj, "angUp", go(obj, "speed", "y"))
end

	go(obj, "angUp", 0)
	StartParticle(lgs.piana1)

function OnLevelRender()
	SetRenderState("tf1")
	if MapFlag("hit") then

	 SetRenderState("tf0")

function OnLevelRelease()
	RemoveTask("Task_hit")
	Task_hit = nil
	EIE_OnUpdateThrow = nil
	EIE_OnEndThrow = nil
	RemoveTask("Task_zmiana")
	Task_zmiana = nil
	RemoveTask("Task_Hamowanie")
	Task_Hamowanie = nil
	RemoveTask("Task_koniec")
	Task_koniec = nil
	RemoveTask("Task_Start")
	Task_Start = nil
	StopSound(lgs.enginesound)
end


function Task_Start()

	local p = CloneLuaObject(lgs.p1)

	CreateTask("Task_Start")

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Funkcja do tworzenia obiektow

function lgs:TworzObiekty(nazwa, rodzaj, miejsce, tablica, ilosc, wysokosc, xstep, ystep, alfa, tabAngle)
	for i = 1 , ilosc do

				go(nazwa_loc, "rotate", tabAngle[i])
			else
				go(nazwa_loc, "rotate", random(1,180))
			end

		end
  		if alfa  then
 			go(nazwa_loc,"setAlpha",alfa)
 		end
 		if nazwa == "wiatr" or  nazwa == "tornado" then
 		    go(nazwa_loc, "anim", "idle", 0, -1)
			go(nazwa_loc, "rotate",90)
		end
        if nazwa == "chmura"  then
			go(nazwa_loc,"anim","idle1", 0, -1)
 		end

function lgs:ASKolizja(tablica)
	if lgs.lastCollisionTime and currentTime - lgs.lastCollisionTime < 1.3 then
		return
	end

	for i = 1, getn(tablica) do
		local name = "area_"..tablica[i].name.."_"..i
		//print(name)

		if ASIsInside(name, lgs.shipPosDziob2D.x, lgs.shipPosDziob2D.y) or ASIsInside(name, lgs.shipPos2D.x, lgs.shipPos2D.y) then
			if not tablica[i].coll then
				lgs.lastCollisionTime = currentTime
			    go(lgs.statek, "anim", "hit", 0 , 1)
                PlaySound("\\models\\car_hit_1.wav")
				tablica[i].coll = 1
				lgs:Punkty()
				go(lgs.statek,"rotate",180)
				go(lgs.statek, "goForward")
				break
			end

		else
			tablica[i].coll = nil
		end
	end

end

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function lgs:Wiatr()
	if lgs.lastCollisionTime and currentTime - lgs.lastCollisionTime < 1.3 then
		return
	end
	for i, v in lgs.listWiatr do
		if i ~= "n" then

				end

				   v.coll = nil
				else

				end
			end
		end
	end
end

	go(lgs.statek, "rideUpdate", 0)

	PlaySound("\\cross2-iglak.wav")
	Wait(1.1)
	go(lgs.statek, "rideUpdate", 1)
    guiDesktop.mouseDetectClick = 1
	RemoveTask()
end
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Funkcja tornada
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function lgs:Tornado()


	for i, v in lgs.listTornado do
		if i ~= "n" then
			// Odwrócenie kierunku w momencie osi¹gniêcia lewej lub prawej krawêdzi
			if v.pos.x > lgs.posp2.x or v.pos.x < 0 then
				v.xstep = - v.xstep;
			end
			// Odwrócenie kierunku w momencie osi¹gniêcia górnej lub dolnej krawêdzi
			if v.pos.z > lgs.posp2.z or v.pos.z < 0 then
				v.ystep = -v.ystep;
			end
			// Samo przesuniêcie obiektu
			v.pos.x = v.pos.x + v.xstep;
			v.pos.z = v.pos.z + v.ystep;
			go(v.id,"place",v.pos)
			//Kolizja
			if Distance2D(v.pos.x, v.pos.z, lgs.shipPos.x, lgs.shipPos.z)  < 20  then
				if not v.coll then
					if lgs.lastCollisionTime and currentTime - lgs.lastCollisionTime < 1.3 then
						return
					end
				    lgs.lastCollisionTime = currentTime
			    	v.coll = 1
					lgs:Punkty()
					CreateTask("Task_Tornado")
				else

				end


			else
   				//przestalismy kolidowac (dzwiek, task)
				if v.coll == 1 then
				   v.coll = nil
				else

				end
			end
        end
	end
end

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

		return
	end
	for i, v in lgs.listChmury do
		if i ~= "n" then
			// Odwrócenie kierunku w momencie osi¹gniêcia lewej lub prawej krawêdzi
			if v.pos.x > lgs.posp2.x or v.pos.x < 0 then
				v.xstep = - v.xstep;
			end
            // Samo przesuniêcie obiektu
			v.pos.x = v.pos.x + v.xstep;
			go(v.id,"place",v.pos)
			go(v.id, "rotate",1)
			//Kolizja
			if Distance2D(v.pos.x, v.pos.z, lgs.shipPos.x, lgs.shipPos.z)  < 30  then
				if not v.coll then
                    lgs.lastCollisionTime = currentTime
					v.coll = 1
					lgs:Punkty()
					go(lgs.statek,"pos",v.pos)
					CreateTask("Task_Chmura")
				else

				end

			else
   				//przestalismy kolidowac (dzwiek, task)
				if v.coll == 1 then
				    v.coll = nil
				else

				end
			end
        end
	end
end

   -- HudImg("data\\maps\\sea\\speed\\bum",0.1, 0, ScreenHeight() -80, 1, 1,80)

		end
	end
	lgs.speed = 1
	go(lgs.statek, "brakingTo", lgs.speed)

function OnLevelRender()
	if MapFlag("gra") then

			//  Wyswietlanie ikon (statki gracza)
		if lgs.hits == 0 then
		    SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_hit1, 0)
		elseif lgs.hits ==1 then
			SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_hit2, 0)
		elseif lgs.hits ==2 then
			SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_hit3, 0)
		elseif lgs.hits ==3  then
			SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_hit4, 0)
		end
		DrawRectangle(Vector(590 ,5, 0), 128, 64, RGBA(1,1,1,1))

		if lgs.speed >1 then
		    local prwdp = random(1,10)
		    if prwdp > 8 then
		    	SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_speed3,0)
		    else
		    	SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_speed4,0)
			end
		else
			local prwdp = random(1,10)
		    if prwdp > 8 then
		    	SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_speed1,0)
		    else
		    	SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_speed2,0)
			end
		end
		DrawRectangle(Vector(ScreenWidth()/2 -150, 5 , 0),256, 128, RGBA(1,1,1,1))

		if lgs.damage == 0  then
			SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_damage1,0)
		elseif lgs.damage == 1 then
			SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_damage2,0)
		elseif lgs.damage == 2 then
			SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_damage3,0)
		end
		DrawRectangle(Vector(30, 5 , 0),128, 64, RGBA(1,1,1,1))

		//rysowanie postepu
		local bw = 150
		local bh = 16
		local pos = (lgs.maxY - lgs.shipPos2D.y) / lgs.maxY
		SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_kuterek,0)
		DrawRectangle(Vector(ScreenWidth() / 2 - 105 + (bw - bh) * pos, 20 ,0), 32, 32, RGBA(1,1,1,1))

		if MapFlag("zly_kierunek") then
			local alpha = (cos(mod(frameCount, 10) * 360 / 10) + 1) * 0.5
			SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_strzalka,0)
			DrawRectangle(Vector(ScreenWidth() / 2 + 60 , ScreenHeight() / 2 ,0), 128, 32, RGBA(1,1,1,alpha))
		end
	end
end

	else
		CreateTask("Task_DrugaRozmowa")
	end
end

function OnLevelUpdate()
	if MapFlag("+Ship_view_druga_rozmowa")  then
		if Distance(go(lgs.kajetan,"pos") ,go(lgs.pingwin,"pos") )  <50 then
			if MapFlag("pingwin_przy_wyjsciu") 	then
				ChangeMap("antarctica_igloo")
			end
		end
	end
end

//=======================================================================
// Animacje z lup¹
//=======================================================================

function Area_anims(name, event, param)

	if guiMenuInv.movingItemName ~= "lupa" then
		if event == "over" then
			lgs:ObjectName(param)
		end
		return 1
	end

	if event == "over" then
		lgs:ObjectName(param)

	elseif event == "in" then

           guiMenuInv:ShineOn(0.3)

  	elseif event == "out" then
	    guiMenuInv:ShineOff()

	elseif event == "click" then
		TwinAnimBkg(name, "standard", 1, 1)
		return 1
	end
end

function lgs:ObjectName(object)

	if object == "komin" then
		 gui:MouseText(Str("freq.komin"))
    elseif object == "gora" then
		 gui:MouseText(Str("antarctica_ship.gora"))
	elseif object == "kamien" then
		 gui:MouseText(Str("antarctica_ship.kamien"))
	elseif object == "snieg" then
		 gui:MouseText(Str("ice_f_boat.snieg"))
    end
end
function OnLevelRelease()

		RemoveTask("Task_PierwszaRozmowa")
	    Task_PierwszaRozmowa = nil
		RemoveTask("Task_DrugaRozmowa")
		Task_DrugaRozmowa = nil

end

	lgs.nextPrzeszkodaX = random(500, 650)
	go(v.obj, "scale", v.scale)
	go(v.obj, "setPosY", v.posY)
	go(v.obj, "rotate", v.angle and v.angle or random(0, 360))
	if v.vUp then
		go(v.obj, "angUp", random(-v.vUp, v.vUp))
	end
	lgs.bojaPrzesunieta = nil
end

function lgs:Start()
	lgs:Przeszkoda()
	lgs.x = lgs.maxX
	lgs.bojaX = lgs.maxX
	lgs.przeszkoda.pos = VectorAdd(lgs.p0, VectorScale(lgs.dir, lgs.x))
	go(lgs.przeszkoda.obj, "place", lgs.przeszkoda.pos)
end

lgs:Start()

local p0 = VectorAdd(lgs.p1, VectorScale(lgs.dir, 10))
local p1 = VectorAdd(p0, VectorScale(lgs.dir, 20))

local p2 = RotatePoint3D(p1, -90, p0)
lgs.piana1 = CreatePartEffect("data\\fx\\piana5.apd", p2, -1, "data\\bitmap\\fx\\pianka", -1, Vector(-lgs.dir.x, 0.1, -lgs.dir.z), 0)
SetPartInitSpeedScale(lgs.piana1, 0.2)

local p2 = RotatePoint3D(p1, 90, p0)
lgs.piana2 = CreatePartEffect("data\\fx\\piana5.apd", p2, -1, "data\\bitmap\\fx\\pianka", -1, Vector(-lgs.dir.x, 0.1, -lgs.dir.z), 0)
SetPartInitSpeedScale(lgs.piana2, 0.2)
//WaterToZBuffer(0)

function lgs:PrzesunPrzeszkody(x)
	lgs.distToStart = lgs.distToStart - x

	local dir = VectorScale(lgs.dir, x)
	local sw = ScreenWidth()
	local v = lgs.przeszkoda

	lgs.x = lgs.x + x
	if lgs.dist < 0.97 and lgs.x < -sw - 300 then
		lgs:Przeszkoda()
	elseif lgs.x < v.xSize and lgs.x > -sw - v.xSize then
		v.pos = VectorAdd(lgs.p0, VectorScale(lgs.dir, lgs.x))
		go(v.obj, "place", v.pos)
		if Distance2D(v.pos, lgs.p1) < v.xCollision then
			if v.pos.y + v.yCollision > lgs.posY then
				if not FindTask("Task_hit") then
					CreateTask("Task_hit")
				end
			end
		end
	end

//	  print(lgs.x, "   ", lgs.bojaX)
	lgs.bojaX = lgs.bojaX + x
	local bojaPos = VectorAdd(lgs.p3, VectorScale(lgs.dir, lgs.bojaX))
	bojaPos = VectorAdd(bojaPos, VectorScale(lgs.dir, x * 15))
	if lgs.bojaHide then
		lgs.bojaHide = nil
		Reveal(lgs.boja)
	end
	go(lgs.boja, "place", bojaPos)
	if lgs.dist < 0.97 and not lgs.bojaPrzesunieta and lgs.x < -sw then
		lgs.bojaPrzesunieta = 1
		lgs.bojaX = lgs.nextPrzeszkodaX + 300
	end
end


function OnLevelUpdate()
	if lgs.speed then
		gui:MouseCursor("no")
		if lgs.speed < lgs.maxSpeed + lgs.accelerate then
			lgs.speed = lgs.speed + lgs.accelerate
		else
			lgs.speed = lgs.maxSpeed
		end

		if NoMapFlag("koniec_gry") then
			lgs:PrzesunPrzeszkody(-lgs.speed)
		end

		SetWaterFollow(lgs.speed * lgs.dir.x, lgs.speed * lgs.dir.z)
		local s = max(0.2, lgs.speed * 0.1)
		SetPartInitSpeedScale(lgs.piana1, s)
		SetPartInitSpeedScale(lgs.piana2, s)
	else
		SetWaterFollow(0, 0)
		SetPartInitSpeedScale(lgs.piana1, 0.2)
		SetPartInitSpeedScale(lgs.piana2, 0.2)
	end

	local pos = go(lgs.samolot, "pos")
	if NoMapFlag("hit") and KbdStruck("space") and not MapFlag("koniec_gry") and not FindTask("Task_koniec") then
		local d = lgs.p1.y - pos.y
		if abs(d) < 1 then
			go(lgs.samolot, "throwUp", min(150, 220 + d), nil, d)
			--HudText(Str("antek_okrzyki."..random(1,5)))
			StopParticle(lgs.piana1)
			StopParticle(lgs.piana2)
		end
	end
	lgs.posY = pos.y
	if NoMapFlag("hit") then
		lgs.maxSpeed = lgs.maxSpeed + 0.0055
	end
	lgs.dist = lgs.distToStart / lgs.maxDist
	SetClockAngle(lgs.distToStart / lgs.maxDist)
	if lgs.dist > 1 and not FindTask("Task_koniec") then
		CreateTask("Task_koniec")
	end
end

	lgs.kat = 0
	local a =  go(item,"pos" )
	local v = {}
	v.x = a.x
	v.y = a.y +1
	v.z = a.z
    StartParticle(lgs.efekt)
	repeat
 		lgs.promien = lgs.promien - 0.1
		v.x = a.x + sin(lgs.kat) * lgs.promien
		v.z = a.z + cos(lgs.kat) * lgs.promien
		lgs.kat = lgs.kat + 30
		Wait(0.01)

	until lgs.promien <0
	StopParticle(lgs.efekt)
	RemoveTask()

SetAreaGroups()
PlaySoundLooped("\\jaskinia.wav")
lgs.kajetan = ImpActor("kajetan")
if LastMap("cave_2") then
	lgs.point0 = GroundPoint("start_k_2")

else
	lgs.point0 = GroundPoint("start_k")

end
lgs.point1 = GroundPoint("skala1")
go(lgs.kajetan, "place", lgs.point0)
go(lgs.kajetan, "rotateToPoint", lgs.point1, 1)
guiDesktop.actor = lgs.kajetan
guiScroll.traceObject = lgs.kajetan
go(lgs.kajetan, "evOnStopJump", "OnActorStopJump")

function OnActorStopJump(actor)
	PlaySound("\\models\\step_normal1.wav")
end
lgs.odlamkiLeca = 1

lgs.coordsCount = 6
lgs.skaly = {}
lgs.odlamki = {}
lgs.maxSkal = 4
lgs.minLevel = -80

for i=1, lgs.maxSkal do
	local maxY = random(12, 16)
	local yDelta = random(20, 38) / 100
	local y0 = random(-maxY, maxY)
	if y0 < 0 then
		yDelta = -yDelta
	end
	local skala = NewObject("skala.planerect")
	if i == 5 then
		go(skala, "setCoords", "big")
	elseif i <= lgs.coordsCount then
		go(skala, "setCoords", "normal"..i)
	else
		go(skala, "setCoords", "normal"..random(1, lgs.coordsCount))
	end
	local level = 0
	local point = GroundPoint("skala"..i)
	go(skala, "place", point)
	go(skala, "rotate", 100)
	go(skala, "move", Vector(0, y0 + level, 0))
	local area = GetArea("skala"..i)
	MoveArea(area, Vector(0, y0 + level + 1, 0))
	tinsert(lgs.skaly, {
		skala = skala,
		area = area,
		maxY = maxY,
		yDelta = yDelta,
		y = y0,
		level = level,
	})

	if i < lgs.maxSkal then
		local point2 = GroundPoint("skala"..(i + 1))
		local rock = NewObject("rock.object3d")
		local pos0 = VectorMid(point, point2)
		pos0.y = pos0.y + 90
		go(rock, "place", pos0)
		go(rock, "scale", 0.1)
		go(rock, "rotate", random(0, 360))
		tinsert(lgs.odlamki, {
			obj = rock,
			pos0 = pos0,
			fall = nil,
			group = 4,
		})
	end
end

function lgs:SkalaToLevel(nr, level, speed)
	if not nr or nr < 1 or nr > getn(lgs.skaly) then
		return
	end
	if not speed then
		speed = 2
	end
    lgs.skaly[nr].toLevel = level
    if lgs.skaly[nr].level > level then
    	lgs.skaly[nr].speedToLevel = -abs(speed)
    else
    	lgs.skaly[nr].speedToLevel = abs(speed)
    end
end

function OnLevelUpdate()
	//if 1 == 1 then return end
	// ska³y - chodniki
	if not MapFlag("zlapany") then
		for i, v in lgs.skaly do
			if i ~= "n" then
				local addY = 0
				if v.toLevel then
					if abs(v.toLevel - v.level) < abs(v.speedToLevel) then
						addY = v.toLevel - v.level
						v.toLevel = nil
					else
						addY = v.speedToLevel
					end
					v.level = v.level + addY
				end
	            v.y = v.y + v.yDelta
				local dir = Vector(0, v.yDelta + addY, 0)
				MoveArea(v.area, dir)
				go(v.skala, "move", dir)
				if abs(v.y) > v.maxY then
					v.yDelta = -v.yDelta
				end
			end
		end
		// od³amki skalne
		for i, v in lgs.odlamki do
			if i ~= "n" then
				if not v.fall then
					if lgs.odlamkiLeca and random(1, v.group and 100 or 500) < 5 then
						if not v.group then
							v.group = 1
						else
							v.group = v.group - 1
							if v.group <= 0 then
								v.group = nil
							end
						end
						v.fall = 1
						v.pos = CloneLuaObject(v.pos0)
						v.rotSpeed = random(-35, 35)
						go(v.obj, "scale", random(9, 16) / 100)
						v.fallSpeed = random(-65, -35) / 10
					end
				else
					go(v.obj, "rotate", v.rotSpeed)
					v.pos.y = v.pos.y + v.fallSpeed
					if v.pos.y < -30 then
						v.fall = nil
						go(v.obj, "place", v.pos0)
					else
						go(v.obj, "place", v.pos)
						if go(lgs.kajetan, "pointInside", v.pos) then
							lgs.bum = 0
							break
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
		if lgs.bum then
			if lgs.bum > 0 then
				lgs.bum = lgs.bum - frameTime
			else
				go(lgs.kajetan, "stop", 0, 1, 1)
	            SetMapFlag("zlapany")
	            guiDesktop:SetCanJump(0)
	            if not FindTask("Task_bumbum") then
					CreateTask("Task_bumbum")
				end
			end
		end
		if lgs.activeSkala then
			lgs.activeSkala.time = lgs.activeSkala.time - frameTime
			if lgs.activeSkala.time < 0 then
				lgs:SkalaToLevel(lgs.activeSkala.nr, lgs.minLevel)
				lgs.bum = 0.6
				lgs.activeSkala = nil
			end
		end
	end
end


function lgs:Restart()
    guiDesktop:SetCanJump(1)
    ClearMapFlag("zlapany")
	go(lgs.kajetan, "stop", 0, 1, 1)
	go(lgs.kajetan, "place", lgs.point0)
	go(lgs.kajetan, "rotateToPoint", lgs.point1, 1)
	gui.fadeScreen = 0
    CreateTask("Task_anim")
end


for i = 1, 2 do
	AddAnimBkg("data\\maps\\cave_1\\anim\\kulka"..i..".anim")
	if not MapFlag("+kulka"..i) then
		SetMapFlag("+kulka"..i, "empty")
	else
		AnimBkg("kulka"..i, MapFlag("+kulka"..i))
	end
end

function lgs:SprawdzKulki()
	if MapFlag("+kulka1") == "yellow" and MapFlag("+kulka2") == "red" then
		ASObjectOff("kulka1")
		ASObjectOff("kulka2")

	end
end

if not lgs:SprawdzKulki() then
	for i = 1, lgs.maxSkal do
		lgs:SkalaToLevel(i, lgs.minLevel, 100)
	end
	OnLevelUpdate()
end

function Task_anim()
	BeginTask()
	guiDesktop.mouseEnabled = nil
	PlaySound("\\railroader-motyl.wav")
	go(lgs.kajetan, "anim", "zawrot", 0, 3)
	local efekt =  CreatePartEffect("data\\fx\\gwiazdki1.apd", "", -1, "data\\bitmap\\fx\\shine_blue", 0)

	v.y = a.y +15
	v.z = a.z

	repeat
 		promien = promien + 0.02

		v.z = a.z + cos( kat) *  promien

end


function Task_bumbum()

	end

function Area_kulki(name, event, param)

	local kulka = MapFlag("+"..name)

	if event == "over"  then
		local kulka = MapFlag("+"..name)

			AnimBkg(name, "yellow")

			PlaySound("ui\\click2.wav")

maps/cave_2/script.lua:
PlaySoundLooped("\\jaskinia.wav")
lgs.kajetan = ImpActor("kajetan")
lgs.point0 = GroundPoint("start_k")
lgs.point1 = GroundPoint("skala1")
lgs.point4 = GroundPoint("skala4")
go(lgs.kajetan, "place", lgs.point0)
go(lgs.kajetan, "rotateToPoint", lgs.point1, 1)
guiDesktop.actor = lgs.kajetan
guiScroll.traceObject = lgs.kajetan




if not MapFlag("+FIGURKA_ZABRANA") then
	local figurka = NewObject("figurka.object3d")
	go(figurka, "placePos", "figurka")
	go(figurka, "rotate", -90)
	go(figurka, "toTake", 1)
	go(figurka, "evOnTake", "Cave2_OnFigurineTake")
end

lgs.odlamkiLeca = 1

lgs.coordsCount = 6
lgs.skaly = {}
lgs.odlamki = {}
lgs.maxSkal = 5
lgs.minLevel = -80
lgs.kierunek = 1

for i=1, lgs.maxSkal do
	local maxY = random(1, 2)
	local yDelta = random(5, 7) / 100
	local y0 = random(-maxY, maxY)
	if y0 < 0 then
		yDelta = -yDelta
	end
	local skala = NewObject("skala.planerect")
	if i == 5 then
		go(skala, "setCoords", "big")
	elseif i <= lgs.coordsCount then
		go(skala, "setCoords", "normal"..i)
	else
		go(skala, "setCoords", "normal"..random(1, lgs.coordsCount))
	end
	local level = (i > 1 or MapFlag("+FIGURKA_ZABRANA")) and lgs.minLevel or 0
	local point = GroundPoint("skala"..i)
	go(skala, "place", point)
	go(skala, "rotate", 100)
	go(skala, "move", Vector(0, y0 + level, 0))
	local area = GetArea("skala"..i)
	MoveArea(area, Vector(0, y0 + level + 1, 0))
	tinsert(lgs.skaly, {
		skala = skala,
		area = area,
		maxY = maxY,
		yDelta = yDelta,
		y = y0,
		level = level,
	})

	if i < lgs.maxSkal - 1 then
		local point2 = GroundPoint("skala"..(i + 1))
		local rock = NewObject("rock.object3d")
		local pos0 = VectorMid(point, point2)
		pos0.y = pos0.y + 70
		go(rock, "place", pos0)
		go(rock, "scale", 0.1)
		go(rock, "rotate", random(0, 360))
		tinsert(lgs.odlamki, {
			obj = rock,
			pos0 = pos0,
			fall = nil,
			group = 4,
		})
	end
end

function lgs:SkalaFromArea(area)
	local n = getn(lgs.skaly)
    for i = 1, n do
    	if lgs.skaly[i].area == area then
    		return i
    	end
    end
end

function lgs:NextSkala(nr, delta)
	if not nr or not delta or nr + delta < 1 or nr + delta > getn(lgs.skaly) then
		return
	end
	return nr + delta
end

function lgs:SkalaToLevel(nr, level, speed)
	if not nr or nr < 1 or nr > getn(lgs.skaly) then
		return
	end
	if not speed then
		speed = 2
	end
    lgs.skaly[nr].toLevel = level
    if lgs.skaly[nr].level > level then
    	lgs.skaly[nr].speedToLevel = -abs(speed)
    else
    	lgs.skaly[nr].speedToLevel = abs(speed)
    end
end

function lgs:SkalyUpdate()
	for i, v in lgs.skaly do
		if i ~= "n" then
			local addY = 0
			if v.toLevel then
				if abs(v.toLevel - v.level) < abs(v.speedToLevel) then
					addY = v.toLevel - v.level
					v.toLevel = nil
				else
					addY = v.speedToLevel
				end
				v.level = v.level + addY
			end
            v.y = v.y + v.yDelta
			local dir = Vector(0, v.yDelta + addY, 0)
			MoveArea(v.area, dir)
			go(v.skala, "move", dir)
			if abs(v.y) > v.maxY then
				v.yDelta = -v.yDelta
			end
		end
	end
end


function lgs:OdlamkiUpdate()
	for i, v in lgs.odlamki do
		if i ~= "n" then
			if not v.fall then
				if lgs.odlamkiLeca and random(1, v.group and 40 or 150) < 5 then
					if not v.group then
						v.group = 1
					else
						v.group = v.group - 1
						if v.group <= 0 then
							v.group = nil
						end
					end
					v.fall = 1
					v.pos = CloneLuaObject(v.pos0)
					v.rotSpeed = random(-35, 35)
					go(v.obj, "scale", random(9, 16) / 100)
					v.fallSpeed = random(-45, -35) / 10
				end
			else
				go(v.obj, "rotate", v.rotSpeed)
				v.pos.y = v.pos.y + v.fallSpeed
				if v.pos.y < -50 then
					v.fall = nil
					go(v.obj, "place", v.pos0)
				else
					go(v.obj, "place", v.pos)
					if go(lgs.kajetan, "pointInside", v.pos) then
						lgs.bum = 0
						break
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end


function OnLevelUpdate()
	//if 1 == 1 then return end
if not MapFlag("zlapany") then
	lgs:SkalyUpdate()
	lgs:OdlamkiUpdate()
	if lgs.bum then
		if lgs.bum > 0 then
			lgs.bum = lgs.bum - frameTime
		else
            go(lgs.kajetan, "stop", 0, 1, 1)
/*
            if guiMenuInv:IsItem("figurka", 1) then
           	 	guiMenuInv:RemoveItem("figurka")
           	 	ClearMapFlag("+FIGURKA_ZABRANA")
           	end
*/
            guiDesktop:SetCanJump(0)
            SetMapFlag("zlapany")
            if not FindTask("Task_bumbum") then
				CreateTask("Task_bumbum")
			end

		end
	end
	if lgs.activeSkala then
		lgs.activeSkala.time = lgs.activeSkala.time - frameTime
		if lgs.activeSkala.time < 0 then
			lgs:SkalaToLevel(lgs.activeSkala.nr, lgs.minLevel)
			lgs.bum = 0.6
			lgs.activeSkala = nil
		end
	end
end
end


function lgs:Restart()
    guiDesktop:SetCanJump(1)
    ClearMapFlag("zlapany")
	go(lgs.kajetan, "stop", 0, 1, 1)
	//DesktopOn()
    if lgs.kierunek > 0 then
		go(lgs.kajetan, "place", lgs.point0)
		go(lgs.kajetan, "rotateToPoint", lgs.point1, 1)
		lgs:SkalaToLevel(1, 0, 100)
		for i = 2, getn(lgs.skaly) do
			lgs:SkalaToLevel(i, lgs.minLevel, 100)
		end
	else
		local n = getn(lgs.skaly)
		lgs:SkalaToLevel(n, 0, 100)
		lgs:SkalaToLevel(n - 1, 0, 100)
		for i = 1, n - 2 do
			lgs:SkalaToLevel(i, lgs.minLevel, 100)
		end
		lgs:SkalyUpdate()
		go(lgs.kajetan, "place", "skala5")
		go(lgs.kajetan, "rotateToPoint", lgs.point4, 1)
	end

	//StopFrameMode(0)
    gui.fadeScreen = 0
    CreateTask("Task_anim")
end


function Level_OnActorStartJump(actor)
	//DesktopOff()
	lgs.activeSkala = nil
	lgs.bum = nil
end

function Level_OnActorStopJump(actor)
	//DesktopOn()
	PlaySound("\\models\\step_normal1.wav")
	local skala = lgs:SkalaFromArea(go(actor, "area"))
	if skala then
		local skala1 = lgs:NextSkala(skala, lgs.kierunek)
		lgs:SkalaToLevel(skala1, 0)
		local skala2 = lgs:NextSkala(skala, -lgs.kierunek)
		lgs:SkalaToLevel(skala2, lgs.minLevel)

		if skala1 then
			lgs.activeSkala = {nr = skala, time = 8}
		end
		if skala == 5 then
			lgs.odlamkiLeca = nil
		else
			//lgs.odlamkiLeca = 1
		end
	else
		lgs.activeSkala = nil
	end
end

function Task_anim()
	BeginTask()
	guiDesktop.mouseEnabled = nil
	PlaySound("\\railroader-motyl.wav")
	go(lgs.kajetan, "anim", "zawrot", 0, 3)
	local efekt =  CreatePartEffect("data\\fx\\gwiazdki1.apd", "", -1, "data\\bitmap\\fx\\shine_blue", 0)
	local promien = 4
	local kat = 0
 	local a =   go(lgs.kajetan,"pos" )
	local v = {}
	v.x = a.x
	v.y = a.y +15
	v.z = a.z
    StartParticle( efekt)
    lgs.licznik = 0
	repeat
 		promien = promien + 0.02
		v.x = a.x + sin( kat) *  promien
		v.z = a.z + cos( kat) *  promien
		v.y = v.y+random(-3,3)
		kat =  kat + 20
        Wait(0.01)
		SetPartPos( efekt,v)
		v.y = a.y +15


	until promien >5.
		StopParticle(efekt)
    WFAnim(lgs.kajetan)
    CreateTask("Task_Efekt")
    HudText(Str("antek_okrzyki."..random(1,5)))
    go(lgs.kajetan, "anim", "jump_lot", 0, 1)

    WFAnim(lgs.kajetan)
    go(lgs.kajetan, "anim", "jump_end", 0, 1)
    WFAnim(lgs.kajetan)
    guiDesktop.mouseEnabled = 1
   	RemoveTask()
end


function Task_bumbum()
	BeginTask()
	lgs.bum = nil
	lgs.activeSkala = nil
	PlaySound("\\bum.wav")
	a = go(lgs.kajetan,"pos")
	a.y = a.y+5
    CreatePartEffect("data\\fx\\energy1.apd", a, 2 , "data\\bitmap\\fx\\ufoblysk2", 1)
 	HudMsg(Str("upadek.1"), 2, 150, 100, 2)
	Wait(0.2)

	RemoveTask()
end

		area = PosArea(pos),
		level = 0,
		floatingLevel = 0,
		floatingSpeed = random(3, 8) / 100,
		floatingMax = random(7, 15) / 10,
		floatingMin = random(-8, 0) / 10,
	}
	tinsert(lgs.area_deska, area)


function lgs:UpdateDeska()
	for i, v in lgs.area_deska do
		if i ~= "n" then
			local d = 0
			if v.floatingLevel then
				if v.floatingUp then
					if v.floatingMax - v.floatingLevel < v.floatingSpeed then
						v.floatingLevel = v.floatingMax
						d = v.floatingMax - v.floatingLevel
						v.floatingUp = nil
					else
						v.floatingLevel = v.floatingLevel + v.floatingSpeed
						d = v.floatingSpeed
					end
				else
					if v.floatingLevel - v.floatingMin < v.floatingSpeed then
						v.floatingLevel = v.floatingMin
						d = v.floatingLevel - v.floatingMin
						v.floatingUp = 1
					else
						v.floatingLevel = v.floatingLevel - v.floatingSpeed
						d = -v.floatingSpeed
					end
				end
			end

		    if v.levelDest then
		    	if v.accelerate then
		    		v.speed = v.speed + v.accelerate
		    	end
				local newLevel
					if v.levelDest < v.level then
						if v.level - v.speed < v.levelDest then
							newLevel = v.levelDest
							v.levelDest = nil
						else
							newLevel = v.level - v.speed
						end
					else
						if v.level + v.speed > v.levelDest then
								newLevel = v.levelDest
								v.levelDest = nil
						else
							newLevel = v.level + v.speed
						end
					end
					d = d + newLevel - v.level
					v.level = newLevel
		    end
		    if d ~= 0 then
				MoveArea(v.area, Vector(0, d, 0))
			end
		end
	end
end

function Task_MostekWracaNaMiejsce()
	BeginTask()
	if not lgs.tasmaSound then
		lgs.tasmaSound =PlaySoundLooped("\\tasma_loop.wav")
	end
	for i, v in lgs.bridge_rotat do
		if i ~= "n" then
			if v.name ==  "bridge1"  then

				repeat
				    SetAreaMoving(PosArea(v.bridge_pos),1)
					v.angle  = v.angle - 1
					RotateArea(v.area,PosToVec(v.bridge_pos) , -1  )
					Wait(0.01)
				until v.angle <= 60
					v.angle = 60
				  	SetAreaMoving(PosArea(v.bridge_pos),1)
					v.enabled = nil
		        end

		end
	end
	StopSound(lgs.tasmaSound)
    lgs.tasmaSound = nil
	RemoveTask()
end

function Task_Mostek_Odkrecanie()
	BeginTask()
    if not lgs.tasmaSound then
		lgs.tasmaSound =PlaySoundLooped("\\tasma_loop.wav")
	end
	for i, v in lgs.bridge_rotat do
		if i ~= "n" then
			for i = 1,20 do

				v.angle  = v.angle + 1
				RotateArea(v.area,PosToVec(v.bridge_pos) , 1  )
				Wait(0.01)

			end
		end
	end
    StopSound(lgs.tasmaSound)
    lgs.tasmaSound = nil
	RemoveTask()
end

function OnLevelUpdate()
	 lgs:UpdateRotatingBridges()
	 lgs:UpdateMovingBridge()
	 lgs:UpdateDeska()

	 if lgs:ActorArea(lgs.kajetan) then
	 	StopSound(lgs.counterSound)
	 end

	 for i, v in lgs.bridges_fall do
		if i ~= "n"  then
			if not v.down then
				ASObjectOn(v.name.."_area")
	  		else
	  			ASObjectOff(v.name.."_area")
			end
		end
	end

	for i, v in lgs.bridge_rotat do
		if i ~= "n"  then
			if not v.moving then
			 	if Distance(go(lgs.kajetan,"pos"),GroundPoint("mostek_blokada"))<30 then
			 		ASObjectOff(v.name.."_area")
			 	else
					ASObjectOn(v.name.."_area")
				end
	  		else
	  			ASObjectOff(v.name.."_area")
			end
		end
	end

	lgs:OpenExit("exit1")
	lgs:OpenExit("exit2")

////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

//=======================================================================
///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

	if lgs.profesor then
		if Distance(go(lgs.kajetan,"pos") ,go(lgs.profesor,"pos") )  <50 then
			if not MapFlag("rozmowa") then
				SetMapFlag("rozmowa")
              //  go(lgs.profesor,"anim","idle",1,-1)
				if not Flag("Easter_Island_po_pierwszej_rozmowie") then
					if not FindTask("Task_ProfesorPierwszaRozmowa") then
						RemoveTask("Task_ProfesorLazi")
						if not FindTask("Task_ProfesorPierwszaRozmowa") then
							CreateTask("Task_ProfesorPierwszaRozmowa")
						end
					end
				else
					if LastMap("easter_island_sea_from_upper") then
						if Flag("zdjecia_wygrana")  then
							if not MapFlag("+profesor_przy_wyjsciu")  then
							   	RemoveTask("Task_ProfesorLazi")
								if not FindTask("Task_ProfesorRozmowaMamyZdjecia") then
									CreateTask("Task_ProfesorRozmowaMamyZdjecia")
								end
							else
								ChangeMap("easter_island_shore")
							end
						else
							if not MapFlag("+item_film_taken") then
							 	if not FindTask("Task_ProfesorRozmowaBrakFilmu") and not MapFlag("+po_dialogu_brak_filmu")then

						    SetMapFlag("+po_dialog_mamy_film")

							CreateTask("Task_ProfesorRozmowaMamyFilm")
						end
					end
				end
			end
		else

			if MapFlag("rozmowa") then
				ClearMapFlag("rozmowa")

-- 					CreateTask("Task_ProfesorLazi")

	end

				 if MapFlag("bambus2") then
				 	ClearMapFlag("bambus2")
				 end
				 SetMapFlag("bambus1")
				 return 1
			end
		end
		if name == "kwiatki1"  then
		    if not MapFlag("+bambus2_odkryty") then
				 CreateTask("Task_Bambus2")
				 if MapFlag("bambus1") then
				 	ClearMapFlag("bambus1")
				 end
				 SetMapFlag("bambus2")
				 return 1
			end
		end
		if name == "posag1" and not MapFlag("+help")  then
            if not FindTask("Task_Help") then
            	SetMapFlag("+help")
	   			CreateTask("Task_Help")
                return 1
	   		end
	   	end

	end
end

function lgs:ObjectName(object)
	if object == "kwiatki" then
		gui:MouseText(Str("freq.kwiatki"))
	elseif object == "palma" then
		gui:MouseText(Str("africa_cross.palm"))
	elseif object == "kamienie" then
		gui:MouseText(Str("freq.kamienie"))
	elseif object == "rusztowanie" then
		gui:MouseText(Str("freq.rusztowanie"))
	elseif object == "posag" then
		gui:MouseText(Str("freq.posag"))
	elseif object == "krzak" then
		gui:MouseText(Str("freq.krzak"))
	elseif object == "namiot" then
		gui:MouseText(Str("freq.namiot"))

	end
end

function OnHelpTake()

end

	gui:MouseText(go(obj,"nameVis"))
   	gui:MouseCursor("select")
end

function Task_HelpEfekt( )
	BeginTask()
 	lgs.promien = 10
	lgs.kat = 0
	lgs.licznik = 0
	local a =   go(lgs.help,"pos" )
	a.y = a.y+1
	local v = {}
	v.x = a.x
	v.y = a.y
	v.z = a.z
    StartParticle(lgs.helpefekt)
    CreatePartEffect("data\\fx\\energy1.apd", go(lgs.help,"pos"), 2 , "data\\bitmap\\fx\\shine_twirl_purple", 2)
	repeat
		if lgs.promien >2 then
	    	lgs.promien = lgs.promien -1
	    end
        lgs.licznik = lgs.licznik+1
		v.x = a.x + sin(lgs.kat) * lgs.promien
		v.z = a.z + cos(lgs.kat) * lgs.promien
		lgs.kat = lgs.kat + 20
		Wait(0.01)
		if random(1,2) >1.5 then
			v.y = 5
		else
			v.y = 1
		end
		SetPartPos(lgs.helpefekt,v)
	until lgs.licznik >60
	StopParticle(lgs.helpefekt)

    RemoveTask()

end

	BeginTask()
 	lgs.promien = 10

			  a =   go(lgs.bambus1,"pos" )

	v.x = a.x
	v.y = a.y
	v.z = a.z
    StartParticle(lgs.efekt)


 	repeat
 		lgs.promien = lgs.promien - 0.05
		v.x = a.x + sin(lgs.kat) * lgs.promien
		v.z = a.z + cos(lgs.kat) * lgs.promien

	until lgs.promien <0
