local pos =   GroundPosition("deska")
local area = {
		area = PosArea(pos),
		level = 0,
		floatingLevel = 0,
		floatingSpeed = random(3, 8) / 100,
		floatingMax = random(7, 15) / 10,
		floatingMin = random(-8, 0) / 10,
	}
	tinsert(lgs.areas, area)


function lgs:UpdateDeska()
	for i, v in lgs.areas do
		if i ~= "n" then
			local d = 0
			if v.floatingLevel then
				if v.floatingUp then
					if v.floatingMax - v.floatingLevel < v.floatingSpeed then
						v.floatingLevel = v.floatingMax
						d = v.floatingMax - v.floatingLevel
						v.floatingUp = nil
					else
						v.floatingLevel = v.floatingLevel + v.floatingSpeed
						d = v.floatingSpeed
					end
				else
					if v.floatingLevel - v.floatingMin < v.floatingSpeed then
						v.floatingLevel = v.floatingMin
						d = v.floatingLevel - v.floatingMin
						v.floatingUp = 1
					else
						v.floatingLevel = v.floatingLevel - v.floatingSpeed
						d = -v.floatingSpeed
					end
				end
			end

		    if v.levelDest then
		    	if v.accelerate then
		    		v.speed = v.speed + v.accelerate
		    	end
				local newLevel
					if v.levelDest < v.level then
						if v.level - v.speed < v.levelDest then
							newLevel = v.levelDest
							v.levelDest = nil
						else
							newLevel = v.level - v.speed
						end
					else
						if v.level + v.speed > v.levelDest then
								newLevel = v.levelDest
								v.levelDest = nil
						else
							newLevel = v.level + v.speed
						end
					end
					d = d + newLevel - v.level
					v.level = newLevel
		    end
		    if d ~= 0 then
				MoveArea(v.area, Vector(0, d, 0))
			end
		end
	end
end

function Area_anims(name, event, param)
	if guiMenuInv.movingItemName ~= "lupa" then
		if event == "over" then
			lgs:ObjectName(param)
		end
		return 1
	end

	if event == "over" then
		lgs:ObjectName(param)
	elseif event == "in" then

           guiMenuInv:ShineOn(0.1)
	elseif event == "out" then
	    guiMenuInv:ShineOff()

		TwinAnimBkg(name, "standard", 1, 1)
	end

//----------------------------------------------------
//wskaznik parametry

//----------------------------------------------------
lgs.licznik = 0
lgs.licznik2 = 0

lgs.desc = {
	{
		obj = NewObject("posag.object3d"),
		scale = 1,
		posY = -30,
		xSize = 50,
		xCollision = 40,
		yCollision = 60,
		//angle = -90,
		vUp = 35,
	},
	{

		posY =	0,
		xSize = 50,
		xCollision = 120,
		yCollision = 30,
		//angle = -90,
	},
}
lgs.counter = 25

//--ladowanie

//------------
//--startowanie
lgs.maxSpeed = 11
//--------------

lgs.speed = 0
lgs.maxX = 2000
lgs.distToStart = 0
lgs.maxDist = 45000

MarkArea(0)

lgs.p0 = GroundPoint("p0")
lgs.p1 = GroundPoint("p1")
lgs.p2 = GroundPoint("p2")
lgs.p3 = GroundPoint("p3")

lgs.dir= VectorNormalize(VectorSub(lgs.p2, lgs.p1))

DesktopOff()

lgs.samolot = NewObject("samolotp.object3d")
go(lgs.samolot, "animAttachedModel", "smiglo", "kreci", 0, -1)
go(lgs.samolot, "place", lgs.p1)
go(lgs.samolot, "anim", "fly", 0, -1)
go(lgs.samolot, "setPosY", 22)
go(lgs.samolot, "rotateToPoint", lgs.p2, 1)
//go(lgs.samolot, "vUp", Vector(0, 0, 1))
go(lgs.samolot, "evOnUpdateThrow", "EIE_OnUpdateThrow")
go(lgs.samolot, "evOnEndThrow", "EIE_OnEndThrow")


lgs.boja = NewObject("boja.object3d")
go(lgs.boja, "scale", 3)
go(lgs.boja, "rotate", 50)
go(lgs.boja, "place", lgs.p2)
go(lgs.boja, "setPosY", -2)
go(lgs.boja, "floatingOn", 1.1, 2, -2 , 1)
go(lgs.boja, "hide")
lgs.bojaHide = 1

EnableWater("data\\maps\\sea\\water\\woda_%d.jpg", RGBA(1,1,1,0.4), 13, 0.002, 0.002, 220.0, 0.0, lgs.speed * lgs.dir.x, lgs.speed * lgs.dir.z)

lgs.nextPrzeszkodaX = random(500, 650)
lgs.bojaX = lgs.nextPrzeszkodaX

function lgs:Przeszkoda()
	lgs.przeszkoda = lgs.desc[random(1, getn(lgs.desc))]
	local v = lgs.przeszkoda
	lgs.x = lgs.nextPrzeszkodaX
	lgs.nextPrzeszkodaX = random(500, 650)
	lgs.bojaPrzesunieta = nil
	go(v.obj, "scale", v.scale)
	go(v.obj, "setPosY", v.posY)
	go(v.obj, "rotate", v.angle and v.angle or random(0, 360))
	if v.vUp then
		go(v.obj, "angUp", random(-v.vUp, v.vUp))
	end
end

function lgs:Start()
	lgs:Przeszkoda()
	lgs.x = lgs.maxX
	lgs.bojaX = lgs.maxX
	lgs.przeszkoda.pos = VectorAdd(lgs.p0, VectorScale(lgs.dir, lgs.x))
	go(lgs.przeszkoda.obj, "place", lgs.przeszkoda.pos)
end

lgs:Start()

local p0 = VectorAdd(lgs.p1, VectorScale(lgs.dir, 10))
local p1 = VectorAdd(p0, VectorScale(lgs.dir, 20))

local p2 = RotatePoint3D(p1, -90, p0)
lgs.piana1 = CreatePartEffect("data\\fx\\piana5.apd", p2, -1, "data\\bitmap\\fx\\pianka", -1, Vector(-lgs.dir.x, 0.1, -lgs.dir.z), 0)
SetPartInitSpeedScale(lgs.piana1, 0.2)

local p2 = RotatePoint3D(p1, 90, p0)
lgs.piana2 = CreatePartEffect("data\\fx\\piana5.apd", p2, -1, "data\\bitmap\\fx\\pianka", -1, Vector(-lgs.dir.x, 0.1, -lgs.dir.z), 0)
SetPartInitSpeedScale(lgs.piana2, 0.2)
//WaterToZBuffer(0)

function lgs:PrzesunPrzeszkody(x)
	lgs.distToStart = lgs.distToStart - x

	local dir = VectorScale(lgs.dir, x)
	local sw = ScreenWidth()
	local v = lgs.przeszkoda

	lgs.x = lgs.x + x
	if lgs.dist < 0.97 and lgs.x < -sw - 300 then
		lgs:Przeszkoda()
	elseif lgs.x < v.xSize and lgs.x > -sw - v.xSize then
		v.pos = VectorAdd(lgs.p0, VectorScale(lgs.dir, lgs.x))
		go(v.obj, "place", v.pos)
		if Distance2D(v.pos, lgs.p1) < v.xCollision then
			if v.pos.y + v.yCollision > lgs.posY then
				if not FindTask("Task_hit") then
					CreateTask("Task_hit")
				end
			end
		end
	end

	lgs.bojaX = lgs.bojaX + x
	local bojaPos = VectorAdd(lgs.p3, VectorScale(lgs.dir, lgs.bojaX))
	bojaPos = VectorAdd(bojaPos, VectorScale(lgs.dir, x * 15))
	if lgs.bojaHide then
		lgs.bojaHide = nil
		Reveal(lgs.boja)
	end
	go(lgs.boja, "place", bojaPos)
	if lgs.dist < 0.97 and not lgs.bojaPrzesunieta and lgs.x < -sw then
		lgs.bojaPrzesunieta = 1
		lgs.bojaX = lgs.nextPrzeszkodaX + 300
	end
end


function OnLevelUpdate()
if lgs.speed then
		gui:MouseCursor("no")
		if lgs.speed < lgs.maxSpeed + lgs.accelerate then
			lgs.speed = lgs.speed + lgs.accelerate
		else
			lgs.speed = lgs.maxSpeed
		end

		if NoMapFlag("koniec_gry") then
			lgs:PrzesunPrzeszkody(-lgs.speed)
		end

		SetWaterFollow(lgs.speed * lgs.dir.x, lgs.speed * lgs.dir.z)
		local s = max(0.2, lgs.speed * 0.1)
		SetPartInitSpeedScale(lgs.piana1, s)
		SetPartInitSpeedScale(lgs.piana2, s)
	else
		SetWaterFollow(0, 0)
		SetPartInitSpeedScale(lgs.piana1, 0.2)
		SetPartInitSpeedScale(lgs.piana2, 0.2)
	end

	local pos = go(lgs.samolot, "pos")
	if NoMapFlag("hit") and KbdStruck("space") and not MapFlag("koniec_gry") and not FindTask("Task_koniec") then
		local d = lgs.p1.y - pos.y
		if abs(d) < 1 then
			go(lgs.samolot, "throwUp", min(150, 220 + d), nil, d)
			--HudText(Str("antek_okrzyki."..random(1,5)))
			StopParticle(lgs.piana1)
			StopParticle(lgs.piana2)
		end
	end
	lgs.posY = pos.y
	if NoMapFlag("hit") then
		lgs.maxSpeed = lgs.maxSpeed + 0.0055
	end
	lgs.dist = lgs.distToStart / lgs.maxDist
	SetClockAngle(lgs.distToStart / lgs.maxDist)
	if lgs.dist > 1 and not FindTask("Task_koniec") then
		CreateTask("Task_koniec")
	end
end


function Task_zmiana()
	BeginTask()
	Wait(5)
	ChangeMap("antarctica_coast")
	RemoveTask()
end

function Task_koniec()
			BeginTask()
			StopMusic("data\\music\\pipe.OGG",-1,80)
			while abs(lgs.p1.y - lgs.posY) > 1 do
				NextTask()
			end
			go(lgs.samolot, "throwUp", 165, nil, 164)
			go(lgs.samolot, "evOnEndThrow")
			StopParticle(lgs.piana1)
			StopParticle(lgs.piana2)
			local hud = HudText(Str("easter_island_sea.1"))
			WFHud(hud)
/*
			local hud = HudText(Str("easter_island_sea.2"))
			WFHud(hud)
*/
			go(lgs.samolot, "anim", "turnR2", 3, -1)
			Wait(3)
			ChangeMap("antarctica_sea")
			RemoveTask()
end

function lgs:zmiana2()
	ChangeMap("easter_island_sea")

end

function lgs:Repeat()
	Msg(Str("msg.tryAgain"), Str("msg.youLoose"), {{caption = Str("keyCaption.ok"), key = "enter", func = lgs.zmiana2}})
end

function Task_hit()
	BeginTask()
	SetMapFlag("hit")
	lgs.licznik = 0
	lgs.licznik2 = 0
	lgs.speed = nil
	go(lgs.samolot, "stop")
	go(lgs.samolot, "anim", "hit")
	PlaySound("\\models\\car_hit_1.wav")
	StopSound(lgs.enginesound)
	WFAnim(lgs.samolot)
	go(lgs.samolot, "anim", "fly", 0, -1)

	RemoveTask()

	go(obj, "angUp", go(obj, "speed", "y"))

	StartParticle(lgs.piana1)

function lgs:SetLevel(level, showInfo)
PlayMusic("data\\music\\foto.ogg")
	if level < 0 then
		level = 1
	end
	local _level = level - 1
/*
	lgs.sinkTime = max(0.15, lgs.levels.sinkTime + lgs.levels.addSinkTime * _level)
	lgs.sinkFactor = lgs.levels.sinkFactor + lgs.levels.addSinkFactor * _level
	lgs.fotoTimeStart = max(0.2, lgs.levels.fotoTime + lgs.levels.addFotoTime * _level)
*/
	lgs.sinkTime = lgs.levels.normalSinkTime + lgs.levels.normalSinkTime * lgs.levels.addSinkTime * (1 - Power(lgs.levels.factorSinkTime, _level))
	lgs.sinkTime = max(lgs.levels.minSinkTime, lgs.sinkTime)

	lgs.sinkFactor = lgs.levels.normalSinkFactor + lgs.levels.normalSinkFactor * lgs.levels.addSinkFactor * (1 - Power(lgs.levels.factorSinkFactor, _level))

	lgs.fotoTimeStart = lgs.levels.normalFotoTime + lgs.levels.normalFotoTime * lgs.levels.addFotoTime * (1 - Power(lgs.levels.factorFotoTime, _level))

	if showInfo then
		lgs.hudLevel = HudMsg(format(Str("msg.levelNo"), level), nil, nil, ScreenHeight() * 0.5)
	end
end

function lgs:SetMovinAround(nr)

		SetAreaMoving(lgs.areas[i].area, abs(i - nr) < 1.1 and 0 or 1)
	end

function _MoveArea(area, level, speed, accelerate)
	area.levelDest = level
	area.speed = speed and abs(speed) or 0.3
	area.accelerate = accelerate
end


function UpdateAreas()

	if lgs.game and lgs.activeArea then
		lgs.activeArea.time = lgs.activeArea.time - frameTime
		if lgs.activeArea.time < 0 then
			_MoveArea(lgs.activeArea.area, -20, 0.02 * lgs.sinkFactor, 0.01 * lgs.sinkFactor)
			lgs.activeArea = nil
		end
	end

	for i, v in lgs.areas do
		if i ~= "n" then
			local d = 0

			if v.floatingLevel then
				if v.floatingUp then
					if v.floatingMax - v.floatingLevel < v.floatingSpeed then
						v.floatingLevel = v.floatingMax
						d = v.floatingMax - v.floatingLevel
						v.floatingUp = nil
					else
						v.floatingLevel = v.floatingLevel + v.floatingSpeed
						d = v.floatingSpeed
					end
				else
					if v.floatingLevel - v.floatingMin < v.floatingSpeed then
						v.floatingLevel = v.floatingMin
						d = v.floatingLevel - v.floatingMin
						v.floatingUp = 1
					else
						v.floatingLevel = v.floatingLevel - v.floatingSpeed
						d = -v.floatingSpeed
					end
				end
			end

            if v.levelDest then
            	if v.accelerate then
            		v.speed = v.speed + v.accelerate
            	end
				local newLevel
 				if v.levelDest < v.level then
					if v.level - v.speed < v.levelDest then
 						newLevel = v.levelDest
 						v.levelDest = nil
					else
						newLevel = v.level - v.speed
					end
 				else
					if v.level + v.speed > v.levelDest then
 						newLevel = v.levelDest
 						v.levelDest = nil
					else
						newLevel = v.level + v.speed
					end
 				end
 				d = d + newLevel - v.level
 				v.level = newLevel
 				if not lgs.endGame and v.level < -18 then
 					guiDesktop:SetCanJump(0)
					CreateTask("Task_Loose")
 				end
            end
            if d ~= 0 then
				MoveArea(v.area, Vector(0, d, 0))
			end
		end
	end

end

function lgs:Wieloryb(num)
	if FindTask("Task_Wieloryb") then
		return
	end
	lgs.foto = nil
	lgs.fotoTime = lgs.fotoTimeStart
	num = num or random(1, lgs.posCount)
	local pos = CloneLuaObject(lgs["w"..num])
	local distX = 200
	local distY = 80
	local posStop = PosToVec(lgs["pos"..num])
	local posStart = VectorMid(posStop, pos, 2)
	posStart.y = pos.y - distY
	posStop.y = posStart.y
	lgs._wieloryb = {
		posMid = pos,
		posStart = posStart,
		posStop = posStop,
		distX =distX,
		distY = distY,
	}
	CreateTask("Task_Wieloryb")
end


function Task_Wieloryb()
	BeginTask()
	local posMid = lgs._wieloryb.posMid
	local posStart = lgs._wieloryb.posStart
	local posStop = lgs._wieloryb.posStop
	local distX = lgs._wieloryb.distX
	local distY = lgs._wieloryb.distY
	go(lgs.wieloryb, "setAlpha", 0)
	go(lgs.wieloryb, "place", posStart)
	go(lgs.wieloryb, "throwUp", distY + 4, 0.2, distY)

	go(lgs.wieloryb, "attachedParticle", "fontanna", 0)
	lgs._wielorybPlynie = 1
	lgs._wielorybWyplywa = 1
	while lgs._wielorybWyplywa do
		NextTask()
	end
	go(lgs.wieloryb, "attachedParticle", "fontanna", 1, 1.3)
	//Wait(0.5)

	go(lgs.wieloryb, "throwUp", 0.01, 0.2, -distY)
	while lgs._wielorybPlynie do
		NextTask()
	end

	Wait(1)
	RemoveTask()
end


function EISFU_OnWielorybUpdateThrow(obj)
	if lgs._wieloryb then
		local pos = go(lgs.wieloryb, "pos")
		local d = max(0, pos.y - lgs._wieloryb.posStart.y)
		d = min(d / (lgs._wieloryb.distY - 1), 1)

		go(lgs.wieloryb, "setAlpha", d)

		local angUp = go(lgs.wieloryb, "speed", "y") * 50
		lgs._wielOK = nil
		if d > 0.95 and lgs._wielAngUp then
			if d > 0.999 then
				lgs._wielOK = 1
			end
			if abs(lgs._wielAngUp - angUp) > 1 then
				if angUp < lgs._wielAngUp then
					angUp = lgs._wielAngUp - 1
				else
					angUp = lgs._wielAngUp + 1
				end
			end
		end
		lgs._wielAngUp = go(lgs.wieloryb, "angUp", angUp)

		go(lgs.wieloryb, "scale", lgs.wielorybScale * 0.7 + d * lgs.wielorybScale * 0.3)

		local newPos
		if lgs._wielorybWyplywa then
			newPos = VectorMid(lgs._wieloryb.posStart, lgs._wieloryb.posMid, d)
		else
			newPos = VectorMid(lgs._wieloryb.posStart, lgs._wieloryb.posMid, 2 - d)
		end
		newPos.y = pos.y
		go(lgs.wieloryb, "place", newPos)
	end
end


function EISFU_OnWielorybEndThrow(obj)
	if lgs._wielorybWyplywa then
		lgs._wielorybWyplywa = nil
	else
		lgs._wielorybPlynie = nil
	end
	go(lgs.wieloryb, "place", lgs._wieloryb.posMid)
end

function lgs:StopOut()
	local from = MapFlag("_MINI_GAME")
	if from and from ~= "_OUT" then
		local fileName = guiMenu:IsSave("autosave")
		if not fileName or not SafeLoad(fileName..".ssv") then
			__ResetGame()
			Menu("menuMain", 1, {"minigames"})
		end
	else
		__ResetGame()
		Menu("menuMain", 1, {"minigames"})
	end
end


function Task_Loose()
	BeginTask()
	guiDesktop:SetCanJump(1)
	lgs.endGame = 1
	for i = 1, 5 do
		SetAreaMoving(lgs.areas[i].area, 1)
	end
	lgs.activeArea = nil
	go(lgs.aktor, "evOnStartJump")
	go(lgs.aktor, "evOnStopJump")
	local hud = HudText(Str("easter_island_sea_from_upper.2"))
	WFHud(hud)
	if lgs.actLevel then
		miejsce = AddHighScore(gc_savedGamesDir.."\\game2.hs", lgs.points)
		local score
		if miejsce then
			score = format(Str("msg.scoreOK"), miejsce)
		else
			score = Str("msg.scoreSmall")
		end
		Msg(format(Str("msg.conquerPoints"), lgs.points).."|"..score.."| |"..Str("msg.playOnceMore"), Str("msg.endGame"), {{caption = Str("keyCaption.yes"), key = "enter", func = lgs.StartOut}, {caption = Str("keyCaption.no"), key = "esc", func = lgs.StopOut}})
	else
		if not MapFlag("+LOOSE") then
			SetMapFlag("+LOOSE")
			SetFlag("zdjecia_przegrana")
			ChangeMap("easter_island_ravine")
		else
			SlideShow({}, nil, 0.5, lgs.Repeat)
		end
	end
	RemoveTask()
end

		_MoveArea(lgs.areas[i], 0, 100)
	end
	lgs.klatki = {}
	lgs.klatek = lgs.klatekToWin
	lgs.points = 0
	Msg(Str("msg.tryAgain"), Str("msg.youLoose"), {{caption = Str("keyCaption.ok"), key = "enter", func = lgs.NewGame}})
end

		_MoveArea(lgs.areas[i], 0)
	end

	lgs.game = 1
	local areaId = lgs:ActorAreaId(lgs.aktor)

		lgs:SetMovinAround(areaId)

			area = lgs.areas[areaId],

	lgs:StartLevel(1)
	lgs:NewGame()
*/
	lgs.actLevel = 0
	CreateTask("Task_NextLevel")
end


function OnLevelEntered()
	if MapFlag("_MINI_GAME") then
		lgs:StartOut()
	else
		lgs:Start()
	end
end


function Task_NextLevel()
    BeginTask()
    lgs.game = nil
	for i = 1, 5 do
		_MoveArea(lgs.areas[i], 0, 0.1, 0.05)
	end
	if lgs.gameStarted then
		Wait(1.5)
	end
	gui.levelRender = nil
	lgs:StartLevel(lgs.actLevel + 1)
	local from = MapFlag("_MINI_GAME")
	if from and from ~= "_OUT" and abs(lgs.actLevel / 5 - floor(lgs.actLevel / 5)) < 0.01 then
		AddHelp(1)
	end
	lgs.activeArea = nil
	lgs:NewGame()
	lgs.game = nil
	WFHud(lgs.hudLevel, 1)
	gui.levelRender = 1
	lgs.game = 1
	if lgs.activeArea then
		lgs.activeArea.time = lgs.sinkTime
	end
    RemoveTask()
end

	BeginTask()
	lgs.efekt = CreatePartEffect("data\\fx\\gwiazdki1.apd", GroundPoint("sruba_point"),3, "data\\bitmap\\shine", 15)

 	lgs.promien = 5
	lgs.kat = 0
	local a =   GroundPoint("sruba_point")

	local v = {}
	v.x = a.x
	v.y = a.y
	v.z = a.z
    StartParticle(lgs.efekt)
	repeat
 		lgs.promien = lgs.promien - 0.06
		v.x = a.x + sin(lgs.kat) * lgs.promien
		v.z = a.z + cos(lgs.kat) * lgs.promien
		lgs.kat = lgs.kat + 30
		Wait(0.01)
			SetPartPos(lgs.efekt,v)
	until lgs.promien <0
		StopParticle(lgs.efekt)
    RemoveTask()

end

MarkArea(0)
 /*#############################################################################

SEA

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
ZMIENNE
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
lgs.koniec = nil
lgs.posp2 = GroundPoint("p2")
lgs.speed = 0
lgs.shipCount = 3
lgs.hits = 0
lgs.damage  = 0
lgs.angle = 0
lgs.maxX = BkgBitmapWidth() - 20

lgs.spr_statek = CreateSprite("data\\bitmap\\kuter_icon_2")

lgs.spr_damage3 = CreateSprite("data\\maps\\sea\\speed\\kuterdamage_3")

lgs.spr_hit1 = CreateSprite("data\\maps\\sea\\speed\\kuterhit_1")

lgs.spr_kuterek = CreateSprite("data\\maps\\sea\\speed\\kuterek")

lgs.spr_strzalka = CreateSprite("data\\bitmap\\side_arrow_2")

lgs.angB = {0, 120, 200, 160, 60, 320, 270, 45, 135, 210, 90, 350, 180, 100, 295}
lgs.angS = {0, 120, 200, 160, 60, 320, 270, 45, 135, 210, 90, 350, 180, 100, 295}

lgs.endGame = nil

/*#############################################################################

FUNKCJE i Taski

#############################################################################*/

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Funkcja do tworzenia obiektow
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function lgs:TworzObiekty(nazwa, rodzaj, miejsce, tablica, ilosc, wysokosc, xstep, ystep, alfa, tabAngle)
	for i = 1 , ilosc do
	    local nazwa_loc = nazwa
		nazwa_loc = NewObject(rodzaj)
		local pos = GroundPoint(miejsce.."_"..i)
		go(nazwa_loc,"place",pos)
		go(nazwa_loc, "setPosY", wysokosc)

		if nazwa ~= "wiatr" then
			if tabAngle and getn(tabAngle) >= i then
				go(nazwa_loc, "rotate", tabAngle[i])
			else
				go(nazwa_loc, "rotate", random(1,180))
			end
		end
		if nazwa == "wiatr" or nazwa =="tornado" then
			go(nazwa_loc, "rotate",90)
			go(nazwa_loc, "anim", "idle", 1, -1)
		end
		if nazwa == "wieloryb" then
			 go(nazwa_loc, "scale", 0.8)
		end
  		if alfa  then
 			go(nazwa_loc,"setAlpha",alfa)
 		end
 		if nazwa == "chmura" then
          	go(nazwa_loc, "anim", "idle1", 1, -1)
		end

		tinsert(tablica, {coll = nil, id = nazwa_loc, name = nazwa, pos =  pos,xstep = xstep, ystep = ystep})
	end
end
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Funkcja kolizji
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function lgs:Kolizja(tablica,odleglosc)
    if lgs.lastCollisionTime and currentTime - lgs.lastCollisionTime < 1 then
		return
	end
	for i, v in tablica do
		if i ~= "n" then
            v.pos  = go(v.id,"pos")

			if Distance2D(v.pos.x, v.pos.z, lgs.shipPos.x, lgs.shipPos.z) <= odleglosc then
				if not v.coll then
				    lgs.lastCollisionTime = currentTime
				    go(lgs.statek, "anim", "hit", 0 , 1)
					v.coll = 1
					lgs:Punkty()
					DrawRectangle(Vector(0, ScreenHeight() - 110 , 0),128, 128, RGBA(1,1,1,1))
				//	go(lgs.statek, "brakingTo", 1)
					go(lgs.statek,"rotate",180)
					go(lgs.statek, "goForward")
					break

 				else

				end
			else
		        //przestalismy kolidowac (dzwiek, task)
				if v.coll == 1 then
					v.coll = nil
				else

				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function lgs:ASKolizja(tablica)
	if lgs.lastCollisionTime and currentTime - lgs.lastCollisionTime < 1 then
		return
	end

	for i = 1, getn(tablica) do
		local name = "area_"..tablica[i].name.."_"..i
		//print(name)

		if ASIsInside(name, lgs.shipPosDziob2D.x, lgs.shipPosDziob2D.y) or ASIsInside(name, lgs.shipPos2D.x, lgs.shipPos2D.y) then
			if not tablica[i].coll then
				lgs.lastCollisionTime = currentTime
			    go(lgs.statek, "anim", "hit", 0 , 1)
			    PlaySound("\\models\\car_hit_1.wav")
				tablica[i].coll = 1
				lgs:Punkty()
				PlaySound("\\models\\car_hit_1.wav")
				go(lgs.statek,"rotate",180)
				go(lgs.statek, "goForward")
				break
			end

		else
			tablica[i].coll = nil
		end
	end

end

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Funkcja wiatru
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function lgs:Wiatr()
    if lgs.lastCollisionTime and currentTime - lgs.lastCollisionTime < 1 then
		return
	end
	for i, v in lgs.listWiatr do
		if i ~= "n" then
			if Distance(v.pos, lgs.shipPos) < 20 then
			    if not v.coll then
			         lgs.lastCollisionTime = currentTime
					 v.coll = 1
                     lgs.speed = lgs.speed +1
                     go(lgs.statek,"brakingTo",lgs.speed)

				else

				end
			else
				if v.coll == 1 then
					go(lgs.statek, "anim", "speed",0,1 )
		            PlaySound("\\cross2-iglak.wav")
				   v.coll = nil
				else

				end
			end
		end
	end
end
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Funkcja tornada
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function lgs:Tornado()

	for i, v in lgs.listTornado do
		if i ~= "n" then

			// Odwrócenie kierunku w momencie osi¹gniêcia lewej lub prawej krawêdzi
			if v.pos.x > lgs.posp2.x or v.pos.x < 0 then
				v.xstep = - v.xstep;
			end
			// Odwrócenie kierunku w momencie osi¹gniêcia górnej lub dolnej krawêdzi
			if v.pos.z > lgs.posp2.z or v.pos.z < 0 then
				v.ystep = -v.ystep;
			end

			// Samo przesuniêcie obiektu
			v.pos.x = v.pos.x + v.xstep;
			v.pos.z = v.pos.z + v.ystep;
			go(v.id,"place",v.pos)
			if lgs.lastCollisionTime and currentTime - lgs.lastCollisionTime < 1 then
				return
			end
			if Distance(v.pos, lgs.shipPos) < 20  then
				if not v.coll then

				    lgs.lastCollisionTime = currentTime
			    	v.coll = 1
					lgs:Punkty()
					CreateTask("Task_Tornado")
				else

				end
			else
   				//przestalismy kolidowac (dzwiek, task)
				if v.coll == 1 then
				   v.coll = nil
				else

				end
			end
        end
	end
end

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Funkcja badajaca czy dotarlismy do brzegu
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function lgs:Brzeg()
	if MapFlag("gra") then
		if  lgs.shipPos.z < 40 then
		    if not lgs.koniec then
				 lgs.koniec = 1
				ClearMapFlag("gra")
    			lgs.hits = 0
  			--	HudMsg(Str("sea1") , 2,nil,300)
  				lgs.endGame = 2.5
		    else

			end
		else
			if lgs.koniec == 1 then
			    lgs.koniec = nil
			else

			end

		end
	end
end


/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Funkcja odpowiedzialna za punkty
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function lgs:Punkty()
   -- HudImg("data\\maps\\sea\\speed\\bum",0.1, 0, ScreenHeight() -80, 1, 1,80)
	lgs.damage = lgs.damage+1

	if lgs.damage >2 then
		lgs.hits =lgs.hits +1

	end

	if lgs.hits ==  3 then
		CreateTask("Task_KoniecGry")
	end

    if lgs.damage ==  3   then
        if lgs.hits ~= 3 then
			HudMsg(Str("sea2"),2, nil,300)
		end
		lgs.damage = 0
	else
		if lgs.hits ~= 3   then
			HudMsg(Str("sea3") , 2,nil,250)
		end
	end
	lgs.speed = 1
	go(lgs.statek,"brakingTo",lgs.speed)

end
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Funkcja chmury
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function lgs:Chmury()

	for i, v in lgs.listChmury do
		if i ~= "n" then
			// Odwrócenie kierunku w momencie osi¹gniêcia lewej lub prawej krawêdzi
			if v.pos.x > lgs.posp2.x or v.pos.x < 20 then
				v.xstep = - v.xstep;
			end
            // Samo przesuniêcie obiektu
			v.pos.x = v.pos.x + v.xstep;
			go(v.id,"place",v.pos)
			go(v.id, "rotate",1)
			if Distance(v.pos, lgs.shipPos) < 20  then
			    if lgs.lastCollisionTime and currentTime - lgs.lastCollisionTime < 1 then
						return
				end
				if not v.coll then

				    lgs.lastCollisionTime = currentTime
					v.coll = 1
					lgs:Punkty()
					go(lgs.statek,"pos",v.pos)
					if not FindTask("Task_Chmura") then
						CreateTask("Task_Chmura")
					end
				else

				end
			else
   				//przestalismy kolidowac (dzwiek, task)
				if v.coll == 1 then
				    v.coll = nil
				else

				end
			end
        end
	end
end

function OnLevelRender()
	if MapFlag("gra") then

			//  Wyswietlanie ikon (statki gracza)
		if lgs.hits == 0 then
		    SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_hit1, 0)
		elseif lgs.hits ==1 then
			SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_hit2, 0)
		elseif lgs.hits ==2 then
			SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_hit3, 0)
		elseif lgs.hits ==3  then
			SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_hit4, 0)
		end
		DrawRectangle(Vector(590 ,5, 0), 128, 64, RGBA(1,1,1,1))

		if lgs.speed >1 then
		    local prwdp = random(1,10)
		    if prwdp > 8 then
		    	SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_speed3,0)
		    else
		    	SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_speed4,0)
			end
		else
			local prwdp = random(1,10)
		    if prwdp > 8 then
		    	SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_speed1,0)
		    else
		    	SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_speed2,0)
			end
		end
		DrawRectangle(Vector(ScreenWidth()/2 -150, 5 , 0),256, 128, RGBA(1,1,1,1))

		if lgs.damage == 0  then
			SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_damage1,0)
		elseif lgs.damage == 1 then
			SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_damage2,0)
		elseif lgs.damage == 2 then
			SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_damage3,0)
		end
		DrawRectangle(Vector(30, 5 , 0),128, 64, RGBA(1,1,1,1))

		//rysowanie postepu
		local bw = 150
		local bh = 16
		local pos = (lgs.maxY - lgs.shipPos2D.y) / lgs.maxY
		SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_kuterek,0)
		DrawRectangle(Vector(ScreenWidth() / 2 - 105 + (bw - bh) * pos, 20 ,0), 32, 32, RGBA(1,1,1,1))

		if MapFlag("zly_kierunek") then
			local alpha = (cos(mod(frameCount, 10) * 360 / 10) + 1) * 0.5
			SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_strzalka,0)
			DrawRectangle(Vector(ScreenWidth() / 2 + 60 , ScreenHeight() / 2 ,0), 128, 32, RGBA(1,1,1,alpha))
		end
	end
end

maps/easter_sea2/script.lua:
MarkArea(0)
 /*#############################################################################

SEA

#############################################################################*/

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
ZMIENNE
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
lgs.koniec = nil
lgs.posp2 = GroundPoint("p2")
lgs.speed = 0
lgs.shipCount = 3
lgs.hits = 0
lgs.damage  = 0
lgs.angle = 0
lgs.maxX = BkgBitmapWidth() - 20
lgs.maxY = BkgBitmapHeight() - 20

lgs.spr_strzalka = CreateSprite("data\\bitmap\\side_arrow_2")

 lgs.angB = {0, 120, 200, 160, 60, 320, 270, 45, 135, 210, 90, 350, 180, 100, 295}
 lgs.angS = {0, 120, 200, 160, 60, 320, 270, 45, 135, 210, 90, 350, 180, 100, 295}

lgs.endGame = nil

/*#############################################################################

FUNKCJE i Taski

#############################################################################*/

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Funkcja do tworzenia obiektow
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function lgs:TworzObiekty(nazwa, rodzaj, miejsce, tablica, ilosc, wysokosc, xstep, ystep, alfa, tabAngle)
	for i = 1 , ilosc do
	    local nazwa_loc = nazwa
		nazwa_loc = NewObject(rodzaj)
		local pos = GroundPoint(miejsce.."_"..i)
		go(nazwa_loc,"place",pos)
		go(nazwa_loc, "setPosY", wysokosc)
		go(nazwa_loc,"scale",0.4)
        if (nazwa == "posag") then
            go(nazwa_loc, "angUp", random(-20, 10))
        	go(nazwa_loc,"rotateToPoint","boat")

        end
        if (nazwa == "wyspa") then
            nazwa_posagu =  "posag"..i
        	nazwa_posagu =NewObject("posag.object3d" )
			go(nazwa_posagu ,"scale",0.4)
			go(nazwa_posagu ,"setPosY",random(10,15))
			go(nazwa_posagu,"angUp", random(10,120))
			go(nazwa_posagu ,"place",pos)

		else
			nazwa_posagu = nil
        end
        if (nazwa == "wiatr") or (nazwa == "wieloryb") then
        	go(nazwa_loc,"anim","idle",0, -1)
        	go(nazwa_loc,"scale",0.7)
        end
        if nazwa == "wiatr" then
			go(nazwa_loc, "rotate",90)
		end

		tinsert(tablica, {coll = nil, id = nazwa_loc, name = nazwa, pos = pos,xstep = xstep, ystep = ystep,posag =nazwa_posagu})
		nazwa_posagu = nil
	end
end


function lgs:ASKolizja(tablica)
	if lgs.lastCollisionTime and currentTime - lgs.lastCollisionTime < 0.6 then
		return
	end

	for i = 1, getn(tablica) do
		local name = "area_"..tablica[i].name.."_"..i
		//print(name)

		if ASIsInside(name, lgs.shipPosDziob2D.x, lgs.shipPosDziob2D.y) or ASIsInside(name, lgs.shipPos2D.x, lgs.shipPos2D.y) then
			if not tablica[i].coll then
				lgs.lastCollisionTime = currentTime
			    go(lgs.statek, "anim", "hit", 0 , 1)
				tablica[i].coll = 1

				if not tablica[i].posag == nil then
				    PlaySound("\\podskok.wav")
					go(tablica[i].posag ,"throwUp", random(10,20 ))
				end
				if tablica[i].name == "posag" then
                    go(tablica[i].id,"vDir",Vector(random(-5,10),random(-5,10), 1))
                    PlaySound("\\models\\car_hit_1.wav")
				end

				go(lgs.statek, "brakingTo", 1)
				go(lgs.statek,"rotate",180)
				go(lgs.statek, "goForward")
				break
			end

		else
			tablica[i].coll = nil
		end
	end

end

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Funkcja kolizji
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function lgs:Kolizja(tablica,odleglosc)
    if lgs.lastCollisionTime and currentTime - lgs.lastCollisionTime < 0.6 then
		return
	end
	for i, v in tablica do
		if i ~= "n" then
            v.pos  = go(v.id,"pos")

			if Distance2D(v.pos.x, v.pos.z, lgs.shipPos.x, lgs.shipPos.z) <= odleglosc then
				if not v.coll then
				    lgs.lastCollisionTime = currentTime
				    go(lgs.statek, "anim", "hit", 0 , 1)
				    PlaySound("\\models\\car_hit_1.wav")
					v.coll = 1

					DrawRectangle(Vector(0, ScreenHeight() - 110 , 0),128, 128, RGBA(1,1,1,1))
					go(lgs.statek, "brakingTo", 1)
					go(lgs.statek,"rotate",180)
					go(lgs.statek, "goForward")
					break

 				else

				end
			else
		        //przestalismy kolidowac (dzwiek, task)
				if v.coll == 1 then
					v.coll = nil
				else

				end
			end
		end
	end
end
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Funkcja wiatru
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function lgs:Wiatr()
    if lgs.lastCollisionTime and currentTime - lgs.lastCollisionTime < 0.6 then
		return
	end
	for i, v in lgs.listWiatr do
		if i ~= "n" then
			if Distance(v.pos, lgs.shipPos) < 30 then
			    if not v.coll then
			         lgs.lastCollisionTime = currentTime
					 v.coll = 1
                     lgs.speed = lgs.speed +1
                     go(lgs.statek,"brakingTo",lgs.speed)
				else

				end
			else
				if v.coll == 1 then
				 go(lgs.statek, "anim", "speed",0,1 )
				  PlaySound("\\cross2-iglak.wav")
				   v.coll = nil
				else

				end
			end
		end
	end
end


/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Funkcja badajaca czy dotarlismy do brzegu
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function lgs:Brzeg()

	if  lgs.shipPos.z < 50 then
	    if not lgs.koniec then
			 lgs.koniec = 1
			ClearMapFlag("gra")
			lgs.hits = 0
				HudMsg(Str("sea1") , 2,nil,350)
				lgs.endGame = 2.5
	    else

		end
	else
		if lgs.koniec == 1 then
		    lgs.koniec = nil
		else

		end

	end

end



function lgs:Kierunek()
   	lgs.angle = go(lgs.statek,"angle")

	if  (lgs.angle > 0 and lgs.angle< 90) or (lgs.angle< -180 and lgs.angle >-270) then
		if not MapFlag("zly_kierunek")then
		    SetMapFlag("zly_kierunek")
		end
	else
		if MapFlag("zly_kierunek") then
			ClearMapFlag("zly_kierunek")
		end
	end
end

function Task_Wieloryb()
	BeginTask()
	//testy
	param = {}
	local nazwa = nil
	local pozycja = nil
	for i, v in lgs.listWiel do
		if i ~= "n" then
	         nazwa = v.id
	         pozycja = v.pos
	        tinsert(param, nazwa ,pozycja)
	    end
	end
	go(nazwa,"walk", "wieloryb_walk")
	WFWalkTo( nazwa)
	go( nazwa, "walk", pozycja)
	WFWalkTo( nazwa)
	RemoveTask()
end
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
Task Rozpoczynajacy gre
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function Task_Wstep()
	BeginTask()
	Wait(2)
	HudMsg(Str("sea_count_3"), 1, nil, 300)
	Wait(1)
	HudMsg(Str("sea_count_2"), 1, nil, 300)
	Wait(1)
	HudMsg(Str("sea_count_1"), 1, nil, 300)
	Wait(1)
	HudMsg(Str("sea_count_start"), 1, nil, 300)
	Wait(1)
    SetMapFlag("gra")
    PlayMusic("data\\music\\pipe.ogg")
	go(lgs.statek, "brakingTo", 1)
    lgs.speed = 1
	RemoveTask()
end
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
Task konczacy  gre w przypadku utraty wszystkich statków
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function Task_KoniecGry()
  	BeginTask()
  	lgs.speed = 0
	ClearMapFlag("gra")
	FadeOutMusic()
	lgs.hits = 0
	lgs.damage = 0
	HudMsg(Str("sea4"), 2,nil,350)
    SlideShow({}, nil, 2, nil)
	Wait(2)
	go(lgs.statek, "place","boat")
	go(lgs.statek, "rotateToPoint", "boat_look",1)
	go(lgs.statek, "brakingTo",lgs.speed)
	CreateTask("Task_Wstep")
	RemoveTask()
end
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
Task konczacy gre w przypadku dotarcia do celu
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function OnLevelEntered()
	CreateTask("Task_Wstep")
end
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function OnLevelRelease()
	RemoveTask("Task_Wstep")
	Task_Wstep = nil
	RemoveTask("Task_KoniecGry")
	Task_KoniecGry = nil
end

/*#############################################################################

Tworzenie obiektow

#############################################################################*/
if GetIdent() =="boy" then
	lgs.statek = NewObject("antek_deska.vehicle")
else
	lgs.statek = NewObject("ania_deska.vehicle")
end
go(lgs.statek, "setPosY", 5)
go(lgs.statek, "place","boat")
go(lgs.statek, "rotate", 180, 1)
go(lgs.statek,"anim","idle", 0, -1)
go(lgs.statek, "floatingOn", 0.5, 2, -2 , 1)
Drive(lgs.statek, 1)
CameraNow(lgs.statek)
go(lgs.statek,"brakingTo",0)
go(lgs.statek, "setMaxSpeed", 3)


lgs.listWyspy = {}
lgs.listPosagi = {}
lgs.listWiatr = {}
lgs.listWiel = {}

lgs:TworzObiekty("wyspa","wyspa.object3d","wyspa",lgs.listWyspy,6,4, nil, nil,nil, lgs.angS)
lgs:TworzObiekty("posag","posag.object3d","posag",lgs.listPosagi,24,-4,nil,nil,nil, lgs.angB)
lgs:TworzObiekty("wiatr","wiatr.object3d","wind",lgs.listWiatr,3,0, nil, nil,nil)
lgs:TworzObiekty("wieloryb","wieloryb.actor","wiel",lgs.listWiel,1,-5, nil, nil,nil)



EnableWater("data\\maps\\sea\\water\\woda_%d.jpg", RGBA(1,1,1,0.6), 13, 0.002, 0.002, 220.0, 0.0)
WaterToZBuffer(0)
PlaySoundLooped("\\waves2.wav",-1  )
/*#############################################################################

WYWIETLANIE NA EKRANIE

#############################################################################*/
function OnLevelRender()
	if MapFlag("gra") then
		if MapFlag("zly_kierunek") then
			local alpha = (cos(mod(frameCount, 10) * 360 / 10) + 1) * 0.5
			SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_strzalka,0)
			DrawRectangle(Vector(ScreenWidth() / 2 + 60 , ScreenHeight() / 2 ,0), 128, 32, RGBA(1,1,1,alpha))
		end
	end
end

/*#############################################################################

G£ÓWNA PÊTLA

#############################################################################*/
function OnLevelUpdate()
-- /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Pozycja statku
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
  	local pl = go(lgs.statek, "bonePos", "n_p_0")
	local pp = go(lgs.statek, "bonePos", "n_l_0")
  	lgs.shipPosDziob = VectorMid(pl, pp)
  	lgs.shipPosDziob2D = MapWorldToBkg(lgs.shipPosDziob)

	lgs.shipPos = go(lgs.statek, "bonePos", "n_l_0")
  	lgs.shipPos2D = MapWorldToBkg(lgs.shipPos)

-- /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
--  Kolizje
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
  	lgs:ASKolizja(lgs.listWyspy)
  	lgs:ASKolizja(lgs.listPosagi)
    lgs:Kolizja(lgs.listWiel,40)
	lgs:Wiatr()


 	if not FindTask("Task_Wieloryb") then
  		CreateTask("Task_Wieloryb")
  	end

-- /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
--  Badamy czy dotarlismy do celu
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
  	lgs:Brzeg()
-- /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
--  Badamy czy p³yniemy w dobr¹ stronê
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
	lgs:Kierunek()

	if lgs.endGame then
		lgs.endGame = lgs.endGame - frameTime
		if lgs.endGame < 0 then
			 ChangeMap("easter_island_beach")
		end
	end
end //koniec OnLevelUpdate

maps/hold/script.lua:
--SetFlag("Koniec_pierwszego_rozdzialu")
 -- guiMenuInv:PutItem(NewObject("lupa.object2d"))

AddTwinAnimBkg("data\\maps\\hold\\anim\\beczka3.anim")
AddTwinAnimBkg("data\\maps\\hold\\anim\\beczka8.anim")
AddTwinAnimBkg("data\\maps\\hold\\anim\\lampa.anim")
--AddTwinAnimBkg("data\\maps\\hold\\anim\\anim_lina.anim")
AddTwinAnimBkg("data\\maps\\hold\\anim\\linab.anim")

if Flag("beczki_przywiazane") then
	TwinAnimBkg("linab", "zwiazane", 0, 0)
	ASObjectOff("area_lina")
end


if not Flag("Koniec_pierwszego_rozdzialu") then
lgs.aktor = ImpActor("kajetan")
	go(lgs.aktor, "place", "p1")
	guiDesktop.actor = lgs.aktor
	guiScroll.traceObject = lgs.aktor
else

	ASObjectOff("schody_obszar")
	ASObjectOff("area_schody")
	guiScroll.traceObject = nil
	guiDesktop.actor = nil
	ASObjectOff("area_lina")
	ASObjectOff("area_beczki")
	DesktopOff()
	lgs.szczur = NewObject("szczur.actor")
    go(lgs.szczur, "place", "szczur_start")
end

//=======================================================================
// Funkcje zwi¹zane z lin¹
//=======================================================================
if not Flag("item_lina_zabrana") then
	if not Flag("item_lina") then
		lgs.lina = NewObject("lina.object2d")
		go(lgs.lina, "place", "lina")
		SetFlag("item_lina")
	end

	function Area_lina(name, event)
		if not Flag("item_lina_zabrana") then
			if event == "over" then
				gui:MouseText(go("lina", "nameVis"))
				if guiMenuInv:CanGetItem() then
					gui:MouseCursor("select")

				end

			elseif event == "click" then
				if guiMenuInv:GetItem("lina") then
					SetFlag("item_lina_zabrana")
					ASObjectOff("area_lina")
					return 1
				end

			end
		end
	end
else
	ASObjectOff("area_lina")
end

//=======================================================================


//=======================================================================
// Funkcje zwi¹zane z beczkami
//=======================================================================
function Area_beczki(name, event,param)
	if event == "over" then
		gui:MouseText(Str("freq.beczki"))
		if not Flag("beczki_przywiazane") then
			gui:MouseImg("doSome")
		end
	elseif event == "click" then
	    if guiMenuInv.movingItemName == "lina"   then
    		if not FindTask("Task_Beczki") then
			   CreateTask("Task_Beczki")
			   return 1
			end
		end
	elseif event == "help" then
		if param == 1 then
			HudText(Str("hint.beczki_ladownia_1"))
		elseif param == 2 then
			HudText(Str("hint.beczki_ladownia_2"))
		end
	end
end

//=======================================================================
// Task  Wiazanie beczek
//=======================================================================
function Task_Beczki()
	BeginTask()
	guiDesktop.mouseDetectClick = nil
	guiMenuInv:RemoveItem("lina")
	go(lgs.aktor, "walk", "szczur_walk")
	WFWalkTo(lgs.aktor)

	go(lgs.aktor,"anim","beczki",1,1)
	go(lgs.aktor, "rotateToPoint", "szczur_start",1)
	Wait(0.6)
	go(lgs.aktor,"anim","beczki",1,1)
	go(lgs.aktor, "place", "szczur_akcja")
	Wait(0.6)
	TwinAnimBkg("linab", "zwiazane", 0, 0)
	go(lgs.aktor,"anim","beczki",1,1)
	go(lgs.aktor, "place", "nowy1")
	Wait(0.6)
	go(lgs.aktor, "place", "nowy2")

	PlaySound("\\lina.wav",1 )
	Wait(1.6)

	SetFlag("beczki_przywiazane")
	go(lgs.aktor, "rotateToPoint", "nowy3")
	go(lgs.aktor,"anim","idle",0.3,-1)
	local hud = HudText(Str("hold1"))
	WFHud(hud)

	guiDesktop.mouseDetectClick = 1
	RemoveTask()
end

//=======================================================================
// Funkcje zwi¹zane ze schodami
//=======================================================================
function Area_schody(name, event)
	if event == "over" then
		gui:MouseText(Str("freq.schody"))
	end
end
//=======================================================================
// Cutscenaze szczurem
//=======================================================================
function Cutscena_szczur()
	BeginTask()
    Wait(1)
    local hud = HudText(Str("hold3"),6)
	go(lgs.szczur,"walk","szczur_walk" )
	WFWalkTo(lgs.szczur)
	go(lgs.szczur,"anim","idle",1,1)
	WFAnim(lgs.szczur)
	go(lgs.szczur,"walk","szczur_akcja" )
	WFWalkTo(lgs.szczur)
	go(lgs.szczur,"anim","idle3",1,1)
    WFAnim(lgs.szczur)
	go(lgs.szczur,"anim","idle2",1,1)
	Wait(2.2)
	go(lgs.szczur,"anim","lookr",1, -1)
	PlaySound("\\sm9.wav")
	local hud = HudText(Str("hold2") )
	WFHud(hud)


	ChangeMap("sea")
	RemoveTask()
end
//=======================================================================
// Animacje z lup¹
//=======================================================================
function Area_anims(name, event, param)
	if guiMenuInv.movingItemName ~= "lupa" then
		if event == "over" then
			lgs:ObjectName(param)
		end
		return
	end

	if event == "over" then
		lgs:ObjectName(param)
	elseif event == "in" then

		guiMenuInv:ShineOn(0.8)
	elseif event == "out" then

		guiMenuInv:ShineOff()
	elseif event == "click" then
		TwinAnimBkg(name, "standard", 1, 1)
		return 1
	end
end

function lgs:ObjectName(object)
	if object == "beczka3" then
		gui:MouseText(Str("freq.beczka"))
    elseif object == "beczka8" then
		gui:MouseText(Str("freq.beczka"))
	elseif object == "lampa" then
		gui:MouseText(Str("freq.lampa"))
	elseif object == "lina" then
		gui:MouseText(Str("obj2d.lina.nameVis"))
	end
end
//=======================================================================


function OnLevelEntered()
	if Flag("Koniec_pierwszego_rozdzialu") then
	 	CreateTask("Cutscena_szczur")
	end
end

function OnLevelUpdate()
	if not lgs.counter or lgs.counter <= 0 then
		PlaySound(random(1,2) == 1 and "\\creak_1.wav" or "\\creak_2.wav", -1)
		lgs.counter = 30*random(10,15)
	else
		lgs.counter = lgs.counter - 1
	end
end

function OnLevelRelease()
	RemoveTask("Cutscena_szczur")
	Cutscena_szczur = nil
	Area_schody = nil
	Area_beczki = nil
	RemoveTask("Task_Beczki")
	Task_Beczki = nil
	Item_lina = nil
	Area_anims = nil
	guiMenuInv:ShineRelease()
	//StopFrameMode(0)
end

PlaySoundLooped("\\waves2.wav",1 )
NoBreakingTask("Task_Beczki")

function lgs:Restart()
	PlaySound("\\_hit.wav")
	Msg(Str("msg.tryAgain"), Str("msg.youLoose"), {{caption = Str("keyCaption.ok"), key = "enter", func = lgs.NewGame}})
end

function lgs:NewGame()
    StopFrameMode(0)
	if lgs.BigBalls then
	    for i,v in lgs.BigBalls do
			if i~="n" then
				 go(v.kula,"remove")
				 StopParticle(v.part)
			end
		end
	end
	if lgs.smallBalls then
	    for i,v in lgs.smallBalls do
			if i~="n" then
			     StopParticle(v.part)
				 go(v.kula,"remove")
			end
		end
	end
	DesktopOn()
	lgs.BigBalls = nil
	lgs.BigBalls = nil
	lgs.koniec_gry = nil
	lgs.kajetan = ImpActor("kajetan")
	go(lgs.kajetan, "place", "start_k")
	go(lgs.kajetan,"rotateToPoint","p6",1)
	guiDesktop.actor = lgs.kajetan
	guiScroll.traceObject = lgs.kajetan
	go(lgs.kajetan, "evOnStopJump", "OnActorStopJump")
	lgs:CreateBigBall()
	lgs:CreateSmallBall()
end

function lgs:CreateBigBall()
    lgs.BigBalls = {}

    for i = 1,4 do
		local kula = NewObject("kulas_d.actor")
		local pos = GroundPoint("kula_start_"..i)
		go(kula,"place","kula_start_"..i)
		if mod(i,2) ==0 then
	 		go(kula,"walkSpeed",  0.8)
	 	else
	 		go(kula,"walkSpeed",  0.4)
	 	end
	 	go(kula, "shadow",2)
		local partpos = pos
	 	partpos.y = partpos.y +10
	    local snieg = CreatePartEffect("data\\fx\\piana1.apd",partpos,  -1, "data\\bitmap\\fx\\pianka", 0.001)
	  	StopParticle(snieg)
		local ball = {
	    pos = pos,
		partpos = partpos,
        kula =  kula,
        part = snieg,
        moving = nil,
        timer = 15,
        position = i,
        actpos = i,

		}
		tinsert(lgs.BigBalls, ball)
	end
-- 		 for i = 1,4 do
-- 			local kula = NewObject("kulas_d.actor")
-- 			local pos = GroundPoint("kula_start_"..i)
-- 			go(kula,"place","kula_start_"..i)

-- 		end

end

function lgs:CreateSmallBall()
    lgs.smallBalls = {}
	for i = 1,4 do
		local kula = NewObject("kulas_d.actor")
		local pos = GroundPoint("s"..i+2)
		go(kula,"place","s"..i)
		go(kula,"scale",0.7)
	 	go(kula,"walkSpeed",  0.2 )
	 	go(kula,"setPosY",0)
		local partpos = pos
	 	//partpos.y = partpos.y +30
        local snieg = CreatePartEffect("data\\fx\\piana1.apd",partpos,  -1, "data\\bitmap\\fx\\pianka",1)
		StartParticle(snieg)
		local ball = {
		pos = pos,
        kula =  kula,
        part = snieg,
        moving = 1,
        partpos = partpos,
        timer = 15,
        position = i,
        actpos = i,
		}
		tinsert(lgs.smallBalls, ball)
	end
end

function lgs:Walk()
    for i,v in lgs.smallBalls do
		 if i~="n" then
		 	if Distance (go(lgs.kajetan,"pos"),  go(v.kula,"pos") )<=8 then
		 	    lgs.koniec_gry = 1
		 		v.moving = nil
		 	    go(v.kula,"stop")
				go(lgs.kajetan,"stop")
	            DesktopOff()
				lgs:Restart()
			end
			 if v.actpos < 10 then
			 	if v.moving then
			         SetPartPos(v.part, go(v.kula,"pos"))
					if Distance(go(v.kula,"pos"),GroundPoint("s"..v.actpos) )<2   then
			        	v.actpos = v.actpos +1
					else
					  	go(v.kula,"move","s"..v.actpos)
					end
			    end
			else
				v.actpos =  1
			end
		end
	end

    for i,v in lgs.BigBalls do
		 if i~="n" then
			if v.actpos < 25 then
				if  v.moving then
					SetPartPos(v.part,  go(v.kula,"pos"))
					if Distance(go(v.kula,"pos"),GroundPoint("p"..v.actpos) )<2   then
						v.actpos = v.actpos +1
					else
						go(v.kula,"move","p"..v.actpos)
					end
	            end
			else
				v.actpos =  v.position
				go(v.kula,"place","kula_start_"..v.position)
				v.moving = 1
			end

			if  Distance (go(lgs.kajetan,"pos"), GroundPoint("p".. v.position ))<10 and not v.moving  then
				v.moving = 1
				StartParticle(v.part)
			end
			if v.moving  then
				if	v.timer <= 0 then
				 	go(v.kula,"setPosY",0)
				else
					v.timer = v.timer -0.7
				end
			end

	 		if go(lgs.kajetan, "pointInside",  go(v.kula,"pos") ) then
				lgs.koniec_gry = 1
				go(lgs.kajetan,"stop")
				go(v.kula,"stop")
				DesktopOff()
				lgs:Restart()
			end
		end
	end

end

			 	if not MapFlag("+gorka1") then
			 	    guiMenuInv:PutItem(guiMenuInv.movingItem)

						CreateTask("Task_Gorka1")

                    return 1
				end
			end

		elseif  event == "help" then

				if param == 1 then
					HudText(Str("hint.sniegowa_gorka_1"))
				elseif param == 2 then
					HudText( Str("hint.sniegowa_gorka_2"))

		elseif event == "over" then

			 if not MapFlag("+gorka1") then
			    gui:MouseText(Str("ice_f_boat.gorka"))

					gui:MouseImg("doSome")
			 	end
				gui:MouseCursor("select")

			 end
		end
	 end

function Area_anims(name, event, param)

	if guiMenuInv.movingItemName ~= "lupa" then
		if event == "over" then
			lgs:ObjectName(param)
		end
		return 1
	end

	if event == "over" then
		lgs:ObjectName(param)

	elseif event == "in" then

           guiMenuInv:ShineOn(0.3)

  	elseif event == "out" then
	    guiMenuInv:ShineOff()

	elseif event == "click" then
		TwinAnimBkg(name, "standard", 1, 1)
		if name == "snieg1" and not MapFlag("+help")  then
            if not FindTask("Task_Help") then
            	SetMapFlag("+help")
	   			CreateTask("Task_Help")
	   			return 1
	   		end
	   	end
	end
end

function lgs:ObjectName(object)
	if object == "snieg" then
		 gui:MouseText(Str("ice_f_boat.gorka"))
    elseif object == "kwiat" then
		 gui:MouseText(Str("ice_f_boat.kwiat"))
    elseif object == "sopel" then
		 gui:MouseText(Str("ice_f_boat.sople"))
	end
end

	if not lgs.koniec_gry then
		lgs:Walk()
	end

	if not MapFlag("+item_lopata_taken") then
		if  Distance( go(lgs.kajetan,"pos"),go(lgs.lopata,"pos"))<30   then
			go(lgs.lopata,"toTake",1)
		end

	end



	if not MapFlag("+item_siec_taken") then
		if Distance( go(lgs.kajetan,"pos"),go(lgs.siec,"pos"))<30   then
			go(lgs.siec,"toTake",1)
		end
	end
end

function Task_HelpEfekt( )
	BeginTask()
 	lgs.promien = 10
	lgs.kat = 0
	lgs.licznik = 0
	local a =   go(lgs.help,"pos" )
	a.y = a.y+1
	local v = {}
	v.x = a.x
	v.y = a.y
	v.z = a.z
    StartParticle(lgs.helpefekt)
    CreatePartEffect("data\\fx\\energy1.apd", go(lgs.help,"pos"), 2 , "data\\bitmap\\fx\\shine_twirl_purple", 2)
	repeat
		if lgs.promien >2 then
	    	lgs.promien = lgs.promien -1
	    end
        lgs.licznik = lgs.licznik+1
		v.x = a.x + sin(lgs.kat) * lgs.promien
		v.z = a.z + cos(lgs.kat) * lgs.promien
		lgs.kat = lgs.kat + 20
		Wait(0.01)
		if random(1,2) >1.5 then
			v.y = 5
		else
			v.y = 1
		end
		SetPartPos(lgs.helpefekt,v)
	until lgs.licznik >60
	StopParticle(lgs.helpefekt)

    RemoveTask()

end

//=======================================================================
// Animacje z lup¹
//=======================================================================

function Area_anims(name, event, param)
	if guiMenuInv.movingItemName ~= "lupa" then
		if event == "over" then
			lgs:ObjectName(param)
		end
		return 1
	end

	if event == "over" then
		lgs:ObjectName(param)
	elseif event == "in" then

           guiMenuInv:ShineOn(0.3)
	elseif event == "out" then
	    guiMenuInv:ShineOff()

	elseif event == "click" then
		TwinAnimBkg(name, "standard", 1, 1)
		if name == "duzy2" and not MapFlag("+help")  then
            if not FindTask("Task_Help") then
            	SetMapFlag("+help")
	   			CreateTask("Task_Help")
	   			return 1
	   		end
	   	end
	end
end

function lgs:ObjectName(object)
	if object == "kwiatek" then
		gui:MouseText(Str("jungle_coast.kwiatek"))
	elseif object == "palma" then
		gui:MouseText(Str("africa_cross.palm"))

	end
end

function lgs:OpenExit(name)
	if Distance(lgs.kajetanPos ,GroundPoint(name.."_point") ) > 30 or FindTask("Task_RozbitekRozmowa") or FindTask("Task_KrokodylOdchodzi") then
		ASObjectOff("exit_"..name)
	else
		ASObjectOn("exit_"..name)
	end
end

function OnLevelUpdate()
    lgs.kajetanPos = go(lgs.kajetan,"pos")
    lgs.rozbitekPos = go(lgs.rozbitek,"pos")
	lgs:OpenExit("creeper")
	lgs:OpenExit("coast")
	lgs:OpenExit("trap")

	if not FindTask("KrokodylSwim") then
		 CreateTask("KrokodylSwim")
	end
	if Distance2D(lgs.punktPos.x,lgs.punktPos.z, lgs.kajetanPos.x, lgs.kajetanPos.z) <= 20 and not Flag("Jungle_koncowka") and  MapFlag("+pierwsze_spotkanie") then
		SetMapFlag("dialog")
	else
		ClearMapFlag("dialog")
	end
 	if Distance2D(lgs.gadkaPos.x,lgs.gadkaPos.z, lgs.kajetanPos.x, lgs.kajetanPos.z) <= 40 and not MapFlag("+pierwsze_spotkanie") then
 	     SetMapFlag("dialog")
 	else
 		ClearMapFlag("dialog")
 	end

	if MapFlag("dialog") then
		if not MapFlag("rozmowa") then
		    SetMapFlag("rozmowa")
            if not  Flag("Jungle_koncowka") then
	            if  not guiMenuInv:IsItem("sloik",1) then
			        if not FindTask("Task_RozbitekRozmowa") then
		            	CreateTask("Task_RozbitekRozmowa")
		            end
				else
					if not FindTask("Task_KrokodylOdchodzi") then
						CreateTask("Task_KrokodylOdchodzi")
					end
				end
			end
		else

		end
	else
        if MapFlag("rozmowa") then
		   ClearMapFlag("rozmowa")

		end
	end


	lgs.counter2 = lgs.counter2 - 1

	if lgs.counter2 <= 0 then
		if random(1,2) ==2 then
			PlaySound("\\birds_enviro.wav", 0)
		else
			PlaySound("\\eagle.wav", 0)
		end
		lgs.counter2 = 30*random(11,18)
	end
end

	lgs.helpshine  = CreatePartEffect("data\\fx\\gwiazdki1.apd", "",-1, "data\\bitmap\\shine", 15)
	StopParticle(lgs.helpshine)
	lgs.helpefekt = CreatePartEffect("data\\fx\\piana3.apd", "",-1, "data\\bitmap\\shine_3_blueb", 0)
	StopParticle(lgs.helpefekt)
elseif not MapFlag("+help_zabrany") and MapFlag("+help") then
	lgs.help= NewObject("zarowka.object3d")
	go(lgs.help, "scale", 1)
	go(lgs.help, "place", "help_stop")
	go(lgs.help, "evOnMouseClick", "OnHelpTake")
	go(lgs.help, "evOnMouseOver", "OnHelpOver")
end


function HelpLeci(item)
	StartParticle(lgs.helpshine)
    go(item, "rotate", 30 )
    go(item,"angUp",random(30 ))
	SetPartPos(lgs.helpshine, go(item,"pos"))
end

function HelpWyladowal(item)
	go(item,"angUp",0)
	go(lgs.help, "evOnMouseClick", "OnHelpTake")
	StopParticle(lgs.helpshine)
	CreateTask("Task_HelpEfekt")
end

function OnHelpTake()
	RemoveTask("Task_HelpEfekt")
	if lgs.helpefekt then
		StopParticle(lgs.helpefekt)
	end
	if not MapFlag("+help_zabrany") then
	    AddHelp()
	    SetMapFlag("+help_zabrany")
    end
    go(lgs.help,"remove")
end

function OnHelpOver(obj)
	gui:MouseText(go(obj,"nameVis"))
   	gui:MouseCursor("select")
   	guiDesktop.mouseDetect = nil
end

function Task_HelpEfekt( )
	BeginTask()
 	lgs.promien = 10
	lgs.kat = 0
	lgs.licznik = 0
	local a =   go(lgs.help,"pos" )
	a.y = a.y+1
	local v = {}
	v.x = a.x
	v.y = a.y
	v.z = a.z
    StartParticle(lgs.helpefekt)
    CreatePartEffect("data\\fx\\energy1.apd", go(lgs.help,"pos"), 2 , "data\\bitmap\\fx\\shine_twirl_purple", 2)
	repeat
		if lgs.promien >2 then
	    	lgs.promien = lgs.promien -1
	    end
        lgs.licznik = lgs.licznik+1
		v.x = a.x + sin(lgs.kat) * lgs.promien
		v.z = a.z + cos(lgs.kat) * lgs.promien
		lgs.kat = lgs.kat + 20
		Wait(0.01)
		if random(1,2) >1.5 then
			v.y = 5
		else
			v.y = 1
		end
		SetPartPos(lgs.helpefekt,v)
	until lgs.licznik >60
	StopParticle(lgs.helpefekt)

    RemoveTask()

end


function Task_Help()
	BeginTask()
	go(lgs.help, "scale",1)
	go(lgs.help, "throwAngle", "help_stop", 70  , 5)

	RemoveTask()
end
//=======================================================================
function OnLevelEntered()
	if not MapFlag("+pierwsze_wejscie") then
		local hud = HudText(Str("Jungle_castaway.speak1") )
		SetMapFlag("+pierwsze_wejscie")
	end
end

function OnLevelRelease()
	RemoveTask("Task_RozbitekRozmowa")
	RemoveTask("Task_KrokodylOdchodzi")
	Task_KrokodylOdchodzi = nil
	Task_RozbitekRozmowa = nil
	Jungle_castaway_OnKrokodylOver = nil
	RemoveTask("Task_HelpEfekt")
    Task_HelpEfekt = nil
    RemoveTask("Task_Help")
    Task_Help = nil
    HelpLeci = nil
    HelpWyladowal = nil
    OnHelpTake = nil
    OnHelpOver = nil
    RemoveTask("KrokodylSwim")
    KrokodylSwim = nil
end

if LastMap("jungle_castaway_hut") then

EnableWater("data\\maps\\preparation_port\\water\\woda_%d.jpg",RGBA(1,1,1,0.15), 12, 0.003, 0.003, 100, 20)

PlaySoundLooped("\\waves1.wav",-1  )
PlayMusic("data\\music\\birds.ogg")
lgs.counter2 = 30*3

lgs.odlamkiLeca = 1
lgs.odlamki = {}

lgs.maxPulapki = 4

for i=1, lgs.maxPulapki do
    local rock = nil
    if random(1,100) >50  then
		 rock = NewObject("ananas.object3d")
	else
		rock = NewObject("banan.object3d")
	end
	 go(rock,"scale",1.5)
	local point = GroundPoint("pulapka"..i)
 	local point2 = GroundPoint("pulapka"..i.."a")
	local pos0 = VectorMid(point, point2)

	pos0.y = pos0.y + 80

	go(rock, "place", pos0)

	go(rock, "rotate", random(0, 360))
	tinsert(lgs.odlamki, {
		obj = rock,
		pos0 = pos0,
		fall = nil,
		group = 4,

	//DesktopOff()

	lgs.bum = nil
end

end

//=======================================================================

//=======================================================================

function lgs:OpenExit(param)
	if Distance(lgs.kajetanPos ,GroundPoint(param.."_point") ) <30 then
		ASObjectOn(param)
	else
		ASObjectOff(param)
	end
end

function OnLevelUpdate()
	lgs.kajetanPos = go(lgs.kajetan,"pos")
	lgs:OpenExit("exit")

	if Flag("Jungle_koncowka") then
		lgs:OpenExit("exit2")
	else
		ASObjectOff("exit2")
	end

	if not lgs.counter or lgs.counter <= 0 then
		PlaySound(random(1,2) == 1 and "\\creak_1.wav" or "\\creak_2.wav", -1,"start_k")
		lgs.counter = 30*random(10,15)
	else
		lgs.counter = lgs.counter - 1
	end
	lgs.counter2 = lgs.counter2 - 1

	if lgs.counter2 <= 0 then
		if random(1,10) > 2 then
			PlaySound("\\birds_enviro.wav", 0)
		else
			PlaySound("\\eagle.wav", 0)
		end
		lgs.counter2 = 30*random(11,18)
	end
	if not MapFlag("zlapany") then
	// spadajace cos
		for i, v in lgs.odlamki do
			if i ~= "n" then
				if not v.fall then
					if lgs.odlamkiLeca and random(1, v.group and 100 or 500) < 30 then
						if not v.group then
							v.group = 1
						else
							v.group = v.group - 1
							if v.group <= 0 then
								v.group = nil
							end
						end
						v.fall = 1
						v.pos = CloneLuaObject(v.pos0)
						v.rotSpeed = random(-35, 35)

						v.fallSpeed = random(-35, -25) / 10
					end

				else
					go(v.obj, "rotate", v.rotSpeed)
					v.pos.y = v.pos.y + v.fallSpeed
					if v.pos.y <= 2 then
						v.fall = nil
						go(v.obj, "place", v.pos0)
					local part = CreatePartEffect("data\\fx\\piana4.apd", v.pos, 1.5, "data\\bitmap\\fx\\pianka", 0.5)

					else
						go(v.obj, "place", v.pos)
						if go(lgs.kajetan, "pointInside", v.pos) then
							lgs.bum = 0
							break
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
		if lgs.bum then
			if lgs.bum > 0 then
				lgs.bum = lgs.bum - frameTime
			else
				go(lgs.kajetan, "stop", 0, 1, 1)
	            SetMapFlag("zlapany")
	            guiDesktop:SetCanJump(0)
	            if not FindTask("Task_bumbum") then
					CreateTask("Task_bumbum")
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function lgs:Restart()
    guiDesktop:SetCanJump(1)
	go(lgs.kajetan, "stop", 0, 1, 1)
	if LastMap("jungle_castaway_hut") then
		go(lgs.kajetan, "place", GroundPoint("exit_point"))
	else
		go(lgs.kajetan, "place", GroundPoint("start_k"))
	end
	go(lgs.kajetan, "rotateToPoint",  "pulapka1" , 1)

    gui.fadeScreen = 0
    ClearMapFlag("zlapany")
    CreateTask("Task_anim")
end

function Task_anim()
	BeginTask()
	guiDesktop.mouseEnabled = nil
	PlaySound("\\railroader-motyl.wav")
	go(lgs.kajetan, "anim", "zawrot", 0, 3)
	local efekt =  CreatePartEffect("data\\fx\\gwiazdki1.apd", "", -1, "data\\bitmap\\fx\\shine_blue", 0)
	local promien = 4
	local kat = 0
 	local a =   go(lgs.kajetan,"pos" )
	local v = {}
	v.x = a.x
	v.y = a.y +15
	v.z = a.z
    StartParticle( efekt)
    lgs.licznik = 0
	repeat
 		promien = promien + 0.02
		v.x = a.x + sin( kat) *  promien
		v.z = a.z + cos( kat) *  promien
		v.y = v.y+random(-3,3)
		kat =  kat + 20
        Wait(0.01)
		SetPartPos( efekt,v)
		v.y = a.y +15


	until promien >5.
	StopParticle(efekt)
    WFAnim(lgs.kajetan)
    CreateTask("Task_Efekt")
    HudText(Str("antek_okrzyki."..random(1,5)))
    go(lgs.kajetan, "anim", "jump_lot", 0, 1)

    WFAnim(lgs.kajetan)
    go(lgs.kajetan, "anim", "jump_end", 0, 1)
    WFAnim(lgs.kajetan)
    guiDesktop.mouseEnabled = 1
   	RemoveTask()
end


function Task_bumbum()
	BeginTask()
	lgs.bum = nil
	PlaySound("\\bum.wav")
	a = go(lgs.kajetan,"pos")
	a.y = a.y+5
    CreatePartEffect("data\\fx\\energy1.apd", a, 2 , "data\\bitmap\\fx\\ufoblysk2", 1)
	HudMsg(Str("upadek.1"), 2, 150, 100, 2)
	Wait(0.2)
	HudMsg(Str("upadek.1"), 2, 450, 100, 2)
	HudMsg(Str("upadek.2"), 2, nil, 300, 2)
	Wait(2)
	SlideShow({}, nil, 0.3, lgs.Restart)

	RemoveTask()
end

if not MapFlag("+bambus_zabrany") and not MapFlag("+bambus_odkryty") then
	lgs.bambus = NewObject("bambus.object3d")
	go(lgs.bambus, "place", "kijek")
	go(lgs.bambus, "toTake", 1)
	go(lgs.bambus, "evOnEndThrow", "BambusWyladowal")
	go(lgs.bambus, "evOnUpdateThrow", "BambusLeci")
	go(lgs.bambus, "scale",0)

	lgs.shineParticle = CreatePartEffect("data\\fx\\gwiazdki1.apd", "",-1, "data\\bitmap\\shine_3", 15)
	StopParticle(lgs.shineParticle)
	lgs.efekt = CreatePartEffect("data\\fx\\moj2_fullcolor.apd", "", -1, "data\\bitmap\\shine_3", 0 )
	StopParticle(lgs.efekt)
elseif not MapFlag("+bambus_zabrany") and MapFlag("+bambus_odkryty") then

	go(lgs.bambus, "scale",1)
	go(lgs.bambus, "evOnTake", "Jungle_OnBambusTake")
end

function Area_anims(name, event, param)
	if guiMenuInv.movingItemName ~= "lupa" then
		if event == "over" then
			lgs:ObjectName(param)
		end
		return 1
	end

	if event == "over" then
		lgs:ObjectName(param)
	elseif event == "in" then

           guiMenuInv:ShineOn(0.1)
	elseif event == "out" then
	    guiMenuInv:ShineOff()

	elseif event == "click" then
		TwinAnimBkg(name, "standard", 1, 1)
		if name == "kwiatek4" and not MapFlag("+bambus_odkryty")then
			CreateTask("Task_Bambus")
		end
	end
end

function lgs:ObjectName(object)
	if object == "kwiatek" then
		gui:MouseText(Str("jungle_coast.kwiatek"))
	elseif object == "kotwica" then
		gui:MouseText(Str("freq.kotwica"))

	end
end

    SetMapFlag("+bambus_zabrany")
	RemoveTask("FireRing_extendet")
	if lgs.efekt then
		StopParticle(lgs.efekt)
	end

end

function Task_Bambus()
	BeginTask()
	Wait(0.2)
	go(lgs.bambus, "scale",1)
	go(lgs.bambus, "throwAngle", "kijek_stop", 40  , 5)
	SetMapFlag("+bambus_odkryty")
	RemoveTask()
end

function BambusLeci(item)
	StartParticle(lgs.shineParticle)
    go(item, "rotate", 30)
	SetPartPos(lgs.shineParticle,  go(item,"pos"))
end

function BambusWyladowal(item)
     go(lgs.bambus, "evOnTake", "Jungle_OnBambusTake")
 	 StopParticle(lgs.shineParticle)
 	 CreateTask("FireRing_extendet")
end

function FireRing_extendet( )
 	BeginTask()
 	lgs.promien = 10
	lgs.kat = 0
	lgs.licznik = 1
	local a =   go(lgs.bambus,"pos" )
	local v = {}
	v.x = a.x
	v.y = a.y
	v.z = a.z
    StartParticle(lgs.efekt)
	lgs.licznik = lgs.licznik -0.01

 	repeat
 		lgs.promien = lgs.promien - 0.05
		v.x = a.x + sin(lgs.kat) * lgs.promien
		v.z = a.z + cos(lgs.kat) * lgs.promien
		lgs.kat = lgs.kat + 30
		Wait(0.01)
			SetPartPos(lgs.efekt,v)
	until lgs.promien <0
		StopParticle(lgs.efekt)

	RemoveTask()

 end

	end


	function lgs:SetMalpa(nr)

		go(lgs.malpa, "rotateToPoint", lgs["p1_"..lgs.malpaPos], 1)
		lgs.malpaPrzechodzi = nil
		lgs.malpaLapie = nil
	end

	function lgs:PgrubienieMalpy()
		local nr = MapFlag("+malpaNr")
		if nr < 3 then
			nr = nr + 1
			SetMapFlag("+malpaNr", nr)
			lgs:SetMalpa(nr)
			return nr
		end
	end

	lgs:SetMalpa(MapFlag("+malpaNr"))
end
function lgs:MalpaZjadla()
	lgs.malpaLapie = nil
	lgs.malpaZjadlaWMiejscu = lgs.malpaZjadlaWMiejscu + 1
	lgs.malpaZjadlaOstatnio = currentTime
	SetMapFlag("+malpaZjadla", MapFlag("+malpaZjadla") + 1)
	if MapFlag("+malpaZjadla") + 0.5 > lgs.malpaZje then
		if lgs:PgrubienieMalpy() then
			SetMapFlag("+malpaZjadla", 0)
		else
			//ga³¹ siê urywa
			lgs:MalpaSpada()
		end
	end
end


lgs.aktor = ImpActor("kajetan")
//go(lgs.aktor, "attachModel", "data\\models\\orzech.mdl", "reka bone", "reka1", nil, "orzech")

function lgs:SetAktor(pos)

	go(lgs.aktor, "place", lgs["p1_"..lgs.aktorPos])

end

end

else

end


function lgs:ZmienKierunekLotu()
	if lgs.ptakDest == lgs.p2 then
		lgs.ptakDest = lgs.p1
	else
		lgs.ptakDest = lgs.p2
	end
	go(lgs.ptak, "move", lgs.ptakDest)
end

function Task_Ptak()
	BeginTask()
	repeat
		lgs:ZmienKierunekLotu()
		WFWalkTo(lgs.ptak)
	until not lgs.ptakLata
	RemoveTask()
end

function lgs:StartPtak(notReveal)
	if not notReveal then
		Reveal(lgs.ptak)
	end
	go(lgs.ptak, "place", lgs.p1)
	go(lgs.ptak, "rotateToPoint", lgs.p2, 1)
	lgs.ptakDest = lgs.p1
	lgs.ptakLata = 1
	CreateTask("Task_Ptak")
end


function lgs:StopPtak()
	local ptak = Actor(lgs.ptak)
	if not ptak then
		return
	end
	RemoveTask("Task_Ptak")
	go(ptak, "stop", 1)
	go(ptak, "hide")
end

lgs.ptak = NewObject("papuga.actor")
lgs:StopPtak()
//lgs:StartPtak(1)

function Jungle_creeper_OnOrzechRemove(obj)
   	if lgs.orzeszkiCount < 0.1 and not lgs.stopGameTime then
		lgs.stopGameTime = 3
		HudMsg(lgs.noNutsTxt, lgs.stopGameTime, nil, ScreenHeight() * 0.5 - 50)
	end
end


function Jungle_creeper_OnEndThrow(obj)
	go(obj, "remove")
end


function lgs:Skorupki()
	local pos = go(lgs.ptak, "bonePos", "dziub_1")
	for i = 1, 3 do
		CreatePartEffect("data\\fx\\skorupki.apd", pos, 1, "data\\bitmap\\fx\\skorupka_"..i)
	end
end

function Jungle_creeper_OnUpdateThrow(obj)
	if not lgs.game then
		return
	end

	local pos = go(obj, "pos")
	local orzech = lgs.orzechy[obj]
	local doMalpy = Distance2D(lgs["p2_"..lgs.malpaPos], pos)

	if orzech and orzech.pos == lgs.malpaPos then
		lgs.malpaNaTrasieOrzecha = 1
	end

	local ptakPos = go(lgs.ptak, "boxMiddle")
	if doMalpy < 40 and Distance(ptakPos, pos) < 20 then
		local obrot
		if abs(AngleDist(DirToAngle(ptakPos, pos), DirToAngle(ptakPos, lgs.ptakDest))) > 90 then
			lgs:ZmienKierunekLotu()
			obrot = 1
		end
		go(lgs.ptak, "rotateToPoint", pos, not obrot)
		go(lgs.ptak, "resetQueue")
		go(lgs.ptak, "qAnim", "attack", 0.1, 1, 1.7, 0)
		go(lgs.ptak, "qDelay", 0.1)
		go(lgs.ptak, "qScript", "lgs:Skorupki()")
		go(lgs.ptak, "qWaitAnim")
		go(lgs.ptak, "qScript", "go("..lgs.ptak..", 'rotateToPoint', "..VecToStr(lgs.ptakDest)..")")
		go(lgs.ptak, "qAnim", "walk", 0.2, -1)
		go(obj, "remove")
		return
	end

	if lgs.malpaLapie then
		return
	end
	if orzech and lgs.malpaPos == orzech.pos and doMalpy < 8 then
		if lgs.malpaPrzechodzi then
			if Distance2D(lgs["p2_"..lgs.malpaPos], go(lgs.malpa, "pos")) < 5 then
				go(lgs.malpa, "place", lgs["p2_"..lgs.malpaPos])
				go(lgs.malpa, "rotateToPoint", lgs["p1_"..lgs.malpaPos])
				lgs.malpaPrzechodzi = nil
				lgs.malpaZjadlaWMiejscu = 0
			else
				return
			end
		end
		lgs.malpaLapie = 1
		go(obj, "remove")
		go(lgs.malpa, "stop")
		go(lgs.malpa, "qAnim", "eat", 0.01, 1, 2)
		go(lgs.malpa, "qAnim", "idle", 0.2, -1)
		go(lgs.malpa, "qScript", "lgs:MalpaZjadla()")
	end
end


lgs.orzechy = {}

function lgs:Rzut()
	if lgs.orzeszkiCount < 0.1 then
		return
	end
  	lgs.orzeszkiCount = lgs.orzeszkiCount - 1
	//if lgs.orzeszkiCount < 0.1 then
		go(lgs.aktor, "hideAttachedModel", "orzech")
	//end
    local obj = NewObject("orzech.object3d")
    local pos = go(lgs.aktor, "bonePos", "r_p_5")   //CloneLuaObject(lgs["p1_"..lgs.aktorPos])
    //local pos = CloneLuaObject(lgs["p1_"..lgs.aktorPos])
    go(obj, "place", pos)
 	go(obj, "throwAngle", lgs["p3_"..lgs.aktorPos], 65, 6)
    go(obj, "anim", "turn", 0, -1)
   	go(obj, "evOnEndThrow", "Jungle_creeper_OnEndThrow")
  	go(obj, "evOnUpdateThrow", "Jungle_creeper_OnUpdateThrow")
  	go(obj, "evOnRemove", "Jungle_creeper_OnOrzechRemove")
    lgs.orzechy[obj] = {obj = obj, pos = lgs.aktorPos}
end

function lgs:EndRzut()
	lgs.rzut = nil
	if lgs.orzeszkiCount > 0.1 then
		go(lgs.aktor, "revealAttachedModel", "orzech")
	end
end

function lgs:KbdUpdate()
	if KbdStruck("left") then
		if lgs.aktorPos > 1 then
			lgs.aktorPos = lgs.aktorPos - 1
			go(lgs.aktor, "place", lgs["p1_"..lgs.aktorPos])
		end

	elseif KbdStruck("right") then
		if lgs.aktorPos < 4 then
			lgs.aktorPos = lgs.aktorPos + 1
			go(lgs.aktor, "place", lgs["p1_"..lgs.aktorPos])
		end

	elseif not lgs.rzut and KbdStruck("space") and lgs.orzeszkiCount > 0.1 then
		lgs.rzut = 1
        go(lgs.aktor, "resetQueue")
        go(lgs.aktor, "qAnim", "throw", 0, 1, 1, 0)
	    local ident = GetIdent()
	    if ident == "girl" then
        	go(lgs.aktor, "qDelay", 0.25)
   		else
        	go(lgs.aktor, "qDelay", 0.34)
   		end
        go(lgs.aktor, "qScript", "lgs:Rzut()")
        go(lgs.aktor, "qWaitAnim")
        go(lgs.aktor, "qAnim", "idle", 0.1, -1)
        go(lgs.aktor, "qScript", "lgs:EndRzut()")
        //go(lgs.aktor, "qScript", "lgs.rzut = nil")
	end
end


function Task_MalpaObrot()
	BeginTask()
	go(lgs.malpa, "rotateToPoint", lgs["p1_"..lgs.malpaPos])
	WFRotate(lgs.malpa)
	lgs.malpaPrzechodzi = nil
	RemoveTask()
end


function lgs:MalpaUpdate()
    if lgs.malpaLapie or lgs.malpaPrzechodzi then
		return
	end
    if random(0, lgs.malpaMobilnosc) < 1 and (lgs.malpaZjadlaWMiejscu > 3 or (currentTime - lgs.malpaZjadlaOstatnio > 1.5 and not lgs.malpaNaTrasieOrzecha) or (currentTime - lgs.malpaZjadlaOstatnio > 2.5)) then
    	local newPos
    	if lgs.malpaPos == 1 then
    		newPos = 2
    	elseif lgs.malpaPos == 4 then
    		newPos = 3
    	else
    		newPos = (random(1, 2) == 1) and lgs.malpaPos - 1 or lgs.malpaPos + 1
    	end
    	lgs.malpaPrzechodzi = 1
    	go(lgs.malpa, "resetQueue")
    	go(lgs.malpa, "qWalk", lgs["p2_"..newPos])
    	go(lgs.malpa, "qScript", "CreateTask('Task_MalpaObrot')")
    	go(lgs.malpa, "qScript", "lgs.malpaZjadlaWMiejscu = 0   lgs.malpaZjadlaOstatnio = currentTime")
    	lgs.malpaPos = newPos
    end
end


function OnLevelUpdate()
	lgs.malpaNaTrasieOrzecha = nil
	if lgs.game then
		gui:MouseCursor("no")
		if lgs.stopGameTime then
			if lgs.stopGameTime > frameTime then
				lgs.stopGameTime = lgs.stopGameTime - frameTime
			else
				lgs:Stop()
			end
		end
		lgs:KbdUpdate()
		lgs:MalpaUpdate()
		if KbdStruck("enter") then
			lgs:Stop()
		end
	end
	//print(Distance2D(go(lgs.ptak, "pos"), lgs.p2_1))
	lgs.counter2 = lgs.counter2 - 1
	if lgs.counter2 <= 0 then
		PlaySound("\\eagle.wav", 0)
		lgs.counter2 = 30*random(11,18)
	end
end


lgs.nutsCountTxt = Str("jungle_creeper.nutsCount")
lgs.noNutsTxt = Str("jungle_creeper.noNuts")

function OnLevelRender()
	if lgs.game then
   		local x0 = 30
   		local y = 10
   		if lgs.orzeszkiCount > 0.1 then
			SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.imageOrzeszki, 0)
			DrawRectangle(Vector(x0, y, 0), 64, 64, RGBA(1,1,1))
			local tw = 68
			SetRenderState("tf1")
   			//local tw = GetTextWidth(gui.fontBigFunny, -8, lgs.nutsCountTxt) * 0.75
			//DrawText(gui.fontBigFunny, Vector(x0, y, 0), 0.75, 0.75, -8, RGBA(1, 1, 1), lgs.nutsCountTxt);
   			DrawText(gui.fontBigFunny, Vector(x0 + tw, y, 0), 0.75, 0.75, -8, RGBA(1, 1, 0.6), lgs.orzeszkiCount);
	   		SetRenderState("tf0")
		end

   		//waga
   		local x0 = 650
   		local y = 10
   		local maxy = 70
        local countMax = 3 * lgs.malpaZje
        local count = (MapFlag("+malpaNr") - 1) * lgs.malpaZje + MapFlag("+malpaZjadla")
		SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.imageSkala, 0)
		DrawRectangle(Vector(x0, y, 0), 64, 128, RGBA(1,1,1))
		SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.imageMalpa, 0)
		DrawRectangle(Vector(x0 - 44, y + 10 + ((countMax - count) / countMax) * maxy, 0), 64, 64, RGBA(1,1,1))
		SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.imageOdwaznik, 0)
		DrawRectangle(Vector(x0 + 43, y + 10 + (count / countMax) * maxy, 0), 64, 64, RGBA(1,1,1))

		SetRenderState("tf1")
		local t = countMax - count
		local w = GetTextWidth(gui.fontBigFunny, -8, t) * 0.33
		DrawText(gui.fontBigFunny, Vector(x0 + 76 - w * 0.5, y + 34 + (count / countMax) * maxy, 0), 0.33, 0.33, -8, RGBA(1, 1, 0.6), t);
   		SetRenderState("tf0")
	end
end


function OnBeforeLevelRelease()
	if Actor(lgs.aktor) then
		go(lgs.aktor, "removeAttachedModel", "orzech")
	end
	RemoveTask("Task_Ptak")
	Task_Ptak = nil
end


function OnLevelRelease()
	RemoveTask("Task_Ptak")

	Jungle_creeper_OnEndThrow = nil
	Jungle_creeper_OnUpdateThrow = nil
	Jungle_creeper_OnStartMove = nil
	Jungle_creeper_OnMalpaOver = nil
	Jungle_creeper_OnMalpaClick = nil
	Jungle_creeper_OnOrzechRemove = nil
	RemoveTask("Task_MalpaObrot")
	Task_MalpaObrot = nil
	RemoveTask("Task_MalpaOut")
	Task_MalpaOut = nil
	RemoveTask("Task_PuszkaSpada")
	Task_PuszkaSpada = nil
	Area_puszka = nil
	RemoveTask("Task_HelpEfekt")
    Task_HelpEfekt = nil
    RemoveTask("Task_Help")
    Task_Help = nil
    HelpLeci = nil
    HelpWyladowal = nil
    OnHelpTake = nil
    OnHelpOver = nil
end


function lgs:StartGame(_orzeszki)

	lgs.stopGameTime = nil
	local orzeszki
	if type(_orzeszki) == "table" and _orzeszki.orzeszki then
		orzeszki = _orzeszki. orzeszki
	end
	if orzeszki then
		PlayMusic("data\\music\\smieci.ogg")
		lgs.orzeszki = orzeszki
		lgs.orzeszkiCount = go(orzeszki, "capacity")
		lgs.game = 1
		lgs:StartPtak()
		lgs:SetAktor(lgs.malpaPos)
		DesktopOff()
		go(lgs.aktor, "revealAttachedModel", "orzech")
	end
end


function lgs:StopGame()
	if lgs.orzeszkiCount > 0.1 and not Flag("JUNGLE_CREEPER_MALPA_SPADLA") then
		go(lgs.orzeszki, "capacity", lgs.orzeszkiCount)
	else
		guiMenuInv:RemoveItem(lgs.orzeszki)
	end
	lgs.stopGameTime = nil
	lgs.game = nil
	go(lgs.aktor, "hideAttachedModel", "orzech")
	lgs:StopPtak()
	StopMusic("data\\music\\smieci.ogg")
	DesktopOn()
end


function lgs:Start(orzeszki)
		SlideShow({"data\\bitmap\\info4.tga"}, 3600, 0.7, lgs.StartGame, nil, {orzeszki = orzeszki}, {{rect = Rect(190, 163, 636, 489), text = Str("info4_start"),fontSize=0.45,fontSpace=-7,lineSpace=-4 }})
	--SlideShow({}, 3600, 0.8, lgs.StartGame, nil, {orzeszki = orzeszki})
end


function lgs:Stop()
	SlideShow({}, nil, 0.8, lgs.StopGame)
end

function Jungle_creeper_OnStartMove(obj)
	go(obj, "anim", "upadek")
end

function Task_MalpaOut()
	BeginTask()
	go(lgs.malpa, "move", "malpaOut", 0.4)
	WFMoveTo(lgs.malpa)
	go(lgs.malpa, "remove")
	lgs:Stop()
	RemoveTask()
end

function Task_PuszkaSpada()
	BeginTask()
	TwinAnimBkg("drzewo", "fall", 0, 0)
    PlaySound("\\szelest.wav")
	pos = go(lgs.puszka, "pos")
	local y = lgs["p1_1"].y + 10
	local d = 5
	while abs(y - pos.y) > d do
		pos.y = pos.y - d
		go(lgs.puszka, "place", pos, 1)
		NextTask()
	end
	pos.y = y
	go(lgs.puszka, "place", pos, 1)
	SetMapFlag("+PUSZKA_SPADLA")
	ASObjectOn("area_puszka")
	PlaySound("models\\obrona.wav")
	SaveGame()
	RemoveTask()
end

function lgs:MalpaSpada()
	guiMenuInv:GameAvailable(1, 1)
	SetFlag("JUNGLE_CREEPER_MALPA_SPADLA")

	lgs.stopGameTime = nil
	lgs.game = nil
	local pos = CloneLuaObject(lgs["p2_"..lgs.malpaPos])
	pos.y = lgs["p1_"..lgs.malpaPos].y
	go(lgs.malpa, "stop")
   	go(lgs.malpa, "evOnStartMoving", "Jungle_creeper_OnStartMove", 1)
   	local ws = go(lgs.malpa, "walkSpeed")
	go(lgs.malpa, "walkSpeed", 5)

	CreateTask("Task_PuszkaSpada")

	go(lgs.malpa, "qMove", pos)
	go(lgs.malpa, "qScript", "go(lgs.malpa, 'walkSpeed', "..(ws + 0.3)..")")
	go(lgs.malpa, "qAnim", "upadek2")
	go(lgs.malpa, "qWaitAnim")
	go(lgs.malpa, "qScript", "CreateTask('Task_MalpaOut')")

end


function Jungle_creeper_OnMalpaOver(obj)
	gui:MouseText(go(obj, "nameVis"))
	if guiMenuInv.movingItemName == "orzeszki" then
		gui:MouseCursor("select")
		guiDesktop.update = nil
	end
end


function Jungle_creeper_OnMalpaClick(obj)
	if guiMenuInv.movingItemName == "orzeszki" then
		lgs:Start(guiMenuInv.movingItemName)
	end

	guiDesktop.update = nil
end


function Jungle_creeper_OnPuszkaOver(obj)
	if not guiDesktop.playerControl then
		return
	end
	gui:MouseText(go(obj, "nameVis"))
	if MapFlag("+PUSZKA_SPADLA") then
		gui:MouseCursor("select")
		guiDesktop.update = nil
	end
end


function Jungle_creeper_OnPuszkaClick(obj)
	if not MapFlag("+PUSZKA_SPADLA") or not guiDesktop.playerControl then
		return
	end
	if guiMenuInv:CanGetItem() then
		go(obj, "remove")
		guiMenuInv:GetItem(NewObject("sloik.object2d"))
		SetMapFlag("+PUSZKA_ZABRANA")
	end
	guiDesktop.update = nil
	guiMenuInv.noDetectMouseClick = 1
end

//=======================================================================
// Animacje z lup¹
//=======================================================================

function Area_anims(name, event, param)
	if guiMenuInv.movingItemName ~= "lupa" then
		if event == "over" then
			lgs:ObjectName(param)
		end
		return 1
	end

	if event == "over" then
		lgs:ObjectName(param)
	elseif event == "in" then

           guiMenuInv:ShineOn(0.3)
	elseif event == "out" then
	    guiMenuInv:ShineOff()

	elseif event == "click" then
		TwinAnimBkg(name, "standard", 1, 1)
		if name == "kwiatek" and not MapFlag("+help")  then
            if not FindTask("Task_Help") then
            	SetMapFlag("+help")
	   			CreateTask("Task_Help")
	   			return 1
	   		end
	   	end
	end
end

// Podpowiedzi
