if not MapFlag("+help_zabrany") and not MapFlag("+help") then
	lgs.help= NewObject("zarowka.object3d")
	go(lgs.help, "place", "help_start")
	go(lgs.help, "evOnEndThrow", "HelpWyladowal")
	go(lgs.help, "evOnUpdateThrow", "HelpLeci")
	go(lgs.help, "scale",0)
    go(lgs.help, "evOnMouseOver", "OnHelpOver")
	lgs.helpshine  = CreatePartEffect("data\\fx\\gwiazdki1.apd", "",-1, "data\\bitmap\\shine", 15)
	StopParticle(lgs.helpshine)
	lgs.helpefekt = CreatePartEffect("data\\fx\\piana3.apd", "",-1, "data\\bitmap\\shine_3_blueb", 0)
	StopParticle(lgs.helpefekt)
elseif not MapFlag("+help_zabrany") and MapFlag("+help") then
	lgs.help= NewObject("zarowka.object3d")
	go(lgs.help, "scale", 1)
	go(lgs.help, "place", "help_stop")
	go(lgs.help, "evOnMouseClick", "OnHelpTake")
	go(lgs.help, "evOnMouseOver", "OnHelpOver")
end


function HelpLeci(item)
	StartParticle(lgs.helpshine)
    go(item, "rotate", 30 )
    go(item,"angUp",random(30 ))
	SetPartPos(lgs.helpshine, go(item,"pos"))
end

function HelpWyladowal(item)
	go(item,"angUp",0)
	go(lgs.help, "evOnMouseClick", "OnHelpTake")
	StopParticle(lgs.helpshine)
	CreateTask("Task_HelpEfekt")
end

function OnHelpTake()
	RemoveTask("Task_HelpEfekt")
	if lgs.helpefekt then
		StopParticle(lgs.helpefekt)
	end
	if not MapFlag("+help_zabrany") then
	    AddHelp()
	    SetMapFlag("+help_zabrany")
    end
    go(lgs.help,"remove")
end

function OnHelpOver(obj)
	gui:MouseText(go(obj,"nameVis"))
   	gui:MouseCursor("select")
   	guiDesktop.mouseDetect = nil
end

function Task_HelpEfekt( )
	BeginTask()
 	lgs.promien = 10
	lgs.kat = 0
	lgs.licznik = 0
	local a =   go(lgs.help,"pos" )
	a.y = a.y+1
	local v = {}
	v.x = a.x
	v.y = a.y
	v.z = a.z
    StartParticle(lgs.helpefekt)
    CreatePartEffect("data\\fx\\energy1.apd", go(lgs.help,"pos"), 2 , "data\\bitmap\\fx\\shine_twirl_purple", 2)
	repeat
		if lgs.promien >2 then
	    	lgs.promien = lgs.promien -1
	    end
        lgs.licznik = lgs.licznik+1
		v.x = a.x + sin(lgs.kat) * lgs.promien
		v.z = a.z + cos(lgs.kat) * lgs.promien
		lgs.kat = lgs.kat + 20
		Wait(0.01)
		if random(1,2) >1.5 then
			v.y = 5
		else
			v.y = 1
		end
		SetPartPos(lgs.helpefekt,v)
	until lgs.licznik >60
	StopParticle(lgs.helpefekt)

    RemoveTask()

end


function Task_Help()
	BeginTask()
	go(lgs.help, "scale",1)
	go(lgs.help, "throwAngle", "help_stop", 70  , 5)

	RemoveTask()
end
//=======================================================================
function lgs:ObjectName(object)
	if object == "kwiatek" then
		gui:MouseText(Str("jungle_coast.kwiatek"))
	end
end
function OnLevelChanged()
	CameraNow(lgs.aktor)
end

MarkArea(0)
 /*#############################################################################

SEA

#############################################################################*/

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
ZMIENNE
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
lgs.koniec = nil
lgs.posp2 = GroundPoint("p2")
lgs.speed = 0
lgs.shipCount = 3
lgs.hits = 0
lgs.damage  = 0
lgs.angle = 0
lgs.maxX = BkgBitmapWidth() - 20
lgs.maxY = BkgBitmapHeight() - 20
lgs.spr_statek = CreateSprite("data\\bitmap\\kuter_icon_2")

lgs.spr_speed1 = CreateSprite("data\\maps\\sea\\speed\\speed_1")
lgs.spr_speed2 = CreateSprite("data\\maps\\sea\\speed\\speed_2")
lgs.spr_speed3 = CreateSprite("data\\maps\\sea\\speed\\speed_3")
lgs.spr_speed4 = CreateSprite("data\\maps\\sea\\speed\\speed_4")

lgs.spr_damage1 = CreateSprite("data\\maps\\sea\\speed\\kuterdamage_1")
lgs.spr_damage2 = CreateSprite("data\\maps\\sea\\speed\\kuterdamage_2")
lgs.spr_damage3 = CreateSprite("data\\maps\\sea\\speed\\kuterdamage_3")
lgs.spr_damage4 = CreateSprite("data\\maps\\sea\\speed\\kuterdamage_4")

lgs.spr_hit1 = CreateSprite("data\\maps\\sea\\speed\\kuterhit_1")
lgs.spr_hit2 = CreateSprite("data\\maps\\sea\\speed\\kuterhit_2")
lgs.spr_hit3 = CreateSprite("data\\maps\\sea\\speed\\kuterhit_3")
lgs.spr_hit4 = CreateSprite("data\\maps\\sea\\speed\\kuterhit_4")

lgs.spr_kuterek = CreateSprite("data\\maps\\sea\\speed\\kuterek")

lgs.spr_strzalka = CreateSprite("data\\bitmap\\side_arrow_2")

lgs.angB = {0, 120, 200, 160, 60, 320, 270, 45, 135, 210, 90, 350, 180, 100, 295}
lgs.angS = {0, 120, 200, 160, 60, 320, 270, 45, 135, 210, 90, 350, 180, 100, 295}

lgs.endGame = nil

/*#############################################################################

FUNKCJE i Taski

#############################################################################*/

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Funkcja do tworzenia obiektow
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function lgs:TworzObiekty(nazwa, rodzaj, miejsce, tablica, ilosc, wysokosc, xstep, ystep, alfa, tabAngle)
	for i = 1 , ilosc do
	    local nazwa_loc = nazwa
		nazwa_loc = NewObject(rodzaj)
		local pos = GroundPoint(miejsce.."_"..i)
		go(nazwa_loc,"place",pos)
		go(nazwa_loc, "setPosY", wysokosc)

		if nazwa ~= "wiatr" then
			if tabAngle and getn(tabAngle) >= i then
				go(nazwa_loc, "rotate", tabAngle[i])
			else
				go(nazwa_loc, "rotate", random(1,180))
			end
		end
		if nazwa == "chmura" then
			go(nazwa_loc, "anim", "idle1", 1, -1)
		end
		if nazwa == "wiatr" then
			go(nazwa_loc, "rotate",90)
			go(nazwa_loc, "anim", "idle", 1, -1)
		end
  		if alfa  then
 			go(nazwa_loc,"setAlpha",alfa)
 		end
 		//go(nazwa_loc,"anim","idle", 0, -1)
		tinsert(tablica, {coll = nil, id = nazwa_loc, name = nazwa, pos =  pos,xstep = xstep, ystep = ystep})
	end
end

function lgs:ASKolizja(tablica)
	if lgs.lastCollisionTime and currentTime - lgs.lastCollisionTime < 0.6 then
		return
	end

	for i = 1, getn(tablica) do
		local name = "area_"..tablica[i].name.."_"..i
		//print(name)

		if ASIsInside(name, lgs.shipPosDziob2D.x, lgs.shipPosDziob2D.y) or ASIsInside(name, lgs.shipPos2D.x, lgs.shipPos2D.y) then
			if not tablica[i].coll then
				lgs.lastCollisionTime = currentTime
			    go(lgs.statek, "anim", "hit", 0 , 1)
				tablica[i].coll = 1
				lgs:Punkty()
                PlaySound("\\models\\car_hit_1.wav")
				go(lgs.statek, "brakingTo", 1)
				go(lgs.statek,"rotate",180)
				go(lgs.statek, "goForward")
				break
			end

		else
			tablica[i].coll = nil
		end
	end

end

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Funkcja wiatru
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

function lgs:Wiatr()
    if lgs.lastCollisionTime and currentTime - lgs.lastCollisionTime < 0.6 then
		return
	end
	for i, v in lgs.listWiatr do
		if i ~= "n" then
		   if Distance(v.pos, lgs.shipPos) < 30 then
		       if not v.coll then
			        lgs.lastCollisionTime = currentTime
					v.coll = 1
					lgs.speed = lgs.speed +1
					go(lgs.statek,"brakingTo",lgs.speed)

				else

				end
			else
				if v.coll == 1 then
					PlaySound("\\cross2-iglak.wav")
					go(lgs.statek, "anim", "speed",0,1 )
					v.coll = nil
				else

				end

			end
		end
	end
end

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Funkcja chmury
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function lgs:Chmury()

	for i, v in lgs.listChmury do
		if i ~= "n" then
			// Odwrócenie kierunku w momencie osi¹gniêcia lewej lub prawej krawêdzi
			if v.pos.x > lgs.posp2.x or v.pos.x < 30 then
				v.xstep = - v.xstep;
			end
            // Samo przesuniêcie obiektu
			v.pos.x = v.pos.x + v.xstep;
			go(v.id,"place",v.pos)
			go(v.id, "rotate",1)
			//Kolizja
			if Distance(v.pos, lgs.shipPos) < 20  then
			    if lgs.lastCollisionTime and currentTime - lgs.lastCollisionTime < 1 then
						return
				end
				if not v.coll then

				    lgs.lastCollisionTime = currentTime
					v.coll = 1
					lgs:Punkty()
					go(lgs.statek,"pos",v.pos)
					if not FindTask("Task_Chmura") then
						CreateTask("Task_Chmura")
					end
				else

				end
			else
   				//przestalismy kolidowac (dzwiek, task)
				if v.coll == 1 then
				    v.coll = nil
				else

				end
			end
        end
	end
end
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Funkcja badajaca czy dotarlismy do brzegu
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function lgs:Brzeg()
	if MapFlag("gra") then
		if  lgs.shipPos.z < 80 then
		    if not lgs.koniec then
				 lgs.koniec = 1
				ClearMapFlag("gra")
    			lgs.hits = 0
  			    go(lgs.statek,"brakingTo",0)
  			    lgs.speed = 0
  				lgs.endGame = 2.5
		    else

			end
		else
			if lgs.koniec == 1 then
			    lgs.koniec = nil
			else

			end

		end
	end
end

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Funkcja odpowiedzialna za punkty
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function lgs:Punkty()

	lgs.damage = lgs.damage+1

	if lgs.damage >2 then
		lgs.hits =lgs.hits +1

	end

	if lgs.hits ==  3 then
		CreateTask("Task_KoniecGry")
	end

    if lgs.damage ==  3   then
        if lgs.hits ~= 3 then
			HudMsg(Str("sea2"),2, nil,300 )
		end
		lgs.damage = 0
	else
		if lgs.hits ~= 3   then
			HudMsg(Str("sea3") , 2,nil,250)
		end
	end
	lgs.speed = 1
	go(lgs.statek,"brakingTo",lgs.speed)

end

function lgs:Kierunek()
   lgs.angle = go(lgs.statek,"angle")

	if  (lgs.angle > 0 and lgs.angle< 90) or (lgs.angle< -180 and lgs.angle >-270) then
		if not MapFlag("zly_kierunek")then
		    SetMapFlag("zly_kierunek")

		else

		end
	else
		if MapFlag("zly_kierunek") then
			ClearMapFlag("zly_kierunek")
		else

		end

	end

end

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
Task chmury
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function Task_Chmura()
	BeginTask()
	PlaySound("\\piorun_6.wav")

function OnLevelRender()
	if MapFlag("gra") then
		//  Wyswietlanie ikon (statki gracza)
		if lgs.hits == 0 then
		    SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_hit1, 0)
		elseif lgs.hits ==1 then
			SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_hit2, 0)
		elseif lgs.hits ==2 then
			SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_hit3, 0)
		elseif lgs.hits ==3  then
			SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_hit4, 0)
		end
		DrawRectangle(Vector(590 ,5, 0), 128, 64, RGBA(1,1,1,1))

		if lgs.speed >1 then
		    local prwdp = random(1,10)
		    if prwdp > 8 then
		    	SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_speed3,0)
		    else
		    	SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_speed4,0)
			end
		else
			local prwdp = random(1,10)
		    if prwdp > 8 then
		    	SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_speed1,0)
		    else
		    	SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_speed2,0)
			end
		end
		DrawRectangle(Vector(ScreenWidth()/2 -150, 5 , 0),256, 128, RGBA(1,1,1,1))

		if lgs.damage == 0  then
			SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_damage1,0)
		elseif lgs.damage == 1 then
			SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_damage2,0)
		elseif lgs.damage == 2 then
			SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_damage3,0)
		end
		DrawRectangle(Vector(30, 5 , 0),128, 64, RGBA(1,1,1,1))

		//rysowanie postepu
		local bw = 150
		local bh = 16
		local pos = (lgs.maxY - lgs.shipPos2D.y) / lgs.maxY
		SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_kuterek,0)
		DrawRectangle(Vector(ScreenWidth() / 2 - 105 + (bw - bh) * pos, 20 ,0), 32, 32, RGBA(1,1,1,1))

		if MapFlag("zly_kierunek") then
			local alpha = (cos(mod(frameCount, 10) * 360 / 10) + 1) * 0.5
			SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_strzalka,0)
			DrawRectangle(Vector(ScreenWidth() / 2 + 60 , ScreenHeight() / 2 ,0), 128, 32, RGBA(1,1,1,alpha))
		end
	end
end

maps/jungle_sea2/script.lua:
MarkArea(0)
 /*#############################################################################

SEA

#############################################################################*/

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
ZMIENNE
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
lgs.koniec = nil
lgs.posp2 = GroundPoint("p2")
lgs.speed = 0
lgs.shipCount = 3
lgs.hits = 0
lgs.damage  = 0
lgs.angle = 0
lgs.maxX = BkgBitmapWidth() - 20
lgs.maxY = BkgBitmapHeight() - 20
lgs.spr_statek = CreateSprite("data\\bitmap\\kuter_icon_2")

lgs.spr_speed1 = CreateSprite("data\\maps\\sea\\speed\\speed_1")
lgs.spr_speed2 = CreateSprite("data\\maps\\sea\\speed\\speed_2")
lgs.spr_speed3 = CreateSprite("data\\maps\\sea\\speed\\speed_3")
lgs.spr_speed4 = CreateSprite("data\\maps\\sea\\speed\\speed_4")

lgs.spr_damage1 = CreateSprite("data\\maps\\sea\\speed\\kuterdamage_1")
lgs.spr_damage2 = CreateSprite("data\\maps\\sea\\speed\\kuterdamage_2")
lgs.spr_damage3 = CreateSprite("data\\maps\\sea\\speed\\kuterdamage_3")
lgs.spr_damage4 = CreateSprite("data\\maps\\sea\\speed\\kuterdamage_4")

lgs.spr_hit1 = CreateSprite("data\\maps\\sea\\speed\\kuterhit_1")
lgs.spr_hit2 = CreateSprite("data\\maps\\sea\\speed\\kuterhit_2")
lgs.spr_hit3 = CreateSprite("data\\maps\\sea\\speed\\kuterhit_3")
lgs.spr_hit4 = CreateSprite("data\\maps\\sea\\speed\\kuterhit_4")

lgs.spr_kuterek = CreateSprite("data\\maps\\sea\\speed\\kuterek")

lgs.spr_strzalka = CreateSprite("data\\bitmap\\side_arrow_2")

 lgs.angB = {0, 120, 200, 160, 60, 320, 270, 45, 135, 210, 90, 350, 180, 100, 295}
 lgs.angS = {0, 120, 200, 160, 60, 320, 270, 45, 135, 210, 90, 350, 180, 100, 295}

lgs.endGame = nil

/*#############################################################################

FUNKCJE i Taski

#############################################################################*/

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Funkcja do tworzenia obiektow
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function lgs:TworzObiekty(nazwa, rodzaj, miejsce, tablica, ilosc, wysokosc, xstep, ystep, alfa, tabAngle)
	for i = 1 , ilosc do
	    local nazwa_loc = nazwa
		nazwa_loc = NewObject(rodzaj)
		local pos = GroundPoint(miejsce.."_"..i)
		go(nazwa_loc,"place",pos)
		go(nazwa_loc, "setPosY", wysokosc)

		if nazwa ~= "wiatr" then
			if tabAngle and getn(tabAngle) >= i then
				go(nazwa_loc, "rotate", tabAngle[i])
			else
				go(nazwa_loc, "rotate", random(1,180))
			end
		end
		if nazwa == "wiatr" then
		    go(nazwa_loc, "anim", "idle", 1, -1)
			go(nazwa_loc, "rotate",90)
		end
		if nazwa == "chmura" then
          	go(nazwa_loc, "anim", "idle1", 1, -1)
		end
  		if alfa  then
 			go(nazwa_loc,"setAlpha",alfa)
 		end


		tinsert(tablica, {coll = nil, id = nazwa_loc, name = nazwa, pos =  pos,xstep = xstep, ystep = ystep})
	end
end
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Funkcja kolizji
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

function lgs:ASKolizja(tablica)
	if lgs.lastCollisionTime and currentTime - lgs.lastCollisionTime < 1 then
		return
	end

	for i = 1, getn(tablica) do
		local name = "area_"..tablica[i].name.."_"..i
		//print(name)

		if ASIsInside(name, lgs.shipPosDziob2D.x, lgs.shipPosDziob2D.y) or ASIsInside(name, lgs.shipPos2D.x, lgs.shipPos2D.y) then
			if not tablica[i].coll then
				lgs.lastCollisionTime = currentTime
			    go(lgs.statek, "anim", "hit", 0 , 1)
				tablica[i].coll = 1
				lgs:Punkty()
				PlaySound("\\models\\car_hit_1.wav")
				go(lgs.statek, "brakingTo", 1)
				go(lgs.statek,"rotate",180)
				go(lgs.statek, "goForward")
				break
			end

		else
			tablica[i].coll = nil
		end
	end

end

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Funkcja wiatru
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function lgs:Wiatr()

	for i, v in lgs.listWiatr do
		if i ~= "n" then
			if Distance(v.pos, lgs.shipPos) < 30 then
				if lgs.lastCollisionTime and currentTime - lgs.lastCollisionTime < 1 then
					return
				end
			    if not v.coll then
					lgs.lastCollisionTime = currentTime
					v.coll = 1
					lgs.speed = lgs.speed +1
					go(lgs.statek,"brakingTo",lgs.speed)

				else

				end
			else
				if v.coll == 1 then
					go(lgs.statek, "anim", "speed",0,1 )
					PlaySound("\\cross2-iglak.wav")
				   v.coll = nil
				else

				end
			end
		end
	end
end

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Funkcja chmury
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function lgs:Chmury()

	for i, v in lgs.listChmury do
		if i ~= "n" then
			// Odwrócenie kierunku w momencie osi¹gniêcia lewej lub prawej krawêdzi
			if v.pos.x > lgs.posp2.x or v.pos.x < 0 then
				v.xstep = - v.xstep;
			end
            // Samo przesuniêcie obiektu
			v.pos.x = v.pos.x + v.xstep;
			go(v.id,"place",v.pos)
			go(v.id, "rotate",1)
			//Kolizja
			if Distance(v.pos, lgs.shipPos) < 25  then
				if lgs.lastCollisionTime and currentTime - lgs.lastCollisionTime < 1 then
					return
				end
				if not v.coll then
					lgs.lastCollisionTime = currentTime
					v.coll = 1
					lgs:Punkty()

					go(lgs.statek,"pos",v.pos)
					if not FindTask("Task_Chmura") then
						CreateTask("Task_Chmura")
					end
				else

				end
			else
   				//przestalismy kolidowac (dzwiek, task)
				if v.coll == 1 then
				    v.coll = nil
				else

				end
			end
        end
	end
end
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Funkcja badajaca czy dotarlismy do brzegu
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function lgs:Brzeg()
	if  lgs.shipPos.z < 80 then
	    if not lgs.koniec then
		   lgs.koniec = 1
		    go(lgs.statek,"brakingTo",0)
			ClearMapFlag("gra")
			lgs.hits = 0
			HudMsg(Str("sea1") , 2,nil,300)
			lgs.endGame = 2.5
	    else

		end
	else
		if lgs.koniec == 1 then
		    lgs.koniec = nil
		else

		end
	end
end

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Funkcja odpowiedzialna za punkty
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function lgs:Punkty()
   -- HudImg("data\\maps\\sea\\speed\\bum",0.1, 0, ScreenHeight() -80, 1, 1,80)
	lgs.damage = lgs.damage+1

	if lgs.damage >2 then
		lgs.hits =lgs.hits +1

	end

	if lgs.hits ==  3 then
		CreateTask("Task_KoniecGry")
	end

    if lgs.damage ==  3   then
        if lgs.hits ~= 3 then
			HudMsg(Str("sea2"), 2,nil,300)
		end
		lgs.damage = 0
	else
		if lgs.hits ~= 3   then
			HudMsg(Str("sea3") , 2,nil,250)
		end
	end
	lgs.speed = 1
	go(lgs.statek,"brakingTo",lgs.speed)

end
function lgs:Kierunek()
   lgs.angle = go(lgs.statek,"angle")

	if  (lgs.angle > 0 and lgs.angle< 90) or (lgs.angle< -180 and lgs.angle >-270) then
		if not MapFlag("zly_kierunek")then
		    SetMapFlag("zly_kierunek")

		else

		end
	else
		if MapFlag("zly_kierunek") then
			ClearMapFlag("zly_kierunek")
		else

		end

	end

end

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
Task chmury
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function Task_Chmura()
	BeginTask()
	PlaySound("\\piorun_6.wav")
	go(lgs.statek,"setSpeed", 0)
	go(lgs.statek, "setPosY", -5)
	Wait(1)
	go(lgs.statek, "setPosY", 5)
	go(lgs.statek,"setSpeed", 1)

	RemoveTask()
end

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
Task Rozpoczynajacy gre
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function Task_Wstep()
	BeginTask()
	Wait(2)
	HudMsg(Str("sea_count_3"), 1, nil, 300)
	Wait(1)
	HudMsg(Str("sea_count_2"), 1, nil, 300)
	Wait(1)
	HudMsg(Str("sea_count_1"), 1, nil, 300)
	Wait(1)
	HudMsg(Str("sea_count_start"), 1, nil, 300)
	Wait(1)
    //Drive(lgs.statek, 1)
    SetMapFlag("gra")
    PlayMusic("data\\music\\pipe.ogg")
	go(lgs.statek, "brakingTo", 1)
    lgs.speed = 1
	RemoveTask()
end
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
Task konczacy  gre w przypadku utraty wszystkich statków
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function Task_KoniecGry()
  	BeginTask()
	ClearMapFlag("gra")
	FadeOutMusic()
	lgs.hits = 0
	lgs.damage = 0
	HudMsg(Str("sea4"), 2,nil,350)
	Wait(2)
	go(lgs.statek, "place","boat")
	go(lgs.statek, "rotateToPoint", "boat_look",1)
	go(lgs.statek, "setSpeed",0)
	CreateTask("Task_Wstep")
	RemoveTask()
end

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function OnLevelEntered()
	CreateTask("Task_Wstep")
end
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function OnLevelRelease()
    RemoveTask("Task_Chmura")
  	Task_Chmura = nil
    RemoveTask("Task_Wstep")
    Task_Wstep = nil
    RemoveTask("Task_KoniecGry")
  	Task_KoniecGry = nil

end

/*#############################################################################

Tworzenie obiektow

#############################################################################*/
lgs.statek = NewObject("kuter.vehicle")
go(lgs.statek, "setPosY", 5)
go(lgs.statek, "place","boat")
go(lgs.statek, "rotate", 180, 1)
--go(lgs.statek, "rotateToPoint", "boat_look",1)
go(lgs.statek,"anim","idle", 0, -1)
go(lgs.statek, "floatingOn", 0.5, 2, -2 , 1)
Drive(lgs.statek, 1)
CameraNow(lgs.statek)
go(lgs.statek, "setMaxSpeed", 5)
go(lgs.statek,"brakingTo",0)

lgs.listWyspyMale = {}
lgs.listWyspyDuze = {}
lgs.listWiatr = {}
lgs.listChmury = {}

lgs:TworzObiekty("wyspam","wyspamala.object3d","rockm",lgs.listWyspyMale,3,1.4, nil, nil,nil, lgs.angS)
lgs:TworzObiekty("wyspad","wyspaduza.object3d","wyspad",lgs.listWyspyDuze,7,1.9,nil,nil,nil, lgs.angB)
lgs:TworzObiekty("chmura","chmura.object3d","chmura",lgs.listChmury,6,-5,0.3, nil,nil )
lgs:TworzObiekty("wiatr","wiatr.object3d","wind",lgs.listWiatr,1,0, nil, nil,nil)

EnableWater("data\\maps\\sea\\water\\woda_%d.jpg", RGBA(1,1,1,0.6), 13, 0.002, 0.002, 220.0, 0.0)
WaterToZBuffer(0)
PlaySoundLooped("\\waves2.wav",-1  )
/*#############################################################################

WYWIETLANIE NA EKRANIE

#############################################################################*/
function OnLevelRender()
	if MapFlag("gra") then

			//  Wyswietlanie ikon (statki gracza)
		if lgs.hits == 0 then
		    SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_hit1, 0)
		elseif lgs.hits ==1 then
			SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_hit2, 0)
		elseif lgs.hits ==2 then
			SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_hit3, 0)
		elseif lgs.hits ==3  then
			SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_hit4, 0)
		end
		DrawRectangle(Vector(590 ,5, 0), 128, 64, RGBA(1,1,1,1))

		if lgs.speed >1 then
		    local prwdp = random(1,10)
		    if prwdp > 8 then
		    	SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_speed3,0)
		    else
		    	SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_speed4,0)
			end
		else
			local prwdp = random(1,10)
		    if prwdp > 8 then
		    	SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_speed1,0)
		    else
		    	SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_speed2,0)
			end
		end
		DrawRectangle(Vector(ScreenWidth()/2 -150, 5 , 0),256, 128, RGBA(1,1,1,1))

		if lgs.damage == 0  then
			SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_damage1,0)
		elseif lgs.damage == 1 then
			SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_damage2,0)
		elseif lgs.damage == 2 then
			SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_damage3,0)
		end
		DrawRectangle(Vector(30, 5 , 0),128, 64, RGBA(1,1,1,1))

		//rysowanie postepu
		local bw = 150
		local bh = 16
		local pos = (lgs.maxY - lgs.shipPos2D.y) / lgs.maxY
		SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_kuterek,0)
		DrawRectangle(Vector(ScreenWidth() / 2 - 105 + (bw - bh) * pos, 20 ,0), 32, 32, RGBA(1,1,1,1))

		if MapFlag("zly_kierunek") then
			local alpha = (cos(mod(frameCount, 10) * 360 / 10) + 1) * 0.5
			SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_strzalka,0)
			DrawRectangle(Vector(ScreenWidth() / 2 + 60 , ScreenHeight() / 2 ,0), 128, 32, RGBA(1,1,1,alpha))
		end
	end
end

/*#############################################################################

G£ÓWNA PÊTLA

#############################################################################*/
function OnLevelUpdate()
-- /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Pozycja statku
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
  	local pl = go(lgs.statek, "bonePos", "piana_przod_lewo_0")
	local pp = go(lgs.statek, "bonePos", "piana_przod_prawo_0")
  	lgs.shipPosDziob = VectorMid(pl, pp)
  	lgs.shipPosDziob2D = MapWorldToBkg(lgs.shipPosDziob)

	lgs.shipPos = go(lgs.statek, "bonePos", "piana_przod_lewo_1")
  	lgs.shipPos2D = MapWorldToBkg(lgs.shipPos)
-- /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
--  Kolizje
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
  	lgs:ASKolizja(lgs.listWyspyDuze)
  	lgs:ASKolizja(lgs.listWyspyMale)

-- /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- £apanie wiatru
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
  	lgs:Wiatr()

-- /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Chmury
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
  	lgs:Chmury()


-- /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
--  Badamy czy dotarlismy do celu
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
  	lgs:Brzeg()
-- /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
--  Badamy czy p³yniemy w dobr¹ stronê
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
	lgs:Kierunek()

	if lgs.endGame then
		lgs.endGame = lgs.endGame - frameTime
		if lgs.endGame < 0 then
			 ChangeMap("jungle_coast")
		end
	end
end //koniec OnLevelUpdate

function lgs:SetLevel(level, showInfo)
	if level < 0 then
		level = 1
	end
	local _level = level - 1
/*
	lgs.speed = lgs.levels.normalSpeed + lgs.levels.addSpeed * _level
	lgs.delay = max(0.4, lgs.levels.normalDelay + lgs.levels.addDelay * _level)
	lgs.delayPos = max(0.8, lgs.levels.normalDelayPos + lgs.levels.addDelayPos * _level)
	lgs.garbageProbality = min(100, lgs.levels.normalGarbageProbality + lgs.levels.addGarbageProbality * _level)
*/
	lgs.speed = lgs.levels.normalSpeed + lgs.levels.normalSpeed * lgs.levels.addSpeed * (1 - Power(lgs.levels.factorSpeed, _level))

	lgs.delay = lgs.levels.normalDelay + lgs.levels.normalDelay * lgs.levels.addDelay * (1 - Power(lgs.levels.factorDelay, _level))
	lgs.delay = max(lgs.levels.minDelay, lgs.delay)

	lgs.delayPos = lgs.levels.normalDelayPos + lgs.levels.normalDelayPos * lgs.levels.addDelayPos * (1 - Power(lgs.levels.factorDelayPos, _level))
	lgs.delayPos = max(lgs.levels.minDelayPos, lgs.delayPos)

	lgs.garbageProbality = lgs.levels.normalGarbageProbality + lgs.levels.normalGarbageProbality * lgs.levels.addGarbageProbality * (1 - Power(lgs.levels.factorGarbageProbality, _level))

	if showInfo then
		HudMsg(format(Str("msg.levelNo"), level), nil, nil, ScreenHeight() * 0.5)
	end
end

function lgs:NewGame(level)

	if level then

		CreateTask("Task_NewGame")

	else
		lgs.actLevel = nil

		lgs._maxPoints = lgs.maxPoints
		lgs:Restart()
		lgs:SetLevel(1)
		CreateTask("Task_NewGame")
	end


end


function Task_NewGame()
	BeginTask()
	lgs.beforeStart = 1
	local hud = HudMsg(Str("landing_pier.catchGarbages"), 3, nil, 180)
    WFHud(hud)
	hud = HudMsg(Str("landing_pier.useKeys"), nil, nil, 240)
	local hud2 = HudImg("data\\bitmap\\klawiatura", 100, nil, 330)
    WFHud(hud)
    Wait(1.5)
    HudDelete(hud2)
    WFHud(hud2)
    if lgs.actLevel then
    	lgs:StartLevel(lgs.actLevel)
	    Wait(1)
    else
		lgs.game = 1
	end
	lgs.beforeStart = nil
	PlayMusic("data\\music\\pilka.ogg")
	RemoveTask()
end


function OnBeforeLevelRelease()
	if Object3D(lgs.kaj) then
		go(lgs.kaj, "removeAttachedModel", "podbierak")

function OnLevelRelease()
	RemoveTask("Task_NewGame")
	Task_NewGame = nil
	RemoveTask("Task_NewGame2")
	Task_NewGame2 = nil
	RemoveTask("Task_ChangeMap")
	Task_ChangeMap = nil
	guiMenuInv:GameAvailable(5, 1)
end


function OnLevelUpdate()
	if lgs.beforeStart then
		gui:MouseCursor("no")
	end
	if lgs.game or lgs.tut then
		if not lgs.showCursor then
			gui:MouseCursor("no")
		end
		if lgs.goUp or (not lgs.tut and not lgs.endLevel and KbdStruck("up"))  then
			lgs.goUp = nil
			if lgs.pos > 1 then
				lgs.pos = lgs.pos - 1
			end
			go(lgs.kaj, "place", "pos"..lgs.pos)
		end
		if lgs.goDown or (not lgs.tut and not lgs.endLevel and KbdStruck("down")) then
			lgs.goDown = nil
			if lgs.pos < 3 then
				lgs.pos = lgs.pos + 1
			end
			go(lgs.kaj, "place", "pos"..lgs.pos)
		end

		if not go(lgs.kaj,"isAnimating") then
			go(lgs.kaj, "anim", "idlecatch", 0.2, -1)
			lgs.anim = nil
		end

		if (lgs.catch or (not lgs.tut and not lgs.endLevel and KbdStruck("space"))) then
			lgs.catch = nil
			if not lgs.anim then
				//go(lgs.kaj, "resetQueue")
				//go(lgs.kaj, "qAnim", "catch")
				//go(lgs.kaj, "qAnim", "idle", nil, -1)

				go(lgs.kaj, "anim", "catch")
				lgs.anim = 1
				lgs.plusk = 10
			end
		end
		if lgs.plusk then
			lgs.plusk = lgs.plusk - 1
			if lgs.plusk < 0 then
                CreatePartEffect("data\\fx\\piana4.apd", "end"..lgs.pos, 1.5, "data\\bitmap\\fx\\pianka", 0.5)
                lgs.plusk = nil
                PlaySound("models\\valuable_inwater.wav")

				local remove
				for i,v in lgs.path do
					if i ~= "n" then
						if lgs.pos == v.path and v.pos.z < v.posend.z + 8 then
							if not remove or remove.drawnTime - remove.endFloating > v.drawnTime - v.endFloating then
								remove = v
							end
						end
					end
				end

				if remove then
					go(remove.model,"remove")
					lgs.score[remove.type] = lgs.score[remove.type] + 1
					if lgs.points then
						lgs.points = lgs.points + 1
					end
					if getn(lgs.tab) < 0.1 then
						lgs.gamestarted = nil
					end
					RemoveFromList(lgs.path, remove)
				end

			end

		end

		if (lgs.gamestarted or lgs.endGame) and not lgs.gameOver and not lgs.endLevel and currentTime - lgs.lastGarbageTime > lgs.delay and random(1000) < (lgs.endGame and 120 or lgs.garbageProbality) then
			local no = lgs.endGame and random(1, getn(lgs.obj)) or tremove(lgs.tab)
			if not no then
				lgs.gamestarted = nil
			else
				local obj = {}

				local rnd = random(1, (lgs.endGame and 7 or 3))

				if lgs.time[rnd] + lgs.delayPos < currentTime then
					lgs.addSpeed = lgs.addSpeed + 0.5
					obj.model = NewObject(lgs.obj[no]..".object3d")
					obj.type = no
					obj.drawnTime = lgs.objDrawnTime[no]
					lgs.time[rnd] = currentTime
					obj.pos = CloneLuaObject(lgs["start"..rnd])
					obj.posend = CloneLuaObject(lgs["end"..rnd])
					obj.path = rnd
					tinsert(lgs.path, obj)

					//go(obj.model, "floatingOn", 0.5, 4, 4 , 5)
					obj.endFloating = 0
					obj.orygY = obj.pos.y + 3
					obj.sinSpeed = 0

					obj.remove = nil
					obj.time = random(100) * 0.01
					obj.speed = lgs.objspeed[no] * 0.01 * (lgs.endGame and 1.5 or 1) * lgs.speed
					go(obj.model, "place", obj.pos)
					go(obj.model, "scale", 3)

					lgs.lastGarbageTime = currentTime
				elseif not lgs.endGame then
					tinsert(lgs.tab, no)
				end
			end
		end

		for i, v in lgs.path do
			if i ~= "n" then
				local add2 = (sin(v.time * (2 + v.sinSpeed)) + 1) * (1.6 - v.sinSpeed * 0.6)
				v.pos.y = v.orygY - add2
				v.time = v.time + 3
				local move = (v.pos.z > v.posend.z)
				if move then
					local add = v.speed
					v.pos.z = v.pos.z - add
				end
				if not move or lgs.gameOver then
					v.orygY = max(-17, v.orygY - (1 / (v.drawnTime * 5)))
					if not lgs.endGame or v.endFloating > 0 then
						v.endFloating = v.endFloating + frameTime;
						go(v.model, "setAlpha", (v.drawnTime - v.endFloating) / 3)
					end
					v.sinSpeed = min(v.sinSpeed + 0.025, 2)
					if v.endFloating > v.drawnTime then
						go(v.model,"remove")
						tremove(lgs.path, i)

						if not lgs.gameOver and not lgs.endGame and not lgs.endLevel then
							if lgs.actLevel then
								lgs.endLevel = 4.5
							else
								lgs.endGame = 14
							end
							HudMsg(Str("landing_pier.garbageSink"), 3.5, nil, 280)
						end

						//lgs.gameover = 1
						//print("GAME OVER")
						break
					end
				end
				//if not lgs.gameover then
					go(v.model, "place", v.pos)
				//end
			end
		end

		if lgs.endGame then
			if lgs.endGame < 7 and lgs.endGame > 6 then
				lgs.endGame = 6
				HudMsg(Str("landing_pier.portFull"), 5, nil, 280)
			end
			lgs.endGame = lgs.endGame - frameTime
			if lgs.endGame < 0 then
			    FadeOutMusic()
				lgs.endGame = nil
				lgs.gameOver = 1
			end
		end

		if lgs.endLevel then
			if lgs.endLevel < 1 and lgs.endLevel > 0 then
				lgs.endLevel = 0
				hudMessage:Clear()
				//Msg(Str("msg.tryAgain"), Str("msg.youLoose"), {{caption = Str("keyCaption.ok"), key = "enter", func = lgs.NewGame, funcParam = 1}})
				miejsce = AddHighScore(gc_savedGamesDir.."\\game5.hs", lgs.points)
				local score
				if miejsce then
					score = format(Str("msg.scoreOK"), miejsce)
				else
					score = Str("msg.scoreSmall")
				end
				Msg(format(Str("msg.conquerPoints"), lgs.points).."|"..score.."| |"..Str("msg.playOnceMore"), Str("msg.endGame"), {{caption = Str("keyCaption.yes"), key = "enter", func = lgs.NewGame, funcParam = 1}, {caption = Str("keyCaption.no"), key = "esc", func = lgs.StopOut}})
				lgs.showCursor = 1
			end
			lgs.endLevel = lgs.endLevel - frameTime
/*
			if lgs.endGame < 0 then
			    FadeOutMusic()
				lgs.endGame = nil
				lgs.gameOver = 1
			end
*/
		end

		if not lgs.tut and not lgs.gamestarted and not lgs.endGame and not lgs.endLevel and not lgs.gameOver and getn(lgs.path) == 0 then
			if lgs.actLevel then
				lgs:Restart()
				lgs:StartLevel(lgs.actLevel + 1)
				local from = MapFlag("_MINI_GAME")
				if from and from ~= "_OUT" and abs(lgs.actLevel / 5 - floor(lgs.actLevel / 5)) < 0.01 then
                   	AddHelp(1)
				end
			else
				lgs.game = nil
				HudMsg(Str("msg.youWin"), 3, nil, 280)
				lgs:WinGame()
				//print("END")
				lgs.tab = {}
				go(lgs.kaj, "anim", "idlecatch", 0.3, -1)
			end
		end

		if lgs.gameOver and getn(lgs.path) == 0 then
			lgs.game = nil
			go(lgs.kaj, "anim", "idlecatch", 0.3, -1)
			//Msg(Str("msg.playOnceMore"), Str("msg.youLoose"), {{caption = Str("keyCaption.yes"), key = "enter", func = lgs.NewGame}, {caption = Str("keyCaption.no"), key = "esc", func = lgs.StopOut}})
			Msg(Str("msg.tryAgain"), Str("msg.youLoose"), {{caption = Str("keyCaption.ok"), key = "enter", func = lgs.NewGame}})
/*
			if guiMenuInv:IsGameAvailable(5) then
				Msg(Str("msg.playOnceMore"), Str("msg.youLoose"), {{caption = Str("keyCaption.yes"), key = "enter", func = lgs.NewGame}, {caption = Str("keyCaption.no"), key = "esc", func = lgs.StopOut}})
			else
				HudMsg(Str("msg.tryAgain"), 3, nil, 280)
				CreateTask("Task_NewGame2")
			end
*/
		end

	else

/*		if KbdStruck("enter") then
			lgs:NewGame()
		end
*/
	end

end


// F-cja odpalana po przegranej jeli nie chcemy graæ ponownie
function lgs:StopOut()
	local from = MapFlag("_MINI_GAME")
	if from then

FUNKCJE i Taski

#############################################################################*/

//=======================================================================
// Funkcje zwi¹zane z drzwiami
//=======================================================================
function Area_drzwi(name, event)
	if event == "over" then
		gui:MouseText(Str("freq.door"))
	elseif event == "click" then
	     CreateTask("Task_OpenTheDoor")
	end
end

function Task_OpenTheDoor()
    BeginTask()
    TwinAnimBkg("drzwi", "open", 1, 1)
    PlaySound ("\\door_wood_open_closed.wav")
	ASObjectOff("area_drzwi")
	ASObjectOn("drzwi_obszar")
	RemoveTask()
end

//=======================================================================
// Animacje z lup¹
//=======================================================================
function Area_anims(name, event, param)
	if guiMenuInv.movingItemName ~= "lupa" then
		if event == "over" then
			lgs:ObjectName(param)
		end
		return 1
	end
	if event == "over" then
		lgs:ObjectName(param)
	elseif event == "in" then

		guiMenuInv:ShineOn(0.5)
	elseif event == "out" then

		guiMenuInv:ShineOff()
	elseif event == "click" then
		TwinAnimBkg(name, "standard", 1, 1)
	 	return 1
	end
end

function lgs:ObjectName(object)
	if object == "kolo1" then
		gui:MouseText(Str("freq.kolo"))
	elseif object == "kolo2" then
	    gui:MouseText(Str("freq.kolo"))
	elseif object == "szczur" then
	    gui:MouseText(Str("freq.okienko"))
	elseif object == "reling1" then
	    gui:MouseText(Str("freq.reling"))
	elseif object == "reling2" then
	    gui:MouseText(Str("freq.reling"))
	elseif object == "reling3" then
	    gui:MouseText(Str("freq.reling"))
	elseif object == "reling4" then
	    gui:MouseText(Str("freq.reling"))
	end
end

//=======================================================================
// Funkcje zwi¹zane z butelka
//=======================================================================
function Task_Butelka()
	BeginTask()
	guiDesktop.mouseEnabled = nil
	ASObjectOff("drzwi_obszar")
	go(lgs.kajetan,"anim","butelka",0,1)
	Wait(0.8)
	ASObjectOff("area_drzwi")
	local hud = HudText(Str("Open_sea_ship.speak1"))
	go(lgs.kajetan,"anim","butelka",0,1)
	WFHud(hud)
    go(lgs.kapitan,"anim","speaking1",1,-1)
	local hud  = HudText(Str("Open_sea_ship.speak2"))
	WFHud(hud)
	go(lgs.kapitan,"anim","idle",1,-1)
    SetMapFlag("butelka_do_wziecia")
    go(lgs.podbierak,"toTake",1)
    guiDesktop.mouseEnabled = 1
	RemoveTask()
end

function Open_sea_OnBottleOver(obj)
	gui:MouseText(go(obj,"nameVis"))
	if guiMenuInv.movingItemName == "podbierak" then
		gui:MouseCursor("select")
	end
 	guiDesktop.update = nil
end

function Open_sea_OnBottleClick(obj)
	 if MapFlag("butelka_do_wziecia") and guiMenuInv.movingItemName == "podbierak" then

		if not FindTask("Task_ButelkaWzieta") then
			CreateTask("Task_ButelkaWzieta")

		end
	 end
	return 1
end

function Task_ButelkaWzieta()
	BeginTask()
	guiDesktop.mouseEnabled = nil
	EnableTriangle("butelka_jump",1)
	guiMenuInv:PutItem(guiMenuInv.movingItem)
	guiMenuInv:RemoveItem("podbierak")
	go(lgs.kajetan, "walk", "butelka_look" )
	WFWalkTo(lgs.kajetan)
	SetMapFlag("+butelka_wzieta")
	go(lgs.kajetan,"jump",GroundPoint("butelka_jump"))
	Wait(1)
	go(lgs.kajetan, "revealAttachedModel","podbierak")
	go(lgs.kajetan, "anim", "idlecatch", 0, -1)
	Wait(0.5)
	go(lgs.kajetan, "anim", "catch",0,1)
	Wait(0.2)
	CreatePartEffect("data\\fx\\piana4.apd", "butelka", 1.5, "data\\bitmap\\fx\\pianka", 0.5)
	PlaySound("models\\valuable_inwater.wav")
	Wait(0.35)
	go("butelka","remove")
	EnableTriangle("butelka_jump",0)
   	Wait(0.10)
	go(lgs.kajetan, "removeAttachedModel", "podbierak")
	go(lgs.kajetan, "anim", "idle", 0, -1)

	go(lgs.kajetan,"jump",GroundPoint("kajetan_butelka"))
	go(lgs.kajetan,"rotateToPoint",go(lgs.kajetan,"pos"))
	WFRotate(lgs.kajetan)
 	go(lgs.kapitan,"rotateToPoint",go(lgs.kajetan,"pos"))
	local hud = HudText(Str("Open_sea_ship.speak3"))
	WFHud(hud)
	go(lgs.kajetan,"rotateToPoint",go(lgs.kapitan,"pos"))
	WFRotate(lgs.kajetan)
	Wait(0.2)
	go(lgs.kajetan, "revealAttachedModel", "list")
	go(lgs.kajetan,"anim","czyta",0.3,-1)

	local hud = HudText(Str("Open_sea_ship.speak4"))
	WFHud(hud)
    go(lgs.kajetan, "removeAttachedModel", "list")
	go(lgs.kajetan,"anim","idle",0,-1)
	go(lgs.kapitan,"rotateToPoint",go(lgs.kajetan,"pos"))
	go(lgs.kapitan,"anim","speaking2",0.5,-1)
	local hud = HudText(Str("Open_sea_ship.speak5"))
	WFHud(hud)
    guiDesktop.mouseEnabled = 1

 	ChangeMap("jungle_sea2")
 	RemoveTask()
end

//=======================================================================
function OnLevelUpdate()

	if not lgs.counter or lgs.counter <= 0 then
		PlaySound(random(1,2) == 1 and "\\creak_1.wav" or "\\creak_2.wav", -1)
		lgs.counter = 30*random(10,15)
	else
		lgs.counter = lgs.counter - 1
	end

	if not MapFlag("+butelka_wzieta") then
		lgs.zmienna = lgs.zmienna +lgs.angle
		if lgs.butelkaPosTmp.x  > lgs.butelkaPos.x + 14 or lgs.butelkaPosTmp.x < lgs.butelkaPos.x -14 then
				 lgs.step = -  lgs.step;
		end

		if lgs.zmienna  > 30 or lgs.zmienna < -30 then
			lgs.angle = -lgs.angle
        end
		go(lgs.butelka,"place",lgs.butelkaPosTmp)
		go(lgs.butelka,"angUp", lgs.zmienna )
		go(lgs.butelka,"rotate", 1 )
	end
end



function OnLevelRelease()
    RemoveTask("Task_ButelkaWzieta")
    Task_ButelkaWzieta = nil
	Area_drzwi = nil
	Area_klapa = nil
	Area_trap = nil
	Area_anims = nil
	Task_OpenTheCover = nil
	RemoveTask("Task_OpenTheDoor")
	Task_OpenTheDoor = nil
	RemoveTask("Task_Butelka")
	Task_Butelka = nil
	guiMenuInv:ShineRelease()
	Open_sea_OnBottleOver = nil
	Open_sea_OnBottleClick = nil
end

function OnLevelEntered()
	if not MapFlag("+butelka_wzieta") then
			CreateTask("Task_Butelka")
	end
end

maps/out_of_ship/script.lua:
/*#############################################################################

POSTACIE I ITEMY

#############################################################################*/
lgs.kajetan = ImpActor("kajetan")

if LastMap("cabin") then
	go(lgs.kajetan, "place", "door_point")
	go(lgs.kajetan, "rotateToPoint", "trap_point")
elseif LastMap("hold") then
	go(lgs.kajetan, "place", "klapa_point")
elseif LastMap("preparation_port")	then
	go(lgs.kajetan, "place", "trap_point")
end

guiDesktop.actor = lgs.kajetan
guiScroll.traceObject = lgs.kajetan

PlaySoundLooped("\\waves2.wav",-1)
AddTwinAnimBkg("data\\maps\\out_of_ship\\anim\\drzwi.anim")
AddTwinAnimBkg("data\\maps\\out_of_ship\\anim\\klapa.anim")
AddTwinAnimBkg("data\\maps\\out_of_ship\\anim\\kolo1.anim")
AddTwinAnimBkg("data\\maps\\out_of_ship\\anim\\kolo2.anim")
AddTwinAnimBkg("data\\maps\\out_of_ship\\anim\\kotwica.anim")
AddTwinAnimBkg("data\\maps\\out_of_ship\\anim\\szczur.anim")
AddTwinAnimBkg("data\\maps\\out_of_ship\\anim\\reling1.anim")
AddTwinAnimBkg("data\\maps\\out_of_ship\\anim\\reling2.anim")
AddTwinAnimBkg("data\\maps\\out_of_ship\\anim\\reling3.anim")
AddTwinAnimBkg("data\\maps\\out_of_ship\\anim\\reling4.anim")

if LastMap("cabin") then
    TwinAnimBkg("drzwi", "opened", 0, 0)
end

if LastMap("hold") then
    TwinAnimBkg("klapa", "opened", 0, 0)
end

EnableWater("data\\maps\\preparation_port\\water\\woda_%d.jpg",RGBA(1,1,1,0.25), 12, 0.003, 0.003, 100, 20)
ASObjectOff("klapa_obszar")
ASObjectOff("drzwi_obszar")
ASObjectOff("area_trap")
/*#############################################################################

FUNKCJE i Taski

#############################################################################*/

//=======================================================================
// Funkcje zwi¹zane z drzwiami
//=======================================================================
function Area_drzwi(name, event)
	if event == "over" then
		gui:MouseText(Str("freq.door"))
	elseif event == "click" then
	     CreateTask("Task_OpenTheDoor")
	     return 1
	end
end
//=======================================================================
// Funkcje zwi¹zane z klapa
//=======================================================================

function Area_klapa(name, event,param)
	if event == "over" and Flag("poklad_klapa_klucz") then
		gui:MouseText(Str("freq.klapa"))

		if not Flag("klapa_otwarta") and Flag("poklad_klapa_klucz")then
			gui:MouseImg("doSome")
		end
	elseif event == "click" then
		if guiMenuInv.movingItemName == "klucz3" or Flag("klapa_otwarta")  then
			   CreateTask("Task_OpenTheCover")
			   return 1
		end
    elseif event == "help" then
    	if not Flag("klapa_otwarta") then
			if param == 1 then
				HudText(Str("hint.klapa_do_ladowni_1"))
			elseif param == 2 then
				HudText(Str("hint.klapa_do_ladowni_2"))
			end
		end

	end
end
//=======================================================================
// Funkcje zwi¹zane z trapem
//=======================================================================
function Area_trap(name, event)
	if event == "over" then
		gui:MouseText(Str("freq.trap"))
	end
end

function Task_OpenTheCover()
	BeginTask()
	TwinAnimBkg("klapa", "open", 1, 1)
 	ASObjectOff("area_klapa")
	ASObjectOn("klapa_obszar")

	if guiMenuInv:IsItem("klucz3",1) then
		guiMenuInv:RemoveItem("klucz3")
	end
	SetFlag("klapa_otwarta")
	RemoveTask()
end

function Task_OpenTheDoor()
    BeginTask()
    TwinAnimBkg("drzwi", "open", 1, 1)
    PlaySound ("\\door_wood_open_closed.wav")
	ASObjectOff("area_drzwi")
	ASObjectOn("drzwi_obszar")
	RemoveTask()
end

//=======================================================================
// Animacje z lup¹
//=======================================================================
function Area_anims(name, event, param)
	if guiMenuInv.movingItemName ~= "lupa" then
		if event == "over" then
			lgs:ObjectName(param)
		end
		return 1
	end
	if event == "over" then
		lgs:ObjectName(param)
	elseif event == "in" then

		guiMenuInv:ShineOn(0.5)
	elseif event == "out" then

		guiMenuInv:ShineOff()
	elseif event == "click" then
		TwinAnimBkg(name, "standard", 1, 1)
		if name == "kolo1" and not MapFlag("+help")  then
                if not FindTask("Task_Help") then
                	SetMapFlag("+help")
		   			CreateTask("Task_Help")
		   		end
		   		return 1

		end
	end
end

function lgs:ObjectName(object)
	if object == "kolo1" then
		gui:MouseText(Str("freq.kolo"))
	elseif object == "kolo2" then
	    gui:MouseText(Str("freq.kolo"))
	elseif object == "kotwica" then
	    gui:MouseText(Str("freq.kotwica"))
	elseif object == "szczur" then
	    gui:MouseText(Str("freq.okienko"))
	elseif object == "reling1" then
	    gui:MouseText(Str("freq.reling"))
	elseif object == "reling2" then
	    gui:MouseText(Str("freq.reling"))
	elseif object == "reling3" then
	    gui:MouseText(Str("freq.reling"))
	elseif object == "reling4" then
	    gui:MouseText(Str("freq.reling"))
	end
end
//=======================================================================
function OnLevelUpdate()
	if not lgs.counter or lgs.counter <= 0 then
		PlaySound(random(1,2) == 1 and "\\creak_1.wav" or "\\creak_2.wav", -1)
		lgs.counter = 30*random(10,15)
	else
		lgs.counter = lgs.counter - 1
	end
end

function OnLevelEntered()
	if LastMap("cabin") then
		TwinAnimBkg("drzwi", "close", 1, 1)
		PlaySound ("\\door_wood_open_closed.wav")
	end

	if LastMap("hold") then
	    TwinAnimBkg("klapa", "close", 1, 1)
	end

	if not Flag("kapitan_odnaleziony") and not Flag("klucz_do_ladowni_zabrany")then
	     HudText(Str("outofship1"), 6)
	end

end

////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
//=======================================================================
// Podpowiedzi
//=======================================================================
///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////


if not MapFlag("+help_zabrany") and not MapFlag("+help") then
	lgs.help= NewObject("zarowka.object3d")
	go(lgs.help, "place", "help_start")
	go(lgs.help, "evOnEndThrow", "HelpWyladowal")
	go(lgs.help, "evOnUpdateThrow", "HelpLeci")
	go(lgs.help, "scale",0)
	go(lgs.help, "evOnMouseOver", "OnHelpOver")
	lgs.helpshine  = CreatePartEffect("data\\fx\\gwiazdki1.apd", "",-1, "data\\bitmap\\shine", 15)
	StopParticle(lgs.helpshine)
	lgs.helpefekt = CreatePartEffect("data\\fx\\piana3.apd", "",-1, "data\\bitmap\\shine_3_blueb", 0)
	StopParticle(lgs.helpefekt)
elseif not MapFlag("+help_zabrany") and MapFlag("+help") then
	lgs.help= NewObject("zarowka.object3d")
	go(lgs.help, "scale", 1)
	go(lgs.help, "place", "help_stop")
	go(lgs.help, "evOnMouseClick", "OnHelpTake")
	go(lgs.help, "evOnMouseOver", "OnHelpOver")
end


function HelpLeci(item)
	StartParticle(lgs.helpshine)
    go(item, "rotate", 30 )
    go(item,"angUp",random(30 ))
	SetPartPos(lgs.helpshine, go(item,"pos"))
end

function HelpWyladowal(item)
 	go(item,"angUp",0)
 	go(lgs.help, "evOnMouseClick", "OnHelpTake")
	StopParticle(lgs.helpshine)
	CreateTask("Task_HelpEfekt")
end

function OnHelpTake()
	RemoveTask("Task_HelpEfekt")
	if lgs.helpefekt then
		StopParticle(lgs.helpefekt)
	end
	if not MapFlag("+help_zabrany") then
	    AddHelp()
	    SetMapFlag("+help_zabrany")
    end
    go(lgs.help,"remove")
end

function OnHelpOver(obj)
	gui:MouseText(go(obj,"nameVis"))
   	gui:MouseCursor("select")
    guiDesktop.mouseDetect = nil
end

function Task_HelpEfekt( )
	BeginTask()
 	lgs.promien = 10
	lgs.kat = 0
	lgs.licznik = 0
	local a =   go(lgs.help,"pos" )
	a.y = a.y+1
	local v = {}
	v.x = a.x
	v.y = a.y
	v.z = a.z
    StartParticle(lgs.helpefekt)
    CreatePartEffect("data\\fx\\energy1.apd", go(lgs.help,"pos"), 2 , "data\\bitmap\\fx\\shine_twirl_purple", 2)
	repeat
		if lgs.promien >2 then
	    	lgs.promien = lgs.promien -1
	    end
        lgs.licznik = lgs.licznik+1
		v.x = a.x + sin(lgs.kat) * lgs.promien
		v.z = a.z + cos(lgs.kat) * lgs.promien
		lgs.kat = lgs.kat + 20
		Wait(0.01)
		if random(1,2) >1.5 then
			v.y = 5
		else
			v.y = 1
		end
		SetPartPos(lgs.helpefekt,v)
	until lgs.licznik >60
	StopParticle(lgs.helpefekt)

    RemoveTask()

end


function Task_Help()
	BeginTask()
	go(lgs.help, "scale",1)
	go(lgs.help, "throwAngle", "help_stop", 75  , 5)
	RemoveTask()
end

function OnLevelRelease()
	Area_drzwi = nil
	Area_klapa = nil
	Area_trap = nil
	Area_anims = nil
	RemoveTask("Task_OpenTheCover")
	Task_OpenTheCover = nil
	RemoveTask("Task_OpenTheDoor")
	Task_OpenTheDoor = nil
	guiMenuInv:ShineRelease()
	RemoveTask("Task_HelpEfekt")
    Task_HelpEfekt = nil
    RemoveTask("Task_Help")
    Task_Help = nil
    HelpLeci = nil
    HelpWyladowal = nil
    OnHelpTake = nil
    OnHelpOver = nil
end

function FireRing_extendet( )
 	BeginTask()
 	lgs.promien = 10
	lgs.kat = 0
	lgs.licznik = 1
	local a =   go(lgs.klucz_do_magazynu,"pos" )
	local v = {}
	v.x = a.x
	v.y = a.y
	v.z = a.z
    StartParticle(lgs.efekt)
	lgs.licznik = lgs.licznik -0.01

 	repeat
 		lgs.promien = lgs.promien - 0.05
		v.x = a.x + sin(lgs.kat) * lgs.promien
		v.z = a.z + cos(lgs.kat) * lgs.promien
		lgs.kat = lgs.kat + 30
		Wait(0.01)
			SetPartPos(lgs.efekt,v)
	until lgs.promien <0
		StopParticle(lgs.efekt)

	RemoveTask()
end

function lgs:ButterFlyStart( )
	lgs.butterflyTab = {}
	local point = GroundPoint("motyle")
	for i = 1,3 do
		point.x = point.x+ random(-20,20)
		point.y = point.y +random( 0,40)
		point.z = point.z +random(-20,20)
		lgs.pointTab[i] = point
		point = GroundPoint("motyle")
		local motyl = NewObject("motyl.actor")
			go(motyl,"scale",8)
			go(motyl,"place",lgs.pointTab[i])
			go(motyl,"setPosY",random(2,10))
			//go(motyl,"walkSpeed",1)
			local butterfly = {
				motyl = motyl,
				pos = point,
				newPos =point,
				ready = 1,
				}
		tinsert(lgs.butterflyTab, butterfly)
		end
end

function lgs:RandomisePoints(newPoint)
	for i = 1,3 do
        local point = GroundPoint(newPoint)
		point.x = point.x+ random(-10,10)
		point.y = point.y +random( 0,25)
		point.z = point.z +random(-10,10)
		lgs.pointTab[i] = point
		lgs.butterflyTab[i].newPos = point
		local point = GroundPoint(newPoint)
	end

end

function lgs:FlyButterFly()
	for i,v in lgs.butterflyTab do
		if i~="n" then
			if Distance2D(go(v.motyl,"pos"),GroundPoint(v.newPos) )>random(1,7)    then

				if v.ready then
					go(v.motyl,"move",GroundPoint(v.newPos))
				end
			else
				if random(1,2) >1.5 then
					go(lgs.butterflyTab[random(1,3)].motyl, "rotate", random(-1,1))
                end
                if lgs.butterflyTab[random(1,3)].ready  then
                	v.ready = nil
                else
                	v.ready = 1

                end
			end
		end
	end
end

function Task_HelpEfekt( )
	BeginTask()
 	lgs.promien = 10
	lgs.kat = 0
	lgs.partlicznik = 0
	local a =   go(lgs.help,"pos" )
	a.y = a.y+1
	local v = {}
	v.x = a.x
	v.y = a.y
	v.z = a.z
    StartParticle(lgs.helpefekt)
    CreatePartEffect("data\\fx\\energy1.apd", go(lgs.help,"pos"), 2 , "data\\bitmap\\fx\\shine_twirl_purple", 2)
	repeat
		if lgs.promien >2 then
	    	lgs.promien = lgs.promien -1
	    end
        lgs.partlicznik = lgs.partlicznik+1
		v.x = a.x + sin(lgs.kat) * lgs.promien
		v.z = a.z + cos(lgs.kat) * lgs.promien
		lgs.kat = lgs.kat + 20
		Wait(0.01)
		if random(1,2) >1.5 then
			v.y = 5
		else
			v.y = 1
		end
		SetPartPos(lgs.helpefekt,v)
	until lgs.partlicznik >60
	StopParticle(lgs.helpefekt)
    lgs.partlicznik = 0
    RemoveTask()

end

function OnLevelUpdate()
	lgs.kajetanPos = go(lgs.kajetan,"pos")
	lgs.mewa2Pos = go(lgs.mewa2,"pos")

	if not Flag("po_pierwszej_rozmowie_z_kapitanem") then

		lgs.fishermanPos = go(lgs.fisherman,"pos")
		lgs:RozmowaZKapitanem()
		if not FindTask("Task_KapitanLazi") and not Flag("po_pierwszej_rozmowie_z_kapitanem") and not MapFlag("rozmowa") then
			CreateTask("Task_KapitanLazi")
		end
	end
	if Distance(lgs.kajetanPos ,GroundPoint("start_kajetan") )  <30 then
		if not Flag("po_pierwszej_grze") and  guiMenuInv:IsItem("mapy",1)  then
		   if not FindTask("Task_Gra") then
		    	CreateTask("Task_Gra")
		   end
		end
	end

	if not Flag("po_pierwszej_rozmowie_z_kapitanem") and not FindTask("Task_KapitanRozmowa") and Flag("klucz_do_magazynu_zabrany")  and MapFlag("rozmowa") and not FindTask("Task_KapitanRozmowa2") then
		CreateTask("Task_KapitanRozmowa2")
	end

	if not FindTask("Task_Mewa")   then
		CreateTask("Task_Mewa")
	end


	if not lgs.counter or lgs.counter <= 0 then
		PlaySound(random(1,2) == 1 and "\\creak_1.wav" or "\\creak_2.wav", -1,"statek_sound")
		lgs.counter = 30*random(10,15)
	else
		lgs.counter = lgs.counter - 1
	end

	if lgs:Przodem(lgs.kajetan, lgs.mewa2) then
		SetMapFlag("przodem")
	else
		ClearMapFlag("przodem")
	end

    //Motyle----------------------------------
     lgs:FlyButterFly()
 	if not lgs.motyleCounter or lgs.motyleCounter <= 0 then
 			if random (1,2)  >1.5 then
 				lgs:RandomisePoints("motyle")
 			else
 				lgs:RandomisePoints("motyle2")
 			end
 			lgs.motyleCounter = 30*random(0.5,0.7)
 	else
 			lgs.motyleCounter = lgs.motyleCounter - 1
 	end

	----------------------------------------------



end //koniec OnLevelUpdate


function lgs:Przodem(ob1, ob2)
	local ang = 90
	local ang1 = go(ob1, "angle")
	local ang2 = go(ob2, "angle")
	local pos1 = go(ob1, "pos")
	local pos2 = go(ob2, "pos")
	if abs(AngleDist(DirToAngle(pos1, pos2), ang1)) < ang then
		if abs(AngleDist(ang1, ang2)) > ang then
			return 1
		end
	end
end

lgs.angB = {0, 120, 200, 160, 60, 320, 270, 45, 135, 210, 90, 350, 180, 100, 295}
lgs.angS = {0, 120, 200, 160, 60, 320, 270, 45, 135, 210, 90, 350, 180, 100, 295}

lgs.endGame = nil

/*#############################################################################

FUNKCJE i Taski

#############################################################################*/

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Funkcja do tworzenia obiektow
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function lgs:TworzObiekty(nazwa, rodzaj, miejsce, tablica, ilosc, wysokosc, xstep, ystep, alfa, tabAngle, animName)
	for i = 1 , ilosc do
	    local nazwa_loc = nazwa
		nazwa_loc = NewObject(rodzaj)
		local pos = GroundPoint(miejsce.."_"..i)
		go(nazwa_loc,"place",pos)
		go(nazwa_loc, "setPosY", wysokosc)
		if animName then
			go(nazwa_loc, "anim", animName, 0, -1)
		end
		if nazwa ~= "wiatr" then
			if tabAngle and getn(tabAngle) >= i then
				go(nazwa_loc, "rotate", tabAngle[i])
			else
				go(nazwa_loc, "rotate", random(1,180))
			end
		end
		if nazwa  == "wiatr" then
		 	go(nazwa_loc, "rotate",90)
		end
  		if alfa  then
 			go(nazwa_loc,"setAlpha",alfa)
 		end
		tinsert(tablica, {coll = nil, id = nazwa_loc, name = nazwa, pos =  pos,xstep = xstep, ystep = ystep})
	end
end


function lgs:ASKolizja(tablica)
	if lgs.lastCollisionTime and currentTime - lgs.lastCollisionTime < 0.6 then
		return
	end

	for i = 1, getn(tablica) do
		local name = "area_"..tablica[i].name.."_"..i
		//print(name)

		if ASIsInside(name, lgs.shipPosDziob2D.x, lgs.shipPosDziob2D.y) or ASIsInside(name, lgs.shipPos2D.x, lgs.shipPos2D.y) then
			if not tablica[i].coll then
				lgs.lastCollisionTime = currentTime
			    go(lgs.statek, "anim", "hit", 0 , 1)
				tablica[i].coll = 1
				lgs:Punkty()
			    PlaySound("\\models\\car_hit_1.wav")
				go(lgs.statek,"rotate",180)
				go(lgs.statek, "goForward")
				break
			end

		else
			tablica[i].coll = nil
		end
	end

end

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Funkcja wiatru
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function lgs:Wiatr()
    if lgs.lastCollisionTime and currentTime - lgs.lastCollisionTime < 0.6 then
		return
	end
	for i, v in lgs.listWiatr do
		if i ~= "n" then
			if Distance(v.pos, lgs.shipPos) < 30 then
			    if not v.coll then
			         lgs.lastCollisionTime = currentTime
					 v.coll = 1
                     lgs.speed = lgs.speed +1
                    // go(lgs.statek, "setMaxSpeed", lgs.speed )
                     go(lgs.statek, "brakingTo", lgs.speed )

				else

				end
			else
				if v.coll == 1 then
				 go(lgs.statek, "anim", "speed",0,1 )
                 PlaySound("\\cross2-iglak.wav")
				   v.coll = nil
				else

				end
			end
		end
	end
end

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Funkcja badajaca czy dotarlismy do brzegu
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function lgs:Brzeg()
	if MapFlag("gra") then
		if  lgs.shipPos.z < 80 then
		    if not lgs.koniec then
				lgs.koniec = 1
				lgs.speed = 0
				go(lgs.statek,"brakingTo",lgs.speed)
				ClearMapFlag("gra")
    			lgs.hits = 0
  			--	HudMsg(Str("sea1") , 2,nil,300)
  				lgs.endGame = 2.5
		    else

			end
		else
			if lgs.koniec == 1 then
			    lgs.koniec = nil
			else

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Funkcja odpowiedzialna za punkty
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function lgs:Punkty()

	lgs.damage = lgs.damage+1

	if lgs.damage >2 then
		lgs.hits =lgs.hits +1

	end

	if lgs.hits ==  3 then
		CreateTask("Task_KoniecGry")
	end

    if lgs.damage ==  3   then
        if lgs.hits ~= 3 then
			HudMsg(Str("sea2"),2, nil,300 )
		end
		lgs.damage = 0
	else
		if lgs.hits ~= 3   then
			HudMsg(Str("sea3") , 2,nil,250)
		end
	end
	lgs.speed = 1
	go(lgs.statek,"brakingTo",lgs.speed)

end

function lgs:Kierunek()
   lgs.angle = go(lgs.statek,"angle")

	if  (lgs.angle > 0 and lgs.angle< 90) or (lgs.angle< -180 and lgs.angle >-270) then
		if not MapFlag("zly_kierunek")then
		    SetMapFlag("zly_kierunek")

		else

		end
	else
		if MapFlag("zly_kierunek") then
			ClearMapFlag("zly_kierunek")
		else

		end

	end

end

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------

function Task_KoniecGry()
  	BeginTask()
	ClearMapFlag("gra")

end

function OnLevelRender()
	if MapFlag("gra") then

			//  Wyswietlanie ikon (statki gracza)
		if lgs.hits == 0 then
		    SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_hit1, 0)
		elseif lgs.hits ==1 then
			SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_hit2, 0)
		elseif lgs.hits ==2 then
			SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_hit3, 0)
		elseif lgs.hits ==3  then
			SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_hit4, 0)
		end
		DrawRectangle(Vector(590 ,5, 0), 128, 64, RGBA(1,1,1,1))

		if lgs.speed >1 then
		    local prwdp = random(1,10)
		    if prwdp > 8 then
		    	SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_speed3,0)
		    else
		    	SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_speed4,0)
			end
		else
			local prwdp = random(1,10)
		    if prwdp > 8 then
		    	SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_speed1,0)
		    else
		    	SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_speed2,0)
			end
		end
		DrawRectangle(Vector(ScreenWidth()/2 -150, 5 , 0),256, 128, RGBA(1,1,1,1))

		if lgs.damage == 0  then
			SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_damage1,0)
		elseif lgs.damage == 1 then
			SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_damage2,0)
		elseif lgs.damage == 2 then
			SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_damage3,0)
		end
		DrawRectangle(Vector(30, 5 , 0),128, 64, RGBA(1,1,1,1))

		//rysowanie postepu
		local bw = 150
		local bh = 16
		local pos = (lgs.maxY - lgs.shipPos2D.y) / lgs.maxY
		SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_kuterek,0)
		DrawRectangle(Vector(ScreenWidth() / 2 - 105 + (bw - bh) * pos, 20 ,0), 32, 32, RGBA(1,1,1,1))

		if MapFlag("zly_kierunek") then
			local alpha = (cos(mod(frameCount, 10) * 360 / 10) + 1) * 0.5
			SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_strzalka,0)
			DrawRectangle(Vector(ScreenWidth() / 2 + 60 , ScreenHeight() / 2 ,0), 128, 32, RGBA(1,1,1,alpha))
		end
	end
end

maps/sea_2/script.lua:
MarkArea(0)
 /*#############################################################################

SEA

#############################################################################*/

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
ZMIENNE
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
lgs.koniec = nil
lgs.posp2 = GroundPoint("p2")
lgs.speed = 0
lgs.shipCount = 3
lgs.hits = 0
lgs.damage  = 0
lgs.angle = 0
lgs.maxX = BkgBitmapWidth() - 20
lgs.maxY = BkgBitmapHeight() - 20
lgs.spr_statek = CreateSprite("data\\bitmap\\kuter_icon_2")

lgs.spr_speed1 = CreateSprite("data\\maps\\sea\\speed\\speed_1")
lgs.spr_speed2 = CreateSprite("data\\maps\\sea\\speed\\speed_2")
lgs.spr_speed3 = CreateSprite("data\\maps\\sea\\speed\\speed_3")
lgs.spr_speed4 = CreateSprite("data\\maps\\sea\\speed\\speed_4")

lgs.spr_damage1 = CreateSprite("data\\maps\\sea\\speed\\kuterdamage_1")
lgs.spr_damage2 = CreateSprite("data\\maps\\sea\\speed\\kuterdamage_2")
lgs.spr_damage3 = CreateSprite("data\\maps\\sea\\speed\\kuterdamage_3")
lgs.spr_damage4 = CreateSprite("data\\maps\\sea\\speed\\kuterdamage_4")

lgs.spr_hit1 = CreateSprite("data\\maps\\sea\\speed\\kuterhit_1")
lgs.spr_hit2 = CreateSprite("data\\maps\\sea\\speed\\kuterhit_2")
lgs.spr_hit3 = CreateSprite("data\\maps\\sea\\speed\\kuterhit_3")
lgs.spr_hit4 = CreateSprite("data\\maps\\sea\\speed\\kuterhit_4")

lgs.spr_kuterek = CreateSprite("data\\maps\\sea\\speed\\kuterek")

lgs.spr_strzalka = CreateSprite("data\\bitmap\\side_arrow_2")

 lgs.angB = {0, 120, 200, 160, 60, 320, 270, 45, 135, 210, 90, 350, 180, 100, 295}
 lgs.angS = {0, 120, 200, 160, 60, 320, 270, 45, 135, 210, 90, 350, 180, 100, 295}

lgs.endGame = nil

/*#############################################################################

FUNKCJE i Taski

#############################################################################*/

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Funkcja do tworzenia obiektow
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function lgs:TworzObiekty(nazwa, rodzaj, miejsce, tablica, ilosc, wysokosc, xstep, ystep, alfa, tabAngle)
	for i = 1 , ilosc do
	    local nazwa_loc = nazwa
		nazwa_loc = NewObject(rodzaj)
		local pos = GroundPoint(miejsce.."_"..i)
		go(nazwa_loc,"place",pos)
		go(nazwa_loc, "setPosY", wysokosc)
		if nazwa ~= "wiatr" then
			if tabAngle and getn(tabAngle) >= i then
				go(nazwa_loc, "rotate", tabAngle[i])
			else
				go(nazwa_loc, "rotate", random(1,180))
			end
		end
		if nazwa == "wiatr" then
			go(nazwa_loc, "rotate",90)
			go(nazwa_loc,"anim","idle", 0, -1)
		end
  		if alfa  then
 			go(nazwa_loc,"setAlpha",alfa)
 		end
 		//go(nazwa_loc,"anim","idle", 0, -1)
		tinsert(tablica, {coll = nil, id = nazwa_loc, name = nazwa, pos =  pos,xstep = xstep, ystep = ystep})
	end
end
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Funkcja kolizji
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/


function lgs:ASKolizja(tablica)
	if lgs.lastCollisionTime and currentTime - lgs.lastCollisionTime < 1 then
		return
	end

	for i = 1, getn(tablica) do
		local name = "area_"..tablica[i].name.."_"..i
		//print(name)

		if ASIsInside(name, lgs.shipPosDziob2D.x, lgs.shipPosDziob2D.y) or ASIsInside(name, lgs.shipPos2D.x, lgs.shipPos2D.y) then
			if not tablica[i].coll then
				lgs.lastCollisionTime = currentTime
			    go(lgs.statek, "anim", "hit", 0 , 1)
				tablica[i].coll = 1
				lgs:Punkty()
				PlaySound("\\models\\car_hit_1.wav")
				DrawRectangle(Vector(0, ScreenHeight() - 110 , 0),128, 128, RGBA(1,1,1,1))
				go(lgs.statek, "brakingTo", 1)
				go(lgs.statek,"rotate",180)
				go(lgs.statek, "goForward")
				break
			end

		else
			tablica[i].coll = nil
		end
	end

end

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Funkcja wiatru
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function lgs:Wiatr()
	if lgs.lastCollisionTime and currentTime - lgs.lastCollisionTime < 1 then
		return
	end
	for i, v in lgs.listWiatr do
		if i ~= "n" then
			if Distance(v.pos, lgs.shipPos) < 20 then
			    if not v.coll then
			         lgs.lastCollisionTime = currentTime
					 v.coll = 1
                     lgs.speed = lgs.speed +1
                     go(lgs.statek, "brakingTo", lgs.speed )

				else

				end
			else
				if v.coll == 1 then
					go(lgs.statek, "anim", "speed",0,1 )
					PlaySound("\\cross2-iglak.wav")
					v.coll = nil
				else

				end
			end
		end
	end
end


/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Funkcja badajaca czy dotarlismy do brzegu
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function lgs:Brzeg()

		if  lgs.shipPos.z < 80 then
		    if not lgs.koniec then
				lgs.koniec = 1
				lgs.speed = 0
				go(lgs.statek,"brakingTo",lgs.speed)
				ClearMapFlag("gra")
    			lgs.hits = 0
  				HudMsg(Str("sea1"),2,nil,300)

  				lgs.endGame = 2.5
		    else

			end
		else
			if lgs.koniec == 1 then
			    lgs.koniec = nil
			else

			end

		end

end

/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Funkcja odpowiedzialna za punkty
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function lgs:Punkty()
   -- HudImg("data\\maps\\sea\\speed\\bum",0.1, 0, ScreenHeight() -80, 1, 1,80)
	lgs.damage = lgs.damage+1

	if lgs.damage >2 then
		lgs.hits =lgs.hits +1

	end

	if lgs.hits ==  3 then
		CreateTask("Task_KoniecGry")
	end

    if lgs.damage ==  3   then
        if lgs.hits ~= 3 then
			HudMsg(Str("sea2"),2, nil,250 )
		end
		lgs.damage = 0
	else
		if lgs.hits ~= 3   then
			HudMsg(Str("sea3") , 2,nil,300)
		end
	end
	lgs.speed = 1
	go(lgs.statek,"brakingTo",lgs.speed)

end

function lgs:Kierunek()
   lgs.angle = go(lgs.statek,"angle")

	if  (lgs.angle > 0 and lgs.angle< 90) or (lgs.angle< -180 and lgs.angle >-270) then
		if not MapFlag("zly_kierunek")then
		    SetMapFlag("zly_kierunek")

		else

		end
	else
		if MapFlag("zly_kierunek") then
			ClearMapFlag("zly_kierunek")
		else

		end

	end

end


/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
Task Rozpoczynajacy gre
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function Task_Wstep()
	BeginTask()
	Wait(2)
	HudMsg(Str("sea_count_3"), 1, nil, 300)
	Wait(1)
	HudMsg(Str("sea_count_2"), 1, nil, 300)
	Wait(1)
	HudMsg(Str("sea_count_1"), 1, nil, 300)
	Wait(1)
	HudMsg(Str("sea_count_start"), 1, nil, 300)
	Wait(1)
	PlayMusic("data\\music\\pipe.ogg")
	go(lgs.statek, "brakingTo", 1)
	SetMapFlag("gra")
    lgs.speed = 1
	RemoveTask()
end
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
Task konczacy  gre w przypadku utraty wszystkich statków
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function Task_KoniecGry()
  	BeginTask()
	ClearMapFlag("gra")
	FadeOutMusic()
	lgs.hits = 0
	lgs.damage = 0
	HudMsg(Str("sea4"),2,nil,350)
	Wait(2)
	go(lgs.statek, "setPosY", 5)
	go(lgs.statek, "place","boat")
	go(lgs.statek, "rotatetoPoint","boat_look", 1)
	go(lgs.statek,"anim","idle", 0, -1)
	go(lgs.statek, "floatingOn", 0.5, 2, -2 , 1)
	Drive(lgs.statek, 1)
	CameraNow(lgs.statek)
	go(lgs.statek, "setMaxSpeed", 10)
	go(lgs.statek, "brakingTo", 0)
	CreateTask("Task_Wstep")
	RemoveTask()
end

function OnLevelEntered()
	CreateTask("Task_Wstep")
end
/*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
function OnLevelRelease()
    RemoveTask("Task_Wstep")
    Task_Wstep = nil
    RemoveTask("Task_KoniecGry")
  	Task_KoniecGry = nil
end

/*#############################################################################

Tworzenie obiektow

#############################################################################*/
lgs.statek = NewObject("kuter.vehicle")
go(lgs.statek, "setPosY", 5)
go(lgs.statek, "place","boat")
go(lgs.statek, "rotate", 180, 1)
go(lgs.statek,"anim","idle", 0, -1)
go(lgs.statek, "floatingOn", 0.5, 2, -2 , 1)
Drive(lgs.statek, 1)
CameraNow(lgs.statek)

go(lgs.statek, "setMaxSpeed", 10)
go(lgs.statek, "stop" )
go(lgs.statek, "brakingTo", 0)
lgs.listWyspyMale = {}
lgs.listWyspyDuze = {}
lgs.listWiatr = {}

lgs:TworzObiekty("wyspam","wyspamala.object3d","rockm",lgs.listWyspyMale,3,1.9, nil, nil,nil, lgs.angS)
lgs:TworzObiekty("wyspad","wyspaduza.object3d","wyspad",lgs.listWyspyDuze,7,1.4,nil,nil,nil, lgs.angB)
lgs:TworzObiekty("wiatr","wiatr.object3d","wind",lgs.listWiatr,1,0, nil, nil,nil)

EnableWater("data\\maps\\sea\\water\\woda_%d.jpg", RGBA(1,1,1,0.5), 13, 0.002, 0.002, 220.0, 0.0)
WaterToZBuffer(0)
PlaySoundLooped("\\waves2.wav",-1  )
/*#############################################################################

WYWIETLANIE NA EKRANIE

#############################################################################*/
function OnLevelRender()
	if MapFlag("gra") then

			//  Wyswietlanie ikon (statki gracza)
		if lgs.hits == 0 then
		    SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_hit1, 0)
		elseif lgs.hits ==1 then
			SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_hit2, 0)
		elseif lgs.hits ==2 then
			SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_hit3, 0)
		elseif lgs.hits ==3  then
			SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_hit4, 0)
		end
		DrawRectangle(Vector(590 ,5, 0), 128, 64, RGBA(1,1,1,1))

		if lgs.speed >1 then
		    local prwdp = random(1,10)
		    if prwdp > 8 then
		    	SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_speed3,0)
		    else
		    	SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_speed4,0)
			end
		else
			local prwdp = random(1,10)
		    if prwdp > 8 then
		    	SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_speed1,0)
		    else
		    	SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_speed2,0)
			end
		end
		DrawRectangle(Vector(ScreenWidth()/2 -150, 5 , 0),256, 128, RGBA(1,1,1,1))

		if lgs.damage == 0  then
			SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_damage1,0)
		elseif lgs.damage == 1 then
			SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_damage2,0)
		elseif lgs.damage == 2 then
			SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_damage3,0)
		end
		DrawRectangle(Vector(30, 5 , 0),128, 64, RGBA(1,1,1,1))

		//rysowanie postepu
		local bw = 150
		local bh = 16
		local pos = (lgs.maxY - lgs.shipPos2D.y) / lgs.maxY
		SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_kuterek,0)
		DrawRectangle(Vector(ScreenWidth() / 2 - 105 + (bw - bh) * pos, 20 ,0), 32, 32, RGBA(1,1,1,1))

		if MapFlag("zly_kierunek") then
			local alpha = (cos(mod(frameCount, 10) * 360 / 10) + 1) * 0.5
			SprSetCurrentFrame(lgs.spr_strzalka,0)
			DrawRectangle(Vector(ScreenWidth() / 2 + 60 , ScreenHeight() / 2 ,0), 128, 32, RGBA(1,1,1,alpha))
		end
	end
end

/*#############################################################################

G£ÓWNA PÊTLA

#############################################################################*/
function OnLevelUpdate()
-- /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Pozycja statku
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
/*
  	lgs.shipPos = go(lgs.statek,"pos")
  	lgs.shipPos2D = MapWorldToBkg(lgs.shipPos)
*/

	local pl = go(lgs.statek, "bonePos", "piana_przod_lewo_0")
	local pp = go(lgs.statek, "bonePos", "piana_przod_prawo_0")
  	lgs.shipPosDziob = VectorMid(pl, pp)
  	lgs.shipPosDziob2D = MapWorldToBkg(lgs.shipPosDziob)

	lgs.shipPos = go(lgs.statek, "bonePos", "piana_przod_lewo_1")
  	lgs.shipPos2D = MapWorldToBkg(lgs.shipPos)

-- /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
--  Kolizje
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
   	lgs:ASKolizja(lgs.listWyspyDuze)
	lgs:ASKolizja(lgs.listWyspyMale)

-- /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- £apanie wiatru
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
  	lgs:Wiatr()

-- /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
--  Badamy czy dotarlismy do celu
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
  	lgs:Brzeg()
-- /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
--  Badamy czy p³yniemy w dobr¹ stronê
-- -----------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
	lgs:Kierunek()

	if lgs.endGame then
		lgs.endGame = lgs.endGame - frameTime
		if lgs.endGame < 0 then
			 ChangeMap("africa_coast_ship")
		end
	end
end //koniec OnLevelUpdate

function lgs:SetPlayerAng(ang)
	if ang < -lgs.maxWind - 0.1 or ang > lgs.maxWind + 0.1 then
		return
	end
	lgs.playerAng = wind
	lgs.angWind = 90 - (wind * 90 / lgs.maxWind)
end

function lgs:AddPlayerAng(addAng)
	local newAng = lgs.playerAng + addAng
	//print(newAng)

	elseif newAng < -90 then
		lgs.playerAng = -90
	else
		lgs.playerAng = newAng
	end
end

function lgs:UpdatePlayerAng()
	if lgs.playerAng > (1.1 * lgs.scaleAng) then
		lgs.playerAng = lgs.playerAng - 1 * lgs.scaleAng

	else

	end

		lgs:AddPlayerAng(-2 * lgs.scaleAng)
	elseif KbdIs("up") then
		lgs:AddPlayerAng(2 * lgs.scaleAng)
	end
end

				go(lgs.aktor, "throwAccelerateX", 1)

	lgs.endSpeed = go(obj, "speed")

	if mode == "WALK" then
		if lgs.zjazd then

				go(obj, "actMovingSpeed", go(obj, "actMovingSpeed") - ySpeed * 0.042)

	end

function lgs:WindUpdate()
	lgs.windFrameTime = lgs.windFrameTime + frameTime
	if lgs.windFrameTime > lgs.windFrameChangeTime then
		lgs.windFrameTime = 0
		lgs.windActFrame = lgs.windActFrame + lgs.windFrameChange
		if lgs.windActFrame > 0 then
			if lgs.windActFrame > lgs.windFramesCount then
				lgs.windFrameChange = -lgs.windFrameChange
				lgs.windActFrame = lgs.windFramesCount - 1
			end
		else
			if lgs.windActFrame < 1 then
				lgs.windFrameChange = -lgs.windFrameChange
				lgs.windActFrame = 2
			end
		end
	end

    if not lgs.windChanging and (not lgs.lastWindChangeTime or currentTime - lgs.lastWindChangeTime > 0.6) and random(0, 20) < 1 then
    	//print(1)
    	local newWind = random(-3, 3)
    	newWind = newWind ~= 0 and newWind or 1
    	if (newWind > 0 and lgs.actWind <= 0) or (newWind < 0 and lgs.actWind >= 0) then
	    	//print(2)
    		if newWind > 0 then
    			lgs.windChanging = 1
    			lgs.windAng = -180
    		else
    			lgs.windChanging = -1
    			lgs.windAng = 0
    		end
    	end

    	if lgs.actWind == 0 then
    		lgs.actWind = 1
    	end
*/
    	//lgs.lastWindChangeTime = currentTime
    end

	if lgs.actScrrenPos then
		local x0, y0 = lgs.actScrrenPos.x + 40, ScreenHeight() - lgs.actScrrenPos.y + 50
		local x, y = x0, y0 + 120
		if lgs.windChanging then
			local speed, newAng = 18
			if lgs.windChanging < 0 then
				//print(3)
				newAng = lgs.windAng - speed
				if newAng <= -180 then
					newAng = -180
					lgs.windChanging = nil
					lgs.lastWindChangeTime = currentTime
				end
			else
				//print(4)
				newAng = lgs.windAng + speed
				if newAng >= 0 then
					newAng = 0
					lgs.windChanging = nil
					lgs.lastWindChangeTime = currentTime
				end
			end
			if newAng < -90 then
				lgs.actWind = -1
			else
				lgs.actWind = 1
			end
			lgs.windAng = newAng
			//print(newAng)
            x, y = RotatePoint2D(x, y, newAng, x0, y0)
		elseif lgs.actWind < 0 then
			y = y0 - 120
		end
        //print(x, "  ", y)
		//lgs.windPos = {x = x, y = y}
		lgs.windPos = {x = x, y = y, ang = (lgs.windAng + 45) * PI / 180}
	end

function lgs:SetWind(wind)
	lgs.wind = wind
	lgs.angWind = 90 - (wind * 90 / lgs.maxWind)
end

function lgs:SetPlayerAng(ang)
	if ang < -lgs.maxWind - 0.1 or ang > lgs.maxWind + 0.1 then
		return
	end
	lgs.playerAng = wind
	lgs.angWind = 90 - (wind * 90 / lgs.maxWind)
end

function lgs:AddPlayerAng(addAng)
	local newAng = lgs.playerAng + addAng
	//print(newAng)
	if newAng > 90 then
		lgs.playerAng = 90
	elseif newAng < -90 then
		lgs.playerAng = -90
	else
		lgs.playerAng = newAng
	end
end

function lgs:UpdatePlayerAng()
	if lgs.playerAng > (1.1 * lgs.scaleAng) then
		lgs.playerAng = lgs.playerAng - 1 * lgs.scaleAng
	elseif lgs.playerAng < (-1.1 * lgs.scaleAng) then
		lgs.playerAng = lgs.playerAng + 1 * lgs.scaleAng
	else
		lgs.playerAng = 0
	end

	if lgs.cpuControl then
		if lgs.cpuAng ~= lgs.actWind then
			if random(0, 6 * lgs.cpuControl) < 1 then
				lgs.cpuAng = lgs.actWind
			end
		end

		lgs:AddPlayerAng(lgs.cpuAng * 2 * lgs.scaleAng)

	else
		if KbdIs("down") then
			lgs:AddPlayerAng(-2 * lgs.scaleAng)
		elseif KbdIs("up") then
			lgs:AddPlayerAng(2 * lgs.scaleAng)
		end
	end
end

function SJ_OnEndThrow(obj)
	go(lgs.aktor, "angUp", 0)
	local pos = go(obj, "pos")
	go(obj, "place", pos)
	pos = go(obj, "pos")
	lgs.endSpeed = go(obj, "speed")
	go(obj, "walkSpeed", lgs.endSpeed)
	go(obj, "walk", lgs.pEnd, 1)
	go(obj, "anim", "ladowanie", 0, 1, 1.3)
