	lgs.pEndJump = pos
	lgs.endDist = Distance(lgs.pEndJump, lgs.pEnd)
	lgs.lot = nil
	if not lgs.pEndJumpMax or Distance(lgs.pEnd, lgs.pEndJumpMax) > Distance(lgs.pEnd, pos) then
		lgs.pEndJumpMax = pos
	end
	//print("*****************  "..Distance(lgs.pEndJump, lgs.pStop))
	local dist = lgs.maxDist * Distance(lgs.pProg, pos) / Distance(lgs.pProg, lgs.pEnd)
	dist = RoundTo(dist, 0.5)
	HudMsg(format("#FFFFCCFF%.1f m", dist), nil, ScreenWidth() / 2 - 60)
	scores = lgs.players[lgs.actPlayer].sources
	lgs.players[lgs.actPlayer].sum = lgs.players[lgs.actPlayer].sum + dist
	tinsert(scores, dist)

	go(obj, "evOnStopMoving", "SJ_OnStopFinishMoving", 1)
	PlaySound("ladowanie.wav")
	lgs:PlaySound("najazd.wav", 1)
end

	if mode == "WALK" then
		if lgs.zjazd then
			local ySpeed = go(obj, "speed", "y")
			if ySpeed < 0 then
				go(obj, "actMovingSpeed", go(obj, "actMovingSpeed") - ySpeed * 0.042)
			end
		else
			local d = (Distance(go(obj, "pos"), lgs.pEnd) * 2) / lgs.endDist
			go(obj, "actMovingSpeed", lgs.endSpeed * min(1, max(d, 0.5)))
		end
	end

			lgs.zjazd = nil
			lgs.lot = 1

function lgs:WindChange(num)
   	lgs.wind = lgs.wind + num
   	lgs.lastWindChange = num
   	lgs.lastWindChangeTime = gui.time
end


function lgs:WindUpdate()
	lgs.windFrameTime = lgs.windFrameTime + frameTime
	if lgs.windFrameTime > lgs.windFrameChangeTime then
		lgs.windFrameTime = 0
		lgs.windActFrame = lgs.windActFrame + lgs.windFrameChange
		if lgs.windActFrame > lgs.windFramesCount then
			lgs.windActFrame = 1
		end

/*
		if lgs.windActFrame > 0 then
			if lgs.windActFrame > lgs.windFramesCount then
				lgs.windFrameChange = -lgs.windFrameChange
				lgs.windActFrame = lgs.windFramesCount - 1
			end
		else
			if lgs.windActFrame < 1 then
				lgs.windFrameChange = -lgs.windFrameChange
				lgs.windActFrame = 2
			end
		end
*/
	end

    if not lgs.windChanging and (not lgs.lastWindChangeTime or currentTime - lgs.lastWindChangeTime > 0.6) and random(0, 20) < 1 then
    	//print(1)
    	local newWind = random(-3, 3)
    	newWind = newWind ~= 0 and newWind or 1
    	if (newWind > 0 and lgs.actWind <= 0) or (newWind < 0 and lgs.actWind >= 0) then
	    	//print(2)
    		if newWind > 0 then
    			lgs.windChanging = 1
    			lgs.windAng = -180
    		else
    			lgs.windChanging = -1
    			lgs.windAng = 0
    		end
    	end
/*
    	lgs.actWind = random(-3, 3)
    	if lgs.actWind == 0 then
    		lgs.actWind = 1
    	end
*/
    	//lgs.lastWindChangeTime = currentTime
    end

	if lgs.actScrrenPos then
		local x0, y0 = lgs.actScrrenPos.x + 40, ScreenHeight() - lgs.actScrrenPos.y + 50
		local x, y = x0, y0 + 120
		if lgs.windChanging then
			local speed, newAng = 18
			if lgs.windChanging < 0 then
				//print(3)
				newAng = lgs.windAng - speed
				if newAng <= -180 then
					newAng = -180
					lgs.windChanging = nil
					lgs.lastWindChangeTime = currentTime
				end
			else
				//print(4)
				newAng = lgs.windAng + speed
				if newAng >= 0 then
					newAng = 0
					lgs.windChanging = nil
					lgs.lastWindChangeTime = currentTime
				end
			end
			if newAng < -90 then
				lgs.actWind = -1
			else
				lgs.actWind = 1
			end
			lgs.windAng = newAng
			//print(newAng)
            x, y = RotatePoint2D(x, y, newAng, x0, y0)
		elseif lgs.actWind < 0 then
			y = y0 - 150
		end
        //print(x, "  ", y)
		//lgs.windPos = {x = x, y = y}
		lgs.windPos = {x = x, y = y, ang = (lgs.windAng + 45) * PI / 180}
	end
end

function lgs:Start(players)
	lgs.game = 1
	lgs.pEndJumpMax = nil
	lgs.pEndJump = nil
	local n = min(4, getn(players))
	lgs.players = {}
	lgs.playersCnt = 0
	for i = 1, n do
		local v = players[i]
		if v == 1 or v == 2 then
			lgs.playersCnt = lgs.playersCnt + 1
			local img = ""
			if i == 1 then
				local iName, iNum = GetIdent()
				if iName == "girl" then
					img = "girl"
				else
					img = "boy"
				end
			elseif i == 2 then
				img = "pin"
			elseif i == 3 then
				img = "nar"
			elseif i == 4 then
				img = "nie"
			end
			if v == 1 then
				img = "jumper."..img
			else
				img = "cpu."..img
			end
			local icon = CreateSprite("data\\bitmap\\faces\\"..img)
			tinsert(lgs.players, {sources = {}, sum = 0, type = v, icon = icon, nr = i, playerNr = lgs.playersCnt})
		end
	end
	ReloadAllTextures()
	lgs.actPlayer = 0
	lgs.aktor = nil

function lgs:SortPlayers(list)
	local Compare = function(a1, a2)
		if (a1.sum > a2.sum) then
			return 1
		end
		return nil
	end

    sort(list, Compare)
end


function Task_Wynik()
	BeginTask()
	local from = MapFlag("_MINI_GAME")

		local hud = AddHelp(1)
		WFHud(hud)

	Msg(lgs.miejsca.." |"..Str("msg.playOnceMore"), Str("msg.endGame"), {{caption = Str("keyCaption.yes"), key = "enter", func = lgs.Start, funcParam = lgs._players}, {caption = Str("keyCaption.no"), key = "esc", func = lgs.StopOut}})

	lgs.list = nil

function lgs:Stop()
	lgs.aktor = nil
	lgs.game = nil

	if not lgs.proba then
		local list = CloneLuaObject(lgs.players)
		lgs:SortPlayers(list)
		local miejsca = ""
		//Str("ski_jump.msg_player"..lgs.players[lgs.actPlayer].nr)
		//ski_jump.player1OnPos
		for i = 1, getn(list) do
			local str
			if list[i].nr == 1 then
				local add = GetIdent()
				if not add then
					add = ".boy"
				else
					add = ""
				end
				str = Str("ski_jump.player"..list[i].nr.."OnPos"..add)
			else
				str = Str("ski_jump.player"..list[i].nr.."OnPos")
			end
			miejsca = miejsca..format(str, i, format("%.1f",list[i].sum)).."|"
			if list[i].type < 2 then
				AddHighScoreFloat(gc_savedGamesDir.."\\game3.hs", list[i].sum)
			end
		end

		if MapFlag("_MINI_GAME") then
			lgs.miejsca = miejsca
			lgs.list = list
			CreateTask("Task_Wynik")
		else
			Msg(miejsca, Str("msg.endGame"), {{caption = Str("keyCaption.ok"), key = "enter", func = ChangeMap, funcParam = "antarctica_igloo", global = 1}})
		end

	else
		lgs.proba = nil
		lgs.maxJumps = 3
		lgs:Start({1, 2, 2, 2})
	end
end

function lgs:NextPlayer()
	lgs.autoNext = nil

	if lgs.actPlayer > 0.9 then
		go(lgs.actors[lgs.players[lgs.actPlayer].nr], "hide")
	end

	lgs.actPlayer = lgs.actPlayer + 1
	if lgs.actPlayer > lgs.playersCnt + 0.1 then
		lgs.actPlayer = 1
		if getn(lgs.players[1].sources) >= lgs.maxJumps then
			lgs:Stop()
			return
		end
	end

	lgs.prog = 1

	lgs.aktor = Reveal(lgs.actors[lgs.players[lgs.actPlayer].nr])

	go(lgs.aktor, "place", "start")
	go(lgs.aktor, "rotateToPoint", lgs.pProg, 1)

			lgs.cpuControl = 3
		else
			lgs.cpuControl = 2
		end
		lgs.cpuAng = 0
	else
		lgs.cpuControl = nil
	end

	lgs.nextPlayerTime = currentTime

	if not lgs.proba then

		if not add and lgs.players[lgs.actPlayer].nr == 1 then
			add = ".boy"
		else
			add = ""
		end

		//HudMsg(format(Str("msg.playerNo"), lgs.actPlayer), nil, nil, ScreenHeight() * 0.5)
	end
	lgs:StopSound()
end

function lgs:SetLevel(level, showInfo)
	if level < 0 then

	local _level = level - 1
	//lgs.speed = lgs.levels.normalSpeed + lgs.levels.addSpeed * _level
	lgs.speed = lgs.levels.normalSpeed + lgs.levels.normalSpeed * lgs.levels.addSpeed * (1 - Power(lgs.levels.factorSpeed, _level))
	//lgs.fireDelay = max(0.7, lgs.levels.normalDelay + lgs.levels.addDelay * _level)
	lgs.fireDelay = lgs.levels.normalDelay + lgs.levels.normalDelay * lgs.levels.addDelay * (1 - Power(lgs.levels.factorDelay, _level))
	lgs.fireDelay = max(lgs.levels.minDelay, lgs.fireDelay)
	if showInfo then

function CountPos(x, y)

function lgs:KbdUpdate()
	local change

	if KbdIs("left") and lgs.x > 0 then
		lgs.x = max(lgs.x - lgs.kbdSpeed, 0)
		change = 1
	end

	if KbdIs("right") and lgs.x < 1 then
		lgs.x = min(lgs.x + lgs.kbdSpeed, 1)
		change = 1
	end

	if KbdIs("up") and lgs.y < 1 then
		lgs.y = min(lgs.y + lgs.kbdSpeed, 1)
		change = 1
	end

	if KbdIs("down") and lgs.y > 0 then
		lgs.y = max(lgs.y - lgs.kbdSpeed, 0)
		change = 1
	end

	if change then
		lgs.pos	= CountPos(lgs.x, lgs.y)
		go(lgs.kosz, "place", lgs.pos)
	end
end


function lgs:PrzesunKosz(x, y)
	x = x * lgs.mouseSpeed
	y = y * lgs.mouseSpeed

	if abs(x) > 0.0001 then
		lgs.x = min(max(lgs.x + x, 0), 1)
		change = 1
	end

	if abs(y) > 0.0001 then
		lgs.y = min(max(lgs.y + y, 0), 1)
		change = 1
	end

	if change then
		lgs.pos	= CountPos(lgs.x, lgs.y)
		go(lgs.kosz, "place", lgs.pos)
	end
end


function Trap_OnEndThrow(obj)
	local orzech = lgs.orzechy[obj]
	if orzech and orzech.iloscOdbic > 1 then
		orzech.odbicia = orzech.odbicia + 1
		if orzech.odbicia < 1.5 then
			PlaySound("\\models\\step_drewno1.wav")
			local pos = go(obj, "pos")
			local posEnd = VectorAdd(pos, VectorScale(orzech.dir, 0.35))
			posEnd.y = pos.y
    		go(obj, "throwAngle", posEnd, random(72, 78), 3.5 * lgs.speed)
		else
			local io = orzech.iloscOdbic
			local pos = go(obj, "pos")
			local addX = (0 + io * random(25, 35) * 0.1) * (random(0, 1) < 1 and -1 or 1) * 0.25
			local addZ = (0 + io * random(25, 35) * 0.1) * (random(0, 1) < 1 and -1 or 1) * 0.25
			pos.x = pos.x + addX
			pos.z = pos.z + addZ
    		go(obj, "throwAngle", pos, random(45, 55), 5 * lgs.speed)
    		PlaySound("\\models\\step_drewno1.wav")
			orzech.iloscOdbic = io - 1

			if orzech.flight then
			    go(obj, "anim", "idle")
			    if lgs.orzechLeci then
			    	lgs.orzechLeci = lgs.orzechLeci - 1
			    	if lgs.orzechLeci < 0.5 then
						lgs.orzechLeci = nil
					end
				end
				orzech.flight = nil
				lgs:RemoveMarker(orzech.marker)
				orzech.marker = nil
			end
		end
	else
		lgs.looseCount = lgs.looseCount + 1
		if lgs.lives then
			lgs.lives = lgs.lives - 1
		end
		go(obj, "timeRemove", 1)
		//go(obj, "remove")
		RemoveRect(orzech.cien)
		PlaySound("\\models\\step_drewno1.wav")
		if orzech.marker then
			lgs:RemoveMarker(orzech.marker)
		end
		lgs.orzechy[obj] = nil
	end
end


function Trap_OnUpdateThrow(obj)
	local orzech = lgs.orzechy[obj]
	if orzech.cien or orzech.marker then
		local pos = CloneLuaObject(go(obj, "pos"))
		pos.y = lgs.p0.y
		if orzech.cien then
			SetRectPos(orzech.cien, pos)
		end
		if orzech.marker and orzech.flight then
			if lgs.game and Distance2D(pos, lgs.pos) < 5 * lgs.koszSize then
				lgs:SetMarkerPos(orzech.marker, pos)
				lgs:SetMarkerColor(orzech.marker, RGBA(1, 0, 0, 0.9))
			else
				lgs:SetMarkerColor(orzech.marker, RGBA(1, 0, 0, 0))
			end
		end
	end
end

function lgs:SetMarkerPos(marker, pos)
	if marker.addY then
		pos.y = pos.y + marker.addY
	end
	marker.pos = pos
	SetRectPos(marker.sLeft, VectorSub(pos, marker.vX))
	SetRectPos(marker.sRight, VectorAdd(pos, marker.vX))
	SetRectPos(marker.sUp, VectorSub(pos, marker.vY))
	SetRectPos(marker.sDown, VectorAdd(pos, marker.vY))
end


function lgs:SetMarkerColor(marker, color)
	SetRectColor(marker.sLeft, color)
	SetRectColor(marker.sRight, color)
	SetRectColor(marker.sUp, color)
	SetRectColor(marker.sDown, color)
end


function lgs:CreateMarker(pos)
	if addY then
		pos.y = pos.y + addY
	end
	local marker = {pos = pos, szer = 4, dl = 10, addY = addY}

	local vX = VectorScale(VectorNormalize(VectorSub(lgs.px, lgs.p0)), marker.dl * 0.5 + 4)
	marker.vX = vX
	local vY = VectorScale(VectorNormalize(VectorSub(lgs.py, lgs.p0)), marker.dl * 0.5 + 7)
	marker.vY = vY

	local s = CreatePlaneRect(VectorSub(pos, vX), 0, marker.szer, marker.dl, 0, RGBA(1, 0, 0, 0), "data\\bitmap\\arrow", 1)
	SetRectAngle(s, DirToAngle(lgs.p0, lgs.px))
	marker.sLeft = s

	local s = CreatePlaneRect(VectorAdd(pos, vX), 0, marker.szer, marker.dl, 0, RGBA(1, 0, 0, 0), "data\\bitmap\\arrow", 1)
	SetRectAngle(s, DirToAngle(lgs.px, lgs.p0))
	marker.sRight = s

	local s = CreatePlaneRect(VectorSub(pos, vY), 0, marker.szer, marker.dl, 0, RGBA(1, 0, 0, 0), "data\\bitmap\\arrow", 1)
	SetRectAngle(s, DirToAngle(lgs.p0, lgs.py))
	marker.sUp = s

	local s = CreatePlaneRect(VectorAdd(pos, vY), 0, marker.szer, marker.dl, 0, RGBA(1, 0, 0, 0), "data\\bitmap\\arrow", 1)
	SetRectAngle(s, DirToAngle(lgs.py, lgs.p0))
	marker.sDown = s

	return marker
end


function lgs:RemoveMarker(marker)
	RemoveRect(marker.sLeft)
	RemoveRect(marker.sRight)
	RemoveRect(marker.sUp)
	RemoveRect(marker.sDown)
end


function lgs:StartLevel(nr)
	lgs.actLevel = nr
	lgs:SetLevel(nr, 1)
	lgs.lastFireTime = lgs.fireDelay - 2
	lgs.orzechyDoWystrzalu = lgs.maxLevelPoints
	lgs.lives = lgs.maxLives
end


function lgs:StartGame(maxLevelPoints, maxLoose)
PlayMusic("data\\music\\orzeszki.ogg")
	if lgs.game then
		return
	end

	lgs.maxLoose = maxLoose
	lgs.looseCount = 0

	if type(maxLevelPoints) == "table" then
		maxLevelPoints = maxLevelPoints.maxLevelPoints
	end
	lgs.maxLevelPoints = maxLevelPoints

	lgs.game = 1
	if maxLevelPoints then
		lgs:StartLevel(1)
	else
		lgs:SetLevel(1)
		lgs.orzechyDoWystrzalu = lgs.maxPoints
		lgs.lastFireTime = lgs.fireDelay
		lgs.actLevel = nil
	end
	lgs.strzelajaceTuby = {}

	DesktopOff()
	local obj = lgs.aktor
	if obj then
		go(obj, "hide")
	end
	Reveal(lgs.kosz)

	lgs.x = 0.5
	lgs.y = 0.5
	lgs.pos	= CountPos(lgs.x, lgs.y)
	go(lgs.kosz, "place", lgs.pos)

	lgs.orzechyNaLokacji = 0

	if not maxLevelPoints then
		lgs.orzechyZlapane = Object("orzeszki")
		if lgs.orzechyZlapane then
			lgs.points = go(lgs.orzechyZlapane, "capacity")
		else
			lgs.points = 0
		end
	else
		lgs.points = 0
	end
end


function lgs:StopGame()
	SaveGame()
	StopMusic("data\\music\\orzeszki.ogg")
	PlayMusic("data\\music\\birds.ogg")
	if not lgs.game then
		return
	end
	while FindTask("Task_wystrzal") do
		RemoveTask("Task_wystrzal")
	end
	lgs.game = nil
	lgs.orzechyDoWystrzalu = nil
	DesktopOn()
	local obj = lgs.kosz
	if obj then
		go(obj, "hide")
	end
	Reveal(lgs.aktor)
	AnimBkg("wajcha", "ready")

end

		promien =  promien - 0.1
		v.x = a.x + sin( kat) *  promien
		v.z = a.z + cos( kat) *  promien
		kat =  kat + 20

		SetPartPos(lgs.efekt,v)
		v.y = 0
	until  promien <0
		StopParticle(lgs.efekt)

	RemoveTask()
end

function FireRing_extendet2( )
 	BeginTask()
	local promien = 10
	local kat = 0
	local a = go(lgs.kufer,"pos" )
	local v = {}
	v.x = a.x
	v.y = a.y
	v.z = a.z
	StartParticle(lgs.efekt)
	repeat
		promien =  promien - 0.1
		v.x = a.x + sin(kat) *  promien
		v.z = a.z + cos(kat) *  promien
		kat =  kat + 20
		Wait(0.01)
		SetPartPos(lgs.efekt,v)
		v.y = v.y+ 0.2
	until promien <0
		StopParticle(lgs.efekt)
	RemoveTask()
end

   	gui:MouseCursor("select")

end

function Task_HelpEfekt( )
	BeginTask()
 	lgs.promien = 10
	lgs.kat = 0
	lgs.partlicznik = 0
	local a =   go(lgs.help,"pos" )
	a.y = a.y+1
	local v = {}
	v.x = a.x
	v.y = a.y
	v.z = a.z
    StartParticle(lgs.helpefekt)
    CreatePartEffect("data\\fx\\energy1.apd", go(lgs.help,"pos"), 2 , "data\\bitmap\\fx\\shine_twirl_purple", 2)
	repeat
		if lgs.promien >2 then
	    	lgs.promien = lgs.promien -1
	    end
        lgs.partlicznik = lgs.partlicznik+1
		v.x = a.x + sin(lgs.kat) * lgs.promien
		v.z = a.z + cos(lgs.kat) * lgs.promien
		lgs.kat = lgs.kat + 20
		Wait(0.01)
		if random(1,2) >1.5 then
			v.y = 5
		else
			v.y = 1
		end
		SetPartPos(lgs.helpefekt,v)
	until lgs.partlicznik >60
	StopParticle(lgs.helpefekt)
    lgs.partlicznik = 0
    RemoveTask()

end


function Task_Help()
	BeginTask()

	go(lgs.help, "scale",1)
	go(lgs.help, "throwAngle", "help_stop", 40  , 5)

	RemoveTask()
end

	FireRing_extendet2 = nil

    Task_Help = nil
    HelpLeci = nil
    HelpWyladowal = nil
    OnHelpTake = nil
    OnHelpOver = nil

    Task_Mapa = nil
end
